```tsx
'use client'

import { useState } from 'react'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'
import { toast } from 'sonner'
import { Loader2, Zap } from 'lucide-react'

export default function LoginPage() {
  const router   = useRouter()
  const supabase = createClient()

  const [email,    setEmail]    = useState('')
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('')
  const [loading,  setLoading]  = useState(false)

  async function handleLogin(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault()
    setLoading(true)
    const { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({ email, password })
    if (error) {
      toast.error(error.message)
      setLoading(false)
      return
    }
    toast.success('Welcome back!')
    router.refresh()
  }

  return (
    <>
      <style>{`
        @keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }

        .login-root {
          min-height: 100vh;
          display: flex;
          background: #07111f;
        }

        /* ── Left panel ── */
        .login-left {
          width: 45%;
          flex-shrink: 0;
          background: linear-gradient(160deg, #0c1f3f 0%, #0a1628 40%, #07111f 100%);
          display: flex;
          flex-direction: column;
          justify-content: space-between;
          padding: 36px 40px;
          position: relative;
          overflow: hidden;
          border-right: 0.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
        }

        /* subtle grid texture on left */
        .login-left::before {
          content: '';
          position: absolute;
          inset: 0;
          background-image:
            linear-gradient(rgba(37,99,235,0.04) 1px, transparent 1px),
            linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(37,99,235,0.04) 1px, transparent 1px);
          background-size: 40px 40px;
          pointer-events: none;
        }

        /* blue glow orb */
        .login-left::after {
          content: '';
          position: absolute;
          width: 400px;
          height: 400px;
          border-radius: 50%;
          background: rgba(37,99,235,0.12);
          top: 50%;
          left: 50%;
          transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
          filter: blur(80px);
          pointer-events: none;
        }

        .left-brand {
          display: flex;
          align-items: center;
          gap: 10px;
          position: relative;
          z-index: 1;
        }

        .left-icon {
          width: 36px;
          height: 36px;
          background: #2563eb;
          border-radius: 9px;
          display: flex;
          align-items: center;
          justify-content: center;
          flex-shrink: 0;
          box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(37,99,235,0.4);
        }

        .left-copy {
          position: relative;
          z-index: 1;
          padding-bottom: 8px;
        }

        .left-tagline {
          font-size: 26px;
          font-weight: 600;
          color: #f1f5f9;
          line-height: 1.3;
          letter-spacing: -0.02em;
          margin: 0 0 12px;
          margin-top: 10px;
        
        }

        .left-sub {
          font-size: 13px;
          color: #334155;
          line-height: 1.6;
          margin: 0;
          max-width: 280px;
        }

        .left-pills {
          display: flex;
          flex-wrap: wrap;
          gap: 8px;
          margin-top: 20px;
        }

        .left-pill {
          font-size: 11px;
          color: #1e40af;
          background: rgba(37,99,235,0.12);
          border: 0.5px solid rgba(37,99,235,0.2);
          padding: 4px 10px;
          border-radius: 20px;
        }

        /* ── Right panel ── */
        .login-right {
          flex: 1;
          display: flex;
          align-items: center;
          justify-content: center;
          padding: 40px 32px;
        }

        .login-form-wrap {
          width: 100%;
          max-width: 360px;
        }

        .form-title {
          font-size: 22px;
          font-weight: 500;
          color: #f1f5f9;
          margin: 0 0 6px;
          letter-spacing: -0.01em;
        }

        .form-subtitle {
          font-size: 13px;
          color: #334155;
          margin: 0 0 32px;
        }

        .field-label {
          display: block;
          font-size: 11px;
          font-weight: 600;
          color: #334155;
          letter-spacing: 0.07em;
          text-transform: uppercase;
          margin-bottom: 7px;
        }

        .field-input {
          width: 100%;
          box-sizing: border-box;
          padding: 10px 14px;
          background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
          border: 0.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.09);
          border-radius: 8px;
          color: #e2e8f0;
          font-size: 13.5px;
          outline: none;
          transition: border-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease;
        }

        .field-input::placeholder { color: #1e3a5f; }

        .field-input:focus {
          border-color: rgba(37,99,235,0.6);
          box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(37,99,235,0.1);
        }

        .submit-btn {
          width: 100%;
          padding: 11px;
          background: #2563eb;
          border: none;
          border-radius: 8px;
          color: #fff;
          font-size: 13.5px;
          font-weight: 500;
          cursor: pointer;
          display: flex;
          align-items: center;
          justify-content: center;
          gap: 8px;
          transition: background 150ms ease;
          letter-spacing: 0.01em;
          margin-top: 24px;
        }

        .submit-btn:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #1d4ed8; }
        .submit-btn:disabled { opacity: 0.6; cursor: not-allowed; }

        .form-footer {
          margin-top: 28px;
          padding-top: 20px;
          border-top: 0.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
          display: flex;
          align-items: center;
          justify-content: space-between;
        }

        .footer-note { font-size: 11px; color: #1e3a5f; }

        .env-badge {
          font-size: 10px;
          font-family: monospace;
          color: #1e293b;
          background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03);
          border: 0.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
          padding: 3px 7px;
          border-radius: 4px;
        }

        /* ── Mobile: stack vertically ── */
        @media (max-width: 640px) {
          .login-root { flex-direction: column; }
          .login-left {
            width: 100%;
            padding: 28px 24px 32px;
            border-right: none;
            border-bottom: 0.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
          }
          .left-tagline { font-size: 20px; }
          .left-sub { display: none; }
          .left-copy { padding-bottom: 0; }
          .login-right { padding: 32px 24px; }
        }
      `}</style>

      <div className="login-root">

        {/* ── Left panel ── */}
        <div className="login-left">

          {/* Brand */}
          <div className="left-brand">
            <div className="left-icon">
              <Zap style={{ width: 16, height: 16, color: '#fff' }} />
            </div>
            <div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 600, color: '#f1f5f9', letterSpacing: '0.01em', lineHeight: 1.2 }}>
                Blue Box
              </div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 10, color: '#1e3a5f', marginTop: 1 }}>
                ERP System
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Copy */}
          <div className="left-copy">
            <h2 className="left-tagline">
              Blue Box ERP
            </h2>
            <p className="left-sub">
              Get your personal, ERP system, which is not clumsy like SAP
            </p>
            <div className="left-pills">
              <span className="left-pill">Fast</span>
              <span className="left-pill">Reliable</span>
              <span className="left-pill">NOT Clumsy</span>
              <span className="left-pill">Easy to learn</span>
            </div>
          </div>

        </div>

        {/* ── Right panel ── */}
        <div className="login-right">
          <div className="login-form-wrap">

            <h1 className="form-title">Sign in</h1>
            <p className="form-subtitle">Internal access only</p>

            <form onSubmit={handleLogin}>

              <div style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
                <label className="field-label">Email address</label>
                <input
                  className="field-input"
                  type="email"
                  value={email}
                  onChange={e => setEmail(e.target.value)}
                  required
                  autoComplete="email"
                  placeholder="you@company.com"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="field-label">Password</label>
                <input
                  className="field-input"
                  type="password"
                  value={password}
                  onChange={e => setPassword(e.target.value)}
                  required
                  autoComplete="current-password"
                  placeholder="••••••••"
                />
              </div>

              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={loading}
                className="submit-btn"
              >
                {loading ? (
                  <>
                    <Loader2 style={{ width: 15, height: 15, animation: 'spin 1s linear infinite' }} />
                    Signing in…
                  </>
                ) : (
                  'Sign in'
                )}
              </button>

            </form>

            <div className="form-footer">
              <span className="footer-note">Contact your administrator for access</span>
              <span className="env-badge">LIVE</span>
            </div>

          </div>
        </div>

      </div>
    </>
  )
}
```

```tsx
'use client'

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'
import { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { toast } from 'sonner'
import { Loader2, Zap, Building2, LogOut } from 'lucide-react'


type OrganizationTemplate = {
  id: string;
  name: string;
};

export default function OnboardingPage() {
  const router = useRouter()
  const supabase = createClient()
  const queryClient = useQueryClient()

  const [orgName, setOrgName] = useState('')

  const [template, setTemplate] = useState("");
  const [templates, setTemplates] = useState<OrganizationTemplate[]>([]);

  const [fullName, setFullName] = useState('')
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)
  const [checking, setChecking] = useState(true)

  

  // Verify auth state on mount
  useEffect(() => {
    async function checkAuth() {
      const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser()
      if (!user) {
        router.push('/login')
        return
      }

      if (user.user_metadata?.full_name) {
        setFullName(user.user_metadata.full_name)
      }

      // Check if user already has an org_id
      const { data: profile, error: profileError } = await supabase
        .from("profiles")
        .select("org_id, full_name")
        .eq("id", user.id)
        .maybeSingle();

      if (profileError) {
        toast.error("Unable to load your account");
        setChecking(false);
        return;
      }

      if (profile?.full_name && !user.user_metadata?.full_name) {
        setFullName(profile.full_name);
      }

      if (profile?.org_id) {
        router.push("/");
        return;
      }

      setChecking(false)
    }

    checkAuth()
  }, [router, supabase])



  useEffect(() => {
    async function loadTemplates() {
      try {
        const response = await fetch("/api/organizations/create");

        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error("Failed to load organization templates");
        }

        const data = await response.json();
        setTemplates(data.templates ?? []);
      } catch (error) {
        console.error("Could not load organization templates:", error);
      }
    }

    loadTemplates();
  }, []);

  async function handleCreateOrg(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault()
    if (!orgName.trim()) {
      toast.error('Organization name is required')
      return
    }

    setLoading(true)
    try {
      const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser()

      const response = await fetch("/api/organizations/create", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          orgName: orgName.trim(),
          template: template || null,
        }),
      });

      const result = await response.json();

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(result.error || "Failed to create organization");
      }

      const orgId = result.orgId;

      if (user && fullName.trim()) {
        try {
          await supabase.auth.updateUser({
            data: { full_name: fullName.trim() },
          });
          await supabase
            .from("profiles")
            .update({ full_name: fullName.trim() })
            .eq("id", user.id);
        } catch (nameErr) {
          console.error("Could not update display name:", nameErr);
        }
      }

      toast.success("Organization created successfully!");
      
      // Await refetch before navigating so the fresh organization is ready in cache
      await Promise.all([
        queryClient.refetchQueries({ queryKey: ["tenant-context"] }),
        queryClient.refetchQueries({ queryKey: ["profile"] }),
      ]);

      router.push("/");
      router.refresh();
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const message =
        err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Failed to create organization";

      toast.error(message);
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  async function handleSignOut() {
    try {
      queryClient.setQueryData(["tenant-context"], {
        user: null,
        profile: null,
        organization: null,
        orgId: null,
      })
      await supabase.auth.signOut()
      queryClient.clear()
      router.push('/login')
    } catch {
      router.push('/login')
    }
  }

  if (checking) {
    return (
      <div style={{ minHeight: '100vh', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', background: '#07111f' }}>
        <Loader2 style={{ width: 24, height: 24, color: '#2563eb', animation: 'spin 1s linear infinite' }} />
      </div>
    )
  }

  return (
    <>
      <style>{`
        @keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }

        .onboarding-root {
          min-height: 100vh;
          display: flex;
          background: #07111f;
        }

        .onboarding-left {
          width: 45%;
          flex-shrink: 0;
          background: linear-gradient(160deg, #0c1f3f 0%, #0a1628 40%, #07111f 100%);
          display: flex;
          flex-direction: column;
          justify-content: space-between;
          padding: 36px 40px;
          position: relative;
          overflow: hidden;
          border-right: 0.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
        }

        .onboarding-left::before {
          content: '';
          position: absolute;
          inset: 0;
          background-image:
            linear-gradient(rgba(37,99,235,0.04) 1px, transparent 1px),
            linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(37,99,235,0.04) 1px, transparent 1px);
          background-size: 40px 40px;
          pointer-events: none;
        }

        .onboarding-left::after {
          content: '';
          position: absolute;
          width: 400px;
          height: 400px;
          border-radius: 50%;
          background: rgba(37,99,235,0.12);
          top: 50%;
          left: 50%;
          transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
          filter: blur(80px);
          pointer-events: none;

          justify-content: center;
          flex-shrink: 0;
          box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(37,99,235,0.4);
        }

        .left-copy {
          position: relative;
          z-index: 1;
          padding-bottom: 8px;
        }

        .left-tagline {
          font-size: 26px;

          color: #f1f5f9;
          line-height: 1.3;
          letter-spacing: -0.02em;
          margin: 0 0 12px;
          margin-top: 10px;
        }

        .left-sub {
          font-size: 13px;
          color: #94a3b8;
          line-height: 1.6;
          margin: 0;
          max-width: 320px;
        }

        .onboarding-right {
          flex: 1;
          display: flex;
          align-items: center;

        }

                  }}
                >
                  Template <span style={{ color: "#64748b" }}>(optional)</span>
                </label>

                <select
                  id="template"
                  value={template}
                  onChange={(e) => setTemplate(e.target.value)}
                  style={{
                    width: "100%",
                    padding: "12px 14px",
                    borderRadius: 8,
                    border: "1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1)",
                    background: "#0f1b2d",
                    color: "#e2e8f0",
                    outline: "none",
                  }}
                >
                  <option value="">No template</option>

                  {templates.map((item) => (
                    <option key={item.id} value={item.id}>
                      {item.name}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>

              <button type="submit" disabled={loading} className="submit-btn">
                {loading ? (
                  <>
                    <Loader2
                      style={{
                        width: 15,
                        height: 15,
                        animation: "spin 1s linear infinite",
                      }}
                    />
                    Creating workspace…
                  </>
                ) : (
                  "Create Organization"
                )}
              </button>
            </form>

            <div>
              <button onClick={handleSignOut} className="signout-link">
                <LogOut style={{ width: 13, height: 13 }} />
                Sign in with another account
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client'

import { useState } from 'react'
import { useQuery, useMutation, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'
import { PageHeader } from '@/components/layout/page-header'
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge'
import { Card, CardBody } from '@/components/ui/card'
import { Input, Textarea } from '@/components/ui/input'
import { TableLoader } from '@/components/ui/spinner'
import { formatCurrency } from '@/lib/utils/format'
import { toast } from 'sonner'
import { Plus, Search, X, Users } from 'lucide-react'
import { useOrgId } from '@/lib/hooks/use-tenant'

function useClients(search: string, orgId: string | null) {
  const supabase = createClient();

  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ["clients", orgId, search],

    queryFn: async () => {
      if (!orgId) {
        throw new Error("Organization context is not available");
      }

      let query = supabase
        .from("clients")
        .select(
          `
          id,
          name,
          contact_person,
          phone,
          email,
          address,
          city,
          state,
          gst_number,
          credit_limit,
          credit_days,
          notes,
          is_active
          `
        )
        .order("name");

      if (search) {
        query = query.or(
          `name.ilike.%${search}%,email.ilike.%${search}%,phone.ilike.%${search}%`
        );
      }

      const { data, error } = await query;

      if (error) {
        throw error;
      }

      return data;
    },

    enabled: !!orgId,
    staleTime: 2 * 60 * 1000,
  });
}

interface ClientForm {
  name:           string
  contact_person: string
  phone:          string
  email:          string
  address:        string
  city:           string
  state:          string
  gst_number:     string
  credit_limit:   string
  credit_days:    string
  notes:          string
}

const EMPTY_FORM: ClientForm = {
  name: '', contact_person: '', phone: '', email: '',
  address: '', city: '', state: 'Gujarat',
  gst_number: '', credit_limit: '0', credit_days: '0', notes: '',
}

export default function ClientsPage() {
  const supabase = createClient()
  const qc       = useQueryClient()
  const orgId    = useOrgId()

  const [search,     setSearch]     = useState('')
  const [showForm,   setShowForm]   = useState(false)
  const [editId,     setEditId]     = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [form,       setForm]       = useState<ClientForm>(EMPTY_FORM)
  const [saving,     setSaving]     = useState(false)

  const { data: clients, isLoading } = useClients(search, orgId)

  function setField(field: keyof ClientForm, value: string) {
    setForm(prev => ({ ...prev, [field]: value }))
  }

  function openNew() {
    setForm(EMPTY_FORM)
    setEditId(null)
    setShowForm(true)
  }

  function openEdit(client: any) {
    setForm({
      name:           client.name           ?? '',
      contact_person: client.contact_person ?? '',
      phone:          client.phone          ?? '',
      email:          client.email          ?? '',
      address:        client.address        ?? '',
      city:           client.city           ?? '',
      state:          client.state          ?? 'Gujarat',
      gst_number:     client.gst_number     ?? '',
      credit_limit:   String(client.credit_limit ?? 0),
      credit_days:    String(client.credit_days  ?? 0),
      notes:          client.notes          ?? '',
    })
    setEditId(client.id)
    setShowForm(true)
  }

async function handleSave() {
  if (!form.name.trim()) {
    toast.error("Client name is required");
    return;
  }

  if (!orgId) {
    toast.error("Organization context is not available");
    return;
  }

  setSaving(true);

  try {
    const payload = {
      name: form.name.trim(),
      contact_person: form.contact_person || null,
      phone: form.phone || null,
      email: form.email || null,
      address: form.address || null,
      city: form.city || null,
      state: form.state || null,
      gst_number: form.gst_number || null,
      credit_limit: Number(form.credit_limit) || 0,
      credit_days: Number(form.credit_days) || 0,
      notes: form.notes || null,
    };

    if (editId) {
      const { error } = await supabase
        .from("clients")
        .update(payload)
        .eq("id", editId);

      if (error) throw error;

      toast.success("Client updated");
    } else {
      const { error } = await supabase.from("clients").insert({
        ...payload,
        org_id: orgId,
      });

      if (error) throw error;

      toast.success("Client added");
    }

    await qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["clients"] });
    setShowForm(false);
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    const message =
      err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Failed to save client";

    toast.error(message);
  } finally {
    setSaving(false);
  }
}

  async function handleToggleActive(id: string, current: boolean) {
    const { error } = await supabase
      .from('clients')
      .update({ is_active: !current })
      .eq('id', id)
    if (error) { toast.error(error.message); return }
    qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['clients'] })
    toast.success(current ? 'Client deactivated' : 'Client activated')
  }

  return (
    <div>

      </PageHeader>

      {/* Slide-in form */}
      {showForm && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex justify-end">

          <div className="relative w-full max-w-md bg-white shadow-2xl overflow-y-auto">
            <div className="sticky top-0 bg-white border-b border-slate-200 px-6 py-4 flex items-center justify-between">
              <h2 className="font-semibold text-slate-900">
                {editId ? 'Edit Client' : 'New Client'}
              </h2>
              <button onClick={() => setShowForm(false)} className="text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600">
                <X className="w-5 h-5" />
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="px-6 py-5 space-y-4">
              <Input
                label="Company / Client Name"
                required
                value={form.name}
                onChange={e => setField('name', e.target.value)}
                placeholder="e.g. Gujarat State Electricity Corp."
              />
              <Input
                label="Contact Person"
                value={form.contact_person}
                onChange={e => setField('contact_person', e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Primary contact name"
              />
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <Input
                  label="Phone"
                  value={form.phone}
                  onChange={e => setField('phone', e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Mobile number"
                />
                <Input
                  label="Email"
                  type="email"
                  value={form.email}
                  onChange={e => setField('email', e.target.value)}
                />
              </div>
              <Input
                label="GST Number"
                value={form.gst_number}
                onChange={e => setField('gst_number', e.target.value)}
                placeholder="22XXXXX1234X1ZX"
              />
              <Textarea
                label="Address"
                value={form.address}
                onChange={e => setField('address', e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Street address"
              />
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <Input
                  label="City"
                  value={form.city}
                  onChange={e => setField('city', e.target.value)}
                />
                <Input
                  label="State"
                  value={form.state}
                  onChange={e => setField('state', e.target.value)}
                />
              </div>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <Input
                  label="Credit Limit (₹)"
                  type="number"
                  min="0"
                  value={form.credit_limit}
                  onChange={e => setField('credit_limit', e.target.value)}
                  hint="0 = no credit"
                />
                <Input
                  label="Credit Days"
                  type="number"
                  min="0"
                  value={form.credit_days}
                  onChange={e => setField('credit_days', e.target.value)}
                  hint="Days to pay invoice"
                />
              </div>
              <Textarea
                label="Notes"
                value={form.notes}
                onChange={e => setField('notes', e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Internal notes about this client…"
              />
            </div>

            <div className="sticky bottom-0 bg-white border-t border-slate-200 px-6 py-4 flex gap-3">
              <Button variant="outline" className="flex-1" onClick={() => setShowForm(false)}>
                Cancel
              </Button>
              <Button className="flex-1" loading={saving} onClick={handleSave}>
                {editId ? 'Save Changes' : 'Add Client'}
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Search */}
      <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm mb-6">
        <div className="px-5 py-4 flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="relative flex-1 max-w-sm">

            <input
              type="text"

            />

      {/* Table */}
      <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm overflow-hidden">
        {isLoading ? <TableLoader /> : (
```

# src/app/(dashboard)/dispatch/[id]/page.tsx

```tsx
'use client'
import { useOrgId } from "@/lib/hooks/use-tenant";
import { useState } from 'react'
import { useParams, useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'
import { PageHeader } from '@/components/layout/page-header'
import { Card, CardBody, CardHeader } from '@/components/ui/card'
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge'
import { PageLoader } from '@/components/ui/spinner'
import { formatCurrency, formatDate, formatQty } from '@/lib/utils/format'
import { toast } from 'sonner'
import {
  Truck, FileText, User, ShoppingCart,
  CheckCircle, ArrowLeft
} from 'lucide-react'
import Link from 'next/link'

const STATUS_COLORS: Record<string, 'warning' | 'success' | 'danger' | 'default'> = {
  dispatched: 'warning',
  delivered:  'success',
  returned:   'danger',
}

const TRANSPORT_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  own_truck:      '🚛 Own Truck',
  supplier_truck: '🚚 Supplier Truck',
  client_truck:   '🚐 Client Truck',
  courier:        '📦 Courier',
  hand_delivery:  '🤝 Hand Delivery',
}

function useChallan(id: string, orgId: string | null) {
  const supabase = createClient();

  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ["delivery-challans", orgId, id],

    queryFn: async () => {
      if (!orgId) {
        throw new Error("Organization context is not available");
      }

      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from("delivery_challans")
        .select(
          `
          *,
          client:clients ( id, name, phone, gst_number, address, city ),
          sales_order:sales_orders ( id, so_number, total_amount, balance_due ),
          creator:profiles!delivery_challans_created_by_fkey ( full_name ),
          delivery_challan_lines (
            id, qty, unit, rate, line_total,
            item:items (
                        id,
                        item_code,
                        name,
                        unit,
                        category_id,
                        item_category:item_categories (
                          id,
                          name
                        )
                      ),
            so_line:sales_order_lines ( id, qty, qty_dispatched )
          )
        `
        )
        .eq("id", id)
        .single();

      if (error) throw error;

      return data;
    },

    enabled: !!orgId && !!id,
    staleTime: 30 * 1000,
  });
}

function useMovements(challanId: string, orgId: string | null) {
  const supabase = createClient();

  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ["challan-movements", orgId, challanId],

    queryFn: async () => {
      if (!orgId) {
        throw new Error("Organization context is not available");
      }

      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from("stock_movements")
        .select("id, qty, movement_type, movement_date, rate_at_time, item_id")
        .eq("ref_type", "delivery_challan")
        .eq("ref_id", challanId);

      if (error) throw error;

      return data;
    },

    enabled: !!orgId && !!challanId,
    staleTime: 60 * 1000,
  });
}

export default function ChallanDetailPage() {
  const { id } = useParams<{ id: string }>();
  const router = useRouter();
  const supabase = createClient();
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const orgId = useOrgId();

  const { data: dc, isLoading } = useChallan(id, orgId);
  const { data: movements } = useMovements(id, orgId);

  const [marking, setMarking] = useState(false);

  if (isLoading) return <PageLoader />;
  if (!dc)
    return <div className="text-slate-500 text-sm p-6">Challan not found</div>;

  const client = dc.client as any;
  const so = dc.sales_order as any;
  const creator = dc.creator as any;
  const lines = (dc.delivery_challan_lines as any[]) ?? [];

  const totalQty = lines.reduce((s: number, l: any) => s + l.qty, 0);
  const totalValue = dc.total_amount ?? 0;

  // ── Mark as delivered ─────────────────────────────────────
async function handleMarkDelivered() {
  if (!orgId) {
    toast.error("Organization context is not available");
    return;
  }

  setMarking(true);

  try {
    const { error } = await supabase
      .from("delivery_challans")
      .update({ status: "delivered" })
      .eq("id", id);

    if (error) throw error;

    // Also update the linked SO status to delivered
    // if all challans for this SO are now delivered
    if (so?.id) {
      const { data: allChallans, error: challansError } = await supabase
        .from("delivery_challans")
        .select("id, status")
        .eq("so_id", so.id);

      if (challansError) throw challansError;

      const allDelivered = allChallans?.every(
        (c) => c.status === "delivered" || c.id === id
      );

      if (allDelivered) {
        const { error: soError } = await supabase
          .from("sales_orders")
          .update({ status: "delivered" })
          .eq("id", so.id);

        if (soError) throw soError;
      }
    }

    await qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["delivery-challans"] });
    await qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["sales-orders"] });

    toast.success("Challan marked as delivered");
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    const message =
      err instanceof Error
        ? err.message
        : "Failed to mark challan as delivered";

    toast.error(message);
  } finally {
    setMarking(false);
  }
}

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title={dc.challan_no}
        description={`Delivery Challan · ${client?.name} · ${formatDate(
          dc.challan_date
        )}`}
      >
        <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => router.back()}>
          <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
          Back
        </Button>

        {/* Print */}
        <a
          href={`/api/pdf?type=challan&id=${dc.id}`}
          target="_blank"
          rel="noopener noreferrer"
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium rounded-lg border border-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 transition-colors"
        >
          <FileText className="w-4 h-4" />
          Print Challan
        </a>

        {/* Mark as delivered */}
        {dc.status === "dispatched" && (
          <Button
            size="sm"
            loading={marking}
            onClick={handleMarkDelivered}
            className="bg-green-600 hover:bg-green-700"
          >
            <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4" />
            Mark Delivered
          </Button>
        )}
      </PageHeader>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
        {/* ── Left ── */}
        <div className="space-y-4">
          {/* Challan details */}
          <Card>
            <CardHeader>
              <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-2">
                <Truck className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600" />
                Challan Details
              </h3>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardBody className="space-y-3 text-sm">
              <Row
                label="Challan No."
                value={
                  <span className="font-mono font-bold">{dc.challan_no}</span>
                }
              />
              <Row
                label="Status"
                value={
                  <Badge variant={STATUS_COLORS[dc.status] ?? "default"}>
                    {dc.status}
                  </Badge>
                }
              />
              <Row label="Date" value={formatDate(dc.challan_date)} />
              <Row
                label="Transport"
                value={TRANSPORT_LABELS[dc.transport_mode] ?? dc.transport_mode}
              />
              {dc.vehicle_no && (
                <Row label="Vehicle No." value={dc.vehicle_no} />
              )}
              {dc.driver_name && <Row label="Driver" value={dc.driver_name} />}
            </CardBody>
          </Card>

          {/* Client */}
          <Card>
            <CardHeader>
              <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-2">
                <User className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600" />
                Deliver To
              </h3>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardBody className="space-y-1.5 text-sm">
              <div className="font-semibold text-slate-900">{client?.name}</div>
              {client?.phone && (
                <div className="text-slate-500">{client.phone}</div>
              )}
              {client?.gst_number && (
                <div className="font-mono text-xs text-slate-400">
                  GST: {client.gst_number}
                </div>
              )}
              {client?.address && (
                <div className="text-slate-500 text-xs">
                  {client.address}, {client.city}
                </div>
              )}
            </CardBody>
          </Card>

          {/* Linked SO */}
          {so && (
            <Card>
              <CardHeader>
                <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-2">
                  <ShoppingCart className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-600" />
                  Sales Order
                </h3>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardBody className="space-y-2 text-sm">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span className="text-slate-500">SO Number</span>
                  <Link
                    href={`/sales-orders/${so.id}`}
                    className="font-mono text-blue-600 hover:underline text-xs"
                  >
                    {so.so_number}
                  </Link>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span className="text-slate-500">SO Value</span>
                  <span className="font-medium">
                    {formatCurrency(so.total_amount)}
                  </span>
                </div>
                {so.balance_due > 0 && (
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <span className="text-slate-500">Balance Due</span>
                    <span className="text-amber-600 font-medium">
                      {formatCurrency(so.balance_due)}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                )}
              </CardBody>
            </Card>
          )}

          {/* Summary */}
          <Card>
            <CardBody className="space-y-2 text-sm">
              <Row label="Total Lines" value={`${lines.length} items`} />
              <Row label="Total Qty" value={`${totalQty} units`} />
              <div className="flex justify-between font-bold text-base border-t border-slate-100 pt-2">
                <span>Challan Value</span>
                <span className="text-blue-600">
                  {formatCurrency(totalValue)}
                </span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 pt-1">
                GST invoice raised separately.
              </p>
            </CardBody>
          </Card>

          {/* Creator */}
          {creator && (
            <Card>
              <CardBody className="text-sm space-y-2">
                <Row label="Created By" value={creator.full_name} />
                <Row label="Created At" value={formatDate(dc.created_at)} />
              </CardBody>
            </Card>
          )}

          {dc.notes && (
            <Card>
              <CardBody>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wide mb-1">
                  Notes
                </p>
                <p className="text-sm text-slate-700">{dc.notes}</p>
              </CardBody>
            </Card>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* ── Right ── */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-2 space-y-6">
          {/* Line items */}
          <Card>
            <CardHeader>
              <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900">
                Items Dispatched
                <span className="ml-2 text-xs font-normal text-slate-400">
                  {lines.length} line{lines.length !== 1 ? "s" : ""}
                </span>
              </h3>
            </CardHeader>
            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
              <table className="w-full text-sm">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="bg-slate-50 border-b border-slate-100">
                    <th className="text-left px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                      #
                    </th>
                    <th className="text-left px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                      Item
                    </th>
                    <th className="text-center px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                      Category
                    </th>
                    <th className="text-right px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                      Qty
                    </th>
                    <th className="text-center px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                      Unit
                    </th>
                    <th className="text-right px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                      Rate
                    </th>
                    <th className="text-right px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                      Value
                    </th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-50">
                  {lines.length === 0 && (
                    <tr>
                      <td
                        colSpan={7}
                        className="text-center py-8 text-slate-400 text-xs"
                      >
                        No lines
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  )}
                  {lines.map((line: any, i: number) => (
                    <tr key={line.id} className="hover:bg-slate-50">
                      <td className="px-4 py-3 text-slate-400 text-xs">
                        {i + 1}
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-3">
                        <Link href={`/items/${line.item?.id}`}>
                          <span className="font-mono text-xs text-slate-400 bg-slate-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded mr-2">
                            {line.item?.item_code}
                          </span>
                          <span className="font-medium text-slate-900 hover:text-blue-600">
                            {line.item?.name}
                          </span>
                        </Link>
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-3 text-center">
                        <Badge variant="default">
                          {line.item?.item_category?.name ?? "—"}
                        </Badge>
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right tabular-nums font-semibold text-slate-900">
                        {formatQty(line.qty, line.unit)}
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-3 text-center font-mono text-xs text-slate-500">
                        {line.unit}
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right tabular-nums text-slate-600">
                        {line.rate ? formatCurrency(line.rate) : "—"}
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right tabular-nums font-semibold text-slate-900">
                        {line.line_total
                          ? formatCurrency(line.line_total)
                          : "—"}
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
                <tfoot>
                  <tr className="bg-slate-50 border-t border-slate-200">
                    <td
                      colSpan={3}
                      className="px-4 py-2.5 text-xs text-slate-500"
                    >
                      {lines.length} item{lines.length !== 1 ? "s" : ""}
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-2.5 text-right font-semibold tabular-nums text-slate-900">
                      {totalQty}
                    </td>
                    <td
                      colSpan={2}
                      className="px-4 py-2.5 text-right text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase"
                    >
                      Total Value
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-2.5 text-right font-bold text-blue-600 tabular-nums">
                      {formatCurrency(totalValue)}
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                </tfoot>
              </table>
            </div>
          </Card>

          {/* Stock movements */}
          {movements && movements.length > 0 && (
            <Card>
              <CardHeader>
                <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900">
                  Stock Movements
                  <span className="ml-2 text-xs font-normal text-slate-400">
                    Auto-created when challan was saved
                  </span>
                </h3>
              </CardHeader>
              <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                <table className="w-full text-sm">
                  <thead>
                    <tr className="bg-slate-50 border-b border-slate-100">
                      <th className="text-left px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                        Type
                      </th>
                      <th className="text-right px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                        Qty
                      </th>
                      <th className="text-right px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                        Rate
                      </th>
                      <th className="text-left px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                        Date
                      </th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-50">
                    {movements.map((m: any) => (
                      <tr key={m.id}>
                        <td className="px-4 py-2.5">
                          <Badge variant="danger">{m.movement_type}</Badge>
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-4 py-2.5 text-right tabular-nums font-semibold text-red-600">
                          -{m.qty}
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-4 py-2.5 text-right tabular-nums text-slate-600">
                          {m.rate_at_time
                            ? formatCurrency(m.rate_at_time)
                            : "—"}
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-4 py-2.5 text-slate-500">
                          {formatDate(m.movement_date)}
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            </Card>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function Row({ label, value }: { label: string; value: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4 text-sm">
      <span className="text-slate-500 flex-shrink-0">{label}</span>
      <span className="text-slate-900 text-right">{value}</span>
    </div>
  )
}
```

```tsx
'use client'

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react'
import { useRouter, useSearchParams } from 'next/navigation'
import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'
import { useOrgId } from '@/lib/hooks/use-tenant'
import { dispatchInventory } from '@/lib/utils/inventory'
import { PageHeader } from '@/components/layout/page-header'
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'
import { Input, Textarea } from '@/components/ui/input'
import { Card, CardBody, CardHeader } from '@/components/ui/card'
import { formatCurrency, formatQty } from '@/lib/utils/format'
import { toast } from 'sonner'
import { Trash2, Save, AlertTriangle } from 'lucide-react'
import type { Enums } from '@/lib/types/database'

type TransportMode = Enums<'transport_mode'>

interface ChallanLine {
  item_id: string;
  item_name: string;
  item_code: string;
  so_line_id: string;
  qty: number;
  unit_id: string;
  unit: string;
  rate: number;
  max_qty: number;
  reservation_id: string | null;
}

function useSalesOrdersForDispatch(orgId: string | null) {
  const supabase = createClient();

  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ["so-for-dispatch", orgId],

    queryFn: async () => {
      if (!orgId) {
        throw new Error("Organization context is not available");
      }

      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from("sales_orders")
        .select(
                    `
            id,
            so_number,

            client:clients (
              id,
              name
            ),

            sales_order_lines (
              id,
              qty,
              qty_dispatched,
              unit_rate,
              unit_id,

              unit:units (
                id,
                name
              ),

              item:items (
                id,
                item_code,
                name
              )
            )
            `
        )
        .in("status", ["confirmed", "in_production", "ready"])
        .order("so_number");

      if (error) throw error;

      return data;
    },

    enabled: !!orgId,
    staleTime: 30 * 1000,
  });
}

// ── NEW: fetch active reservations for the selected SO ────────
// Returns a map of item_id → reservation_id so dispatch can
// consume against the reservation rather than raw available stock.
function useSOReservations(soId: string, orgId: string | null) {
  const supabase = createClient();

  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ["so-reservations-for-dispatch", orgId, soId],

    enabled: !!orgId && !!soId,

    queryFn: async () => {
      if (!orgId) {
        throw new Error("Organization context is not available");
      }

      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from("stock_reservations")
        .select("id, item_id, qty_reserved, qty_consumed, status")
        .eq("ref_type", "sales_order")
        .eq("ref_id", soId)
        .in("status", ["active", "partially_consumed"]);

      if (error) throw error;

      return new Map((data ?? []).map((r) => [r.item_id, r.id]));
    },

    staleTime: 30 * 1000,
  });
}

export default function NewChallanPage() {
  const router       = useRouter()
  const searchParams = useSearchParams()
  const supabase     = createClient()
  const orgId        = useOrgId()

const { data: salesOrders } = useSalesOrdersForDispatch(orgId);

  const [selectedSoId,  setSelectedSoId]  = useState(searchParams.get('so') ?? '')
  const [challanDate,   setChallanDate]   = useState(new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0])
  const [transportMode, setTransportMode] = useState<TransportMode>('client_truck')
  const [vehicleNo,     setVehicleNo]     = useState('')
  const [driverName,    setDriverName]    = useState('')
  const [notes,         setNotes]         = useState('')
  const [lines,         setLines]         = useState<ChallanLine[]>([])
  const [saving,        setSaving]        = useState(false)

  // ── Fetch reservations for the selected SO ────────────────
const { data: reservationMap } = useSOReservations(selectedSoId, orgId);

  // Pre-fill lines from SO when selected
  // Now also attaches reservation_id per item from reservationMap
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!selectedSoId || !salesOrders) return;
    const so = salesOrders.find((s) => s.id === selectedSoId);
    if (!so) return;

    const soLines = (so.sales_order_lines as any[]) ?? [];
    const remaining = soLines
      .filter((l) => l.qty - (l.qty_dispatched ?? 0) > 0)
      .map((l) => ({
        item_id: l.item?.id ?? "",
        item_name: l.item?.name ?? "",
        item_code: l.item?.item_code ?? "",
        so_line_id: l.id,
        qty: l.qty - (l.qty_dispatched ?? 0),
        unit_id: l.unit_id,
        unit: l.unit?.name ?? "",
        rate: l.unit_rate,
        max_qty: l.qty - (l.qty_dispatched ?? 0),
        reservation_id: reservationMap?.get(l.item?.id) ?? null,
      }));

    setLines(remaining);
  }, [selectedSoId, salesOrders, reservationMap]);

  // ── Re-attach reservation_ids once reservationMap loads ───
  // The SO lines effect runs before reservationMap is ready on
  // first render, so we patch them in as soon as the map arrives.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!reservationMap || lines.length === 0) return
    setLines(prev => prev.map(l => ({
      ...l,
      reservation_id: reservationMap.get(l.item_id) ?? null,
    })))
  }, [reservationMap])

  const selectedSo     = salesOrders?.find(s => s.id === selectedSoId)
  const selectedClient = selectedSo?.client as any
  const totalAmount    = lines.reduce((s, l) => s + l.qty * l.rate, 0)

  // Warn if any line has no reservation (stock not reserved for this SO)
  const missingReservations = lines.filter(l => !l.reservation_id)

  function updateLine(i: number, field: keyof ChallanLine, value: string | number) {
    setLines(prev => prev.map((l, idx) => {
      if (idx !== i) return l
      if (field === 'qty') return { ...l, qty: Math.min(Number(value), l.max_qty) }
      return { ...l, [field]: value }
    }))
  }

  function removeLine(i: number) {
    setLines(prev => prev.filter((_, idx) => idx !== i))
  }

  async function handleSave() {


    if (!selectedSoId)               { toast.error('Select a sales order');        return }
    if (lines.length === 0)          { toast.error('Add at least one item');       return }
    if (lines.some(l => l.qty <= 0)) { toast.error('All quantities must be > 0'); return }
    if (lines.some(l => l.rate <= 0)){ toast.error('All rates must be > 0');      return }

    if (!orgId) {
        toast.error("Organization context is not available");
        return;
    }

    // ── Warn but allow if reservation missing ─────────────
    // This handles edge cases where SO was confirmed without reserving
    if (missingReservations.length > 0) {
      const names = missingReservations.map(l => l.item_name).join(', ')
      toast.warning(
        `No reservation found for: ${names}. Dispatching from available stock directly.`,
        { duration: 5000 }
      )
    }

    setSaving(true)
    const dispatchedItems: Array<{ itemId: string; qty: number }> = []

    try {
      const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser()

      // ── STEP 1: Create challan header first ───────────────
      // We need the challan id to pass as ref_id to dispatchInventory
      const { data: dcNo, error: rpcErr } = await supabase.rpc('next_dc_no', {
        p_org_id: orgId,
      })
      if (rpcErr) throw rpcErr

      const { data: challan, error: dcErr } = await supabase
        .from('delivery_challans')
        .insert({
          org_id:         orgId,
          challan_no:     dcNo as string,
          so_id:          selectedSoId,
          client_id:      selectedClient?.id,
          challan_date:   challanDate,
          transport_mode: transportMode,
          vehicle_no:     vehicleNo  || null,
          driver_name:    driverName || null,
          total_amount:   totalAmount,
          status:         'dispatched',
          notes:          notes      || null,
          created_by:     user?.id   ?? null,
        })
        .select('id')
        .single()

      if (dcErr) throw dcErr

      // ── STEP 2: Dispatch each line, consuming its reservation ─
      // Passing reservation_id tells the DB RPC to:
      //   1. Deduct from reserved_qty (not available_qty directly)
      //   2. Mark reservation as consumed / partially_consumed
      //   3. Record the stock_movement with ref_type='delivery_challan'
      for (const line of lines) {
        await dispatchInventory({
          itemId:        line.item_id,
          qty:           line.qty,
          rate:          line.rate,
          reservationId: line.reservation_id ?? undefined, // null → dispatch from available
          refId:         challan.id,
          notes:         `Challan ${dcNo} — SO ${selectedSo?.so_number}`,
        })
        dispatchedItems.push({ itemId: line.item_id, qty: line.qty })
      }

      // ── STEP 3: Insert challan lines (document record) ────
      const { error: linesErr } = await supabase
        .from("delivery_challan_lines")
        .insert(
          lines.map((l) => ({
            challan_id: challan.id,
            item_id: l.item_id,
            so_line_id: l.so_line_id,
            qty: l.qty,
            unit_id: l.unit_id,
            rate: l.rate,
          }))
        );

      if (linesErr) throw linesErr

      // ── STEP 4: Update qty_dispatched on each SO line ─────
      for (const line of lines) {
        if (!line.so_line_id) continue
        const soLine = (selectedSo?.sales_order_lines as any[])
          ?.find(l => l.id === line.so_line_id)
        if (!soLine) continue
        await supabase
          .from('sales_order_lines')
          .update({ qty_dispatched: (soLine.qty_dispatched ?? 0) + line.qty })
          .eq('id', line.so_line_id)
      }

      toast.success(`Challan ${dcNo} created — ${dispatchedItems.length} items dispatched from reserved stock`)
      router.push('/dispatch')

    } catch (err: any) {
      toast.error(`Failed: ${err.message}`)
    } finally {
      setSaving(false)
    }
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="New Delivery Challan"
        description="Create dispatch document for outgoing goods"
      >
        <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={() => router.back()}>Cancel</Button>
        <Button size="sm" loading={saving} onClick={handleSave}>
          <Save className="w-4 h-4" />
          Create Challan
        </Button>
      </PageHeader>

      {/* Reservation status notice */}
      {selectedSoId && lines.length > 0 && (
        missingReservations.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="mb-6 flex items-start gap-3 bg-teal-50 border border-teal-200 rounded-xl px-5 py-3">
            <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-teal-600 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
            <p className="text-sm text-teal-800">
              All items have active reservations. Dispatch will consume from reserved stock —
              reservation will be marked as consumed automatically.
            </p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="mb-6 flex items-start gap-3 bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 rounded-xl px-5 py-3">
            <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-600 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
            <p className="text-sm text-amber-800">
              Some items have no active reservation. Go back and Reserve Stock on the
              Sales Order first, or dispatch will deduct directly from available stock.
            </p>
          </div>
        )
      )}

      {!selectedSoId && (
        <div className="mb-6 flex items-start gap-3 bg-blue-50 border border-blue-200 rounded-xl px-5 py-3">
          <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
          <p className="text-sm text-blue-800">
            Select a sales order. Dispatch will consume from the reserved stock for that order.
          </p>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">

        {/* ── Left: Header ── */}
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <Card>
            <CardHeader>
              <h3 className="font-semibold text-slate-900 text-sm">Dispatch Details</h3>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardBody className="space-y-4">

              <div>
                <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
                  Sales Order <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
                </label>
                <select
                  value={selectedSoId}
                  onChange={e => setSelectedSoId(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 text-sm rounded-lg border border-slate-300 bg-white focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500"
                >
                  <option value="">Select sales order…</option>
                  {salesOrders?.map(so => (
                    <option key={so.id} value={so.id}>
                      {so.so_number} — {(so.client as any)?.name}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>

              {selectedClient && (
                <div className="bg-slate-50 rounded-lg p-3 text-sm">
                  <p className="font-semibold text-slate-900">{selectedClient.name}</p>
                  {selectedClient.phone && (
                    <p className="text-slate-500 text-xs mt-0.5">{selectedClient.phone}</p>
                  )}
                </div>
              )}

              <Input
                label="Challan Date"
                type="date"
                value={challanDate}
                onChange={e => setChallanDate(e.target.value)}
              />

              <div>
                <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
                  Transport Mode
                </label>
                <select
                  value={transportMode}
                  onChange={e => setTransportMode(e.target.value as TransportMode)}
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 text-sm rounded-lg border border-slate-300 bg-white focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500"
                >
                  <option value="client_truck">Client Truck</option>
                  <option value="own_truck">Our Truck</option>
                  <option value="courier">Courier</option>
                  <option value="hand_delivery">Hand Delivery</option>
                  <option value="supplier_truck">Supplier Truck</option>
                </select>
              </div>

              <Input label="Vehicle No." placeholder="e.g. GJ01AB1234" value={vehicleNo} onChange={e => setVehicleNo(e.target.value)} />
              <Input label="Driver Name" value={driverName} onChange={e => setDriverName(e.target.value)} />
              <Textarea label="Notes" placeholder="Any special instructions…" value={notes} onChange={e => setNotes(e.target.value)} />
            </CardBody>
          </Card>

          <Card>
            <CardHeader>
              <h3 className="font-semibold text-slate-900 text-sm">Summary</h3>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardBody className="space-y-2">
              <div className="flex justify-between text-sm">
                <span className="text-slate-500">Lines</span>
                <span className="font-medium">{lines.length}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between text-sm">
                <span className="text-slate-500">Reserved lines</span>
                <span className={lines.length - missingReservations.length > 0 ? 'font-medium text-teal-600' : 'text-slate-400'}>
                  {lines.length - missingReservations.length} of {lines.length}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between text-sm font-bold border-t border-slate-100 pt-2">
                <span>Challan Value</span>
                <span className="text-blue-600">{formatCurrency(totalAmount)}</span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">GST invoice raised separately.</p>
            </CardBody>
          </Card>
        </div>

        {/* ── Right: Lines ── */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-2">
          <Card>
            <CardHeader>
              <h3 className="font-semibold text-slate-900 text-sm">
                Items to Dispatch
                <span className="ml-2 text-xs font-normal text-slate-400">
                  {lines.length} line{lines.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}
                </span>
              </h3>
            </CardHeader>

            {!selectedSoId ? (
              <CardBody>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-slate-400 text-sm py-4">
                  <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4" />
                  Select a sales order to load items
                </div>
              </CardBody>
            ) : lines.length === 0 ? (
              <CardBody>
                <p className="text-slate-400 text-sm py-4 text-center">
                  All items on this order have already been dispatched
                </p>
              </CardBody>
            ) : (
              <CardBody className="p-0">
                <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                  <table className="w-full text-sm">
                    <thead>
                      <tr className="bg-slate-50 border-b border-slate-100">
                        <th className="text-left px-3 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500">Item</th>
                        <th className="text-right px-3 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 w-28">Remaining</th>
                        <th className="text-right px-3 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 w-28">Dispatch Qty</th>
                        <th className="text-center px-3 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 w-16">Unit</th>
                        <th className="text-right px-3 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 w-28">Rate (₹)</th>
                        <th className="text-right px-3 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 w-28">Line Total</th>
                        {/* ── NEW: reservation indicator column ── */}
                        <th className="text-center px-3 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 w-20">Stock</th>
                        <th className="w-8"></th>
                      </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-50">
                      {lines.map((line, i) => (
                        <tr key={i} className="group">
                          <td className="px-3 py-2.5">
                            <span className="font-mono text-xs text-slate-400 bg-slate-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded mr-2">
                              {line.item_code}
                            </span>
                            <span className="font-medium text-slate-900 text-sm">{line.item_name}</span>
                          </td>
                          <td className="px-3 py-2.5 text-right tabular-nums text-slate-400 text-xs">
                            {formatQty(line.max_qty, line.unit)}
                          </td>
                          <td className="px-3 py-2.5">
                            <input
                              type="number" min="0.0001" max={line.max_qty} step="any"
                              value={line.qty}
                              onChange={e => updateLine(i, 'qty', Number(e.target.value))}
                              className="w-full px-2 py-1.5 text-xs rounded border border-slate-200 text-right focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500"
                            />
                          </td>
                          <td className="px-3 py-2.5 font-mono text-xs text-slate-500 text-center">{line.unit}</td>
                          <td className="px-3 py-2.5">
                            <input
                              type="number" min="0" step="any"
                              value={line.rate}
                              onChange={e => updateLine(i, 'rate', Number(e.target.value))}
                              className="w-full px-2 py-1.5 text-xs rounded border border-slate-200 text-right focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500"
                            />
                          </td>
                          <td className="px-3 py-2.5 text-right tabular-nums font-semibold text-slate-900 text-xs">
                            {formatCurrency(line.qty * line.rate)}
                          </td>
                          {/* ── Reserved / Available indicator ── */}
                          <td className="px-3 py-2.5 text-center">
                            {line.reservation_id ? (
                              <span style={{ fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 600, background: 'rgba(20,184,166,0.12)', color: '#0d9488', padding: '2px 7px', borderRadius: 5 }}>
                                Reserved
                              </span>
                            ) : (
                              <span style={{ fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 600, background: 'rgba(245,158,11,0.12)', color: '#b45309', padding: '2px 7px', borderRadius: 5 }}>
                                Available
                              </span>
                            )}
                          </td>
                          <td className="px-2 py-2">
                            <button
                              onClick={() => removeLine(i)}
                              className="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 text-slate-300 hover:text-red-500 transition-all"
                            >
                              <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                            </button>
                          </td>
                        </tr>
                      ))}
                    </tbody>
                    <tfoot>
                      <tr className="bg-blue-50 border-t border-blue-100">
                        <td colSpan={6} className="px-3 py-2.5 text-right font-bold text-slate-700 text-sm">
                          Total Challan Value
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-3 py-2.5 text-right tabular-nums font-bold text-blue-600">
                          {formatCurrency(totalAmount)}
                        </td>
                        <td colSpan={2}></td>
                      </tr>
                    </tfoot>
                  </table>
                </div>
              </CardBody>
            )}
          </Card>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}
```
