```tsx
'use client'


import { useOrgId } from "@/lib/hooks/use-tenant";
import { useState } from 'react'
import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'
import { PageHeader } from '@/components/layout/page-header'
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge'
import { TableLoader } from '@/components/ui/spinner'
import { formatCurrency, formatDate } from '@/lib/utils/format'
import { Plus, Search, Eye } from 'lucide-react'
import Link from 'next/link'
import { Route } from 'next'

function useDeliveryChallans(search: string, orgId: string | null) {
  const supabase = createClient();

  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ["delivery-challans", orgId, search],

    queryFn: async () => {
      if (!orgId) {
        throw new Error("Organization context is not available");
      }

      let query = supabase
        .from("delivery_challans")
        .select(
          `
          id, so_id, challan_no, challan_date, transport_mode,
          vehicle_no, driver_name, total_amount, status, created_at,
          client:clients ( id, name ),
          sales_order:sales_orders ( so_number ),
          delivery_challan_lines ( id )
        `
        )
        .order("created_at", { ascending: false });

      if (search) {
        query = query.ilike("challan_no", `%${search}%`);
      }

      const { data, error } = await query;

      if (error) throw error;

      return data;
    },

    enabled: !!orgId,
    staleTime: 30 * 1000,
  });
}

const STATUS_COLORS: Record<string, 'warning' | 'success' | 'danger'> = {
  dispatched: 'warning',
  delivered:  'success',
  returned:   'danger',
}

const TRANSPORT_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  own_truck:      '🚛 Own Truck',
  supplier_truck: '🚚 Supplier Truck',
  client_truck:   '🚐 Client Truck',
  courier:        '📦 Courier',
  hand_delivery:  '🤝 Hand Delivery',
}

export default function DispatchPage() {
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const orgId = useOrgId();

  const { data: challans, isLoading } = useDeliveryChallans(search, orgId);

  const totalDispatched =
    challans?.filter((c) => c.status === "dispatched").length ?? 0;
  const totalDelivered =
    challans?.filter((c) => c.status === "delivered").length ?? 0;
  const totalValue =
    challans?.reduce((s, c) => s + (c.total_amount ?? 0), 0) ?? 0;

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="Dispatch"
        description="Delivery challans for outgoing goods"
      >
        <Link href={"/dispatch/new" as Route}>
          <Button size="sm">
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
            New Challan
          </Button>
        </Link>
      </PageHeader>

      {/* Stats */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4 mb-6">
        <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm p-5">
          <p className="text-sm text-slate-500">In Transit</p>
          <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-amber-600 mt-1">
            {totalDispatched}
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm p-5">
          <p className="text-sm text-slate-500">Delivered</p>
          <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-green-600 mt-1">
            {totalDelivered}
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm p-5">
          <p className="text-sm text-slate-500">Total Value Dispatched</p>
          <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-900 mt-1">
            {formatCurrency(totalValue)}
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Search */}
      <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm mb-6">
        <div className="px-5 py-4 flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="relative flex-1 max-w-sm">
            <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-slate-400" />
            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder="Search by challan number…"
              value={search}
              onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full pl-9 pr-4 py-2 text-sm rounded-lg border border-slate-300 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-transparent"
            />
          </div>
          <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 ml-auto">
            {challans?.length ?? 0} challans
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Table */}
      <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm overflow-hidden">
        {isLoading ? (
          <TableLoader />
        ) : (
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full text-sm">
              <thead>
                <tr className="bg-slate-50 border-b border-slate-200">
                  <th className="text-left px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                    Challan No.
                  </th>
                  <th className="text-left px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                    Client
                  </th>
                  <th className="text-left px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                    Sales Order
                  </th>
                  <th className="text-left px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                    Date
                  </th>
                  <th className="text-left px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                    Transport
                  </th>
                  <th className="text-left px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                    Vehicle
                  </th>
                  <th className="text-center px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                    Lines
                  </th>
                  <th className="text-right px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                    Value
                  </th>
                  <th className="text-center px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                    Status
                  </th>
                  <th className="text-center px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                    View
                  </th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-50">
                {challans?.length === 0 && (
                  <tr>
                    <td
                      colSpan={10}
                      className="text-center py-12 text-slate-400 text-sm"
                    >
                      No challans found
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                )}
                {challans?.map((c: any) => (
                  <tr
                    key={c.id}
                    className="hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors"
                  >
                    <td className="px-4 py-3">
                      <Link
                        href={`/dispatch/${c.id}` as Route}
                        className="font-mono text-sm font-semibold text-blue-600 hover:underline"
                      >
                        {c.challan_no}
                      </Link>
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3 font-medium text-slate-900">
                      {c.client?.name}
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3">
                      {c.sales_order && (
                        <Link
                          href={`/sales-orders/${c.so_id}`}
                          className="font-mono text-xs text-blue-500 hover:underline"
                        >
                          {c.sales_order.so_number}
                        </Link>
                      )}
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3 text-slate-600">
                      {formatDate(c.challan_date)}
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3 text-xs text-slate-600">
                      {TRANSPORT_LABELS[c.transport_mode] ?? c.transport_mode}
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3 text-xs text-slate-500">
                      {c.vehicle_no ?? "—"}
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3 text-center font-medium text-slate-700">
                      {c.delivery_challan_lines?.length ?? 0}
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right tabular-nums font-semibold text-slate-900">
                      {formatCurrency(c.total_amount)}
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3 text-center">
                      <Badge variant={STATUS_COLORS[c.status] ?? "default"}>
                        {c.status}
                      </Badge>
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3 text-center">
                      <Link href={`/dispatch/${c.id}` as Route}>
                        <button className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:text-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-50 transition-colors">
                          <Eye className="w-4 h-4" />
                        </button>
                      </Link>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

# src/app/(dashboard)/error.tsx

```tsx
'use client'

import { useEffect } from 'react'
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'
import { AlertTriangle, RefreshCw, Home } from 'lucide-react'
import Link from 'next/link'

interface ErrorProps {
  error:  Error & { digest?: string }
  reset:  () => void
}

// This file is automatically used by Next.js when any page
// inside (dashboard) throws an unhandled error.
// It catches both Server Component errors and client-side errors.
export default function DashboardError({ error, reset }: ErrorProps) {

  useEffect(() => {
    // Log to console in dev — in production you'd send to Sentry etc.
    console.error('[Dashboard Error]', error)
  }, [error])

  return (
    <div className="flex items-center justify-center min-h-[60vh]">
      <div className="text-center max-w-md">

        {/* Icon */}
        <div className="w-16 h-16 rounded-2xl bg-red-50 border border-red-100 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-6">
          <AlertTriangle className="w-8 h-8 text-red-500" />
        </div>

        {/* Heading */}
        <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold text-slate-900 mb-2">
          Something went wrong
        </h2>

        {/* Message */}
        <p className="text-sm text-slate-500 mb-2">
          An unexpected error occurred while loading this page.
        </p>

        {/* Error detail in dev */}
        {process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development' && error?.message && (
          <div className="mb-6 px-4 py-3 bg-slate-900 rounded-lg text-left">
            <p className="text-xs font-mono text-red-400 break-all">
              {error.message}
            </p>
            {error.digest && (
              <p className="text-xs font-mono text-slate-500 mt-1">
                Digest: {error.digest}
              </p>
            )}
          </div>
        )}

        {!error?.message && <div className="mb-6" />}

        {/* Actions */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-3">
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            size="sm"
            onClick={reset}
          >
            <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4" />
            Try Again
          </Button>
          <Link href="/">
            <Button size="sm">
              <Home className="w-4 h-4" />
              Go to Dashboard
            </Button>
          </Link>
        </div>

      </div>
    </div>
  )
}
```

```tsx
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server'
import { notFound } from 'next/navigation'
import { PageHeader } from '@/components/layout/page-header'
import { Card, CardBody, CardHeader } from '@/components/ui/card'
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge'
import { formatCurrency, formatDate, formatQty } from '@/lib/utils/format'
import { Truck, Package, FileText, User } from 'lucide-react'
import Link from 'next/link'

interface Props {
  params: Promise<{ id: string }>
}

const STATUS_COLORS: Record<string, 'success' | 'warning' | 'danger' | 'default'> = {
  received:  'success',
  partial:   'warning',
  pending:   'default',
  cancelled: 'danger',
}

const TRANSPORT_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  own_truck:      '🚛 Own Truck',
  supplier_truck: '🚚 Supplier Truck',
  client_truck:   '🚐 Client Truck',
  courier:        '📦 Courier',
  hand_delivery:  '🤝 Hand Delivery',
}

export default async function GrnDetailPage({ params }: Props) {
  const { id } = await params
  const supabase = await createClient()

  const [{ data: grn }, { data: movements }] = await Promise.all([
    supabase
      .from("inbound_receipts")
      .select(
        `
        *,
        supplier:suppliers ( id, name, phone, gst_number, city ),
        receiver:profiles!inbound_receipts_received_by_fkey ( full_name ),
        creator:profiles!inbound_receipts_created_by_fkey ( full_name ),
        inbound_receipt_lines (
          id, qty_ordered, qty_received, unit,
          rate, gst_percent, line_total, notes,
          item:items (
                  id,
                  item_code,
                  name,
                  unit,
                  category_id,
                  item_category:item_categories (
                    id,
                    name
                  )
                )
              )
      `
      )
      .eq("id", id)
      .single(),

    supabase
      .from("stock_movements")
      .select("id, qty, movement_type, movement_date, rate_at_time")
      .eq("ref_type", "inbound_receipt")
      .eq("ref_id", id),
  ]);

  if (!grn) notFound()

  const supplier = grn.supplier  as any
  const receiver = grn.receiver  as any
  const creator  = grn.creator   as any
  const lines    = (grn.inbound_receipt_lines as any[]) ?? []
  const subtotal   = grn.total_amount ?? 0
  const gstAmount  = grn.gst_amount   ?? 0
  const grandTotal = subtotal + gstAmount

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title={grn.receipt_no}
        description={`Goods Received Note · ${supplier?.name} · ${formatDate(grn.receipt_date)}`}
      >
        <a
          href={`/api/pdf?type=grn&id=${grn.id}`}
          target="_blank"
          rel="noopener noreferrer"
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium rounded-lg border border-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 transition-colors"
        >
          <FileText className="w-4 h-4" />
          Print GRN
        </a>
      </PageHeader>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">

        {/* ── Left ── */}
        <div className="space-y-4">

          <Card>
            <CardHeader>
              <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-2">
                <Package className="w-4 h-4 text-teal-600" />
                Receipt Details
              </h3>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardBody className="space-y-3 text-sm">
              <Row label="GRN No."     value={<span className="font-mono font-bold">{grn.receipt_no}</span>} />
              <Row label="Status"      value={<Badge variant={STATUS_COLORS[grn.status] ?? 'default'}>{grn.status}</Badge>} />
              <Row label="Date"        value={formatDate(grn.receipt_date)} />
              <Row label="Transport"   value={TRANSPORT_LABELS[grn.transport_mode] ?? grn.transport_mode} />
              {grn.vehicle_no  && <Row label="Vehicle"        value={grn.vehicle_no} />}
              {grn.driver_name && <Row label="Driver"         value={grn.driver_name} />}
              {grn.challan_no  && <Row label="Sup. Challan"   value={<span className="font-mono text-xs">{grn.challan_no}</span>} />}
              {grn.invoice_no  && <Row label="Invoice No."    value={<span className="font-mono text-xs">{grn.invoice_no}</span>} />}
            </CardBody>
          </Card>

          <Card>
            <CardHeader>
              <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-2">
                <Truck className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600" />
                Supplier
              </h3>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardBody className="space-y-1.5 text-sm">
              <div className="font-semibold text-slate-900">{supplier?.name}</div>
              {supplier?.phone && <div className="text-slate-500">{supplier.phone}</div>}
              {supplier?.gst_number && (
                <div className="font-mono text-xs text-slate-400">GST: {supplier.gst_number}</div>
              )}
              {supplier?.city && <div className="text-slate-500 text-xs">{supplier.city}</div>}
            </CardBody>
          </Card>

          <Card>
            <CardHeader>
              <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-2">
                <User className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400" />
                Recorded By
              </h3>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardBody className="space-y-2 text-sm">
              {receiver && <Row label="Received By" value={receiver.full_name} />}
              {creator  && <Row label="Entered By"  value={creator.full_name} />}
              <Row label="Created At" value={formatDate(grn.created_at)} />
            </CardBody>
          </Card>

          <Card>
            <CardBody className="space-y-2 text-sm">
              <Row label="Subtotal" value={formatCurrency(subtotal)} />
              <Row label="GST"      value={formatCurrency(gstAmount)} />
              <div className="flex justify-between font-bold text-base border-t border-slate-100 pt-2">
                <span>Total</span>
                <span className="text-teal-600">{formatCurrency(grandTotal)}</span>
              </div>
            </CardBody>
          </Card>

          {grn.notes && (
            <Card>
              <CardBody>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wide mb-1">Notes</p>
                <p className="text-sm text-slate-700">{grn.notes}</p>
              </CardBody>
            </Card>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* ── Right ── */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-2 space-y-6">

          <Card>
            <CardHeader>
              <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900">
                Items Received
                <span className="ml-2 text-xs font-normal text-slate-400">
                  {lines.length} line{lines.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}
                </span>
              </h3>
            </CardHeader>
            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
              <table className="w-full text-sm">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="bg-slate-50 border-b border-slate-100">
                    <th className="text-left px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">#</th>
                    <th className="text-left px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">Item</th>
                    <th className="text-right px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">Ordered</th>
                    <th className="text-right px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">Received</th>
                    <th className="text-right px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">Rate</th>
                    <th className="text-center px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">GST</th>
                    <th className="text-right px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">Amount</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-50">
                  {lines.length === 0 && (
                    <tr><td colSpan={7} className="text-center py-8 text-slate-400 text-xs">No lines</td></tr>
                  )}
                  {lines.map((line: any, i: number) => {
                    const variance = line.qty_ordered
                      ? line.qty_received - line.qty_ordered
                      : null
                    return (
                      <tr key={line.id} className="hover:bg-slate-50">
                        <td className="px-4 py-3 text-slate-400 text-xs">{i + 1}</td>
                        <td className="px-4 py-3">
                          <Link href={`/items/${line.item?.id}`}>
                            <span className="font-mono text-xs text-slate-400 bg-slate-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded mr-2">
                              {line.item?.item_code}
                            </span>
                            <span className="font-medium text-slate-900 hover:text-blue-600">
                              {line.item?.name}
                            </span>
                          </Link>
                          {line.notes && (
                            <div className="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-0.5">{line.notes}</div>
                          )}
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right tabular-nums text-slate-500">
                          {line.qty_ordered ? formatQty(line.qty_ordered, line.unit) : '—'}
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right tabular-nums">
                          <span className="font-semibold text-slate-900">
                            {formatQty(line.qty_received, line.unit)}
                          </span>
                          {variance !== null && variance !== 0 && (
                            <div className={`text-xs ${variance > 0 ? 'text-green-600' : 'text-red-600'}`}>
                              {variance > 0 ? '+' : ''}{formatQty(variance, line.unit)}
                            </div>
                          )}
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right tabular-nums text-slate-600">
                          {formatCurrency(line.rate)}
                          <div className="text-xs text-slate-400">/{line.unit}</div>
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-4 py-3 text-center text-slate-500">{line.gst_percent}%</td>
                        <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right tabular-nums font-semibold text-slate-900">
                          {formatCurrency(line.line_total)}
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    )
                  })}
                </tbody>
                <tfoot>
                  <tr className="bg-slate-50 border-t border-slate-200">
                    <td colSpan={6} className="px-4 py-2.5 text-right text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">Subtotal</td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-2.5 text-right font-semibold tabular-nums">{formatCurrency(subtotal)}</td>
                  </tr>
                  <tr className="bg-slate-50">
                    <td colSpan={6} className="px-4 py-1.5 text-right text-xs text-slate-500">GST</td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-1.5 text-right tabular-nums text-slate-600">{formatCurrency(gstAmount)}</td>
                  </tr>
                  <tr className="bg-teal-50 border-t border-teal-100">
                    <td colSpan={6} className="px-4 py-3 text-right font-bold text-slate-800">Total</td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right font-bold text-teal-600 text-base tabular-nums">
                      {formatCurrency(grandTotal)}
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                </tfoot>
              </table>
            </div>
          </Card>

          {/* Stock movements */}
          {movements && movements.length > 0 && (
            <Card>
              <CardHeader>
                <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900">
                  Stock Movements Created
                  <span className="ml-2 text-xs font-normal text-slate-400">
                    Auto-created when lines were saved
                  </span>
                </h3>
              </CardHeader>
              <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                <table className="w-full text-sm">
                  <thead>
                    <tr className="bg-slate-50 border-b border-slate-100">
                      <th className="text-left px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">Type</th>
                      <th className="text-right px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">Qty</th>
                      <th className="text-right px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">Rate</th>
                      <th className="text-left px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">Date</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-50">
                    {movements.map((m: any) => (
                      <tr key={m.id}>
                        <td className="px-4 py-2.5">
                          <Badge variant="success">{m.movement_type}</Badge>
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-4 py-2.5 text-right tabular-nums font-semibold text-green-600">
                          +{m.qty}
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-4 py-2.5 text-right tabular-nums text-slate-600">
                          {m.rate_at_time ? formatCurrency(m.rate_at_time) : '—'}
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-4 py-2.5 text-slate-500">
                          {formatDate(m.movement_date)}
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            </Card>
          )}

        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

function Row({ label, value }: { label: string; value: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4 text-sm">
      <span className="text-slate-500 flex-shrink-0">{label}</span>
      <span className="text-slate-900 text-right">{value}</span>
    </div>
  )
}
```

# src/app/(dashboard)/inbound/new/page.tsx

```tsx
'use client'

import { useState } from 'react'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'
import { useOrgId } from '@/lib/hooks/use-tenant'
import { receiveInventory } from '@/lib/utils/inventory'
import { PageHeader } from '@/components/layout/page-header'
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'
import { Input, Textarea } from '@/components/ui/input'
import { Card, CardBody, CardHeader } from '@/components/ui/card'
import { formatCurrency } from '@/lib/utils/format'
import { toast } from 'sonner'
import { Plus, Trash2, Save } from 'lucide-react'
import type {
    Enums
  } from '@/lib/types/database'

type GstRate = Enums<'gst_rate'>

type TransportMode = Enums<'transport_mode'>
  


interface GrnLine {
  item_id: string;
  item_name: string;
  item_code: string;
  qty_ordered: number;
  qty_received: number;
  unit_id: string;
  unit_name: string;
  rate: number;
  gst_percent: GstRate;
}

const EMPTY_LINE: GrnLine = {
  item_id: "",
  item_name: "",
  item_code: "",
  qty_ordered: 0,
  qty_received: 1,
  unit_id: "",
  unit_name: "",
  rate: 0,
  gst_percent: "18",
};

function useSuppliers(orgId: string | null) {
  const supabase = createClient();

  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ["suppliers-list", orgId],
    queryFn: async () => {
      if (!orgId) return [];

      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from("suppliers")
        .select("id, name, payment_terms")
        .eq("is_active", true)
        .order("name");

      if (error) throw error;
      return data;
    },
    enabled: !!orgId,
    staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000,
  });
}

function useItemsForGrn(orgId: string | null) {
  const supabase = createClient();

  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ["items-for-grn", orgId],
    queryFn: async () => {
      if (!orgId) return [];

      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from("items")
        .select(
          `
          id,
          item_code,
          name,
          unit_id,
          hsn_code,
          unit:units (
            id,
            name
          )
        `
        )
        .eq("is_active", true)
        .or("is_traded.eq.true,is_raw_material.eq.true")
        .order("name");

      if (error) throw error;

      // Get current purchase prices
      const { data: prices, error: pricesError } = await supabase
        .from("v_current_prices")
        .select("item_id, purchase_rate, gst_percent");

      if (pricesError) throw pricesError;

      const priceMap = new Map(prices?.map((p) => [p.item_id, p]) ?? []);

      return (
        data?.map((i) => ({
          ...i,
          price: priceMap.get(i.id) ?? null,
        })) ?? []
      );
    },
    enabled: !!orgId,
    staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000,
  });
}

export default function NewGrnPage() {
  const router   = useRouter()
  const supabase = createClient()
  const orgId    = useOrgId()

const { data: suppliers } = useSuppliers(orgId);
const { data: items } = useItemsForGrn(orgId);

  const [supplierId,    setSupplierId]    = useState('')
  const [receiptDate,   setReceiptDate]   = useState(new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0])
  const [transportMode, setTransportMode] = useState<TransportMode>('supplier_truck')
  const [vehicleNo,     setVehicleNo]     = useState('')
  const [driverName,    setDriverName]    = useState('')
  const [challanNo,     setChallanNo]     = useState('')
  const [invoiceNo,     setInvoiceNo]     = useState('')
  const [notes,         setNotes]         = useState('')
  const [lines,         setLines]         = useState<GrnLine[]>([{ ...EMPTY_LINE }])
  const [saving,        setSaving]        = useState(false)

  const lineSubtotal  = (l: GrnLine) => l.qty_received * l.rate
  const lineGst       = (l: GrnLine) => lineSubtotal(l) * Number(l.gst_percent) / 100
  const subtotal      = lines.reduce((s, l) => s + lineSubtotal(l), 0)
  const gstAmount     = lines.reduce((s, l) => s + lineGst(l), 0)
  const totalAmount   = subtotal + gstAmount

  function addLine() {
    setLines(prev => [...prev, { ...EMPTY_LINE }])
  }

  function removeLine(i: number) {
    setLines(prev => prev.filter((_, idx) => idx !== i))
  }

  function updateLine(i: number, field: keyof GrnLine, value: string | number) {
    setLines(prev => prev.map((l, idx) => idx !== i ? l : { ...l, [field]: value }))
  }

  function selectItem(lineIdx: number, itemId: string) {
    const item = items?.find(i => i.id === itemId)
    if (!item) return
    setLines(prev => prev.map((l, i) => {
      if (i !== lineIdx) return l
      return {
        ...l,
        item_id: item.id,
        item_name: item.name,
        item_code: item.item_code,
        unit_id: item.unit_id ?? "",
        unit_name: item.unit?.name ?? "",
        rate: item.price?.purchase_rate ?? 0,
        gst_percent: (item.price?.gst_percent ?? "18") as GstRate,
      };
    }))
  }

  async function handleSave() {
    if (!supplierId)              { toast.error('Select a supplier');               return }
    if (lines.some(l => !l.item_id)) { toast.error('All lines need an item');      return }
    if (lines.some((l) => !l.unit_id)) {
      toast.error("All items need a unit assigned");
      return;
    }
    if (lines.some(l => l.qty_received <= 0)) { toast.error('All quantities must be > 0'); return }
    if (lines.some(l => l.rate <= 0))         { toast.error('All rates must be > 0');       return }

    if (!orgId) {
      toast.error("Organization not loaded");
      return;
    }

    setSaving(true)
    try {
      // Generate GRN number with tenant org_id
      const { data: grnNo, error: rpcErr } = await supabase.rpc("next_grn_no", {
        p_org_id: orgId,
      });
      if (rpcErr) throw rpcErr;

      // Get current user
      const {
        data: { user },
      } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

      // Create GRN header with org_id
      const { data: grn, error: grnErr } = await supabase
        .from("inbound_receipts")
        .insert({
          org_id: orgId,
          receipt_no: grnNo as string,
          supplier_id: supplierId,
          receipt_date: receiptDate,
          transport_mode: transportMode,
          vehicle_no: vehicleNo || null,
          driver_name: driverName || null,
          challan_no: challanNo || null,
          invoice_no: invoiceNo || null,
          total_amount: subtotal,
          gst_amount: gstAmount,
          status: "received",
          notes: notes || null,
          received_by: user?.id ?? null,
          created_by: user?.id ?? null,
        })
        .select("id")
        .single();

      if (grnErr) throw grnErr;

      // Insert GRN lines. Note: there is no DB trigger on inbound_receipt_lines that
      // syncs stock — the receiveInventory() calls below are what create the
      // stock_movements rows and update inventory_balance for each line.
      const { error: linesErr } = await supabase
        .from("inbound_receipt_lines")
        .insert(
          lines.map((l) => ({
            receipt_id: grn.id,
            item_id: l.item_id,
            qty_ordered: l.qty_ordered > 0 ? l.qty_ordered : null,
            qty_received: l.qty_received,
            unit_id: l.unit_id,
            rate: l.rate,
            gst_percent: l.gst_percent,
          }))
        );

      if (linesErr) throw linesErr;

      // ── Create stock movements manually ─────────────────────
      for (const line of lines) {
        await receiveInventory({
          itemId: line.item_id,
          qty: line.qty_received,
          rate: line.rate,
          refId: grn.id,
        });
      }

      toast.success(`GRN ${grnNo} created — stock updated`);
      router.push("/inbound");
    } catch (err: unknown) {
        toast.error(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to create GRN')
} finally {
      setSaving(false)
    }
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="New GRN"
        description="Record goods received from supplier"
      >
        <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={() => router.back()}>
          Cancel
        </Button>
        <Button size="sm" loading={saving} onClick={handleSave}>
          <Save className="w-4 h-4" />
          Save GRN
        </Button>
      </PageHeader>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
        {/* ── Left: Header ── */}
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <Card>
            <CardHeader>
              <h3 className="font-semibold text-slate-900 text-sm">
                Receipt Details
              </h3>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardBody className="space-y-4">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
                  Supplier <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
                </label>
                <select
                  value={supplierId}
                  onChange={(e) => setSupplierId(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 text-sm rounded-lg border border-slate-300 bg-white focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500"
                >
                  <option value="">Select supplier…</option>
                  {suppliers?.map((s) => (
                    <option key={s.id} value={s.id}>
                      {s.name}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>

              <Input
                label="Receipt Date"
                type="date"
                value={receiptDate}
                onChange={(e) => setReceiptDate(e.target.value)}
              />

              <div>
                <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
                  Transport Mode
                </label>
                <select
                  value={transportMode}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setTransportMode(e.target.value as TransportMode)
                  }
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 text-sm rounded-lg border border-slate-300 bg-white focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500"
                >
                  <option value="supplier_truck">Supplier Truck</option>
                  <option value="own_truck">Our Truck</option>
                  <option value="client_truck">Client Truck</option>
                  <option value="courier">Courier</option>
                  <option value="hand_delivery">Hand Delivery</option>
                </select>
              </div>

              <Input
                label="Vehicle No."
                placeholder="e.g. GJ01AB1234"
                value={vehicleNo}
                onChange={(e) => setVehicleNo(e.target.value)}
              />

              <Input
                label="Driver Name"
                placeholder="Driver's name"
                value={driverName}
                onChange={(e) => setDriverName(e.target.value)}
              />

              <Input
                label="Supplier Challan No."
                placeholder="Supplier's delivery challan ref"
                value={challanNo}
                onChange={(e) => setChallanNo(e.target.value)}
              />

              <Input
                label="Invoice No."
                placeholder="Supplier's invoice number"
                value={invoiceNo}
                onChange={(e) => setInvoiceNo(e.target.value)}
              />

              <Textarea
                label="Notes"
                placeholder="Any notes about this delivery…"
                value={notes}
                onChange={(e) => setNotes(e.target.value)}
              />
            </CardBody>
          </Card>

          {/* Summary */}
          <Card>
            <CardHeader>
              <h3 className="font-semibold text-slate-900 text-sm">Summary</h3>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardBody className="space-y-2">
              <div className="flex justify-between text-sm">
                <span className="text-slate-500">Subtotal</span>
                <span className="font-medium">{formatCurrency(subtotal)}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between text-sm">
                <span className="text-slate-500">GST</span>
                <span className="font-medium">{formatCurrency(gstAmount)}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between text-base font-bold border-t border-slate-100 pt-2 mt-2">
                <span>Total</span>
                <span className="text-teal-600">
                  {formatCurrency(totalAmount)}
                </span>
              </div>
            </CardBody>
          </Card>
        </div>

        {/* ── Right: Lines ── */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-2">
          <Card>
            <CardHeader>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <h3 className="font-semibold text-slate-900 text-sm">
                  Items Received
                  <span className="ml-2 text-xs font-normal text-slate-400">
                    {lines.length} line{lines.length !== 1 ? "s" : ""}
                  </span>
                </h3>
                <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={addLine}>
                  <Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  Add Item
                </Button>
              </div>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardBody className="p-0">
              <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                <table className="w-full text-sm">
                  <thead>
                    <tr className="bg-slate-50 border-b border-slate-100">
                      <th className="text-left px-3 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500">
                        Item
                      </th>
                      <th className="text-right px-3 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 w-24">
                        Ordered
                      </th>
                      <th className="text-right px-3 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 w-24">
                        Received
                      </th>
                      <th className="text-left px-3 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 w-16">
                        Unit
                      </th>
                      <th className="text-right px-3 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 w-28">
                        Rate (₹)
                      </th>
                      <th className="text-center px-3 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 w-16">
                        GST%
                      </th>
                      <th className="text-right px-3 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 w-28">
                        Line Total
                      </th>
                      <th className="w-8"></th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-50">
                    {lines.map((line, i) => (
                      <tr key={i} className="group">
                        <td className="px-3 py-2">
                          <select
                            value={line.item_id}
                            onChange={(e) => selectItem(i, e.target.value)}
                            className="w-full px-2 py-1.5 text-xs rounded border border-slate-200 bg-white focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-teal-500 min-w-[200px]"
                          >
                            <option value="">Select item…</option>
                            {items?.map((item) => (
                              <option key={item.id} value={item.id}>
                                [{item.item_code}] {item.name}
                              </option>
                            ))}
                          </select>
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-3 py-2">
                          <input
                            type="number"
                            min="0"
                            step="any"
                            value={line.qty_ordered || ""}
                            placeholder="—"
                            onChange={(e) =>
                              updateLine(
                                i,
                                "qty_ordered",
                                Number(e.target.value)
                              )
                            }
                            className="w-full px-2 py-1.5 text-xs rounded border border-slate-200 text-right focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-teal-500"
                          />
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-3 py-2">
                          <input
                            type="number"
                            min="0.0001"
                            step="any"
                            value={line.qty_received}
                            onChange={(e) =>
                              updateLine(
                                i,
                                "qty_received",
                                Number(e.target.value)
                              )
                            }
                            className="w-full px-2 py-1.5 text-xs rounded border border-slate-200 text-right focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-teal-500"
                          />
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-3 py-2">
                          <input
                            type="text"
                            value={line.unit_name || "—"}
                            readOnly
                            className="w-full px-2 py-1.5 text-xs rounded border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 text-center text-slate-500 focus:outline-none"
                          />
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-3 py-2">
                          <input
                            type="number"
                            min="0"
                            step="any"
                            value={line.rate}
                            onChange={(e) =>
                              updateLine(i, "rate", Number(e.target.value))
                            }
                            className="w-full px-2 py-1.5 text-xs rounded border border-slate-200 text-right focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-teal-500"
                          />
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-3 py-2">
                          <select
                            value={line.gst_percent}
                            onChange={(e) =>
                              updateLine(
                                i,
                                "gst_percent",
                                e.target.value as GstRate
                              )
                            }
                            className="w-full px-1.5 py-1.5 text-xs rounded border border-slate-200 text-center focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-teal-500"
                          >
                            {["0", "5", "12", "18", "28"].map((r) => (
                              <option key={r} value={r}>
                                {r}%
                              </option>
                            ))}
                          </select>
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-3 py-2 text-right tabular-nums">
                          <div className="font-semibold text-xs text-slate-900">
                            {formatCurrency(lineSubtotal(line))}
                          </div>
                          <div className="text-xs text-slate-400">
                            +{formatCurrency(lineGst(line))}
                          </div>
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-2 py-2">
                          {lines.length > 1 && (
                            <button
                              onClick={() => removeLine(i)}
                              className="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 text-slate-300 hover:text-red-500 transition-all"
                            >
                              <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                            </button>
                          )}
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                  <tfoot>
                    <tr className="bg-slate-50 border-t border-slate-200">
                      <td
                        colSpan={6}
                        className="px-3 py-2.5 text-right text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase"
                      >
                        Subtotal
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-3 py-2.5 text-right tabular-nums font-semibold text-xs">
                        {formatCurrency(subtotal)}
                      </td>
                      <td></td>
                    </tr>
                    <tr className="bg-slate-50">
                      <td
                        colSpan={6}
                        className="px-3 py-1.5 text-right text-xs text-slate-500"
                      >
                        GST
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-3 py-1.5 text-right tabular-nums text-xs text-slate-600">
                        {formatCurrency(gstAmount)}
                      </td>
                      <td></td>
                    </tr>
                    <tr className="bg-teal-50 border-t border-teal-100">
                      <td
                        colSpan={6}
                        className="px-3 py-2.5 text-right font-bold text-slate-700 text-sm"
                      >
                        Total
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-3 py-2.5 text-right tabular-nums font-bold text-teal-600">
                        {formatCurrency(totalAmount)}
                      </td>
                      <td></td>
                    </tr>
                  </tfoot>
                </table>
              </div>
              <div className="px-4 py-3 border-t border-slate-100">
                <button
                  onClick={addLine}
                  className="text-sm text-teal-600 hover:text-teal-700 font-medium flex items-center gap-1.5"
                >
                  <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
                  Add another item
                </button>
              </div>
            </CardBody>
          </Card>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client'

import { useState } from 'react'
import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/client";
import { useOrgId } from "@/lib/hooks/use-tenant";
import { PageHeader } from '@/components/layout/page-header'
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge'
import { TableLoader } from '@/components/ui/spinner'
import { formatCurrency, formatDate } from '@/lib/utils/format'
import { Plus, Search, Eye, Truck } from 'lucide-react'
import Link from 'next/link'
import { Route } from 'next'

function useInboundReceipts(search: string, orgId: string | null) {
  const supabase = createClient();

  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ["inbound-receipts", orgId, search],
    queryFn: async () => {
      if (!orgId) return [];

      let query = supabase
        .from("inbound_receipts")
        .select(
          `
          id, receipt_no, receipt_date, transport_mode,
          vehicle_no, challan_no, invoice_no,
          total_amount, gst_amount, status, created_at,
          supplier:suppliers ( id, name ),
          inbound_receipt_lines ( id )
        `
        )
        .order("created_at", { ascending: false });

      if (search) query = query.ilike("receipt_no", `%${search}%`);

      const { data, error } = await query;
      if (error) throw error;
      return data;
    },
    enabled: !!orgId,
    staleTime: 30 * 1000,
  });
}

const STATUS_COLORS: Record<string, 'success' | 'warning' | 'danger' | 'default'> = {
  received: 'success',
  partial:  'warning',
  pending:  'default',
  cancelled:'danger',
}

const TRANSPORT_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  own_truck:      '🚛 Own Truck',
  supplier_truck: '🚚 Supplier Truck',
  client_truck:   '🚐 Client Truck',
  courier:        '📦 Courier',
  hand_delivery:  '🤝 Hand Delivery',
}

export default function InboundPage() {
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const orgId = useOrgId();
  const { data: receipts, isLoading } = useInboundReceipts(search, orgId);

  const totalValue = (receipts ?? []).reduce(
    (s, r) => s + (r.total_amount ?? 0),
    0
  );

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="Inbound (GRN)"
        description="Goods received notes from suppliers"
      >
        <Link href="/inbound/new">
          <Button size="sm">
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
            New GRN
          </Button>
        </Link>
      </PageHeader>

      {/* Summary */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4 mb-6">
        <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm p-5">
          <p className="text-sm text-slate-500">Total GRNs</p>
          <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-900 mt-1">
            {receipts?.length ?? 0}
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm p-5">
          <p className="text-sm text-slate-500">Total Value Received</p>
          <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-900 mt-1">
            {formatCurrency(totalValue)}
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm p-5">
          <p className="text-sm text-slate-500">This Month</p>
          <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-900 mt-1">
            {receipts?.filter((r) => {
              const d = new Date(r.created_at);
              const now = new Date();
              return (
                d.getMonth() === now.getMonth() &&
                d.getFullYear() === now.getFullYear()
              );
            }).length ?? 0}
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Search */}
      <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm mb-6">
        <div className="px-5 py-4 flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="relative flex-1 max-w-sm">
            <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-slate-400" />
            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder="Search by GRN number…"
              value={search}
              onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full pl-9 pr-4 py-2 text-sm rounded-lg border border-slate-300 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-transparent"
            />
          </div>
          <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 ml-auto">
            {receipts?.length ?? 0} receipts
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Table */}
      <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm overflow-hidden">
        {isLoading ? (
          <TableLoader />
        ) : (
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full text-sm">
              <thead>
                <tr className="bg-slate-50 border-b border-slate-200">
                  <th className="text-left px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                    GRN No.
                  </th>
                  <th className="text-left px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                    Supplier
                  </th>
                  <th className="text-left px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                    Date
                  </th>
                  <th className="text-left px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                    Transport
                  </th>
                  <th className="text-left px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                    Challan / Invoice
                  </th>
                  <th className="text-center px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                    Lines
                  </th>
                  <th className="text-right px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                    Value
                  </th>
                  <th className="text-center px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                    Status
                  </th>
                  <th className="text-center px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                    View
                  </th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-50">
                {receipts?.length === 0 && (
                  <tr>
                    <td
                      colSpan={9}
                      className="text-center py-12 text-slate-400 text-sm"
                    >
                      No GRNs found
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                )}
                {receipts?.map((r: any) => (
                  <tr
                    key={r.id}
                    className="hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors"
                  >
                    <td className="px-4 py-3">
                      <Link
                        href={`/inbound/${r.id}` as Route}
                        className="font-mono text-sm font-semibold text-teal-600 hover:underline"
                      >
                        {r.receipt_no}
                      </Link>
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3 font-medium text-slate-900">
                      {r.supplier?.name}
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3 text-slate-600">
                      {formatDate(r.receipt_date)}
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3 text-xs text-slate-600">
                      {TRANSPORT_LABELS[r.transport_mode] ?? r.transport_mode}
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3">
                      <div className="text-xs text-slate-600">
                        {r.challan_no ?? "—"}
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-xs text-slate-400">
                        {r.invoice_no ?? ""}
                      </div>
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3 text-center">
                      <span className="text-slate-700 font-medium">
                        {r.inbound_receipt_lines?.length ?? 0}
                      </span>
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right tabular-nums">
                      <div className="font-semibold text-slate-900">
                        {formatCurrency(r.total_amount)}
                      </div>
                      {r.gst_amount > 0 && (
                        <div className="text-xs text-slate-400">
                          +{formatCurrency(r.gst_amount)} GST
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3 text-center">
                      <Badge variant={STATUS_COLORS[r.status] ?? "default"}>
                        {r.status}
                      </Badge>
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3 text-center">
                      <Link href={`/inbound/${r.id}` as Route}>
                        <button className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:text-teal-600 hover:bg-teal-50 transition-colors">
                          <Eye className="w-4 h-4" />
                        </button>
                      </Link>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client'

import { useState } from 'react'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { useItems } from '@/lib/hooks/use-items'
import { adjustInventory } from '@/lib/utils/inventory'
import { PageHeader } from '@/components/layout/page-header'
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'
import { Input, Textarea } from '@/components/ui/input'
import { Card, CardBody, CardHeader } from '@/components/ui/card'
import { toast } from 'sonner'
import { Save, AlertTriangle } from 'lucide-react'
import { useOrgId } from "@/lib/hooks/use-tenant";

export default function AdjustInventoryPage() {
const router = useRouter();
const orgId = useOrgId();
const { data: items, isLoading: itemsLoading } = useItems();

  const [itemId, setItemId] = useState('')
  const [delta, setDelta] = useState('')
  const [reason, setReason] = useState('')
  const [refId, setRefId] = useState('')
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false)

  async function handleSave() {
    if (!itemId) { toast.error('Please select an item'); return }
    if (!delta || Number(delta) === 0) { toast.error('Delta cannot be zero'); return }
    if (!reason.trim()) { toast.error('A reason is required for manual adjustments'); return }

    if (!orgId) {
      toast.error("Organization not loaded");
      return;
    }

    setSaving(true)
    try {
      await adjustInventory({
        itemId,
        delta: Number(delta),
        reason: reason.trim(),
        refId: refId.trim() || undefined,
      })

      toast.success('Stock adjusted successfully')
      router.push('/inventory')
    } catch (err: unknown) {
        toast.error(
          `Adjustment failed: ${err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Unknown error'}`
        )
      } finally {
      setSaving(false)
    }
  }

  const selectedItem = items?.find(i => i.id === itemId)

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="Manual Stock Adjustment"
        description="Add or remove stock for physical reconciliation or write-offs"
      >
        <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={() => router.back()}>
          Cancel
        </Button>
        <Button size="sm" loading={saving} onClick={handleSave}>
          <Save className="w-4 h-4" />
          Save Adjustment
        </Button>
      </PageHeader>

      <div className="mb-6 flex items-start gap-3 bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 rounded-xl px-5 py-3">
        <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-600 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
        <div className="text-sm text-amber-800 space-y-1">
          <p>
            <strong>Warning:</strong> Manual adjustments bypass the standard
            sales/production workflow.
          </p>
          <p>
            Use a <strong>positive</strong> number to add stock (e.g., found
            extra items during stocktake).
            <br />
            Use a <strong>negative</strong> number to remove stock (e.g.,
            damaged goods, write-offs).
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="max-w-2xl">
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <h3 className="font-semibold text-slate-900 text-sm">
              Adjustment Details
            </h3>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardBody className="space-y-4">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
                Item <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
              </label>
              <select
                value={itemId}
                onChange={(e) => setItemId(e.target.value)}
                disabled={itemsLoading}
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 text-sm rounded-lg border border-slate-300 bg-white focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 disabled:opacity-50"
              >
                <option value="">Select item…</option>
                {items?.map((item) => (
                  <option key={item.id} value={item.id}>
                    {item.item_code} — {item.name}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>

            {selectedItem && (
              <div className="bg-slate-50 rounded-lg p-3 text-sm">
                <p className="font-semibold text-slate-900">
                  {selectedItem.name}
                </p>
                <p className="text-slate-500 text-xs mt-0.5">Unit: —</p>
              </div>
            )}

            <Input
              label="Adjustment Quantity (Delta)"
              type="number"
              step="any"
              placeholder="e.g. 5 or -2"
              value={delta}
              onChange={(e) => setDelta(e.target.value)}
              required
            />

            <Textarea
              label="Reason for Adjustment"
              placeholder="Explain why this adjustment is necessary…"
              value={reason}
              onChange={(e) => setReason(e.target.value)}
              required
              rows={3}
            />

            <Input
              label="Reference Document ID (Optional)"
              placeholder="UUID of a related document if any"
              value={refId}
              onChange={(e) => setRefId(e.target.value)}
            />
          </CardBody>
        </Card>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client'

import { useState } from 'react'
import { useStockLevels, useReorderAlerts } from '@/lib/hooks/use-stock'
import { PageHeader } from '@/components/layout/page-header'
import { StatCard } from '@/components/ui/card'
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge'
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'
import { TableLoader } from '@/components/ui/spinner'
import { formatQty } from '@/lib/utils/format'
import { useProfile } from '@/lib/hooks/use-profile'
import Link from 'next/link'
import {
  Search, AlertTriangle, Package,
  TrendingDown, CheckCircle2, Filter
} from 'lucide-react'


import { useEffect } from 'react'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'
import { useOrgId } from '@/lib/hooks/use-tenant'
import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";



export default function InventoryPage() {
  const [search, setSearch]     = useState('')
  const [categoryId, setCategoryId] = useState("");
  const [showLowOnly, setShowLowOnly] = useState(false)
  const orgId = useOrgId()

  const { data: profile } = useProfile()
  const canAdjust = profile?.role === 'admin' || profile?.role === 'manager' || profile?.role === 'store'


  const { data: alerts } = useReorderAlerts()
  const { data: stock, isLoading , refetch } = useStockLevels(search)
  const supabase = createClient()


  const { data: categories = [] } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["item-categories", orgId],
    queryFn: async () => {
      if (!orgId) return [];

      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from("item_categories")
        .select("id, name")
        .eq("is_active", true)
        .order("name");

      if (error) throw error;
      return data;
    },
    enabled: !!orgId,
  });


  // GRN created
  // ↓
  // Trigger updates inventory_balance
  // ↓
  // Realtime websocket event fires
  // ↓
  // Inventory page receives event
  // ↓
  // refetch() executes
  // ↓
  // UI updates live
useEffect(() => {
  if (!orgId) return
  const channel = supabase
    .channel(`inventory-balance-${orgId}`)
    .on('postgres_changes', {
      event: 'UPDATE',
      schema: 'public',
      table: 'inventory_balance',
      filter: `org_id=eq.${orgId}`,
    }, () => refetch())
    .subscribe()
  return () => { supabase.removeChannel(channel) }
}, [orgId, supabase, refetch])



  // Apply filters client-side
  const filtered = (stock ?? []).filter(item => {
    if (categoryId && item.category_id !== categoryId) return false;
    if (showLowOnly && !item.below_reorder) return false
    return true
  })

  const totalItems    = stock?.length ?? 0
  const lowStockCount = alerts?.length ?? 0
  const outOfStock    = (stock ?? []).filter(i => i.qty_available && i.qty_available <= 0).length
  const healthyCount  = totalItems - lowStockCount

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="Inventory"
        description="Live stock levels — updated in real time"
      >
        {canAdjust && (
          <Link href="/inventory/adjust">
            <Button size="sm">Adjust Stock</Button>
          </Link>
        )}
      </PageHeader>

      {/* Stats */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 mb-6">
        <StatCard
          label="Total Items"
          value={totalItems}
          icon={<Package className="w-5 h-5" />}
        />
        <StatCard
          label="Healthy Stock"
          value={healthyCount}
          sub="above reorder level"
          icon={<CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5 text-green-600" />}
          className="border-green-100"
        />
        <StatCard
          label="Low Stock"
          value={lowStockCount}
          sub="at or below reorder level"
          icon={<AlertTriangle className="w-5 h-5 text-amber-600" />}
          className={lowStockCount > 0 ? "border-amber-200" : ""}
        />
        <StatCard
          label="Out of Stock"
          value={outOfStock}
          sub="zero available qty"
          icon={<TrendingDown className="w-5 h-5 text-red-600" />}
          className={outOfStock > 0 ? "border-red-200" : ""}
        />
      </div>

      {/* Filters */}
      <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm mb-6">
        <div className="px-5 py-4 flex flex-wrap gap-3 items-center">
          {/* Search */}
          <div className="relative flex-1 min-w-[200px] max-w-xs">
            <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-slate-400" />
            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder="Search items…"
              value={search}
              onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
              className="
                w-full pl-9 pr-4 py-2 text-sm rounded-lg border border-slate-300
                focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-transparent
              "
            />
          </div>

          {/* Category filter */}
          <select
            value={categoryId}
            onChange={(e) => setCategoryId(e.target.value)}
            className="
              px-3 py-2 text-sm rounded-lg border border-slate-300 bg-white
              focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500
            "
          >
            <option value="">All Categories</option>
            {categories.map((c) => (
              <option key={c.id} value={c.id}>
                {c.name}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>

          {/* Low stock toggle */}
          <Button
            variant={showLowOnly ? "primary" : "outline"}
            size="sm"
            onClick={() => setShowLowOnly((v) => !v)}
          >
            <AlertTriangle className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            Low Stock Only
            {lowStockCount > 0 && (
              <span
                className={`
                text-xs px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full font-bold
                ${showLowOnly ? "bg-white/20" : "bg-amber-100 text-amber-700"}
              `}
              >
                {lowStockCount}
              </span>
            )}
          </Button>

          <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 ml-auto">
            {filtered.length} items
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Table */}
      <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm overflow-hidden">
        {isLoading ? (
          <TableLoader />
        ) : (
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full text-sm">
              <thead>
                <tr className="bg-slate-50 border-b border-slate-200">
                  <th className="text-left px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wide">
                    Item Code
                  </th>
                  <th className="text-left px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wide">
                    Name
                  </th>
                  <th className="text-left px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wide">
                    Category
                  </th>
                  <th className="text-right px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wide">
                    On Hand
                  </th>
                  <th className="text-right px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wide">
                    Reserved
                  </th>
                  <th className="text-right px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wide">
                    Available
                  </th>
                  <th className="text-center px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wide">
                    Status
                  </th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-50">
                {filtered.length === 0 && (
                  <tr>
                    <td
                      colSpan={7}
                      className="text-center py-12 text-slate-400 text-sm"
                    >
                      No items found
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                )}
                {filtered.map((item) => {
                  const isLow = item.below_reorder;
                  const isZero = item.qty_available && item.qty_available <= 0;

                  return (
                    <tr
                      key={item.item_id}
                      className={`
                        hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors
                        ${
                          isZero
                            ? "bg-red-50/30"
                            : isLow
                            ? "bg-amber-50/30"
                            : ""
                        }
                      `}
                    >
                      <td className="px-4 py-3">
                        <span className="font-mono text-xs text-slate-500 bg-slate-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded">
                          {item.item_code}
                        </span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-3">
                        <span className="font-medium text-slate-900">
                          {item.name}
                        </span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-3">
                        <Badge variant="default">{item.category ?? "—"}</Badge>
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right text-slate-700 tabular-nums">
                        {formatQty(item.qty_on_hand, item.unit ?? undefined)}
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right tabular-nums">
                        {item.qty_reserved && item.qty_reserved > 0 ? (
                          <span className="text-amber-600 font-medium">
                            {formatQty(
                              item.qty_reserved,
                              item.unit ?? undefined
                            )}
                          </span>
                        ) : (
                          <span className="text-slate-300">—</span>
                        )}
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right font-semibold tabular-nums">
                        <span
                          className={
                            isZero
                              ? "text-red-600"
                              : isLow
                              ? "text-amber-600"
                              : "text-slate-900"
                          }
                        >
                          {formatQty(
                            item.qty_available,
                            item.unit ?? undefined
                          )}
                        </span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-3 text-center">
                        {isZero ? (
                          <Badge variant="danger">Out of Stock</Badge>
                        ) : isLow ? (
                          <Badge variant="warning">Low Stock</Badge>
                        ) : (
                          <Badge variant="success">Healthy</Badge>
                        )}
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  );
                })}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```
