# src/app/(dashboard)/items/[id]/page.tsx

```tsx
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server'
import { notFound } from 'next/navigation'
import { PageHeader } from '@/components/layout/page-header'
import { Card, CardBody, CardHeader } from '@/components/ui/card'
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge'
import { formatCurrency, formatDate, formatQty } from '@/lib/utils/format'
import { Package, TrendingUp, Layers, History } from 'lucide-react'

interface Props {
  params: Promise<{ id: string }>
}

export default async function ItemDetailPage({ params }: Props) {
  const { id } = await params
  const supabase = await createClient()

  // Fetch item + prices + BOM + stock in parallel
  const [
    { data: item },
    { data: prices },
    { data: bom },
    { data: stock },
    { data: recentMovements },
  ] = await Promise.all([
    supabase
      .from("items")
      .select(
        `
        *,
        item_category:item_categories (
          id,
          name
        ),
        material_type:material_types (
          id,
          name
        ),
        unit:units (
          id,
          name
        )
        `
      )
      .eq("id", id)
      .single(),

    supabase
      .from("item_prices")
      .select("*, supplier:suppliers(name)")
      .eq("item_id", id)
      .order("effective_from", { ascending: false })
      .limit(10),

    supabase
      .from("bom")
      .select(
        `
          id, qty_per_unit, unit_id, notes, is_active,

          unit:units (
            id,
            name
          ),

          component:items!bom_component_id_fkey(
            id,
            item_code,
            name,
            unit_id
          )
      `
      )
      .eq("finished_item_id", id)
      .eq("is_active", true),

    supabase.from("v_stock_levels").select("*").eq("item_id", id).single(),

    supabase
      .from("stock_movements")
      .select(
        "id, movement_type, qty, rate_at_time, movement_date, notes, ref_type"
      )
      .eq("item_id", id)
      .order("created_at", { ascending: false })
      .limit(10),
  ]);

  if (!item) notFound()

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title={item.name}
        description={`${item.item_code} · ${
          item.item_category?.name ?? "—"
        } · ${item.unit?.name ?? "—"}`}
      />

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
        {/* ── Left column: Details + Stock ── */}
        <div className="space-y-6">
          {/* Item details */}
          <Card>
            <CardHeader>
              <h3 className="font-semibold text-slate-900 text-sm flex items-center gap-2">
                <Package className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600" />
                Item Details
              </h3>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardBody className="space-y-3">
              <Row
                label="Item Code"
                value={
                  <code className="font-mono text-xs bg-slate-100 px-2 py-0.5 rounded">
                    {item.item_code}
                  </code>
                }
              />
              <Row
                label="Category"
                value={
                  <Badge variant="default">
                    {item.item_category?.name ?? "—"}
                  </Badge>
                }
              />
              <Row label="Sub-Category" value={item.sub_category ?? "—"} />
              <Row label="Material" value={item.material_type?.name ?? "—"} />
              <Row label="Unit" value={item.unit?.name ?? "—"} />
              <Row label="HSN Code" value={item.hsn_code ?? "—"} />
              <Row label="Size / Spec" value={item.size_spec ?? "—"} />
              <Row
                label="Type"
                value={
                  <div className="flex gap-1">
                    {item.is_traded && <Badge variant="info">Traded</Badge>}
                    {item.is_manufactured && (
                      <Badge variant="purple">Manufactured</Badge>
                    )}
                    {item.is_raw_material && (
                      <Badge variant="teal">Raw Material</Badge>
                    )}
                  </div>
                }
              />
              {item.notes && (
                <div className="pt-2 border-t border-slate-100">
                  <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">{item.notes}</p>
                </div>
              )}
            </CardBody>
          </Card>

          {/* Stock levels */}
          {stock && (
            <Card>
              <CardHeader>
                <h3 className="font-semibold text-slate-900 text-sm flex items-center gap-2">
                  <TrendingUp className="w-4 h-4 text-teal-600" />
                  Stock Levels
                </h3>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardBody className="space-y-3">
                <Row
                  label="On Hand"
                  value={
                    <span className="font-semibold">
                      {formatQty(stock.qty_on_hand, stock.unit ?? undefined)}
                    </span>
                  }
                />
                <Row
                  label="Reserved"
                  value={
                    stock.qty_reserved && stock.qty_reserved > 0 ? (
                      <span className="text-amber-600 font-medium">
                        {formatQty(stock.qty_reserved, stock.unit ?? undefined)}
                      </span>
                    ) : (
                      "—"
                    )
                  }
                />
                <Row
                  label="Available"
                  value={
                    <span
                      className={`font-bold text-base ${
                        stock.below_reorder
                          ? "text-amber-600"
                          : "text-green-600"
                      }`}
                    >
                      {formatQty(stock.qty_available, stock.unit ?? undefined)}
                    </span>
                  }
                />
                <Row
                  label="Reorder At"
                  value={formatQty(
                    stock.reorder_level,
                    stock.unit ?? undefined
                  )}
                />
                {stock.below_reorder && (
                  <div className="pt-2">
                    <Badge variant="warning">⚠ Below reorder level</Badge>
                  </div>
                )}
              </CardBody>
            </Card>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* ── Right column: Prices + BOM + Movements ── */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-2 space-y-6">
          {/* Price history */}
          <Card>
            <CardHeader>
              <h3 className="font-semibold text-slate-900 text-sm flex items-center gap-2">
                <History className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600" />
                Price History
              </h3>
            </CardHeader>
            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
              <table className="w-full text-sm">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="bg-slate-50 border-b border-slate-100">
                    <th className="text-left px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                      Supplier
                    </th>
                    <th className="text-right px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                      Purchase Rate
                    </th>
                    <th className="text-right px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                      Selling Rate
                    </th>
                    <th className="text-center px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                      GST
                    </th>
                    <th className="text-left px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                      Effective From
                    </th>
                    <th className="text-left px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                      Status
                    </th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-50">
                  {prices?.length === 0 && (
                    <tr>
                      <td
                        colSpan={6}
                        className="text-center py-6 text-slate-400 text-xs"
                      >
                        No price records
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  )}
                  {prices?.map((price) => {
                    const isActive =
                      !price.effective_to ||
                      new Date(price.effective_to) >= new Date();
                    return (
                      <tr
                        key={price.id}
                        className={isActive ? "bg-green-50/40" : ""}
                      >
                        <td className="px-4 py-2.5 text-slate-600">
                          {(price.supplier as any)?.name ?? (
                            <span className="text-slate-400">General</span>
                          )}
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-4 py-2.5 text-right tabular-nums">
                          {formatCurrency(price.selling_rate)}
                          <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 font-normal ml-1">
                            /{item.unit?.name ?? "—"}
                          </span>
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-4 py-2.5 text-right font-semibold tabular-nums">
                          {formatCurrency(price.selling_rate)}
                          <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 font-normal ml-1">
                            /{item.unit?.name ?? "—"}
                          </span>
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-4 py-2.5 text-center text-slate-600">
                          {price.gst_percent}%
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-4 py-2.5 text-slate-600">
                          {formatDate(price.effective_from)}
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-4 py-2.5">
                          {isActive ? (
                            <Badge variant="success">Active</Badge>
                          ) : (
                            <Badge variant="default">
                              Expired {formatDate(price.effective_to)}
                            </Badge>
                          )}
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    );
                  })}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </Card>

          {/* BOM */}
          {item.is_manufactured && (
            <Card>
              <CardHeader>
                <h3 className="font-semibold text-slate-900 text-sm flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Layers className="w-4 h-4 text-purple-600" />
                  Bill of Materials
                  <Badge variant="purple">{bom?.length ?? 0} components</Badge>
                </h3>
              </CardHeader>
              <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                <table className="w-full text-sm">
                  <thead>
                    <tr className="bg-slate-50 border-b border-slate-100">
                      <th className="text-left px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                        Component
                      </th>
                      <th className="text-right px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                        Qty per Unit
                      </th>
                      <th className="text-left px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                        Notes
                      </th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-50">
                    {bom?.length === 0 && (
                      <tr>
                        <td
                          colSpan={3}
                          className="text-center py-6 text-slate-400 text-xs"
                        >
                          No BOM defined
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    )}
                    {bom?.map((line) => (
                      <tr key={line.id}>
                        <td className="px-4 py-2.5">
                          <span className="font-mono text-xs text-slate-400 mr-2">
                            {(line.component as any)?.item_code}
                          </span>
                          <span className="font-medium text-slate-900">
                            {(line.component as any)?.name}
                          </span>
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-4 py-2.5 text-right tabular-nums font-semibold">
                          {formatQty(line.qty_per_unit, line.unit?.name)}
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-4 py-2.5 text-slate-500 text-xs">
                          {line.notes ?? "—"}
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            </Card>
          )}

          {/* Recent stock movements */}
          <Card>
            <CardHeader>
              <h3 className="font-semibold text-slate-900 text-sm">
                Recent Stock Movements
              </h3>
            </CardHeader>
            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
              <table className="w-full text-sm">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="bg-slate-50 border-b border-slate-100">
                    <th className="text-left px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                      Date
                    </th>
                    <th className="text-left px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                      Type
                    </th>
                    <th className="text-right px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                      Qty
                    </th>
                    <th className="text-right px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                      Rate
                    </th>
                    <th className="text-left px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                      Source
                    </th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-50">
                  {recentMovements?.length === 0 && (
                    <tr>
                      <td
                        colSpan={5}
                        className="text-center py-6 text-slate-400 text-xs"
                      >
                        No movements recorded
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  )}
                  {recentMovements?.map((m) => {
                    const isPositive = [
                      "inbound",
                      "produced",
                      "adjustment_in",
                      "returned_client",
                    ].includes(m.movement_type);
                    return (
                      <tr key={m.id}>
                        <td className="px-4 py-2.5 text-slate-500">
                          {formatDate(m.movement_date)}
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-4 py-2.5">
                          <Badge variant={isPositive ? "success" : "danger"}>
                            {m.movement_type.replace("_", " ")}
                          </Badge>
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-4 py-2.5 text-right tabular-nums font-semibold">
                          <span
                            className={
                              isPositive ? "text-green-600" : "text-red-600"
                            }
                          >
                            {isPositive ? "+" : "-"}
                            {formatQty(m.qty, item.unit?.name)}
                          </span>
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-4 py-2.5 text-right tabular-nums text-slate-600">
                          {m.rate_at_time
                            ? formatCurrency(m.rate_at_time)
                            : "—"}
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-4 py-2.5 text-slate-500 text-xs">
                          {m.ref_type?.replace("_", " ") ?? "—"}
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    );
                  })}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </Card>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// Simple label-value row helper
function Row({ label, value }: { label: string; value: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4 text-sm">
      <span className="text-slate-500 flex-shrink-0">{label}</span>
      <span className="text-slate-900 text-right">{value}</span>
    </div>
  )
}
```

# src/app/(dashboard)/items/categories/page.tsx

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { useQuery, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/client";
import { useOrgId } from "@/lib/hooks/use-tenant";
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/layout/page-header";
import { Card, CardBody } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { Plus, Pencil, Power, Search } from "lucide-react";

interface Category {
  id: string;
  code: string;
  name: string;
  description: string | null;
  is_active: boolean;
}

interface CategoryForm {
  code: string;
  name: string;
  description: string;
}

const emptyForm: CategoryForm = {
  code: "",
  name: "",
  description: "",
};

export default function ItemCategoriesPage() {
  const supabase = createClient();
  const orgId = useOrgId();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();

  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [showModal, setShowModal] = useState(false);
  const [editingCategory, setEditingCategory] = useState<Category | null>(null);
  const [form, setForm] = useState<CategoryForm>(emptyForm);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

  const {
    data: categories = [],
    isLoading,
    error,
  } = useQuery<Category[]>({
    queryKey: ["item-categories", orgId],

    queryFn: async () => {
      if (!orgId) return [];

      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from("item_categories")
        .select("id, code, name, description, is_active")
        .eq("org_id", orgId)
        .order("name");

      if (error) throw error;

      return data ?? [];
    },

    enabled: !!orgId,
  });

  const filteredCategories = categories.filter((category) => {
    const term = search.trim().toLowerCase();

    if (!term) return true;

    return (
      category.code.toLowerCase().includes(term) ||
      category.name.toLowerCase().includes(term) ||
      (category.description ?? "").toLowerCase().includes(term)
    );
  });

  function openAddModal() {
    setEditingCategory(null);
    setForm(emptyForm);
    setShowModal(true);
  }

  function openEditModal(category: Category) {
    setEditingCategory(category);

    setForm({
      code: category.code,
      name: category.name,
      description: category.description ?? "",
    });

    setShowModal(true);
  }

  function closeModal() {
    if (saving) return;

    setShowModal(false);
    setEditingCategory(null);
    setForm(emptyForm);
  }

  function updateForm(field: keyof CategoryForm, value: string) {
    setForm((current) => ({
      ...current,
      [field]: value,
    }));
  }

  async function handleSave() {
    if (!orgId) {
      toast.error("Organization not loaded");
      return;
    }

    const code = form.code.trim().toUpperCase();
    const name = form.name.trim();
    const description = form.description.trim();

    if (!code) {
      toast.error("Category code is required");
      return;
    }

    if (!name) {
      toast.error("Category name is required");
      return;
    }

    setSaving(true);

    try {
      if (editingCategory) {
        const { error } = await supabase
          .from("item_categories")
          .update({
            code,
            name,
            description: description || null,
          })
          .eq("id", editingCategory.id)
          .eq("org_id", orgId);

        if (error) throw error;

        toast.success("Category updated");
      } else {
        const { error } = await supabase.from("item_categories").insert({
          org_id: orgId,
          code,
          name,
          description: description || null,
        });

        if (error) throw error;

        toast.success("Category created");
      }

      await queryClient.invalidateQueries({
        queryKey: ["item-categories", orgId],
      });

      closeModal();
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      console.error("CATEGORY SAVE ERROR:", err);

      const message =
        err instanceof Error
          ? err.message
          : typeof err === "object" && err !== null && "message" in err
          ? String(err.message)
          : "Failed to save category";

      toast.error(message);
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  }

  async function toggleCategory(category: Category) {
    if (!orgId) {
      toast.error("Organization not loaded");
      return;
    }

    try {
      const { error } = await supabase
        .from("item_categories")
        .update({
          is_active: !category.is_active,
        })
        .eq("id", category.id)
        .eq("org_id", orgId);

      if (error) throw error;

      await queryClient.invalidateQueries({
        queryKey: ["item-categories", orgId],
      });

      toast.success(
        category.is_active ? "Category deactivated" : "Category activated"
      );
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      console.error("CATEGORY STATUS ERROR:", err);

      const message =
        err instanceof Error
          ? err.message
          : typeof err === "object" && err !== null && "message" in err
          ? String(err.message)
          : "Failed to update category";

      toast.error(message);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="Item Categories"
        description="Manage item categories for your organization"
      >
        <Button size="sm" onClick={openAddModal}>
          <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
          Add Category
        </Button>
      </PageHeader>

      {/* Search */}
      <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm mb-6">
        <div className="px-5 py-4 flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="relative flex-1 max-w-sm">
            <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-slate-400" />

            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder="Search categories…"
              value={search}
              onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full pl-9 pr-4 py-2 text-sm rounded-lg border border-slate-300 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-transparent"
            />
          </div>

          <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 ml-auto">
            {filteredCategories.length} categories
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Categories */}
      <Card>
        <CardBody>
          {isLoading ? (
            <div className="py-10 text-center text-sm text-slate-500">
              Loading categories...
            </div>
          ) : error ? (
            <div className="py-10 text-center text-sm text-red-500">
              Failed to load categories
            </div>
          ) : filteredCategories.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="py-10 text-center text-sm text-slate-500">
              {search
                ? "No categories match your search."
                : "No item categories found."}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
              <table className="w-full text-sm">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="bg-slate-50 border-b border-slate-200">
                    <th className="text-left px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                      Code
                    </th>

                    <th className="text-left px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                      Name
                    </th>

                    <th className="text-left px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                      Description
                    </th>

                    <th className="text-left px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                      Status
                    </th>

                    <th className="text-right px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                      Actions
                    </th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>

                <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
                  {filteredCategories.map((category) => (
                    <tr key={category.id} className="hover:bg-slate-50">
                      <td className="px-4 py-3">
                        <span className="font-mono text-sm text-slate-600">
                          {category.code}
                        </span>
                      </td>

                      <td className="px-4 py-3">
                        <span className="font-medium text-slate-700">
                          {category.name}
                        </span>
                      </td>

                      <td className="px-4 py-3 text-sm text-slate-500">
                        {category.description || "—"}
                      </td>

                      <td className="px-4 py-3">
                        <Badge
                          variant={category.is_active ? "success" : "default"}
                        >
                          {category.is_active ? "Active" : "Inactive"}
                        </Badge>
                      </td>

                      <td className="px-4 py-3">
                        <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
                          <Button
                            variant="outline"
                            size="sm"
                            onClick={() => openEditModal(category)}
                          >
                            <Pencil className="w-4 h-4 mr-1" />
                            Edit
                          </Button>

                          <Button
                            variant="outline"
                            size="sm"
                            onClick={() => toggleCategory(category)}
                          >
                            <Power className="w-4 h-4 mr-1" />
                            {category.is_active ? "Deactivate" : "Activate"}
                          </Button>
                        </div>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          )}
        </CardBody>
      </Card>

      {/* Add / Edit Modal */}
      {showModal && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/40 px-4">
          <div className="w-full max-w-lg rounded-xl bg-white shadow-xl">
            <div className="border-b border-slate-200 px-6 py-4">
              <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold text-slate-900">
                {editingCategory ? "Edit Item Category" : "Add Item Category"}
              </h2>

              <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500">
                {editingCategory
                  ? "Update the category details."
                  : "Create a category for your organization."}
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-4 px-6 py-5">
              <div>
                <label className="mb-1.5 block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700">
                  Code
                </label>

                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={form.code}
                  onChange={(e) => updateForm("code", e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="e.g. CONDUCTOR"
                  disabled={saving}
                  className="w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500/20 disabled:bg-slate-100"
                />

                <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">
                  Used as the unique internal category code.
                </p>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="mb-1.5 block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700">
                  Name
                </label>

                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={form.name}
                  onChange={(e) => updateForm("name", e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="e.g. Conductor"
                  disabled={saving}
                  className="w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500/20 disabled:bg-slate-100"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="mb-1.5 block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700">
                  Description
                </label>

                <textarea
                  value={form.description}
                  onChange={(e) => updateForm("description", e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Optional description"
                  rows={3}
                  disabled={saving}
                  className="w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500/20 disabled:bg-slate-100"
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex justify-end gap-3 border-t border-slate-200 px-6 py-4">
              <Button variant="outline" onClick={closeModal} disabled={saving}>
                Cancel
              </Button>

              <Button onClick={handleSave} disabled={saving}>
                {saving
                  ? "Saving..."
                  : editingCategory
                  ? "Save Changes"
                  : "Create Category"}
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client'

import { useState } from 'react'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'
import { useOrgId } from '@/lib/hooks/use-tenant'
import { PageHeader } from '@/components/layout/page-header'
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'
import { Card, CardBody, CardHeader } from '@/components/ui/card'
import { parseSpreadsheet, type RowResult } from '@/lib/utils/spreadsheet-import'
import { validateBomRow, type BomImportRow } from '@/lib/utils/bom-import'
import { toast } from 'sonner'
import { Upload, CheckCircle2, XCircle, Save } from 'lucide-react'

export default function ImportBomPage() {
  const router = useRouter()
  const supabase = createClient()
  const orgId = useOrgId()

  const [rows, setRows] = useState<RowResult<BomImportRow>[]>([])
  const [fileName, setFileName] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [parsing, setParsing] = useState(false)
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false)

  const validRows = rows.filter((r) => r.errors.length === 0)
  const invalidRows = rows.filter((r) => r.errors.length > 0)

  async function handleFile(file: File) {
    if (!orgId) {
      toast.error('Organization not loaded yet — try again in a moment')
      return
    }

    setParsing(true)
    setFileName(file.name)
    try {
      // Pull every item code for this org once, so codes in the sheet can be
      // resolved to UUIDs without a round trip per row.
      const { data: items, error } = await supabase
        .from('items')
        .select('id, item_code')
      if (error) throw error

      const itemsByCode = new Map(
        (items ?? []).map((i) => [i.item_code.toUpperCase(), i.id])
      )


      const { data: units, error: unitsError } = await supabase
        .from("units")
        .select("id, name")
        .eq("is_active", true)
        .order("name");

      if (unitsError) throw unitsError;

      const unitsByName = new Map(
        (units ?? []).map((u) => [u.name.toLowerCase(), u.id])
      );

      const parsed = await parseSpreadsheet(file)
      if (parsed.length === 0) {
        toast.error('No rows found in that file')
        setRows([])
        return
      }
      const results = parsed.map((raw, i) =>
        validateBomRow(raw, i + 2, itemsByCode, unitsByName)
      );
      setRows(results)
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error('Could not read that file — is it a valid .xlsx or .csv?')
      console.error(err)
    } finally {
      setParsing(false)
    }
  }

  async function handleImport() {
    if (!orgId) {
      toast.error('Organization not loaded')
      return
    }
    if (validRows.length === 0) {
      toast.error('No valid rows to import')
      return
    }

    setSaving(true)
    try {
      const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser()

    const payload = validRows.map((r) => ({
      finished_item_id: r.data!.finished_item_id,
      component_id: r.data!.component_id,
      qty_per_unit: r.data!.qty_per_unit,
      unit_id: r.data!.unit_id,
      notes: r.data!.notes,
      org_id: orgId,
      created_by: user?.id ?? null,
    }));

        const { error } = await supabase
            .from('bom')
            .upsert(payload, {
            onConflict: 'finished_item_id,component_id',
            })

      if (error) throw error

      toast.success(`Imported ${validRows.length} BOM line${validRows.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}`)
      router.push('/items')
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      toast.error(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Import failed')
    } finally {
      setSaving(false)
    }
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="Import Bill of Materials"
        description="Bulk-add BOM lines by referencing items by their item code"
      >
        <a
          href="/templates/bom-import-template.xlsx"
          download
          className="inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-slate-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium hover:bg-slate-50"
        >
          Download Template
        </a>
        <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={() => router.back()}>
          Cancel
        </Button>
        {validRows.length > 0 && (
          <Button size="sm" loading={saving} onClick={handleImport}>
            <Save className="w-4 h-4" />
            Import {validRows.length} line{validRows.length !== 1 ? "s" : ""}
          </Button>
        )}
      </PageHeader>

      <Card className="mb-6">
        <CardBody>
          <label className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2 border-2 border-dashed border-slate-200 rounded-lg py-10 cursor-pointer hover:border-blue-300 hover:bg-blue-50/30 transition-colors">
            <Upload className="w-6 h-6 text-slate-400" />
            <span className="text-sm text-slate-600">
              {fileName ?? "Click to choose a .xlsx, .xls, or .csv file"}
            </span>
            <span className="text-xs text-slate-400">
              Columns: finished_item_code, component_item_code, qty_per_unit,
              unit, notes — codes must already exist in Items
            </span>
            <input
              type="file"
              accept=".xlsx,.xls,.csv"
              className="hidden"
              onChange={(e) => {
                const file = e.target.files?.[0];
                if (file) handleFile(file);
              }}
            />
          </label>
        </CardBody>
      </Card>

      {parsing && (
        <p className="text-sm text-slate-500">
          Reading file and matching item codes…
        </p>
      )}

      {rows.length > 0 && (
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-4 text-sm">
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-green-600 font-medium">
                <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4" /> {validRows.length} valid
              </span>
              {invalidRows.length > 0 && (
                <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-red-600 font-medium">
                  <XCircle className="w-4 h-4" /> {invalidRows.length} with
                  errors
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardBody className="p-0">
            <div className="overflow-x-auto max-h-[500px] overflow-y-auto">
              <table className="w-full text-xs">
                <thead className="sticky top-0 bg-slate-50">
                  <tr className="border-b border-slate-100">
                    <th className="text-left px-3 py-2 font-semibold text-slate-500">
                      Row
                    </th>
                    <th className="text-left px-3 py-2 font-semibold text-slate-500">
                      Finished Item
                    </th>
                    <th className="text-left px-3 py-2 font-semibold text-slate-500">
                      Component
                    </th>
                    <th className="text-left px-3 py-2 font-semibold text-slate-500">
                      Qty/Unit
                    </th>
                    <th className="text-left px-3 py-2 font-semibold text-slate-500">
                      Issues
                    </th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-50">
                  {rows.map((r) => (
                    <tr
                      key={r.rowNumber}
                      className={r.errors.length > 0 ? "bg-red-50/50" : ""}
                    >
                      <td className="px-3 py-2 text-slate-400">
                        {r.rowNumber}
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-3 py-2 font-medium text-slate-700">
                        {String(r.raw.finished_item_code ?? "—")}
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-3 py-2 text-slate-600">
                        {String(r.raw.component_item_code ?? "—")}
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-3 py-2 text-slate-600">
                        {String(r.raw.qty_per_unit ?? "—")}
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-3 py-2 text-red-600">
                        {r.errors.length > 0 ? (
                          r.errors.join("; ")
                        ) : (
                          <span className="text-green-600">OK</span>
                        )}
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/client";
import { useOrgId } from "@/lib/hooks/use-tenant";
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/layout/page-header";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardBody, CardHeader } from "@/components/ui/card";
import {
  parseSpreadsheet,
  type RowResult,
} from "@/lib/utils/spreadsheet-import";
import { validateItemRow, type ItemImportRow } from "@/lib/utils/item-import";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { Upload, CheckCircle2, XCircle, Save } from "lucide-react";
import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";

export default function ImportItemsPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const supabase = createClient();
  const orgId = useOrgId();

  const { data: categories = [], isLoading: categoriesLoading } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["item-categories", orgId],
    queryFn: async () => {
      if (!orgId) return [];

      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from("item_categories")
        .select("id, code, name")
        .eq("is_active", true)
        .order("name");

      if (error) throw error;
      return data;
    },
    enabled: !!orgId,
  });

  const { data: materialTypes = [], isLoading: materialTypesLoading } =
    useQuery({
      queryKey: ["material-types", orgId],
      queryFn: async () => {
        if (!orgId) return [];

        const { data, error } = await supabase
          .from("material_types")
          .select("id, code, name")
          .eq("is_active", true)
          .order("name");

        if (error) throw error;
        return data;
      },
      enabled: !!orgId,
    });

  const { data: units = [], isLoading: unitsLoading } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["units", orgId],
    queryFn: async () => {
      if (!orgId) return [];

      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from("units")
        .select("id, code, name")
        .eq("is_active", true)
        .order("name");

      if (error) throw error;
      return data;
    },
    enabled: !!orgId,
  });

  const [rows, setRows] = useState<RowResult<ItemImportRow>[]>([]);
  const [fileName, setFileName] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [parsing, setParsing] = useState(false);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

  const validRows = rows.filter((r) => r.errors.length === 0);
  const invalidRows = rows.filter((r) => r.errors.length > 0);

  async function handleFile(file: File) {
    if (categoriesLoading || materialTypesLoading || unitsLoading) {
      toast.error("Categories, material types, or units are still loading");
      return;
    }

    if (categories.length === 0) {
      toast.error("No active item categories found for this organization");
      return;
    }

    if (materialTypes.length === 0) {
      toast.error("No active material types found for this organization");
      return;
    }

    if (units.length === 0) {
      toast.error("No active units found for this organization");
      return;
    }

    setParsing(true);
    setFileName(file.name);

    try {
      const parsed = await parseSpreadsheet(file, "Item Import");

      if (parsed.length === 0) {
        toast.error("No rows found in that file");
        setRows([]);
        return;
      }

      const results = parsed.map((raw, i) =>
        validateItemRow(raw, i + 2, categories, materialTypes, units)
      );

      setRows(results);
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error("Could not read that file — is it a valid .xlsx or .csv?");
      console.error(err);
    } finally {
      setParsing(false);
    }
  }

  async function handleImport() {
    if (!orgId) {
      toast.error("Organization not loaded");
      return;
    }

    if (validRows.length === 0) {
      toast.error("No valid rows to import");
      return;
    }

    setSaving(true);

    try {
      const {
        data: { user },
      } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

      console.log("Import user:", user?.id);

      const payload = validRows.map((r) => ({
        ...r.data!,
        org_id: orgId,
        created_by: user?.id ?? null,
      }));

      // Upsert on (org_id, item_code) — re-importing the same code updates
      // the existing row instead of erroring or duplicating.
      const { error } = await supabase
        .from("items")
        .upsert(payload, { onConflict: "org_id,item_code" });

      if (error) throw error;

      toast.success(
        `Imported ${validRows.length} item${validRows.length !== 1 ? "s" : ""}`
      );

      router.push("/items");
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      toast.error(
        err instanceof Error
          ? err.message
          : typeof err === "object" && err !== null && "message" in err
          ? String(err.message)
          : "Import failed"
      );
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="Import Items"
        description="Bulk-add or update items from an Excel or CSV file"
      >
        <a
          href="/api/items/template"
          download
          className="inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-slate-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium hover:bg-slate-50"
        >
          Download Template
        </a>

        <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={() => router.back()}>
          Cancel
        </Button>

        {validRows.length > 0 && (
          <Button size="sm" loading={saving} onClick={handleImport}>
            <Save className="w-4 h-4" />
            Import {validRows.length} item
            {validRows.length !== 1 ? "s" : ""}
          </Button>
        )}
      </PageHeader>

      <Card className="mb-6">
        <CardBody>
          <label className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2 border-2 border-dashed border-slate-200 rounded-lg py-10 cursor-pointer hover:border-blue-300 hover:bg-blue-50/30 transition-colors">
            <Upload className="w-6 h-6 text-slate-400" />

            <span className="text-sm text-slate-600">
              {fileName ?? "Click to choose a .xlsx, .xls, or .csv file"}
            </span>

            <span className="text-xs text-slate-400">
              Columns: item_code, name, category, sub_category, material_type,
              size_spec, unit, hsn_code, is_traded, is_manufactured,
              is_raw_material, reorder_level, reorder_qty, notes
            </span>

            <input
              type="file"
              accept=".xlsx,.xls,.csv"
              className="hidden"
              onChange={(e) => {
                const file = e.target.files?.[0];
                if (file) handleFile(file);
              }}
            />
          </label>
        </CardBody>
      </Card>

      {parsing && <p className="text-sm text-slate-500">Reading file…</p>}

      {rows.length > 0 && (
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-4 text-sm">
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-green-600 font-medium">
                <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                {validRows.length} valid
              </span>

              {invalidRows.length > 0 && (
                <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-red-600 font-medium">
                  <XCircle className="w-4 h-4" />
                  {invalidRows.length} with errors
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
          </CardHeader>

          <CardBody className="p-0">
            <div className="overflow-x-auto max-h-[500px] overflow-y-auto">
              <table className="w-full text-xs">
                <thead className="sticky top-0 bg-slate-50">
                  <tr className="border-b border-slate-100">
                    <th className="text-left px-3 py-2 font-semibold text-slate-500">
                      Row
                    </th>

                    <th className="text-left px-3 py-2 font-semibold text-slate-500">
                      Item Code
                    </th>

                    <th className="text-left px-3 py-2 font-semibold text-slate-500">
                      Name
                    </th>

                    <th className="text-left px-3 py-2 font-semibold text-slate-500">
                      Category
                    </th>

                    <th className="text-left px-3 py-2 font-semibold text-slate-500">
                      Unit
                    </th>

                    <th className="text-left px-3 py-2 font-semibold text-slate-500">
                      Issues
                    </th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>

                <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-50">
                  {rows.map((r) => (
                    <tr
                      key={r.rowNumber}
                      className={r.errors.length > 0 ? "bg-red-50/50" : ""}
                    >
                      <td className="px-3 py-2 text-slate-400">
                        {r.rowNumber}
                      </td>

                      <td className="px-3 py-2 font-medium text-slate-700">
                        {String(r.raw.item_code ?? "—")}
                      </td>

                      <td className="px-3 py-2 text-slate-600">
                        {String(r.raw.name ?? "—")}
                      </td>

                      <td className="px-3 py-2 text-slate-600">
                        {String(r.raw.category ?? "—")}
                      </td>

                      <td className="px-3 py-2 text-slate-600">
                        {String(r.raw.unit ?? "—")}
                      </td>

                      <td className="px-3 py-2 text-red-600">
                        {r.errors.length > 0 ? (
                          r.errors.join("; ")
                        ) : (
                          <span className="text-green-600">OK</span>
                        )}
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </CardBody>
        </Card>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";

import { useQuery, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";

import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/client";

import { useOrgId } from "@/lib/hooks/use-tenant";

import { PageHeader } from "@/components/layout/page-header";

import { Card, CardBody } from "@/components/ui/card";

import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";

import { toast } from "sonner";

import { Plus, Pencil, Power, Search } from "lucide-react";

interface MaterialType {
  id: string;
  code: string;
  name: string;
  description: string | null;
  is_active: boolean;
}

interface MaterialTypeForm {
  code: string;
  name: string;
  description: string;
}

const emptyForm: MaterialTypeForm = {
  code: "",
  name: "",
  description: "",
};

export default function MaterialTypesPage() {
  const supabase = createClient();
  const orgId = useOrgId();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();

  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [showModal, setShowModal] = useState(false);
  const [editingMaterialType, setEditingMaterialType] =
    useState<MaterialType | null>(null);
  const [form, setForm] = useState<MaterialTypeForm>(emptyForm);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

  const {
    data: materialTypes = [],
    isLoading,
    error,
  } = useQuery<MaterialType[]>({
    queryKey: ["material-types", orgId],

    queryFn: async () => {
      if (!orgId) return [];

      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from("material_types")
        .select("id, code, name, description, is_active")
        .eq("org_id", orgId)
        .order("name");

      if (error) throw error;

      return data ?? [];
    },

    enabled: !!orgId,
  });

  const filteredMaterialTypes = materialTypes.filter((materialType) => {
    const term = search.trim().toLowerCase();

    if (!term) return true;

    return (
      materialType.code.toLowerCase().includes(term) ||
      materialType.name.toLowerCase().includes(term) ||
      (materialType.description ?? "").toLowerCase().includes(term)
    );
  });

  function openAddModal() {
    setEditingMaterialType(null);
    setForm(emptyForm);
    setShowModal(true);
  }

  function openEditModal(materialType: MaterialType) {
    setEditingMaterialType(materialType);

    setForm({
      code: materialType.code,
      name: materialType.name,
      description: materialType.description ?? "",
    });

    setShowModal(true);
  }

  function closeModal() {
    if (saving) return;

    setShowModal(false);
    setEditingMaterialType(null);
    setForm(emptyForm);
  }

  function updateForm(field: keyof MaterialTypeForm, value: string) {
    setForm((current) => ({
      ...current,
      [field]: value,
    }));
  }

  async function handleSave() {
    if (!orgId) {
      toast.error("Organization not loaded");
      return;
    }

    const code = form.code.trim().toUpperCase();
    const name = form.name.trim();
    const description = form.description.trim();

    if (!code) {
      toast.error("Material type code is required");
      return;
    }

    if (!name) {
      toast.error("Material type name is required");
      return;
    }

    setSaving(true);

    try {
      if (editingMaterialType) {
        const { error } = await supabase
          .from("material_types")
          .update({
            code,
            name,
            description: description || null,
          })
          .eq("id", editingMaterialType.id)
          .eq("org_id", orgId);

        if (error) throw error;

        toast.success("Material type updated");
      } else {
        const { error } = await supabase.from("material_types").insert({
          org_id: orgId,
          code,
          name,
          description: description || null,
        });

        if (error) throw error;

        toast.success("Material type created");
      }

      await queryClient.invalidateQueries({
        queryKey: ["material-types", orgId],
      });

      closeModal();
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      console.error("MATERIAL TYPE SAVE ERROR:", err);

      const message =
        err instanceof Error
          ? err.message
          : typeof err === "object" && err !== null && "message" in err
          ? String(err.message)
          : "Failed to save material type";

      toast.error(message);
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  }

  async function toggleMaterialType(materialType: MaterialType) {
    if (!orgId) {
      toast.error("Organization not loaded");
      return;
    }

    try {
      const { error } = await supabase
        .from("material_types")
        .update({
          is_active: !materialType.is_active,
        })
        .eq("id", materialType.id)
        .eq("org_id", orgId);

      if (error) throw error;

      await queryClient.invalidateQueries({
        queryKey: ["material-types", orgId],
      });

      toast.success(
        materialType.is_active
          ? "Material type deactivated"
          : "Material type activated"
      );
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      console.error("MATERIAL TYPE STATUS ERROR:", err);

      const message =
        err instanceof Error
          ? err.message
          : typeof err === "object" && err !== null && "message" in err
          ? String(err.message)
          : "Failed to update material type";

      toast.error(message);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="Material Types"
        description="Manage material types for your organization"
      >
        <Button size="sm" onClick={openAddModal}>
          <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
          Add Material Type
        </Button>
      </PageHeader>

      {/* Search */}
      <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm mb-6">
        <div className="px-5 py-4 flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="relative flex-1 max-w-sm">
            <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-slate-400" />

            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder="Search material types…"
              value={search}
              onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full pl-9 pr-4 py-2 text-sm rounded-lg border border-slate-300 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-transparent"
            />
          </div>

          <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 ml-auto">
            {filteredMaterialTypes.length} material types
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Material Types */}
      <Card>
        <CardBody>
          {isLoading ? (
            <div className="py-10 text-center text-sm text-slate-500">
              Loading material types...
            </div>
          ) : error ? (
            <div className="py-10 text-center text-sm text-red-500">
              Failed to load material types
            </div>
          ) : filteredMaterialTypes.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="py-10 text-center text-sm text-slate-500">
              {search
                ? "No material types match your search."
                : "No material types found."}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
              <table className="w-full text-sm">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="bg-slate-50 border-b border-slate-200">
                    <th className="text-left px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                      Code
                    </th>

                    <th className="text-left px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                      Name
                    </th>

                    <th className="text-left px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                      Description
                    </th>

                    <th className="text-left px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                      Status
                    </th>

                    <th className="text-right px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                      Actions
                    </th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>

                <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
                  {filteredMaterialTypes.map((materialType) => (
                    <tr key={materialType.id} className="hover:bg-slate-50">
                      <td className="px-4 py-3">
                        <span className="font-mono text-sm text-slate-600">
                          {materialType.code}
                        </span>
                      </td>

                      <td className="px-4 py-3">
                        <span className="font-medium text-slate-700">
                          {materialType.name}
                        </span>
                      </td>

                      <td className="px-4 py-3 text-sm text-slate-500">
                        {materialType.description || "—"}
                      </td>

                      <td className="px-4 py-3">
                        <Badge
                          variant={
                            materialType.is_active ? "success" : "default"
                          }
                        >
                          {materialType.is_active ? "Active" : "Inactive"}
                        </Badge>
                      </td>

                      <td className="px-4 py-3">
                        <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
                          <Button
                            variant="outline"
                            size="sm"
                            onClick={() => openEditModal(materialType)}
                          >
                            <Pencil className="w-4 h-4 mr-1" />
                            Edit
                          </Button>

                          <Button
                            variant="outline"
                            size="sm"
                            onClick={() => toggleMaterialType(materialType)}
                          >
                            <Power className="w-4 h-4 mr-1" />
                            {materialType.is_active ? "Deactivate" : "Activate"}
                          </Button>
                        </div>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          )}
        </CardBody>
      </Card>

      {/* Add / Edit Modal */}
      {showModal && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/40 px-4">
          <div className="w-full max-w-lg rounded-xl bg-white shadow-xl">
            <div className="border-b border-slate-200 px-6 py-4">
              <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold text-slate-900">
                {editingMaterialType
                  ? "Edit Material Type"
                  : "Add Material Type"}
              </h2>

              <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500">
                {editingMaterialType
                  ? "Update the material type details."
                  : "Create a material type for your organization."}
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-4 px-6 py-5">
              <div>
                <label className="mb-1.5 block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700">
                  Code
                </label>

                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={form.code}
                  onChange={(e) => updateForm("code", e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="e.g. COPPER"
                  disabled={saving}
                  className="w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500/20 disabled:bg-slate-100"
                />

                <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">
                  Used as the unique internal material type code.
                </p>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="mb-1.5 block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700">
                  Name
                </label>

                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={form.name}
                  onChange={(e) => updateForm("name", e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="e.g. Copper"
                  disabled={saving}
                  className="w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500/20 disabled:bg-slate-100"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="mb-1.5 block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700">
                  Description
                </label>

                <textarea
                  value={form.description}
                  onChange={(e) => updateForm("description", e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Optional description"
                  rows={3}
                  disabled={saving}
                  className="w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500/20 disabled:bg-slate-100"
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex justify-end gap-3 border-t border-slate-200 px-6 py-4">
              <Button variant="outline" onClick={closeModal} disabled={saving}>
                Cancel
              </Button>

              <Button onClick={handleSave} disabled={saving}>
                {saving
                  ? "Saving..."
                  : editingMaterialType
                  ? "Save Changes"
                  : "Create Material Type"}
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { useOrgId } from "@/lib/hooks/use-tenant";
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/layout/page-header";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { TableLoader } from "@/components/ui/spinner";
import { formatCurrency } from "@/lib/utils/format";
import { Search } from "lucide-react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/client";
import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { useItemCategories } from "@/lib/hooks/use-items";

// Fetch items with their current prices joined
function useItemsWithPrices(
  search: string,
  categoryId: string,
  orgId: string | null
) {
  const supabase = createClient();

  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ["items-with-prices", orgId, search, categoryId],

    queryFn: async () => {
      if (!orgId) return [];

      let query = supabase
        .from("items")
        .select(
          `
          id,
          item_code,
          name,
          category_id,
          sub_category,
          material_type_id,

          material_type:material_types (
            id,
            name
          ),

          unit_id,

          unit:units (
            id,
            name
          ),

          size_spec,
          hsn_code,
          is_traded,
          is_manufactured,
          is_raw_material,
          reorder_level,
          is_active
          `
        )
        .eq("is_active", true)
        .order("category_id")
        .order("item_code");

      if (categoryId) {
        query = query.eq("category_id", categoryId);
      }

      if (search) {
        query = query.or(`name.ilike.%${search}%,item_code.ilike.%${search}%`);
      }

      const { data: items, error } = await query;

      if (error) throw error;

      const { data: prices } = await supabase
        .from("v_current_prices")
        .select("item_id, purchase_rate, selling_rate, gst_percent, rate_unit");

      const priceMap = new Map(prices?.map((p) => [p.item_id, p]) ?? []);

      return (
        items?.map((item) => ({
          ...item,
          price: priceMap.get(item.id) ?? null,
        })) ?? []
      );
    },

    enabled: !!orgId,
    staleTime: 3 * 60 * 1000,
  });
}

export default function ItemsPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [categoryId, setCategoryId] = useState("");
  const orgId = useOrgId();

  const { data: categories, isLoading: isCategoriesLoading } =
    useItemCategories();

  const categoryNameById = new Map(
    categories?.map((category) => [category.id, category.name]) ?? []
  );

  const { data: items, isLoading } = useItemsWithPrices(
    search,
    categoryId,
    orgId
  );

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="Items"
        description="Master catalogue — all products, raw materials and traded goods"
      >
        <Button
          variant="outline"
          size="sm"
          onClick={() => router.push("/items/import")}

          Import Items
        </Button>

        <Button
          variant="outline"
          size="sm"
          onClick={() => router.push("/items/import-bom")}
        >
          Import BOM
        </Button>
      </PageHeader>

      {/* Filters */}
      <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm mb-6">
        <div className="px-5 py-4 flex flex-wrap gap-3 items-center">
          <div className="relative flex-1 min-w-[200px] max-w-sm">
            <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-slate-400" />

            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder="Search by name or code…"

              onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
              className="
                w-full pl-9 pr-4 py-2 text-sm rounded-lg border border-slate-300

              "
            />

          <select

          <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 ml-auto">

      </div>

      {/* Table */}
      <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm overflow-hidden">
        {isLoading ? (
          <TableLoader />
        ) : (
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full text-sm">
              <thead>
                <tr className="bg-slate-50 border-b border-slate-200">
                  <th className="text-left px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wide w-28">
                    Code
                  </th>

                  <th className="text-left px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wide">
                    Name
                  </th>

                  <th className="text-left px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wide">
                    Category
                  </th>

                  <th className="text-left px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wide">
                    Material
                  </th>

                  <th className="text-center px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wide">
                    Unit
                  </th>

                  <th className="text-right px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wide">
                    Purchase Rate
                  </th>

                  <th className="text-right px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wide">
                    Selling Rate
                  </th>

                  <th className="text-center px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wide">
                    Type
                  </th>
                </tr>
              </thead>

              <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-50">
                {items?.length === 0 && (
                  <tr>
                    <td
                      colSpan={8}
                      className="text-center py-12 text-slate-400 text-sm"
                    >
                      No items found
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                )}

                {items?.map((item) => (
                  <tr
                    key={item.id}
                    className="hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <td className="px-4 py-3">
                      <Link href={`/items/${item.id}`}>
                        <span className="font-mono text-xs text-blue-600 bg-blue-50 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded hover:underline">
                          {item.item_code}
                        </span>
                      </Link>
                    </td>

                    <td className="px-4 py-3">
                      <Link
                        href={`/items/${item.id}`}
                        className="font-medium text-slate-900 hover:text-blue-600"
                      >
                        {item.name}
                      </Link>

                      {item.size_spec && (
                        <div className="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-0.5 truncate max-w-xs">
                          {item.size_spec}
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </td>

                    <td className="px-4 py-3">
                      <Badge variant="default">
                        {item.category_id
                          ? categoryNameById.get(item.category_id) ?? "—"
                          : "—"}
                      </Badge>
                    </td>

                    <td className="px-4 py-3 text-slate-600">
                      {item.material_type?.name ?? "—"}
                    </td>

                    <td className="px-4 py-3 text-center">
                      <span className="font-mono text-xs text-slate-500">
                        {item.unit?.name ?? "—"}
                      </span>
                    </td>

                    <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right text-slate-700 tabular-nums">
                      {item.price?.purchase_rate ? (
                        formatCurrency(item.price.purchase_rate)
                      ) : (
                        <span className="text-slate-300">—</span>
                      )}
                    </td>

                    <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right font-semibold text-slate-900 tabular-nums">
                      {item.price?.selling_rate ? (
                        formatCurrency(item.price.selling_rate)
                      ) : (
                        <span className="text-slate-300 font-normal">—</span>
                      )}
                    </td>

                    <td className="px-4 py-3">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1">
                        {item.is_traded && <Badge variant="info">Traded</Badge>}

                        {item.is_manufactured && (
                          <Badge variant="purple">Mfg</Badge>
                        )}

                        {item.is_raw_material && (
                          <Badge variant="teal">Raw</Badge>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

# src/app/(dashboard)/layout.tsx

```tsx
import { redirect } from 'next/navigation'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server'
import { Sidebar } from '@/components/layout/sidebar'
import { TenantProvider } from '@/components/providers/tenant-provider'

// This layout wraps every page inside (dashboard)
// It checks auth server-side as a second layer of protection
// and ensures the user belongs to an organization before entering.
export default async function DashboardLayout({
  children,
}: {
  children: React.ReactNode
}) {
  const supabase = await createClient()
  const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser()

  if (!user) {
    redirect('/login')
  }

  // Server-side check: if profile has no org_id, route to onboarding
  const { data: profile } = await supabase
    .from('profiles')
    .select('org_id')
    .eq('id', user.id)
    .maybeSingle()

  if (profile && !profile.org_id) {
    redirect('/onboarding' as any)
  }

  // Manual access switch — flip organizations.access_status in Supabase to
  // 'suspended' and every user in that org gets routed here on next load.
  const { data: isActive } = await supabase.rpc('org_is_active')

  if (isActive === false) {
    redirect('/suspended' as any)
  }

  return (
    <TenantProvider>
      <div className="flex min-h-screen bg-slate-50">

        {/* Fixed sidebar */}
        <Sidebar />

        {/* Main content — offset by sidebar width */}
        <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col ml-64">

          {/* Page content */}
          <main className="flex-1 p-6 animate-fade-in">
            {children}
          </main>

        </div>
      </div>
    </TenantProvider>
  )
}
```

```tsx
                </div>

            ))}
          </div>
  
        </div>
      </div>
    )
  }
```
