```tsx
'use client'

import { useEffect } from 'react'
import { useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'
import { StatCard } from '@/components/ui/card'
import { PageHeader } from '@/components/layout/page-header'
import { OrderStatusBadge } from '@/components/ui/badge'
import { formatCurrency, formatDate, formatQty } from '@/lib/utils/format'
import {
  Package, ShoppingCart, FileText,
  Factory, AlertTriangle,
} from 'lucide-react'
import Link from 'next/link'
import { useOrgId } from '@/lib/hooks/use-tenant'

// ── Data hooks ────────────────────────────────────────────────

function useDashboardStats(orgId: string | null) {



  const supabase = createClient();
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ["dashboard-stats", orgId],
    queryFn: async () => {
      if (!orgId) {
        return {
          pendingApprovals: 0,
          activeOrders: 0,
          inProduction: 0,
        };
      }
      const [
        { count: pendingApprovals },
        { count: activeOrders },
        { count: inProduction },
      ] = await Promise.all([
        supabase
          .from("quotations")
          .select("id", { count: "exact", head: true })
          .eq("status", "pending_approval"),
        supabase
          .from("sales_orders")
          .select("id", { count: "exact", head: true })
          .in("status", ["confirmed", "in_production", "ready"]),
        supabase
          .from("production_orders")
          .select("id", { count: "exact", head: true })
          .eq("status", "in_progress"),
      ]);
      return {
        pendingApprovals: pendingApprovals ?? 0,
        activeOrders: activeOrders ?? 0,
        inProduction: inProduction ?? 0,
      };
    },
    enabled: !!orgId,
    staleTime: 30 * 1000,
  });
}

function useReorderAlerts(orgId: string | null) {
  const supabase = createClient();
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ["reorder-alerts", orgId],
    queryFn: async () => {
      if (!orgId) return [];
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from("v_reorder_alerts")
        .select("*")
        .order("qty_available", { ascending: true })
        .limit(5);
      if (error) throw error;
      return data;
    },
    enabled: !!orgId,
    staleTime: 60 * 1000,
  });
}

function useRecentOrders(orgId: string | null) {
  const supabase = createClient()
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ["recent-orders", orgId],
    queryFn: async () => {
      if (!orgId) return [];
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from("v_so_pipeline")
        .select("*")
        .order("order_date", { ascending: false })
        .limit(6);
      if (error) throw error;
      return data;
    },
    enabled: !!orgId,
    staleTime: 30 * 1000,
  });
}

// ── Component ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

export default function DashboardPage() {
  const supabase = createClient()
  const qc       = useQueryClient()
  const orgId    = useOrgId()

  const { data: stats }        = useDashboardStats(orgId)
  const { data: alerts }       = useReorderAlerts(orgId)
  const { data: recentOrders } = useRecentOrders(orgId)

  const alertCount = alerts?.length ?? 0

  // ── Realtime subscriptions ─────────────────────────────────
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!orgId) return

    const channel = supabase
      .channel(`dashboard-realtime-${orgId}`)

      // Inventory balance changes → refresh reorder alerts + stats
      .on('postgres_changes', {
        event:  'UPDATE',
        schema: 'public',
        table:  'inventory_balance',
        filter: `org_id=eq.${orgId}`,
      }, () => {
        qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['reorder-alerts'] })
      })

      // Sales order changes → refresh recent orders + stats
      .on('postgres_changes', {
        event:  '*',
        schema: 'public',
        table:  'sales_orders',
        filter: `org_id=eq.${orgId}`,
      }, () => {
        qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['recent-orders'] })
        qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['dashboard-stats'] })
      })

      // Quotation changes → refresh pending approval count
      .on('postgres_changes', {
        event:  '*',
        schema: 'public',
        table:  'quotations',
        filter: `org_id=eq.${orgId}`,
      }, () => {
        qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['dashboard-stats'] })
      })

      // Production order changes → refresh in-production count
      .on('postgres_changes', {
        event:  '*',
        schema: 'public',
        table:  'production_orders',
        filter: `org_id=eq.${orgId}`,
      }, () => {
        qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['dashboard-stats'] })
      })

      .subscribe()

    return () => { supabase.removeChannel(channel) }
  }, [orgId, supabase, qc])

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="Dashboard"
        description={`Good ${getGreeting()} — here's what's happening today`}
      />

      {/* ── Stat Cards ── */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 mb-8">
        <StatCard
          label="Low Stock Alerts"
          value={alertCount}
          sub="items below reorder level"
          icon={<AlertTriangle className="w-5 h-5" />}
          className={alertCount > 0 ? 'border-amber-200' : ''}
        />
        <StatCard
          label="Pending Approvals"
          value={stats?.pendingApprovals ?? 0}
          sub="quotations awaiting sign-off"
          icon={<FileText className="w-5 h-5" />}
        />
        <StatCard
          label="Active Orders"
          value={stats?.activeOrders ?? 0}
          sub="confirmed, production, ready"
          icon={<ShoppingCart className="w-5 h-5" />}
        />
        <StatCard
          label="In Production"
          value={stats?.inProduction ?? 0}
          sub="orders on shop floor"
          icon={<Factory className="w-5 h-5" />}
        />
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">

        {/* ── Recent Sales Orders ── */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-2 bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm overflow-hidden">
          <div className="px-5 py-4 border-b border-slate-100 flex items-center justify-between">
            <h3 className="font-semibold text-slate-900 text-sm">Recent Sales Orders</h3>
            <Link href="/sales-orders" className="text-xs text-blue-600 hover:underline">
              View all →
            </Link>
          </div>
          <div className="divide-y divide-slate-50">
            {!recentOrders?.length && (
              <p className="text-sm text-slate-400 text-center py-8">No orders yet</p>
            )}
            {recentOrders?.map((order: any) => (
              <Link
                key={order.id}
                href={`/sales-orders/${order.id}`}
                className="flex items-center justify-between px-5 py-3.5 hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors"
              >
                <div>
                  <div className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-900">
                    {order.so_number}
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-xs text-slate-500">
                    {order.client_name} · {formatDate(order.order_date)}
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                  <div className="text-right">
                    <div className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900">
                      {formatCurrency(order.total_amount)}
                    </div>
                    {order.balance_due > 0 && (
                      <div className="text-xs text-amber-600">
                        {formatCurrency(order.balance_due)} due
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <OrderStatusBadge status={order.status as any} />
                </div>
              </Link>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* ── Low Stock Alerts ── */}
        <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm overflow-hidden">
          <div className="px-5 py-4 border-b border-slate-100 flex items-center justify-between">
            <h3 className="font-semibold text-slate-900 text-sm flex items-center gap-2">
              <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-500" />
              Reorder Alerts
            </h3>
            <Link href="/inventory" className="text-xs text-blue-600 hover:underline">
              View all →
            </Link>
          </div>
          <div className="divide-y divide-slate-50">
            {alerts?.length === 0 && (
              <p className="text-sm text-slate-400 text-center py-8">
                All stock levels healthy ✓
              </p>
            )}
            {alerts?.map((item: any) => (
              <div key={item.item_id} className="px-5 py-3">
                <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                  <div>
                    <div className="text-xs font-mono text-slate-400">
                      {item.item_code}
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-800 leading-tight">
                      {item.name}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-right flex-shrink-0">
                    <div className="text-sm font-bold text-amber-600">
                      {formatQty(item.qty_available, item.unit)}
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-xs text-slate-400">
                      min {formatQty(item.reorder_level)}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

function getGreeting() {
  const h = new Date().getHours()
  if (h < 12) return 'morning'
  if (h < 17) return 'afternoon'
  return 'evening'
}
```

```tsx
'use client'

import { useState } from 'react'
import { useOrgId } from "@/lib/hooks/use-tenant";
import { useParams, useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'
import {
  useProductionOrder,
  useAssignWorker,
} from '@/lib/hooks/use-production'
import { PageHeader } from '@/components/layout/page-header'
import { Card, CardBody, CardHeader } from '@/components/ui/card'
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'
import { Badge, ProductionStatusBadge } from '@/components/ui/badge'
import { PageLoader } from '@/components/ui/spinner'
import { formatDate, formatQty } from '@/lib/utils/format'
import { toast } from 'sonner'
import { ArrowLeft, Users, Package, Plus, Info } from 'lucide-react'

function useWorkers(orgId: string | null) {
  const supabase = createClient();
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ["workers", orgId],
    queryFn: async () => {
      if (!orgId) return [];

      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from("workers")
        .select("id, name, skill")
        .eq("is_active", true)
        .order("name");

      if (error) throw error;
      return data;
    },
    enabled: !!orgId,
    staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000,
  });
}

export default function ProductionDetailPage() {
const { id } = useParams<{ id: string }>();
const router = useRouter();
const orgId = useOrgId();

const { data: order, isLoading } = useProductionOrder(id);
const { mutate: assignWorker, isPending: assigningWorker } = useAssignWorker();
const { data: workers = [] } = useWorkers(orgId);
  const [selectedWorker, setSelectedWorker] = useState('')

  if (isLoading) return <PageLoader />
  if (!order)    return <div className="text-slate-500 text-sm p-6">Production order not found</div>

  const items       = (order.production_order_items as any[]) ?? []
  const assignments = (order.production_assignments as any[]) ?? []
  const creator     = order.creator as any

  const isPending    = order.status === 'pending'
  const isInProgress = order.status === 'in_progress'
  const isCompleted  = order.status === 'completed'
  // Workers can be assigned as long as order isn't completed
  const canAssign    = isPending || isInProgress

  const assignedWorkerIds = assignments.map((a: any) => a.worker?.id)

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title={order.po_number}
        description="Production Order — View Only"
      >
        <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => router.back()}>
          <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
          Back
        </Button>
        {/* ── No Start / Hold / Resume / Complete buttons here ──
            All status transitions happen from My Tasks page only  */}
      </PageHeader>

      {/* Info banner — tells user where to act */}
      {!isCompleted && (
        <div className="mb-6 flex items-start gap-3 bg-blue-50 border border-blue-200 rounded-xl px-5 py-3">
          <Info className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-500 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
          <p className="text-sm text-blue-800">
            To start, pause, or complete this production order, go to{" "}
            <a
              href="/tasks"
              className="font-semibold underline underline-offset-2"
            >
              My Tasks
            </a>
            . This page is for viewing order details only.
          </p>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
        {/* ── Left: Details + Workers ── */}
        <div className="space-y-4">
          {/* Status card */}
          <Card>
            <CardBody className="space-y-3">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <span className="text-sm text-slate-500">Status</span>
                <ProductionStatusBadge status={order.status} />
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between text-sm">
                <span className="text-slate-500">PRD Number</span>
                <span className="font-mono font-bold text-slate-900">
                  {order.po_number}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between text-sm">
                <span className="text-slate-500">Type</span>
                <Badge variant="purple">Standalone</Badge>
              </div>
              {order.start_date && (
                <div className="flex justify-between text-sm">
                  <span className="text-slate-500">Started</span>
                  <span className="text-slate-700">
                    {formatDate(order.start_date)}
                  </span>
                </div>
              )}
              {order.target_date && (
                <div className="flex justify-between text-sm">
                  <span className="text-slate-500">Target</span>
                  <span
                    className={
                      !isCompleted && new Date(order.target_date) < new Date()
                        ? "text-red-500 font-medium"
                        : "text-slate-700"
                    }
                  >
                    {formatDate(order.target_date)}
                  </span>
                </div>
              )}
              {order.completed_date && (
                <div className="flex justify-between text-sm">
                  <span className="text-slate-500">Completed</span>
                  <span className="text-green-600 font-medium">
                    {formatDate(order.completed_date)}
                  </span>
                </div>
              )}
              {creator && (
                <div className="flex justify-between text-sm pt-2 border-t border-slate-100">
                  <span className="text-slate-500">Created By</span>
                  <span className="text-slate-700">{creator.full_name}</span>
                </div>
              )}
              {order.notes && (
                <div className="pt-2 border-t border-slate-100">
                  <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wide mb-1">
                    Notes
                  </p>
                  <p className="text-sm text-slate-700">{order.notes}</p>
                </div>
              )}
            </CardBody>
          </Card>

          {/* Workers — assign still allowed from detail view */}
          <Card>
            <CardHeader>
              <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-2">
                <Users className="w-4 h-4 text-purple-600" />
                Assigned Workers
                <Badge variant="purple">{assignments.length}</Badge>
              </h3>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardBody className="space-y-3">
              {assignments.length === 0 && (
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">
                  No workers assigned yet
                </p>
              )}
              {assignments.map((a: any) => (
                <div key={a.id} className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div>
                    <div className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-900">
                      {a.worker?.name}
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-xs text-slate-400">
                      {a.worker?.skill}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  {a.hours_worked && (
                    <span className="text-xs bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 px-2 py-0.5 rounded">
                      {a.hours_worked}h
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>
              ))}

              {canAssign && (
                <div className="pt-2 border-t border-slate-100 space-y-2">
                  <select
                    value={selectedWorker}
                    onChange={(e) => setSelectedWorker(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full px-3 py-2 text-xs rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-purple-500"
                  >
                    <option value="">Select worker…</option>
                    {workers
                      .filter((w) => !assignedWorkerIds.includes(w.id))
                      .map((w) => (
                        <option key={w.id} value={w.id}>
                          {w.name} — {w.skill}
                        </option>
                      ))}
                  </select>
                  <Button
                    size="sm"
                    variant="secondary"
                    loading={assigningWorker}
                    onClick={() => {
                      if (!selectedWorker) {
                        toast.error("Select a worker");
                        return;
                      }
                      assignWorker(
                        { productionOrderId: id, workerId: selectedWorker },
                        { onSuccess: () => setSelectedWorker("") }
                      );
                    }}
                    className="w-full text-purple-700 bg-purple-50 hover:bg-purple-100"
                  >
                    <Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    Assign Worker
                  </Button>
                </div>
              )}
            </CardBody>
          </Card>
        </div>

        {/* ── Right: Items + reserved materials ── */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-2 space-y-6">
          {/* Finished items */}
          <Card>
            <CardHeader>
              <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-2">
                <Package className="w-4 h-4 text-purple-600" />
                Items to Produce
              </h3>
            </CardHeader>
            <div className="divide-y divide-slate-50">
              {items.map((item: any) => {
                const pct =
                  item.qty_required > 0
                    ? Math.min(
                        100,
                        Math.round(
                          (item.qty_produced / item.qty_required) * 100
                        )
                      )
                    : 0;
                const isDone = pct >= 100;

                return (
                  <div key={item.id} className="px-5 py-4">
                    <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4 mb-2">
                      <div>
                        <span className="font-mono text-xs text-slate-400 bg-slate-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded mr-2">
                          {item.item?.item_code}
                        </span>
                        <span className="font-semibold text-slate-900">
                          {item.item?.name}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-right flex-shrink-0">
                        <div
                          className={`font-bold text-sm ${
                            isDone ? "text-green-600" : "text-slate-900"
                          }`}
                        > 
                          {formatQty(item.qty_produced, item.unit?.name)} /{" "}
                          {formatQty(item.qty_required, item.unit?.name)}
                        </div>
                        {isDone && (
                          <div className="text-xs text-green-600">
                            Complete ✓
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <div className="flex-1 bg-slate-100 rounded-full h-2">
                        <div
                          className={`h-2 rounded-full transition-all ${
                            isDone ? "bg-green-500" : "bg-purple-500"
                          }`}
                          style={{ width: `${pct}%` }}
                        />
                      </div>
                      <span className="text-xs text-slate-500 tabular-nums w-10 text-right">
                        {pct}%
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    {isCompleted && isDone && (
                      <p className="text-xs text-green-600 mt-2">
                        ✓ Added to stock on {formatDate(order.completed_date)}
                      </p>
                    )}
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </Card>

          {/* Reserved raw materials */}
          <ReservedMaterialsCard
            productionOrderId={id}
            orgId={orgId}
            isPending={isPending}
            isInProgress={isInProgress}
          />
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Reserved materials sub-component (view only) ─────────────
function ReservedMaterialsCard({
  productionOrderId,
  orgId,
  isPending,
  isInProgress,
}: {
  productionOrderId: string;
  orgId: string | null;
  isPending: boolean;
  isInProgress: boolean;
}) {
  const supabase = createClient();

  const { data: reservations } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["production-reservations", orgId, productionOrderId],
    queryFn: async () => {
      if (!orgId) return [];

      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from("stock_reservations")
        .select(
          `
          id, qty_reserved, qty_consumed, qty_released, status,
          item:items ( id, item_code, name, unit )
        `
        )
        .eq("ref_type", "production_order")
        .eq("ref_id", productionOrderId)
        .order("created_at");
      if (error) throw error;
      return data ?? [];
    },
    enabled: !!orgId && !!productionOrderId,
    staleTime: 30 * 1000,
  });

  if (!reservations || reservations.length === 0) return null;

  const statusColors: Record<string, any> = {
    active: "warning",
    consumed: "success",
    partially_consumed: "info",
    released: "default",
    expired: "danger",
  };

  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader>
        <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-2">
          <Package className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-600" />
          Reserved Raw Materials
          {isPending && (
            <span className="text-xs font-normal text-slate-400">
              — will be consumed when production is started via My Tasks
            </span>
          )}
          {isInProgress && (
            <span className="text-xs font-normal text-green-600">
              — consumed when production started
            </span>
          )}
        </h3>
      </CardHeader>
      <div className="overflow-x-auto">
        <table className="w-full text-sm">
          <thead>
            <tr className="bg-slate-50 border-b border-slate-100">
              <th className="text-left px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                Material
              </th>
              <th className="text-right px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                Reserved
              </th>
              <th className="text-right px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                Consumed
              </th>
              <th className="text-center px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                Status
              </th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-50">
            {reservations.map((r: any) => (
              <tr key={r.id}>
                <td className="px-4 py-2.5">
                  <span className="font-mono text-xs text-slate-400 bg-slate-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded mr-2">
                    {r.item?.item_code}
                  </span>
                  <span className="font-medium text-slate-900">
                    {r.item?.name}
                  </span>
                </td>
                <td className="px-4 py-2.5 text-right tabular-nums font-semibold text-slate-900">
                  {formatQty(r.qty_reserved, r.item?.unit?.name)}
                </td>
                <td className="px-4 py-2.5 text-right tabular-nums">
                  <span
                    className={
                      r.qty_consumed > 0
                        ? "text-green-600 font-medium"
                        : "text-slate-400"
                    }
                  >
                    {formatQty(r.qty_consumed, r.item?.unit?.name)}
                  </span>
                </td>
                <td className="px-4 py-2.5 text-center">
                  <Badge variant={statusColors[r.status] ?? "default"}>
                    {r.status.replace("_", " ")}
                  </Badge>
                </td>
              </tr>
            ))}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client'



import { useState, useEffect } from 'react'

import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'

import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query'

import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'

import { useOrgId } from '@/lib/hooks/use-tenant'

import { reserveInventory } from '@/lib/utils/inventory'

import { PageHeader } from '@/components/layout/page-header'

import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'

import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input'

import { Card, CardBody, CardHeader } from '@/components/ui/card'

import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge'

import { formatQty } from '@/lib/utils/format'

import { toast } from 'sonner'

import { Trash2, Save, AlertTriangle, CheckCircle, Package } from 'lucide-react'



interface RawMaterialLine {

  item_id:       string

  item_name:     string

  item_code:     string

  unit:          string

  qty_per_unit:  number   // from BOM — per single finished unit

  qty_needed:    number   // qty_per_unit × finishQty — total needed

  qty_available: number

  sufficient:    boolean

  source:        'bom' | 'manual'

}



interface FinishedItem {
  item_id: string;

  item_name: string;

  item_code: string;

  unit_id: string;

  unit: string;
}



function useManufacturedItems(orgId: string | null) {

  const supabase = createClient();



  return useQuery({

    queryKey: ["manufactured-items", orgId],

    queryFn: async () => {

      if (!orgId) return [];



      const { data, error } = await supabase

        .from("items")

        .select(

          `

          id,

          item_code,

          name,

          unit_id,

          category_id,

          unit:units (

            id,

            name

          )

        `

        )

        .eq("is_manufactured", true)

        .eq("is_active", true)

        .order("name");



      if (error) throw error;

      return data ?? [];

    },

    enabled: !!orgId,

    staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000,

  });

}



function useRawMaterialItems(orgId: string | null) {

  const supabase = createClient();



  return useQuery({

    queryKey: ["raw-material-items", orgId],

    queryFn: async () => {

      if (!orgId) return [];



      const { data, error } = await supabase

        .from("items")

        .select(

                  `

          id,

          item_code,

          name,

          unit_id,

          category_id,

          unit:units (

            id,

            name

          )

        `

        )

        .eq("is_raw_material", true)

        .eq("is_active", true)

        .order("name");



      if (error) throw error;

      return data ?? [];

    },

    enabled: !!orgId,

    staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000,

  });

}



export default function NewProductionPage() {

  const router   = useRouter()

  const supabase = createClient()

  const orgId    = useOrgId()



const { data: mfgItems } = useManufacturedItems(orgId);

const { data: rawItems } = useRawMaterialItems(orgId);



  const [finishedItem, setFinishedItem] = useState<FinishedItem | null>(null)

  const [finishQty,    setFinishQty]    = useState<number>(1)

  const [targetDate,   setTargetDate]   = useState('')

  const [notes,        setNotes]        = useState('')



  const [rawMaterials, setRawMaterials] = useState<RawMaterialLine[]>([])

  const [loadingBom,   setLoadingBom]   = useState(false)

  const [bomExists,    setBomExists]    = useState<boolean | null>(null)

  const [saving,       setSaving]       = useState(false)



  const canCreate    = rawMaterials.length > 0 && rawMaterials.every(r => r.sufficient)

  const hasShortage  = rawMaterials.some(r => !r.sufficient)



  // ── Re-fetch BOM when item changes ───────────────────────

  useEffect(() => {

    if (!finishedItem || finishQty <= 0) return

    fetchBomAndStock(finishedItem.item_id, finishQty)

  }, [finishedItem?.item_id])



  // ── Re-multiply ALL lines when finishQty changes ─────────

  // Both BOM and manual lines store qty_per_unit.

  // qty_needed is always qty_per_unit × finishQty.

  useEffect(() => {

    if (rawMaterials.length === 0 || finishQty <= 0) return



    setRawMaterials(prev => prev.map(r => {

      const qtyNeeded = r.qty_per_unit * finishQty

      return {

        ...r,

        qty_needed: qtyNeeded,

        sufficient: r.qty_available >= qtyNeeded,

      }

    }))

  }, [finishQty])



  async function fetchBomAndStock(itemId: string, qty: number) {

    setLoadingBom(true)

    setBomExists(null)

    setRawMaterials([])



    try {

      const { data: bom, error: bomErr } = await supabase

        .from("bom")

        .select(

          `

            id,

            qty_per_unit,

            unit_id,

            notes,

            is_active,



            unit:units (

              id,

              name

            ),



            component:items!bom_component_id_fkey (

              id,

              item_code,

              name,

              unit_id

            )

          `

        )

        .eq("finished_item_id", itemId)

        .eq("is_active", true);



      if (bomErr) throw bomErr



      if (!bom || bom.length === 0) {

        setBomExists(false)

        setLoadingBom(false)

        return

      }



      setBomExists(true)



      const componentIds = bom.map(b => (b.component as any).id)



      const { data: stock } = await supabase

        .from('inventory_balance')

        .select('item_id, available_qty')

        .in('item_id', componentIds)



      const stockMap = new Map(stock?.map(s => [s.item_id, s.available_qty ?? 0]) ?? [])



      // ── KEY FIX: store qty_per_unit separately so qty changes

      //    can re-multiply without a round trip to Supabase ────

      const lines: RawMaterialLine[] = bom.map(b => { 

        const component    = b.component as any

        const qtyPerUnit   = b.qty_per_unit               // e.g. 2 screws per unit

        const qtyNeeded    = qtyPerUnit * qty              // e.g. 2 × 5 = 10 screws

        const qtyAvailable = stockMap.get(component.id) ?? 0



        return {

          item_id:       component.id,

          item_name:     component.name,

          item_code:     component.item_code,

          unit:          b.unit?.name ?? "",

          qty_per_unit:  qtyPerUnit,

          qty_needed:    qtyNeeded,

          qty_available: qtyAvailable,

          sufficient:    qtyAvailable >= qtyNeeded,

          source:        'bom' as const,

        }

      })



      setRawMaterials(lines)

    } catch (err: any) {

      toast.error(`BOM fetch failed: ${err.message}`)

    } finally {

      setLoadingBom(false)

    }

  }



  async function addManualLine(itemId: string) {

    const item = rawItems?.find(i => i.id === itemId)

    if (!item) return

    if (rawMaterials.find(r => r.item_id === itemId)) {

      toast.error('Item already added')

      return

    }

    const { data: stock } = await supabase

      .from('inventory_balance')

      .select('available_qty')

      .eq('item_id', itemId)

      .single()



    const qtyAvailable = stock?.available_qty ?? 0



    setRawMaterials(prev => [...prev, {

      item_id:       item.id,

      item_name:     item.name,

      item_code:     item.item_code,

      unit:          item.unit?.name ?? '',

      qty_per_unit:  0,   // user will type this — "how many per finished unit"

      qty_needed:    0,   // computed: qty_per_unit × finishQty

      qty_available: qtyAvailable,

      sufficient:    false,

      source:        'manual',

    }])

  }



  // User types how many of this raw material per finished unit

  // qty_needed = qty_per_unit × finishQty

  function updateManualQty(itemId: string, qtyPerUnit: number) {

    setRawMaterials(prev => prev.map(r => {

      if (r.item_id !== itemId) return r

      const qtyNeeded = qtyPerUnit * finishQty

      return {

        ...r,

        qty_per_unit: qtyPerUnit,

        qty_needed:   qtyNeeded,

        sufficient:   r.qty_available >= qtyNeeded,

      }

    }))

  }



  function removeManualLine(itemId: string) {

    setRawMaterials(prev => prev.filter(r => r.item_id !== itemId))

  }



  async function handleCreate() {

    if (!finishedItem)             { toast.error('Select a finished item');                  return }

    if (finishQty <= 0)            { toast.error('Quantity must be greater than 0');         return }

    if (rawMaterials.length === 0) { toast.error('Add raw materials');                       return }

    if (hasShortage)               { toast.error('Insufficient stock for some materials');   return }



    if (!orgId) {

      toast.error("Organization not loaded");

      return;

    }

    setSaving(true)

    try {

      const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser()

      const { data: prdNo, error: rpcErr } = await supabase.rpc('next_prd_no', {

        p_org_id: orgId,

      })

      if (rpcErr) throw rpcErr



      const { data: prd, error: prdErr } = await supabase

        .from('production_orders')

        .insert({

          org_id:      orgId,

          po_number:   prdNo as string,

          so_id:       null,

          status:      'pending',

          target_date: targetDate || null,

          notes:       notes      || null,

          created_by:  user?.id   ?? null,

        })

        .select('id, po_number')

        .single()



      if (prdErr) throw prdErr



      const { error: itemsErr } = await supabase

        .from("production_order_items")

        .insert({
          production_order_id: prd.id,
          item_id: finishedItem.item_id,
          qty_required: finishQty,
          unit_id: finishedItem.unit_id,
        });



      if (itemsErr) throw itemsErr



      // ── Reserve raw materials ─────────────────────────────

      // qty_needed is already qty_per_unit × finishQty at this point

      for (const raw of rawMaterials) {

        await reserveInventory({

          itemId:      raw.item_id,

          qty:         raw.qty_needed,   // correctly scaled to finishQty

          refType:     'production_order',

          refId:       prd.id,

          expiryHours: 168,

          notes:       `Reserved for ${prd.po_number} — producing ${finishQty}× ${finishedItem.item_name}`,

        })

      }



      toast.success(`${prd.po_number} created — ${finishQty} units planned, materials reserved`)

      router.push(`/production/${prd.id}`)



    } catch (err: unknown) {

  toast.error(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to create production order')

    } finally {

      setSaving(false)

    }

  }



  return (

    <div>

      <PageHeader

        title="New Production Order"

        description="Only manufactured items can be produced"

      >

        <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={() => router.back()}>Cancel</Button>

        <Button

          size="sm"

          loading={saving}

          disabled={!canCreate}

          onClick={handleCreate}

          className={canCreate ? 'bg-purple-600 hover:bg-purple-700' : ''}

        >

          <Save className="w-4 h-4" />

          Create & Reserve Materials

        </Button>

      </PageHeader>



      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">



        {/* ── Left: Finished item + details ── */}

        <div className="space-y-4">

          <Card>

            <CardHeader>

              <h3 className="font-semibold text-slate-900 text-sm flex items-center gap-2">

                <Package className="w-4 h-4 text-purple-600" />

                What to Produce

              </h3>

            </CardHeader>

            <CardBody className="space-y-4">

              <div>

                <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">

                  Finished Item <span className="text-red-500">*</span>

                </label>

                <select

                  value={finishedItem?.item_id ?? ''}

                  onChange={e => {

                    const item = mfgItems?.find(i => i.id === e.target.value)

                    if (!item) {
                      setFinishedItem(null);
                      setRawMaterials([]);
                      setBomExists(null);
                      return;
                    }

                    if (!item.unit_id) {
                      toast.error("Selected item has no unit");
                      return;
                    }

                    setFinishedItem({
                      item_id: item.id,
                      item_name: item.name,
                      item_code: item.item_code,
                      unit_id: item.unit_id,
                      unit: item.unit?.name ?? "",
                    });

                  }
                }

                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 text-sm rounded-lg border border-slate-300 bg-white focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-purple-500"

                >

                  <option value="">Select manufactured item…</option>

                  {mfgItems?.map(item => (

                    <option key={item.id} value={item.id}>

                      [{item.item_code}] {item.name}

                    </option>

                  ))}

                </select>

                <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-1">Only items marked as "Manufactured" appear here</p>

              </div>



              <div>

                <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">

                  Quantity to Produce <span className="text-red-500">*</span>

                </label>

                <input

                  type="number"

                  min="1"

                  step="any"

                  value={finishQty}

                  onChange={e => setFinishQty(Math.max(1, Number(e.target.value)))}

                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 text-sm rounded-lg border border-slate-300 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-purple-500"

                />

                {finishedItem && (

                  <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-1">

                    Unit: {finishedItem.unit}

                    {bomExists === true && rawMaterials.length > 0 && (

                      <span className="ml-1 text-purple-600">

                        — materials auto-scaled to ×{finishQty}

                      </span>

                    )}

                  </p>

                )}

              </div>



              <Input

                label="Target Completion Date"

                type="date"

                value={targetDate}

                onChange={e => setTargetDate(e.target.value)}

              />



              <div>

                <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">Notes</label>

                <textarea

                  rows={3}

                  value={notes}

                  onChange={e => setNotes(e.target.value)}

                  placeholder="Any special instructions…"

                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 text-sm rounded-lg border border-slate-300 resize-none focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-purple-500"

                />

              </div>

            </CardBody>

          </Card>



          {/* Stock summary */}

          {rawMaterials.length > 0 && (

            <Card className={hasShortage ? 'border-red-200' : 'border-green-200'}>

              <CardBody className="space-y-2">

                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">

                  {hasShortage ? (

                    <>

                      <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-red-500" />

                      <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-red-700">Insufficient Materials</span>

                    </>

                  ) : (

                    <>

                      <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-green-600" />

                      <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-green-700">All Materials Available</span>

                    </>

                  )}

                </div>

                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">

                  {hasShortage

                    ? 'Resolve shortages before creating this production order.'

                    : `Creating this order will reserve all listed materials for ${finishQty}× ${finishedItem?.item_name}.`

                  }

                </p>

              </CardBody>

            </Card>

          )}

        </div>



        {/* ── Right: Raw materials ── */}

        <div className="lg:col-span-2">

          <Card>

            <CardHeader>

              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">

                <h3 className="font-semibold text-slate-900 text-sm">

                  Raw Materials Required

                  {bomExists === true  && <Badge variant="success"  className="ml-2">From BOM</Badge>}

                  {bomExists === false && <Badge variant="warning"  className="ml-2">No BOM — Manual Input</Badge>}

                </h3>

                {/* Show qty context always when an item is selected */}

                {finishedItem && (

                  <span className="text-xs text-slate-400">

                    Quantities for <span className="font-semibold text-purple-600">{finishQty} {finishedItem.unit}</span>

                  </span>

                )}

              </div>

            </CardHeader>



            <CardBody className="p-0">

              {!finishedItem && (

                <div className="px-5 py-10 text-center text-slate-400 text-sm">

                  Select a finished item to see required materials

                </div>

              )}



              {finishedItem && loadingBom && (

                <div className="px-5 py-10 text-center text-slate-400 text-sm">

                  Checking BOM and stock levels…

                </div>

              )}



              {finishedItem && !loadingBom && rawMaterials.length > 0 && (

                <div className="overflow-x-auto">

                  <table className="w-full text-sm">

                    <thead>

                      <tr className="bg-slate-50 border-b border-slate-100">

                        <th className="text-left px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">Component</th>

                        <th className="text-right px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">Per Unit</th>

                        <th className="text-right px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">Total (×{finishQty})</th>

                        <th className="text-right px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">Available</th>

                        <th className="text-center px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">Status</th>

                        {bomExists === false && <th className="w-8"></th>}

                      </tr>

                    </thead>

                    <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-50">

                      {rawMaterials.map(raw => (

                        <tr

                          key={raw.item_id}

                          className={raw.sufficient ? 'hover:bg-slate-50' : 'bg-red-50/40'}

                        >

                          <td className="px-4 py-3">

                            <span className="font-mono text-xs text-slate-400 bg-slate-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded mr-2">

                              {raw.item_code}

                            </span>

                            <span className="font-medium text-slate-900">{raw.item_name}</span>

                          </td>



                          {/* Per-unit column — editable for manual, read-only for BOM */}

                          <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right tabular-nums">

                            {raw.source === 'manual' ? (

                              <input

                                type="number"

                                min="0.0001"

                                step="any"

                                value={raw.qty_per_unit || ''}

                                placeholder="per unit"

                                onChange={e => updateManualQty(raw.item_id, Number(e.target.value))}

                                className="w-24 px-2 py-1 text-xs rounded border border-slate-200 text-right focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-purple-500"

                              />

                            ) : (

                              <span className="text-slate-400 text-xs">

                                {formatQty(raw.qty_per_unit, raw.unit)}

                              </span>

                            )}

                          </td>



                          {/* Total needed = qty_per_unit × finishQty — always computed, never editable */}

                          <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right tabular-nums">

                            <span className="font-semibold text-slate-900">

                              {raw.qty_needed > 0 ? formatQty(raw.qty_needed, raw.unit) : <span className="text-slate-300">—</span>}

                            </span>

                          </td>



                          <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right tabular-nums">

                            <span className={raw.sufficient ? 'text-green-600 font-medium' : 'text-red-600 font-bold'}>

                              {formatQty(raw.qty_available, raw.unit)}

                            </span>

                          </td>

                          <td className="px-4 py-3 text-center">

                            {raw.sufficient ? (

                              <Badge variant="success">OK</Badge>

                            ) : (

                              <Badge variant="danger">

                                Short {formatQty(raw.qty_needed - raw.qty_available, raw.unit)}

                              </Badge>

                            )}

                          </td>

                          {bomExists === false && (

                            <td className="px-2 py-3">

                              <button

                                onClick={() => removeManualLine(raw.item_id)}

                                className="text-slate-300 hover:text-red-500 transition-colors"

                              >

                                <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />

                              </button>

                            </td>

                          )}

                        </tr>

                      ))}

                    </tbody>

                  </table>

                </div>

              )}



              {/* No BOM — manual add */}

              {finishedItem && !loadingBom && bomExists === false && (

                <div className="px-5 py-4 border-t border-slate-100">

                  <p className="text-xs text-amber-700 bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 mb-3">

                    No BOM found for this item. Add raw materials manually below,

                    or first add a BOM in the Items page.

                  </p>

                  <select

                    defaultValue=""

                    onChange={e => { if (e.target.value) addManualLine(e.target.value); e.target.value = '' }}

                    className="w-full px-3 py-2 text-sm rounded-lg border border-slate-300 bg-white focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-purple-500"

                  >

                    <option value="">Add raw material…</option>

                    {rawItems?.map(item => (

                      <option key={item.id} value={item.id}>

                        [{item.item_code}] {item.name} ({item.unit?.name})

                      </option>

                    ))}

                  </select>

                </div>

              )}



              {finishedItem && !loadingBom && bomExists === true && rawMaterials.length === 0 && (

                <div className="px-5 py-10 text-center text-slate-400 text-sm">

                  BOM found but no active components. Check the BOM setup for this item.

                </div>

              )}

            </CardBody>

          </Card>

        </div>

      </div>

    </div>

  )

}
```

```tsx
'use client'

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'
import { useProductionOrders } from '@/lib/hooks/use-production'
import { PageHeader } from '@/components/layout/page-header'
import { ProductionStatusBadge } from '@/components/ui/badge'
import { TableLoader } from '@/components/ui/spinner'
import { formatDate, formatQty } from '@/lib/utils/format'
import { Search, Eye, Plus } from 'lucide-react'
import Link from 'next/link'
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'
import type { Enums } from '@/lib/types/database'
import type { Route } from 'next'
import { useProfile } from '@/lib/hooks/use-profile'

type ProductionStatus = Enums<'production_status'>

const STATUS_TABS: { label: string; value: ProductionStatus | '' }[] = [
  { label: 'All',         value: '' },
  { label: 'Pending',     value: 'pending' },
  { label: 'In Progress', value: 'in_progress' },
  { label: 'Completed',   value: 'completed' },
]

import { useOrgId } from '@/lib/hooks/use-tenant'

export default function ProductionPage() {
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<ProductionStatus | ''>('')
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('')
  const { data: profile } = useProfile()
  const orgId = useOrgId()

  const canCreate    = profile?.role === 'admin' || profile?.role === 'manager'
  const isProduction = profile?.role === 'production'

  const { data: orders, isLoading, refetch } = useProductionOrders({
    status: status || undefined,
  })

  const supabase = createClient()

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!orgId) return
    const channel = supabase
      .channel(`production-realtime-${orgId}`)
      .on('postgres_changes', {
        event: '*',
        schema: 'public',
        table: 'production_orders',
        filter: `org_id=eq.${orgId}`,
      }, () => refetch())
      .subscribe()
    return () => { supabase.removeChannel(channel) }
  }, [orgId, supabase, refetch])

  const filtered = (orders ?? []).filter(o => {
    if (!search) return true
    return o.po_number.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase())
  })

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="Production"
        description="Shop floor orders — view what is being manufactured"
      >
        {canCreate && (
          <Link href="/production/new">
            <Button className="bg-purple-600 hover:bg-purple-700" size="sm">
              <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
              Create Production Order
            </Button>
          </Link>
        )}
      </PageHeader>

      {/* Status tabs */}
      <div className="flex gap-1 mb-4 bg-slate-100 p-1 rounded-lg w-fit">
        {STATUS_TABS.map(tab => (
          <button
            key={tab.value}
            onClick={() => setStatus(tab.value)}
            className={`
              px-3 py-1.5 rounded-md text-sm font-medium transition-all
              ${status === tab.value
                ? 'bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-sm'
                : 'text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-700'
              }
            `}
          >
            {tab.label}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Search */}
      <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm mb-6">
        <div className="px-5 py-4 flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="relative flex-1 max-w-sm">
            <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-slate-400" />
            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder="Search by PRD no…"
              value={search}
              onChange={e => setSearch(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full pl-9 pr-4 py-2 text-sm rounded-lg border border-slate-300 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-purple-500 focus:border-transparent"
            />
          </div>
          <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 ml-auto">{filtered.length} orders</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Table */}
      <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm overflow-hidden">
        {isLoading ? (
          <TableLoader />
        ) : (
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full text-sm">
              <thead>
                <tr className="bg-slate-50 border-b border-slate-200">
                  <th className="text-left px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wide">PRD Number</th>
                  {/* Sales Order + Client — hidden for production role (commercial data) */}
                  {!isProduction && (
                    <>
                      <th className="text-left px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wide">Sales Order</th>
                      <th className="text-left px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wide">Client</th>
                    </>
                  )}
                  <th className="text-left px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wide">Items to Produce</th>
                  <th className="text-left px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wide">Workers</th>
                  <th className="text-left px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wide">Target Date</th>
                  <th className="text-center px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wide">Status</th>
                  <th className="text-center px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wide">View</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-50">
                {filtered.length === 0 && (
                  <tr>
                    <td colSpan={isProduction ? 6 : 8} className="text-center py-12 text-slate-400 text-sm">
                      No production orders found
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                )}
                {filtered.map((order: any) => {
                  const items       = order.production_order_items ?? []
                  const assignments = order.production_assignments ?? []
                  const isOverdue   = order.target_date &&
                    new Date(order.target_date) < new Date() &&
                    !['completed', 'cancelled'].includes(order.status)

                  return (
                    <tr
                      key={order.id}
                      className={`hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors ${
                        isOverdue ? "bg-red-50/30" : ""
                      }`}
                    >
                      {/* PRD number — plain text for production, link for others */}
                      <td className="px-4 py-3">
                        {isProduction ? (
                          <span className="font-mono text-sm font-semibold text-purple-600">
                            {order.po_number}
                          </span>
                        ) : (
                          <Link
                            href={`/production/${order.id}` as Route}
                            className="font-mono text-sm font-semibold text-purple-600 hover:underline"
                          >
                            {order.po_number}
                          </Link>
                        )}
                      </td>

                      {/* Sales Order + Client — hidden for production role */}
                      {!isProduction && (
                        <>
                          <td className="px-4 py-3">
                            {order.so ? (
                              <Link
                                href={`/sales-orders/${order.so.id}` as Route}
                                className="font-mono text-xs text-blue-600 hover:underline"
                              >
                                {order.so.so_number}
                              </Link>
                            ) : (
                              <span className="text-slate-400 text-xs">
                                Stock build
                              </span>
                            )}
                          </td>
                          <td className="px-4 py-3 text-slate-700">
                            {order.so?.client?.name ?? "—"}
                          </td>
                        </>
                      )}

                      <td className="px-4 py-3">
                        <div className="space-y-0.5">
                          {items.slice(0, 2).map((item: any) => (
                            <div
                              key={item.id}
                              className="text-xs text-slate-600"
                            >
                              <span className="font-mono text-slate-400 mr-1">
                                {item.item?.item_code}
                              </span>
                              {formatQty(item.qty_required, item.unit?.name)}
                              {item.qty_produced > 0 && (
                                <span className="text-green-600 ml-1">
                                  ({formatQty(item.qty_produced)} done)
                                </span>
                              )}
                            </div>
                          ))}
                          {items.length > 2 && (
                            <div className="text-xs text-slate-400">
                              +{items.length - 2} more
                            </div>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </td>

                      <td className="px-4 py-3">
                        {assignments.length > 0 ? (
                          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
                            {assignments.slice(0, 3).map((a: any) => (
                              <span
                                key={a.id}
                                className="text-xs bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded"
                              >
                                {a.worker?.name?.split(" ")[0]}
                              </span>
                            ))}
                            {assignments.length > 3 && (
                              <span className="text-xs text-slate-400">
                                +{assignments.length - 3}
                              </span>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        ) : (
                          <span className="text-slate-300 text-xs">
                            Unassigned
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </td>

                      <td className="px-4 py-3">
                        <span
                          className={
                            isOverdue
                              ? "text-red-600 font-medium"
                              : "text-slate-600"
                          }
                        >
                          {order.target_date
                            ? formatDate(order.target_date)
                            : "—"}
                          {isOverdue && " ⚠"}
                        </span>
                      </td>

                      <td className="px-4 py-3 text-center">
                        <ProductionStatusBadge status={order.status} />
                      </td>

                      {/* Eye button — only way to navigate for production role */}
                      <td className="px-4 py-3 text-center">
                        <Link href={`/production/${order.id}` as Route}>
                          <Button variant="ghost" size="sm">
                            <Eye className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          </Button>
                        </Link>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  );
                })}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}
```
