```tsx
'use client'

import { useState } from 'react'
import { useParams, useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { useQuotation, useUpdateQuotationStatus } from '@/lib/hooks/use-quotations'
import { useCanApprove, useCanSell } from '@/lib/hooks/use-profile'
import { useOrgId } from '@/lib/hooks/use-tenant'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'
import { PageHeader } from '@/components/layout/page-header'
import { Card, CardBody, CardHeader } from '@/components/ui/card'
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'
import { Badge, DocumentStatusBadge } from '@/components/ui/badge'
import { PageLoader } from '@/components/ui/spinner'
import { formatCurrency, formatDate, formatQty } from '@/lib/utils/format'
import { toast } from 'sonner'
import {
  CheckCircle, XCircle, ShoppingCart,
  Printer, ArrowLeft, Clock, User, Calendar
} from 'lucide-react'

export default function QuotationDetailPage() {
  const { id } = useParams<{ id: string }>()
  const router  = useRouter()
  const supabase = createClient()
  const orgId = useOrgId()

  const canApprove  = useCanApprove()
  const canSell     = useCanSell()

  const { data: qt, isLoading } = useQuotation(id)
  const { mutate: updateStatus, isPending: isUpdatingStatus } = useUpdateQuotationStatus()

  const [convertingToSO, setConvertingToSO] = useState(false)
  const [rejectComment, setRejectComment]   = useState('')
  const [showRejectBox, setShowRejectBox]   = useState(false)

  if (isLoading) return <PageLoader />
  if (!qt) return <div className="text-slate-500 text-sm">Quotation not found</div>

  const client  = qt.client  as any
  const creator = qt.creator as any
  const approver = qt.approver as any
  const lines   = qt.quotation_lines as any[] ?? []

  const isPendingApproval = qt.status === 'pending_approval'
  const isDraft    = qt.status === 'draft'
  const isApproved = qt.status === 'approved'
  const isConverted = qt.status === 'converted'
  const canConvert = isApproved && canSell && !isConverted

  // ── Convert to Sales Order ────────────────────────────────
  async function convertToSO() {
    if (!qt) return;
    if (!orgId) {
      toast.error("Organization not loaded");
      return;
    }

    setConvertingToSO(true);
  try {
    //calculating delivery date
    const orderDate = new Date();

    const deliveryDate = qt.delivery_days
      ? new Date(orderDate.getTime() + qt.delivery_days * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000)
          .toISOString()
          .split("T")[0]
      : null;

    // Generate SO number with tenant org_id
    const { data: soNo, error: rpcErr } = await supabase.rpc("next_so_no", {
      p_org_id: orgId,
    });
    if (rpcErr) throw rpcErr;

    const {
      data: { user },
    } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
    // Create sales order from quotation with org_id
    const { data: so, error: soErr } = await supabase
      .from("sales_orders")
      .insert({
        org_id: orgId,
        so_number: soNo as string,
        created_by: user?.id ?? null,
        quotation_id: qt.id,
        client_id: qt.client_id,
        order_date: new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0],
        status: "confirmed",
        subtotal: qt.subtotal,
        gst_amount: qt.gst_amount,
        total_amount: qt.total_amount,
        balance_due: qt.total_amount,
        payment_terms: qt.payment_terms,
        delivery_date: deliveryDate,
        notes:
          [qt.notes, qt.transport_note && `Transport: ${qt.transport_note}`]
            .filter(Boolean)
            .join("\n\n") || null,
      })
      .select("id")
      .single();

    if (soErr) throw soErr;

    // Copy quotation lines to SO lines
    const { error: linesErr } = await supabase.from("sales_order_lines").insert(
      lines.map((l: any, idx: number) => ({
        so_id: so.id,
        item_id: l.item_id,
        description: l.description,
        qty: l.qty,
        unit_id: l.unit_id,
        unit_rate: l.unit_rate,
        gst_percent: l.gst_percent,
        sort_order: idx,
      }))
    );

    if (linesErr) throw linesErr;

    // ── Mark quotation as converted ───────────────────────
    // Prevents double-conversion and makes the status clear in the list
    await supabase
      .from("quotations")
      .update({ status: "converted" as any }) // add 'converted' to enum — see SQL below
      .eq("id", qt.id);

    toast.success("Sales order created successfully!");
    router.push(`/sales-orders/${so.id}`);
  } catch (err: unknown) {
  toast.error(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to convert quotation')
  } finally {
    setConvertingToSO(false);
  }
}

  function handleApprove() {
    updateStatus({ id, status: 'approved' })
    setShowRejectBox(false)
  }

  function handleReject() {
    if (!rejectComment.trim()) {
      toast.error('Please add a reason for rejection')
      return
    }
    updateStatus({ id, status: 'rejected', comments: rejectComment })
    setShowRejectBox(false)
    setRejectComment('')
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title={qt.quotation_no}
        description={`Created ${formatDate(qt.created_at)} · ${client?.name}`}
      >
        <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => router.back()}>
          <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
          Back
        </Button>

        {/* Submit for approval (draft only, sales role) */}
        {isDraft && canSell && (
          <Button
            size="sm"
            loading={isUpdatingStatus}
            onClick={() => updateStatus({ id, status: 'pending_approval' })}
          >
            <Clock className="w-4 h-4" />
            Submit for Approval
          </Button>
        )}

        {/* Approve/Reject (pending, manager/admin only) */}
        {isPendingApproval && canApprove && (
          <>
            <Button
              variant="secondary"
              size="sm"
              loading={isUpdatingStatus}
              onClick={handleApprove}
              className="text-green-700 bg-green-50 hover:bg-green-100"
            >
              <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4" />
              Approve
            </Button>
            <Button
              variant="ghost"
              size="sm"
              onClick={() => setShowRejectBox(v => !v)}
              className="text-red-600 hover:bg-red-50"
            >
              <XCircle className="w-4 h-4" />
              Reject
            </Button>
          </>
        )}

        {/* Convert to SO (approved only, not yet converted) */}
        {canConvert && (
          <Button
            size="sm"
            loading={convertingToSO}
            onClick={convertToSO}
            className="bg-teal-600 hover:bg-teal-700"
          >
            <ShoppingCart className="w-4 h-4" />
            Convert to Sales Order
          </Button>
        )}

        {/* Already converted — show badge instead of button */}
        {isConverted && (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 bg-teal-50 border border-teal-200 rounded-lg">
            <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-teal-600" />
            <span className="text-sm font-medium text-teal-700">Converted to SO</span>
          </div>
        )}
      </PageHeader>

      {/* Reject comment box */}
      {showRejectBox && (
        <div className="mb-6 bg-red-50 border border-red-200 rounded-xl p-4">
          <p className="text-sm font-medium text-red-800 mb-2">
            Reason for rejection
          </p>
          <textarea
            rows={2}
            value={rejectComment}
            onChange={e => setRejectComment(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Explain why this quotation is being rejected…"
            className="w-full px-3 py-2 text-sm rounded-lg border border-red-200 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-red-400 resize-none"
          />
          <div className="flex gap-2 mt-2">
            <Button variant="danger" size="sm" onClick={handleReject}>
              Confirm Rejection
            </Button>
            <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => setShowRejectBox(false)}>
              Cancel
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">

        {/* ── Left column ── */}
        <div className="space-y-4">

          {/* Status card */}
          <Card>
            <CardBody className="space-y-3">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <span className="text-sm text-slate-500">Status</span>
                {(qt.status as any) === 'converted' ? (
                  <span style={{
                    display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4,
                    fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 600, padding: '2px 8px',
                    borderRadius: 5, background: 'rgba(20,184,166,0.12)',
                    color: '#0d9488',
                  }}>
                    Converted
                  </span>
                ) : (
                  <DocumentStatusBadge status={qt.status} />
                )}
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
                <span className="text-slate-500">Quotation No.</span>
                <span className="font-mono font-semibold text-slate-900">{qt.quotation_no}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
                <span className="text-slate-500">Date</span>
                <span className="text-slate-700">{formatDate(qt.quotation_date)}</span>
              </div>
              {qt.valid_until && (
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
                  <span className="text-slate-500">Valid Until</span>
                  <span className={new Date(qt.valid_until) < new Date() ? 'text-red-500' : 'text-slate-700'}>
                    {formatDate(qt.valid_until)}
                  </span>
                </div>
              )}
              {qt.delivery_days && (
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
                  <span className="text-slate-500">Delivery</span>
                  <span className="text-slate-700">{qt.delivery_days} days</span>
                </div>
              )}
            </CardBody>
          </Card>

          {/* Client card */}
          <Card>
            <CardHeader>
              <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-2">
                <User className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600" />
                Client
              </h3>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardBody className="space-y-2 text-sm">
              <div className="font-semibold text-slate-900">{client?.name}</div>
              {client?.phone && <div className="text-slate-500">{client.phone}</div>}
              {client?.gst_number && (
                <div className="font-mono text-xs text-slate-400">GST: {client.gst_number}</div>
              )}
              {client?.address && (
                <div className="text-slate-500 text-xs">{client.address}, {client.city}</div>
              )}
            </CardBody>
          </Card>

          {/* Terms card */}
          <Card>
            <CardHeader>
              <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900">Terms & Notes</h3>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardBody className="space-y-2 text-sm">
              {qt.payment_terms && (
                <div>
                  <span className="text-slate-400 text-xs uppercase tracking-wide">Payment</span>
                  <p className="text-slate-700 mt-0.5">{qt.payment_terms}</p>
                </div>
              )}
              {qt.transport_note && (
                <div>
                  <span className="text-slate-400 text-xs uppercase tracking-wide">Transport</span>
                  <p className="text-slate-700 mt-0.5">{qt.transport_note}</p>
                </div>
              )}
              {qt.notes && (
                <div>
                  <span className="text-slate-400 text-xs uppercase tracking-wide">Notes</span>
                  <p className="text-slate-700 mt-0.5">{qt.notes}</p>
                </div>
              )}
            </CardBody>
          </Card>

          {/* Approval info */}
          {(creator || approver) && (
            <Card>
              <CardHeader>
                <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Calendar className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400" />
                  Workflow
                </h3>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardBody className="space-y-2 text-sm">
                {creator && (
                  <div className="flex justify-between">
                    <span className="text-slate-400">Created by</span>
                    <span className="text-slate-700">{creator.full_name}</span>
                  </div>
                )}
                {approver && (
                  <div className="flex justify-between">
                    <span className="text-slate-400">Approved by</span>
                    <span className="text-slate-700">{approver.full_name}</span>
                  </div>
                )}
                {qt.approved_at && (
                  <div className="flex justify-between">
                    <span className="text-slate-400">Approved at</span>
                    <span className="text-slate-700">{formatDate(qt.approved_at)}</span>
                  </div>
                )}
              </CardBody>
            </Card>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* ── Right column: Line items ── */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-2">
          <Card>
            <CardHeader>
              <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900">
                Line Items
                <span className="ml-2 text-xs font-normal text-slate-400">
                  {lines.length} item{lines.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}
                </span>
              </h3>
            </CardHeader>

            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
              <table className="w-full text-sm">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="bg-slate-50 border-b border-slate-100">
                    <th className="text-left px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">#</th>
                    <th className="text-left px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">Item</th>
                    <th className="text-right px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">Qty</th>
                    <th className="text-right px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">Rate</th>
                    <th className="text-center px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">GST</th>
                    <th className="text-right px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">Subtotal</th>
                    <th className="text-right px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">Total</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-50">
                  {lines.map((line: any, i: number) => {
                    const lineSubtotal = line.qty * line.unit_rate
                    const lineGst = lineSubtotal * Number(line.gst_percent) / 100
                    const lineTotal = lineSubtotal + lineGst
                    return (
                      <tr key={line.id} className="hover:bg-slate-50">
                        <td className="px-4 py-3 text-slate-400 text-xs">{i + 1}</td>
                        <td className="px-4 py-3">
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                            <span className="font-mono text-xs text-slate-400 bg-slate-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded">
                              {line.item?.item_code}
                            </span>
                            <div>
                              <div className="font-medium text-slate-900">
                                {line.description || line.item?.name}
                              </div>
                              {line.description && line.description !== line.item?.name && (
                                <div className="text-xs text-slate-400">{line.item?.name}</div>
                              )}
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right tabular-nums">
                          {formatQty(line.qty, line.unit)}
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right tabular-nums">
                          {formatCurrency(line.unit_rate)}
                          <div className="text-xs text-slate-400">/{line.unit}</div>
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-4 py-3 text-center text-slate-600">
                          {line.gst_percent}%
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right tabular-nums text-slate-700">
                          {formatCurrency(lineSubtotal)}
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right tabular-nums font-semibold text-slate-900">
                          {formatCurrency(lineTotal)}
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    )
                  })}
                </tbody>
                <tfoot>
                  <tr className="bg-slate-50 border-t border-slate-200">
                    <td colSpan={6} className="px-4 py-2.5 text-right text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                      Subtotal
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-2.5 text-right tabular-nums font-semibold">
                      {formatCurrency(qt.subtotal)}
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                  <tr className="bg-slate-50">
                    <td colSpan={6} className="px-4 py-1.5 text-right text-xs text-slate-500">
                      GST
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-1.5 text-right tabular-nums text-slate-600">
                      {formatCurrency(qt.gst_amount)}
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                  <tr className="bg-blue-50 border-t border-blue-100">
                    <td colSpan={6} className="px-4 py-3 text-right font-bold text-slate-800">
                      Total Amount
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right tabular-nums font-bold text-blue-600 text-base">
                      {formatCurrency(qt.total_amount)}
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                </tfoot>
              </table>
            </div>
          </Card>
        </div>

      </div>
    </div>
  )
}
```

```tsx
'use client'

import { useState } from 'react'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'
import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { PageHeader } from '@/components/layout/page-header'
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'
import { Input, Textarea } from '@/components/ui/input'
import { Card, CardBody, CardHeader } from '@/components/ui/card'
import { formatCurrency } from '@/lib/utils/format'
import { toast } from 'sonner'
import { Plus, Trash2, Save, Send } from 'lucide-react'
import type { Enums } from '@/lib/types/database'
import { useOrgId } from '@/lib/hooks/use-tenant'

type GstRate = Enums<'gst_rate'>

interface LineItem {
  item_id: string;
  item_name: string;
  item_code: string;
  description: string;
  qty: number;
  unit_id: string | null;
  unit: string;
  unit_rate: number;
  gst_percent: GstRate;
}

const EMPTY_LINE: LineItem = {
  item_id: "",
  item_name: "",
  item_code: "",
  description: "",
  qty: 1,
  unit_id: null,
  unit: "",
  unit_rate: 0,
  gst_percent: "18",
};

// Fetch active clients
function useClients() {
  const supabase = createClient();
  const orgId = useOrgId();

  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ["clients-list", orgId],
    queryFn: async () => {
      if (!orgId) return [];

      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from("clients")
        .select("id, name, phone, gst_number")
        .eq("is_active", true)
        .order("name");

      if (error) throw error;
      return data;
    },
    enabled: !!orgId,
    staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000,
    refetchOnMount: true,
  });
}

// Fetch items with current selling price
function useItemsForQuote() {
  const supabase = createClient();
  const orgId = useOrgId();

  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ["items-for-quote", orgId],
    queryFn: async () => {
      if (!orgId) return [];
      const { data: items, error } = await supabase
        .from("items")
        .select(
          `
          id,
          item_code,
          name,
          unit_id,
          unit:units (
            id,
            name
          ),
          hsn_code,
          category_id
        `
        )
        .eq("is_active", true)
        .order("name");
      if (error) throw error;

      const { data: prices } = await supabase
        .from("v_current_prices")
        .select("item_id, selling_rate, gst_percent, rate_unit");

      const priceMap = new Map(prices?.map((p) => [p.item_id, p]) ?? []);
      return (
        items?.map((i) => ({ ...i, price: priceMap.get(i.id) ?? null })) ?? []
      );
    },
    staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000,
    enabled: !!orgId,
  });
}

export default function NewQuotationPage() {
  const router = useRouter()
  const supabase = createClient()
  const orgId = useOrgId()

  const { data: clients } = useClients()
  const { data: items }   = useItemsForQuote()

  const [clientId, setClientId]         = useState('')
  const [validUntil, setValidUntil]     = useState('')
  const [deliveryDays, setDeliveryDays] = useState('')
  const [paymentTerms, setPaymentTerms] = useState('50% advance, 50% on delivery')
  const [transportNote, setTransportNote] = useState('')
  const [notes, setNotes]               = useState('')
  const [lines, setLines]               = useState<LineItem[]>([{ ...EMPTY_LINE }])
  const [saving, setSaving]             = useState(false)
  const [submitting, setSubmitting]     = useState(false)

  
  // ── Line calculations ─────────────────────────────────────
  const lineSubtotal  = (l: LineItem) => l.qty * l.unit_rate
  const lineGst       = (l: LineItem) => lineSubtotal(l) * Number(l.gst_percent) / 100
  const lineTotal     = (l: LineItem) => lineSubtotal(l) + lineGst(l)

  const subtotal   = lines.reduce((s, l) => s + lineSubtotal(l), 0)
  const gstAmount  = lines.reduce((s, l) => s + lineGst(l), 0)
  const totalAmount = subtotal + gstAmount

  // ── Line handlers ─────────────────────────────────────────
  function addLine() {
    setLines(prev => [...prev, { ...EMPTY_LINE }])
  }

  function removeLine(i: number) {
    setLines(prev => prev.filter((_, idx) => idx !== i))
  }

  function updateLine(i: number, field: keyof LineItem, value: string | number) {
    setLines(prev => prev.map((l, idx) => {
      if (idx !== i) return l
      const updated = { ...l, [field]: value }
      return updated
    }))
  }


  function selectItem(lineIdx: number, itemId: string) {
    const item = items?.find(i => i.id === itemId)
    if (!item) return
    setLines(prev => prev.map((l, i) => {
      if (i !== lineIdx) return l
      return {
        ...l,
        item_id: item.id,
        item_name: item.name,
        item_code: item.item_code,
        unit_id: item.unit_id,
        unit: item.unit?.name ?? "",
        unit_rate: item.price?.selling_rate ?? 0,
        gst_percent: (item.price?.gst_percent ?? "18") as GstRate,
      };
    }))
  }

  // ── Save / Submit ─────────────────────────────────────────
  async function save(submit: boolean) {
    if (!clientId) { toast.error('Please select a client'); return }
    if (lines.some((l) => !l.item_id)) {
      toast.error("All lines must have an item selected");
      return;
    }

    if (lines.some((l) => !l.unit_id)) {
      toast.error("All items must have a unit");
      return;
    }

    if (lines.some((l) => l.qty <= 0)) {
      toast.error("All quantities must be greater than 0");
      return;
    }
    if (!orgId) {
      toast.error("Organization not loaded");
      return;
    }

    submit ? setSubmitting(true) : setSaving(true)

    try {
      // Generate quotation number with tenant org_id
      const { data: qtNo, error: rpcErr } = await supabase.rpc("next_qt_no", {
        p_org_id: orgId,
      });
      if (rpcErr) throw rpcErr;

      const {
        data: { user },
      } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
      // Insert quotation header with org_id
      const { data: qt, error: qtErr } = await supabase
        .from("quotations")
        .insert({
          org_id: orgId,
          quotation_no: qtNo as string,
          created_by: user?.id ?? null,
          client_id: clientId,
          valid_until: validUntil || null,
          delivery_days: deliveryDays ? Number(deliveryDays) : null,
          payment_terms: paymentTerms || null,
          transport_note: transportNote || null,
          notes: notes || null,
          status: submit ? "pending_approval" : "draft",
          subtotal,
          gst_amount: gstAmount,
          total_amount: totalAmount,
        })
        .select("id")
        .single();

      if (qtErr) throw qtErr;

      // Insert lines
      const { error: linesErr } = await supabase.from("quotation_lines").insert(
        lines.map((l, idx) => ({
          quotation_id: qt.id,
          item_id: l.item_id,
          description: l.description || null,
          qty: l.qty,
          unit_id: l.unit_id!,
          unit_rate: l.unit_rate,
          gst_percent: l.gst_percent,
          sort_order: idx,
        }))
      );

      if (linesErr) throw linesErr;

      toast.success(
        submit ? "Quotation submitted for approval" : "Quotation saved as draft"
      );
      router.push(`/quotations/${qt.id}`);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      toast.error(
        err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Failed to save quotation"
      );
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="New Quotation"
        description="Create a price offer for a client"
      >
        <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={() => router.back()}>
          Cancel
        </Button>
        <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" loading={saving} onClick={() => save(false)}>
          <Save className="w-4 h-4" />
          Save Draft
        </Button>
        <Button size="sm" loading={submitting} onClick={() => save(true)}>
          <Send className="w-4 h-4" />
          Submit for Approval
        </Button>
      </PageHeader>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">

        {/* ── Left: Header fields ── */}
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <Card>
            <CardHeader>
              <h3 className="font-semibold text-slate-900 text-sm">Client & Terms</h3>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardBody className="space-y-4">

              {/* Client */}
              <div>
                <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
                  Client <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
                </label>
                <select
                  value={clientId}
                  onChange={e => setClientId(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 text-sm rounded-lg border border-slate-300 bg-white focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500"
                >
                  <option value="">Select client…</option>
                  {clients?.map(c => (
                    <option key={c.id} value={c.id}>{c.name}</option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>

              <Input
                label="Valid Until"
                type="date"
                value={validUntil}
                onChange={e => setValidUntil(e.target.value)}
                hint="Typically 30–45 days from today"
              />

              <Input
                label="Delivery Days"
                type="number"
                placeholder="e.g. 7"
                value={deliveryDays}
                onChange={e => setDeliveryDays(e.target.value)}
              />

              <div>
                <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5">
                  Payment Terms
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={paymentTerms}
                  onChange={e => setPaymentTerms(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 text-sm rounded-lg border border-slate-300 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500"
                />
              </div>

              <Input
                label="Transport Note"
                placeholder="e.g. Client will arrange transport"
                value={transportNote}
                onChange={e => setTransportNote(e.target.value)}
              />

              <Textarea
                label="Notes"
                placeholder="Any additional notes for this quotation…"
                value={notes}
                onChange={e => setNotes(e.target.value)}
              />
            </CardBody>
          </Card>

          {/* Totals */}
          <Card>
            <CardHeader>
              <h3 className="font-semibold text-slate-900 text-sm">Summary</h3>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardBody className="space-y-2">
              <div className="flex justify-between text-sm">
                <span className="text-slate-500">Subtotal</span>
                <span className="font-medium">{formatCurrency(subtotal)}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between text-sm">
                <span className="text-slate-500">GST</span>
                <span className="font-medium">{formatCurrency(gstAmount)}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between text-base font-bold border-t border-slate-100 pt-2 mt-2">
                <span>Total</span>
                <span className="text-blue-600">{formatCurrency(totalAmount)}</span>
              </div>
            </CardBody>
          </Card>
        </div>

        {/* ── Right: Line items ── */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-2">
          <Card>
            <CardHeader>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <h3 className="font-semibold text-slate-900 text-sm">
                  Line Items
                  <span className="ml-2 text-xs font-normal text-slate-400">
                    {lines.length} item{lines.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}
                  </span>
                </h3>
                <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={addLine}>
                  <Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  Add Line
                </Button>
              </div>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardBody className="p-0">
              <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                <table className="w-full text-sm">
                  <thead>
                    <tr className="bg-slate-50 border-b border-slate-100">
                      <th className="text-left px-3 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500">Item</th>
                      <th className="text-left px-3 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 w-24">Qty</th>
                      <th className="text-left px-3 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 w-20">Unit</th>
                      <th className="text-right px-3 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 w-28">Rate (₹)</th>
                      <th className="text-center px-3 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 w-16">GST%</th>
                      <th className="text-right px-3 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 w-28">Total</th>
                      <th className="w-8"></th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-50">
                    {lines.map((line, i) => (
                      <tr key={i} className="group">
                        <td className="px-3 py-2">
                          <select
                            value={line.item_id}
                            onChange={e => selectItem(i, e.target.value)}
                            className="w-full px-2 py-1.5 text-xs rounded border border-slate-200 bg-white focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500 min-w-[200px]"
                          >
                            <option value="">Select item…</option>
                            {items?.map(item => (
                              <option key={item.id} value={item.id}>
                                [{item.item_code}] {item.name}
                              </option>
                            ))}
                          </select>
                          {line.item_id && (
                            <input
                              type="text"
                              placeholder="Description override (optional)"
                              value={line.description}
                              onChange={e => updateLine(i, 'description', e.target.value)}
                              className="mt-1 w-full px-2 py-1 text-xs rounded border border-slate-100 bg-slate-50 focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500 placeholder:text-slate-300"
                            />
                          )}
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-3 py-2">
                          <input
                            type="number"
                            min="0.0001"
                            step="any"
                            value={line.qty}
                            onChange={e => updateLine(i, 'qty', Number(e.target.value))}
                            className="w-full px-2 py-1.5 text-xs rounded border border-slate-200 text-right focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500"
                          />
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-3 py-2">
                          <input
                            type="text"
                            value={line.unit}
                            onChange={e => updateLine(i, 'unit', e.target.value)}
                            className="w-full px-2 py-1.5 text-xs rounded border border-slate-200 text-center focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500"
                          />
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-3 py-2">
                          <input
                            type="number"
                            min="0"
                            step="any"
                            value={line.unit_rate}
                            onChange={e => updateLine(i, 'unit_rate', Number(e.target.value))}
                            className="w-full px-2 py-1.5 text-xs rounded border border-slate-200 text-right focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500"
                          />
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-3 py-2">
                          <select
                            value={line.gst_percent}
                            onChange={e => updateLine(i, 'gst_percent', e.target.value as GstRate)}
                            className="w-full px-1.5 py-1.5 text-xs rounded border border-slate-200 text-center focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500"
                          >
                            {['0','5','12','18','28'].map(r => (
                              <option key={r} value={r}>{r}%</option>
                            ))}
                          </select>
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-3 py-2 text-right tabular-nums">
                          <div className="font-semibold text-slate-900 text-xs">
                            {formatCurrency(lineSubtotal(line))}
                          </div>
                          <div className="text-xs text-slate-400">
                            +{formatCurrency(lineGst(line))} GST
                          </div>
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-2 py-2">
                          {lines.length > 1 && (
                            <button
                              onClick={() => removeLine(i)}
                              className="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 text-slate-300 hover:text-red-500 transition-all"
                            >
                              <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                            </button>
                          )}
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>

                  {/* Footer totals */}
                  <tfoot>
                    <tr className="bg-slate-50 border-t border-slate-200">
                      <td colSpan={5} className="px-3 py-2.5 text-right text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500">
                        Subtotal
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-3 py-2.5 text-right tabular-nums font-semibold text-slate-900 text-xs">
                        {formatCurrency(subtotal)}
                      </td>
                      <td></td>
                    </tr>
                    <tr className="bg-slate-50">
                      <td colSpan={5} className="px-3 py-1.5 text-right text-xs text-slate-500">
                        GST
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-3 py-1.5 text-right tabular-nums text-slate-600 text-xs">
                        {formatCurrency(gstAmount)}
                      </td>
                      <td></td>
                    </tr>
                    <tr className="bg-blue-50 border-t border-blue-100">
                      <td colSpan={5} className="px-3 py-2.5 text-right text-sm font-bold text-slate-700">
                        Total
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-3 py-2.5 text-right tabular-nums font-bold text-blue-600">
                        {formatCurrency(totalAmount)}
                      </td>
                      <td></td>
                    </tr>
                  </tfoot>
                </table>
              </div>

              {/* Add line button bottom */}
              <div className="px-4 py-3 border-t border-slate-100">
                <button
                  onClick={addLine}
                  className="text-sm text-blue-600 hover:text-blue-700 font-medium flex items-center gap-1.5"
                >
                  <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
                  Add another line
                </button>
              </div>
            </CardBody>
          </Card>
        </div>

      </div>
    </div>
  )
}
```

# src/app/(dashboard)/quotations/page.tsx

```tsx
'use client'

import { useState } from 'react'
import { useQuotations, useUpdateQuotationStatus } from '@/lib/hooks/use-quotations'
import { useCanApprove } from '@/lib/hooks/use-profile'
import { PageHeader } from '@/components/layout/page-header'
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'
import { DocumentStatusBadge } from '@/components/ui/badge'
import { TableLoader } from '@/components/ui/spinner'
import { formatCurrency, formatDate } from '@/lib/utils/format'
import { Plus, Search, CheckCircle, XCircle, Eye } from 'lucide-react'
import Link from 'next/link'
import type { Enums } from '@/lib/types/database'

type DocumentStatus = Enums<'document_status'>

// ── Add 'converted' as a UI-only filter value ─────────────────
// Once the DB enum is updated, remove the `as any` casts
const STATUS_TABS: { label: string; value: DocumentStatus | 'converted' | '' }[] = [
  { label: 'All',              value: '' },
  { label: 'Draft',            value: 'draft' },
  { label: 'Pending Approval', value: 'pending_approval' },
  { label: 'Approved',         value: 'approved' },
  { label: 'Converted',        value: 'converted' },
  { label: 'Rejected',         value: 'rejected' },
]

export default function QuotationsPage() {
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<DocumentStatus | 'converted' | ''>('')
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('')
  const [approvingId, setApprovingId] = useState<string | null>(null)

  const canApprove = useCanApprove()
  const { data: quotations, isLoading } = useQuotations({
    status: (status || undefined) as DocumentStatus | undefined,
    search,
  })
  const { mutate: updateStatus, isPending } = useUpdateQuotationStatus()

  function handleApprove(id: string) {
    setApprovingId(id)
    updateStatus({ id, status: 'approved' }, { onSettled: () => setApprovingId(null) })
  }

  function handleReject(id: string) {
    setApprovingId(id)
    updateStatus({ id, status: 'rejected' }, { onSettled: () => setApprovingId(null) })
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="Quotations"
        description="Customer price offers and approval workflow"
      >
        <Link href="/quotations/new">
          <Button size="sm">
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
            New Quotation
          </Button>
        </Link>
      </PageHeader>

      {/* Status tabs */}
      <div className="flex gap-1 mb-4 bg-slate-100 p-1 rounded-lg w-fit">
        {STATUS_TABS.map(tab => (
          <button
            key={tab.value}
            onClick={() => setStatus(tab.value)}
            className={`
              px-3 py-1.5 rounded-md text-sm font-medium transition-all
              ${status === tab.value
                ? 'bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-sm'
                : 'text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-700'
              }
            `}
          >
            {tab.label}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Search */}
      <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm mb-6">
        <div className="px-5 py-4 flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="relative flex-1 max-w-sm">
            <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-slate-400" />
            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder="Search by quotation number…"
              value={search}
              onChange={e => setSearch(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full pl-9 pr-4 py-2 text-sm rounded-lg border border-slate-300 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-transparent"
            />
          </div>
          <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 ml-auto">
            {quotations?.length ?? 0} quotations
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Table */}
      <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm overflow-hidden">
        {isLoading ? (
          <TableLoader />
        ) : (
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full text-sm">
              <thead>
                <tr className="bg-slate-50 border-b border-slate-200">
                  <th className="text-left px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wide">Quotation No.</th>
                  <th className="text-left px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wide">Client</th>
                  <th className="text-left px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wide">Date</th>
                  <th className="text-left px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wide">Valid Until</th>
                  <th className="text-right px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wide">Amount</th>
                  <th className="text-center px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wide">Status</th>
                  <th className="text-left px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wide">Created By</th>
                  <th className="text-center px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wide">Actions</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-50">
                {quotations?.length === 0 && (
                  <tr>
                    <td colSpan={8} className="text-center py-12 text-slate-400 text-sm">
                      No quotations found
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                )}
                {quotations?.map(q => {
                  const isExpired   = q.valid_until && new Date(q.valid_until) < new Date()
                  const isPendingQ  = q.status === 'pending_approval'
                  const isConverted = (q.status as any) === 'converted'

                  return (
                    <tr key={q.id} className="hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors">
                      <td className="px-4 py-3">
                        <Link
                          href={`/quotations/${q.id}`}
                          className="font-mono text-sm font-semibold text-blue-600 hover:underline"
                        >
                          {q.quotation_no}
                        </Link>
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-3">
                        <div className="font-medium text-slate-900">{(q.client as any)?.name}</div>
                        <div className="text-xs text-slate-400">{(q.client as any)?.phone}</div>
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-3 text-slate-600">{formatDate(q.quotation_date)}</td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-3">
                        <span className={isExpired && q.status === 'draft' ? 'text-red-500' : 'text-slate-600'}>
                          {q.valid_until ? formatDate(q.valid_until) : '—'}
                        </span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right tabular-nums">
                        <div className="font-semibold text-slate-900">{formatCurrency(q.total_amount)}</div>
                        <div className="text-xs text-slate-400">+GST {formatCurrency(q.gst_amount)}</div>
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-3 text-center">
                        {/* Converted gets its own inline badge since DocumentStatusBadge
                            won't know about it until the DB enum is updated */}
                        {isConverted ? (
                          <span style={{
                            display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4,
                            fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 600, padding: '2px 8px',
                            borderRadius: 5, background: 'rgba(20,184,166,0.12)',
                            color: '#0d9488',
                          }}>
                            Converted
                          </span>
                        ) : (
                          <DocumentStatusBadge status={q.status} />
                        )}
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-3 text-slate-500 text-xs">
                        {(q.creator as any)?.full_name ?? '—'}
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-3">
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5">
                          <Link href={`/quotations/${q.id}`}>
                            <Button variant="ghost" size="sm">
                              <Eye className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                            </Button>
                          </Link>
                          {/* Approve/Reject only for pending, non-converted */}
                          {canApprove && isPendingQ && !isConverted && (
                            <>
                              <Button
                                variant="secondary"
                                size="sm"
                                loading={isPending && approvingId === q.id}
                                onClick={() => handleApprove(q.id)}
                                className="text-green-700 bg-green-50 hover:bg-green-100"
                              >
                                <CheckCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                                Approve
                              </Button>
                              <Button
                                variant="ghost"
                                size="sm"
                                onClick={() => handleReject(q.id)}
                                className="text-red-600 hover:bg-red-50"
                              >
                                <XCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                              </Button>
                            </>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  )
                })}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}
```

# src/app/(dashboard)/sales-orders/[id]/page.tsx

```tsx
'use client'

import { useState } from 'react'
import { useOrgId } from "@/lib/hooks/use-tenant";
import { useParams, useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { useSalesOrder, useUpdateSOStatus, useRecordPayment } from '@/lib/hooks/use-sales-orders'
import { useCanApprove, useCanSell } from '@/lib/hooks/use-profile'
import { reserveInventory, releaseInventory } from '@/lib/utils/inventory'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'
import { useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { PageHeader } from '@/components/layout/page-header'
import { Card, CardBody, CardHeader } from '@/components/ui/card'
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'
import { Badge, OrderStatusBadge } from '@/components/ui/badge'
import { PageLoader } from '@/components/ui/spinner'
import { formatCurrency, formatDate, formatQty } from '@/lib/utils/format'
import { toast } from 'sonner'
import {
  ArrowLeft, Send, CreditCard,
  Package, Truck, CheckCircle,
  User, FileText, AlertTriangle, XCircle
} from 'lucide-react'
import Link from 'next/link'

export default function SalesOrderDetailPage() {
  const { id }   = useParams<{ id: string }>()
  const router   = useRouter()
  const supabase = createClient()
  const qc       = useQueryClient()
  const orgId = useOrgId();

  const canApprove = useCanApprove()
  const canSell    = useCanSell()

  const { data: so, isLoading, refetch } = useSalesOrder(id)
  const { mutate: updateStatus, isPending: updatingStatus } = useUpdateSOStatus()
  const { mutate: recordPayment, isPending: recordingPayment } = useRecordPayment()

  const [paymentAmount,   setPaymentAmount]   = useState('')
  const [showPaymentBox,  setShowPaymentBox]  = useState(false)
  const [reservingStock,  setReservingStock]  = useState(false)
  const [cancelling,      setCancelling]      = useState(false)
  const [showCancelConfirm, setShowCancelConfirm] = useState(false)

  // ── All reservations for this SO (active + partially_consumed) ─
const { data: reservations } = useQuery({
  queryKey: ["so-reservations", orgId, id],
  queryFn: async () => {
    if (!orgId || !id) return [];

    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from("stock_reservations")
      .select("id, item_id, qty_reserved, qty_consumed, status")
      .eq("ref_type", "sales_order")
      .eq("ref_id", id)
      .in("status", ["active", "partially_consumed"]);

    if (error) throw error;
    return data ?? [];
  },
  enabled: !!orgId && !!id,
  staleTime: 30 * 1000,
});

  const hasReservations = (reservations?.length ?? 0) > 0

  if (isLoading) return <PageLoader />
  if (!so)       return <div className="text-slate-500 text-sm p-6">Sales order not found</div>

  const salesOrder = so
  const client     = so.client as any
  const lines      = (so.sales_order_lines as any[]) ?? []
  const challans   = (so.delivery_challans as any[]) ?? []

  const isConfirmed  = so.status === 'confirmed'
  const isReserved   = so.status === 'ready'
  const isDispatched = so.status === 'dispatched'
  const isDelivered  = so.status === 'delivered'
  const isCancelled  = so.status === 'cancelled'

  // ── Reserve stock ─────────────────────────────────────────
  async function handleReserveStock() {

    if (!orgId) {
      toast.error("Organization not loaded");
      return;
    }

    setReservingStock(true)
    try {
      let allSucceeded = true
      for (const line of lines) {
        try {
          await reserveInventory({
            itemId:  line.item_id,
            qty:     line.qty,
            refType: 'sales_order',
            refId:   salesOrder.id,
          })
        } catch (err: unknown) {
          toast.error(
            `${line.item?.name}: ${
              err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Failed to reserve stock"
            }`
          );
          allSucceeded = false
          break
        }
      }
      if (allSucceeded) {
        updateStatus({ id, status: 'ready' })
        toast.success('Stock reserved — order is now ready to dispatch')
        qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["so-reservations", orgId, id] });
        refetch()
      }
    } finally {
      setReservingStock(false)
    }
  }

  // ── Cancel SO + release all reservations ──────────────────
  // Flow:
  //   1. Release every active/partially_consumed reservation
  //      → DB marks them as 'released', restores available_qty
  //   2. Mark SO as 'cancelled'
  //   3. Invalidate queries so UI reflects the freed stock
  async function handleCancel() {

    if (!orgId) {
      toast.error("Organization not loaded");
      return;
    }
    
    setCancelling(true)
    try {
      // Release each reservation individually
      // releaseInventory with no qtyToRelease = release all remaining
      const activeReservations = reservations ?? [];

      for (const reservation of activeReservations) {
        await releaseInventory({
          reservationId: reservation.id,
          notes: `SO cancelled — ${salesOrder.so_number}`,
        });
      }

      // Mark SO as cancelled
      updateStatus({ id, status: "cancelled" });

      if (activeReservations.length > 0) {
        toast.success(
          `SO ${salesOrder.so_number} cancelled — ${activeReservations.length} reservation(s) released back to available stock`
        );
      } else {
        toast.success(`SO ${salesOrder.so_number} cancelled`);
      }

      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["so-reservations", orgId, id] });
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["stock-levels"] });
      setShowCancelConfirm(false);
      refetch();
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      toast.error(
        `Cancel failed: ${err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Unknown error"}`
      );
    } finally {
      setCancelling(false);
    }
  }

  // ── Record payment ────────────────────────────────────────
  function handleRecordPayment() {
    const amount = Number(paymentAmount)
    if (!amount || amount <= 0) { toast.error('Enter a valid payment amount'); return }
    if (amount > (salesOrder.balance_due ?? 0)) {
      toast.error(`Amount exceeds balance due (${formatCurrency(salesOrder.balance_due ?? 0)})`)
      return
    }
    recordPayment(
      {
        id,
        amount,
        currentAdvance: salesOrder.advance_paid ?? 0,
        totalAmount:    salesOrder.total_amount,
      },
      {
        onSuccess: () => {
          setPaymentAmount('')
          setShowPaymentBox(false)
        },
      }
    )
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title={salesOrder.so_number}
        description={`${client?.name} · ${formatDate(so.order_date)}`}
      >
        <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => router.back()}>
          <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
          Back
        </Button>

        {/* Reserve Stock */}
        {isConfirmed && !hasReservations && canSell && (
          <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" loading={reservingStock} onClick={handleReserveStock}>
            <Package className="w-4 h-4" />
            Reserve Stock
          </Button>
        )}

        {/* Already reserved badge */}
        {isConfirmed && hasReservations && (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 bg-teal-50 border border-teal-200 rounded-lg">
            <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-teal-600" />
            <span className="text-sm font-medium text-teal-700">Stock Reserved</span>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Create challan */}
        {isReserved && canSell && (
          <Link href={`/dispatch/new?so=${so.id}`}>
            <Button size="sm">
              <Send className="w-4 h-4" />
              Create Challan
            </Button>
          </Link>
        )}

        {/* Record payment */}
        {(salesOrder.balance_due ?? 0) > 0 && canSell && !isCancelled && (
          <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={() => setShowPaymentBox(v => !v)}>
            <CreditCard className="w-4 h-4" />
            Record Payment
          </Button>
        )}

        {/* Cancel — only available when not already dispatched/delivered/cancelled */}
        {!isDispatched && !isDelivered && !isCancelled && canSell && (
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            size="sm"
            onClick={() => setShowCancelConfirm(true)}
            style={{ borderColor: 'rgba(239,68,68,0.4)', color: '#ef4444' }}
          >
            <XCircle className="w-4 h-4" />
            Cancel Order
          </Button>
        )}
      </PageHeader>

      {/* ── Cancel confirmation banner ──────────────────────── */}
      {showCancelConfirm && (
        <div className="mb-6 flex items-start gap-4 bg-red-50 border border-red-200 rounded-xl px-5 py-4">
          <AlertTriangle className="w-5 h-5 text-red-500 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
          <div className="flex-1">
            <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-red-800 mb-1">
              Cancel {salesOrder.so_number}?
            </p>
            <p className="text-sm text-red-700">
              {hasReservations
                ? `This will release ${reservations?.length} reservation(s) back to available stock. This cannot be undone.`
                : 'This will cancel the order. This cannot be undone.'
              }
            </p>
            <div className="flex gap-3 mt-3">
              <Button
                size="sm"
                loading={cancelling}
                onClick={handleCancel}
                style={{ background: '#ef4444', color: '#fff' }}
              >
                Yes, Cancel Order
              </Button>
              <Button
                variant="outline"
                size="sm"
                onClick={() => setShowCancelConfirm(false)}
              >
                Keep Order
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Reservation warning */}
      {isConfirmed && !hasReservations && (
        <div className="mb-6 flex items-start gap-3 bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 rounded-xl px-5 py-3">
          <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-600 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
          <p className="text-sm text-amber-800">
            Stock has not been reserved yet. Reserve stock before creating a delivery challan —
            dispatch only works from reserved stock.
          </p>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Payment box */}
      {showPaymentBox && (
        <div className="mb-6 bg-blue-50 border border-blue-200 rounded-xl p-4">
          <p className="text-sm font-medium text-blue-800 mb-3">
            Record payment — Balance due: {formatCurrency(salesOrder.balance_due ?? 0)}
          </p>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <input
              type="number"
              value={paymentAmount}
              onChange={e => setPaymentAmount(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Amount received (₹)"
              className="flex-1 max-w-xs px-3 py-2 text-sm rounded-lg border border-blue-200 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-400"
            />
            <Button size="sm" loading={recordingPayment} onClick={handleRecordPayment}>Save</Button>
            <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => setShowPaymentBox(false)}>Cancel</Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">

        {/* ── Left column ── */}
        <div className="space-y-4">

          {/* Status */}
          <Card>
            <CardBody className="space-y-3">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <span className="text-sm text-slate-500">Status</span>
                {salesOrder.status === 'ready' ? (
                  <span className="inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md text-xs font-medium bg-teal-100 text-teal-700">
                    Reserved
                  </span>
                ) : (
                  <OrderStatusBadge status={salesOrder.status} />
                )}
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between text-sm">
                <span className="text-slate-500">SO Number</span>
                <span className="font-mono font-bold text-slate-900">{salesOrder.so_number}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between text-sm">
                <span className="text-slate-500">Order Date</span>
                <span className="text-slate-700">{formatDate(salesOrder.order_date)}</span>
              </div>
              {salesOrder.delivery_date && (
                <div className="flex justify-between text-sm">
                  <span className="text-slate-500">Delivery By</span>
                  <span className={
                    new Date(salesOrder.delivery_date) < new Date() &&
                    !['delivered', 'cancelled'].includes(salesOrder.status)
                      ? 'text-red-500 font-medium'
                      : 'text-slate-700'
                  }>
                    {formatDate(salesOrder.delivery_date)}
                  </span>
                </div>
              )}
              {salesOrder.payment_terms && (
                <div className="flex justify-between text-sm">
                  <span className="text-slate-500">Payment</span>
                  <span className="text-slate-700 text-right text-xs max-w-[160px]">
                    {salesOrder.payment_terms}
                  </span>
                </div>
              )}
            </CardBody>
          </Card>

          {/* Client */}
          <Card>
            <CardHeader>
              <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-2">
                <User className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600" />
                Client
              </h3>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardBody className="space-y-1.5 text-sm">
              <div className="font-semibold text-slate-900">{client?.name}</div>
              {client?.phone && <div className="text-slate-500">{client.phone}</div>}
              {client?.gst_number && (
                <div className="font-mono text-xs text-slate-400">GST: {client.gst_number}</div>
              )}
              {client?.address && (
                <div className="text-slate-500 text-xs">{client.address}, {client.city}</div>
              )}
            </CardBody>
          </Card>

          {/* Financials */}
          <Card>
            <CardHeader>
              <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-2">
                <CreditCard className="w-4 h-4 text-green-600" />
                Financials
              </h3>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardBody className="space-y-2 text-sm">
              <div className="flex justify-between">
                <span className="text-slate-500">Subtotal</span>
                <span>{formatCurrency(salesOrder.subtotal)}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between">
                <span className="text-slate-500">GST</span>
                <span>{formatCurrency(salesOrder.gst_amount)}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between font-semibold border-t border-slate-100 pt-2">
                <span>Total</span>
                <span>{formatCurrency(salesOrder.total_amount)}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between">
                <span className="text-slate-500">Advance Paid</span>
                <span className="text-green-600 font-medium">
                  {formatCurrency(salesOrder.advance_paid ?? 0)}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between font-bold border-t border-slate-100 pt-2">
                <span>Balance Due</span>
                <span className={(salesOrder.balance_due ?? 0) > 0 ? 'text-amber-600' : 'text-green-600'}>
                  {(salesOrder.balance_due ?? 0) > 0 ? formatCurrency(salesOrder.balance_due) : 'Paid ✓'}
                </span>
              </div>
            </CardBody>
          </Card>

          {/* Source quotation */}
          {salesOrder.quotation_id && (
            <Card>
              <CardBody className="text-sm">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span className="text-slate-500 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <FileText className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    Source Quotation
                  </span>
                  <Link
                    href={`/quotations/${salesOrder.quotation_id as string}`}
                    className="font-mono text-blue-600 hover:underline text-xs"
                  >
                    {(salesOrder.quotation as any)?.quotation_no}
                  </Link>
                </div>
              </CardBody>
            </Card>
          )}

          {/* Active reservations */}
          {hasReservations && (
            <Card>
              <CardHeader>
                <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Package className="w-4 h-4 text-teal-600" />
                  Reserved Stock
                  <Badge variant="teal">{reservations?.length}</Badge>
                </h3>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardBody className="space-y-2 text-sm">
                {reservations?.map((r: any) => (
                  <div key={r.id} className="flex justify-between items-center">
                    <span className="text-slate-600 text-xs truncate max-w-[140px]">{r.item_id}</span>
                    <span className="font-medium text-teal-700">{r.qty_reserved} reserved</span>
                  </div>
                ))}
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 pt-1 border-t border-slate-100">
                  These quantities are committed for this order only.
                  {!isCancelled && ' Cancelling the order will release them back to available stock.'}
                </p>
              </CardBody>
            </Card>
          )}

          {/* Deliveries */}
          {challans.length > 0 && (
            <Card>
              <CardHeader>
                <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Truck className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600" />
                  Deliveries
                </h3>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardBody className="space-y-2">
                {challans.map((c: any) => (
                  <div key={c.id} className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
                    <Link href={`/dispatch/${c.id}`} className="font-mono text-blue-600 hover:underline">
                      {c.challan_no}
                    </Link>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <span className="text-slate-400 text-xs">{formatDate(c.challan_date)}</span>
                      <Badge variant={c.status === 'delivered' ? 'success' : 'warning'}>{c.status}</Badge>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </CardBody>
            </Card>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* ── Right: Line items ── */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-2">
          <Card>
            <CardHeader>
              <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900">
                Line Items
                <span className="ml-2 text-xs font-normal text-slate-400">
                  {lines.length} item{lines.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}
                </span>
              </h3>
            </CardHeader>
            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
              <table className="w-full text-sm">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="bg-slate-50 border-b border-slate-100">
                    <th className="text-left px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">#</th>
                    <th className="text-left px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">Item</th>
                    <th className="text-right px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">Ordered</th>
                    <th className="text-right px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">Dispatched</th>
                    <th className="text-right px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">Rate</th>
                    <th className="text-right px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">Total</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-50">
                  {lines.map((line: any, i: number) => {
                    const subtotal      = line.qty * line.unit_rate
                    const gst           = subtotal * Number(line.gst_percent) / 100
                    const allDispatched = (line.qty_dispatched ?? 0) >= line.qty
                    return (
                      <tr key={line.id} className="hover:bg-slate-50">
                        <td className="px-4 py-3 text-slate-400 text-xs">{i + 1}</td>
                        <td className="px-4 py-3">
                          <span className="font-mono text-xs text-slate-400 bg-slate-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded mr-2">
                            {line.item?.item_code}
                          </span>
                          <span className="font-medium text-slate-900">
                            {line.description || line.item?.name}
                          </span>
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right tabular-nums font-semibold">
                          {formatQty(line.qty, line.unit)}
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right tabular-nums">
                          <span className={allDispatched ? 'text-green-600 font-medium' : 'text-amber-600'}>
                            {formatQty(line.qty_dispatched ?? 0, line.unit)}
                          </span>
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right tabular-nums text-slate-600">
                          {formatCurrency(line.unit_rate)}
                          <div className="text-xs text-slate-400">/{line.unit}</div>
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right tabular-nums">
                          <div className="font-semibold text-slate-900">{formatCurrency(subtotal + gst)}</div>
                          <div className="text-xs text-slate-400">incl. {line.gst_percent}% GST</div>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    )
                  })}
                </tbody>
                <tfoot>
                  <tr className="bg-slate-50 border-t border-slate-200">
                    <td colSpan={5} className="px-4 py-2.5 text-right text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">Subtotal</td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-2.5 text-right font-semibold tabular-nums">{formatCurrency(salesOrder.subtotal ?? 0)}</td>
                  </tr>
                  <tr className="bg-slate-50">
                    <td colSpan={5} className="px-4 py-1.5 text-right text-xs text-slate-500">GST</td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-1.5 text-right tabular-nums text-slate-600">{formatCurrency(salesOrder.gst_amount ?? 0)}</td>
                  </tr>
                  <tr className="bg-blue-50 border-t border-blue-100">
                    <td colSpan={5} className="px-4 py-3 text-right font-bold text-slate-800">Total</td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right font-bold text-blue-600 text-base tabular-nums">{formatCurrency(salesOrder.total_amount ?? 0)}</td>
                  </tr>
                </tfoot>
              </table>
            </div>
          </Card>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}
```
