```tsx
'use client'

import { useState } from 'react'
import { useSalesOrders } from '@/lib/hooks/use-sales-orders'
import { PageHeader } from '@/components/layout/page-header'
import { OrderStatusBadge } from '@/components/ui/badge'
import { TableLoader } from '@/components/ui/spinner'
import { formatCurrency, formatDate } from '@/lib/utils/format'
import { Search, Eye, AlertCircle } from 'lucide-react'
import Link from 'next/link'
import type { Enums } from '@/lib/types/database'

type OrderStatus = Enums<'order_status'>

// Removed in_production. ready → reserved.
const STATUS_TABS: { label: string; value: OrderStatus | '' }[] = [
  { label: 'All',        value: '' },
  { label: 'Confirmed',  value: 'confirmed' },
  { label: 'Reserved',   value: 'ready' },       // 'ready' in DB = 'Reserved' in UI
  { label: 'Dispatched', value: 'dispatched' },
  { label: 'Delivered',  value: 'delivered' },
  { label: 'Cancelled',  value: 'cancelled' },
]

// Maps DB status to friendly display label
function statusLabel(status: string): string {
  const map: Record<string, string> = {
    draft:         'Draft',
    confirmed:     'Confirmed',
    in_production: 'In Production', // legacy — keep for display only
    ready:         'Reserved',      // renamed
    dispatched:    'Dispatched',
    delivered:     'Delivered',
    cancelled:     'Cancelled',
  }
  return map[status] ?? status
}

export default function SalesOrdersPage() {
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<OrderStatus | ''>('')
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('')

  const { data: orders, isLoading } = useSalesOrders({
    status: status || undefined,
    search,
  })

  const totalOutstanding = (orders ?? [])
    .filter((o: any) => (o.balance_due ?? 0) > 0)
    .reduce((s: number, o: any) => s + (o.balance_due ?? 0), 0)

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="Sales Orders"
        description="Track orders from confirmation through dispatch and delivery"
      />

      {/* Outstanding balance alert */}
      {totalOutstanding > 0 && (
        <div className="mb-4 flex items-center gap-3 bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 rounded-xl px-5 py-3">
          <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-600 flex-shrink-0" />
          <span className="text-sm text-amber-800">
            Total outstanding balance:{' '}
            <strong>{formatCurrency(totalOutstanding)}</strong>
          </span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Status tabs */}
      <div className="flex gap-1 mb-4 bg-slate-100 p-1 rounded-lg w-fit overflow-x-auto">
        {STATUS_TABS.map(tab => (
          <button
            key={tab.value}
            onClick={() => setStatus(tab.value)}
            className={`
              px-3 py-1.5 rounded-md text-sm font-medium transition-all whitespace-nowrap
              ${status === tab.value
                ? 'bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-sm'
                : 'text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-700'
              }
            `}
          >
            {tab.label}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Search */}
      <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm mb-6">
        <div className="px-5 py-4 flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="relative flex-1 max-w-sm">
            <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-slate-400" />
            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder="Search by SO number…"
              value={search}
              onChange={e => setSearch(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full pl-9 pr-4 py-2 text-sm rounded-lg border border-slate-300 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-transparent"
            />
          </div>
          <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 ml-auto">
            {orders?.length ?? 0} orders
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Table */}
      <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm overflow-hidden">
        {isLoading ? <TableLoader /> : (
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full text-sm">
              <thead>
                <tr className="bg-slate-50 border-b border-slate-200">
                  <th className="text-left px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">SO Number</th>
                  <th className="text-left px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">Client</th>
                  <th className="text-left px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">Order Date</th>
                  <th className="text-left px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">Delivery By</th>
                  <th className="text-right px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">Total</th>
                  <th className="text-right px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">Balance Due</th>
                  <th className="text-center px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">Status</th>
                  <th className="text-left px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">Quotation</th>
                  <th className="text-center px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">View</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-50">
                {orders?.length === 0 && (
                  <tr>
                    <td colSpan={9} className="text-center py-12 text-slate-400 text-sm">
                      No sales orders found
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                )}
                {orders?.map((order: any) => {
                  const isOverdue = order.delivery_date &&
                    new Date(order.delivery_date) < new Date() &&
                    !['delivered', 'cancelled'].includes(order.status)

                  // Show "Reserved" label instead of "Ready"
                  const displayStatus = order.status === 'ready' ? 'reserved' : order.status

                  return (
                    <tr
                      key={order.id}
                      className={`hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors ${isOverdue ? 'bg-red-50/30' : ''}`}
                    >
                      <td className="px-4 py-3">
                        <Link
                          href={`/sales-orders/${order.id}`}
                          className="font-mono text-sm font-semibold text-blue-600 hover:underline"
                        >
                          {order.so_number}
                        </Link>
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-3">
                        <div className="font-medium text-slate-900">
                          {order.client?.name}
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-xs text-slate-400">
                          {order.client?.phone}
                        </div>
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-3 text-slate-600">
                        {formatDate(order.order_date)}
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-3">
                        <span className={isOverdue ? 'text-red-600 font-medium' : 'text-slate-600'}>
                          {order.delivery_date ? formatDate(order.delivery_date) : '—'}
                          {isOverdue && ' ⚠'}
                        </span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right tabular-nums font-semibold text-slate-900">
                        {formatCurrency(order.total_amount)}
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right tabular-nums">
                        {(order.balance_due ?? 0) > 0 ? (
                          <span className="text-amber-600 font-medium">
                            {formatCurrency(order.balance_due)}
                          </span>
                        ) : (
                          <span className="text-green-600 text-xs font-medium">Paid ✓</span>
                        )}
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-3 text-center">
                        {/* Override badge for ready→reserved */}
                        {order.status === 'ready' ? (
                          <span className="inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md text-xs font-medium bg-teal-100 text-teal-700">
                            Reserved
                          </span>
                        ) : (
                          <OrderStatusBadge status={order.status} />
                        )}
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-3">
                        {order.quotation?.quotation_no ? (
                          <Link
                            href={`/quotations/${order.quotation_id}`}
                            className="font-mono text-xs text-slate-500 hover:text-blue-600 hover:underline"
                          >
                            {order.quotation.quotation_no}
                          </Link>
                        ) : (
                          <span className="text-slate-300 text-xs">Direct</span>
                        )}
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-3 text-center">
                        <Link href={`/sales-orders/${order.id}`}>
                          <button className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:text-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-50 transition-colors">
                            <Eye className="w-4 h-4" />
                          </button>
                        </Link>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  )
                })}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}
```

```tsx
'use client'

import { useState } from 'react'
import { useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'
import { useIsAdmin, useProfile } from '@/lib/hooks/use-profile'
import { PageHeader } from '@/components/layout/page-header'
import { Card, CardBody, CardHeader } from '@/components/ui/card'
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge'
import { TableLoader } from '@/components/ui/spinner'
import { formatDate, formatCurrency } from '@/lib/utils/format'
import { toast } from 'sonner'
import {
  Shield, RefreshCw, Tag,
  Check, X, AlertTriangle, Users,
} from 'lucide-react'
import type { Enums } from '@/lib/types/database'
import { useOrgId } from '@/lib/hooks/use-tenant'


type UserRole = Enums<"user_role">
// ── Tabs ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const TABS = ['Users', 'Price Update', 'Reconcile'] as const
type Tab = typeof TABS[number]

// ── Role badge colors ─────────────────────────────────────────
const ROLE_COLORS: Record<UserRole, 'danger' | 'warning' | 'info' | 'teal' | 'purple' | 'default'> = {
  admin:      'danger',
  manager:    'warning',
  sales:      'info',
  store:      'teal',
  production: 'purple',
  viewer:     'default',
}

// ── Fetch all profiles ────────────────────────────────────────
function useAllProfiles(orgId: string | null) {
  const supabase = createClient();

  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ["all-profiles", orgId],
    queryFn: async () => {
      if (!orgId) return [];

      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from("profiles")
        .select("id, full_name, role, is_active, created_at")
        .eq("org_id", orgId)
        .order("full_name");

      if (error) throw error;
      return data;
    },
    enabled: !!orgId,
    staleTime: 60 * 1000,
  });
}

// ── Fetch items with current prices ──────────────────────────
function useItemsWithPrices(search: string, orgId: string | null) {
  const supabase = createClient();
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ["items-for-price-update", orgId, search],
    queryFn: async () => {
      if (!orgId) return [];

      let query = supabase
        .from("items")
        .select(
          `
              id,
              item_code,
              name,
              unit_id,
              category_id,
              item_category:item_categories (
                id,
                name
              ),
              unit:units (
                id,
                name
              )
            `
        )
        .eq("is_active", true)
        .order("category_id");

      if (search) {
        query = query.or(`name.ilike.%${search}%,item_code.ilike.%${search}%`);
      }

      const { data: items, error } = await query;
      if (error) throw error;

      const { data: prices } = await supabase
        .from("v_current_prices")
        .select(
          "item_id, purchase_rate, selling_rate, gst_percent, rate_unit, effective_from"
        );

      const priceMap = new Map(prices?.map((p) => [p.item_id, p]) ?? []);
      return (
        items?.map((i) => ({
          ...i,
          currentPrice: priceMap.get(i.id) ?? null,
        })) ?? []
      );  
    },
    staleTime: 2 * 60 * 1000,
    enabled: !!orgId,
  });
}

export default function SettingsPage() {
  const supabase     = createClient()
  const qc           = useQueryClient()
  const isAdmin      = useIsAdmin()
  const orgId        = useOrgId()
  const { data: me } = useProfile()

  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<Tab>('Users')

  // ── Users state ───────────────────────────────────────────
  const { data: profiles, isLoading: loadingProfiles } = useAllProfiles(orgId)
  const [updatingRole, setUpdatingRole] = useState<string | null>(null)

  // ── Price update state ────────────────────────────────────
  const [priceSearch,  setPriceSearch]  = useState('')
  const [editingPrice, setEditingPrice] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [newPurchase,  setNewPurchase]  = useState('')
  const [newSelling,   setNewSelling]   = useState('')
  const [savingPrice,  setSavingPrice]  = useState(false)

  const { data: items, isLoading: loadingItems } = useItemsWithPrices(priceSearch, orgId)

  // ── Reconcile state ───────────────────────────────────────
  const [reconciling,     setReconciling]     = useState(false)
  const [reconcileResult, setReconcileResult] = useState<any[] | null>(null)

  // ── Update role ───────────────────────────────────────────
  async function handleRoleChange(userId: string, newRole: UserRole) {
    if (userId === me?.id) { toast.error("You can't change your own role"); return }
    setUpdatingRole(userId)
    try {
      const { error } = await supabase
        .from("profiles")
        .update({ role: newRole })
        .eq("id", userId);
      if (error) throw error;
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["all-profiles"] });
      toast.success("Role updated");
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      toast.error(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Operation failed");
    } finally {
      setUpdatingRole(null);
    }
  }

  // ── Toggle active ─────────────────────────────────────────
  async function handleToggleUser(userId: string, current: boolean) {
    if (userId === me?.id) { toast.error("You can't deactivate yourself"); return }
    const { error } = await supabase
      .from('profiles')
      .update({ is_active: !current })
      .eq('id', userId)
    if (error) { toast.error(error.message); return }
    qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['all-profiles'] })
    toast.success(current ? 'User deactivated' : 'User activated')
  }

  // ── Save new price ────────────────────────────────────────
  async function handleSavePrice(itemId: string) {
    if (!newSelling && !newPurchase) {
      toast.error('Enter at least a purchase or selling rate')
      return
    }

    if (!orgId) {
      toast.error("Organization not loaded");
      return;
    }

    setSavingPrice(true)
    try {
      const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser()
      const today = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]

      // Close the current active price
      await supabase
        .from('item_prices')
        .update({ effective_to: today })
        .eq('item_id', itemId)
        .is('effective_to', null)

      // Insert new price row
      ///LATEST CHANGE
      const currentPrice = items?.find((i) => i.id === itemId)?.currentPrice;

      const selectedItem = items?.find((i) => i.id === itemId);

      if (!selectedItem?.unit_id) {
        toast.error("Item has no unit assigned");
        return;
      }

      const { error } = await supabase.from("item_prices").insert({
        org_id: orgId,
        item_id: itemId,
        purchase_rate: newPurchase ? Number(newPurchase) : null,
        selling_rate: newSelling ? Number(newSelling) : null,
        gst_percent: (currentPrice?.gst_percent ?? "18") as any,
        unit_id: selectedItem.unit_id,
        effective_from: today,
        created_by: user?.id ?? null,
      });

      if (error) throw error

      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['items-for-price-update'] })
      setEditingPrice(null)
      setNewPurchase('')
      setNewSelling('')
      toast.success('Price updated — effective from today')
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      toast.error(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Operation failed");
    } finally {
      setSavingPrice(false)
    }
  }

  function cancelPriceEdit() {
    setEditingPrice(null)
    setNewPurchase('')
    setNewSelling('')
  }

  // ── Reconcile ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  async function handleReconcile() {
    setReconciling(true)
    setReconcileResult(null)
    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc("reconcile_inventory_balance");
      if (error) throw error;
      const result = (data as any[]) ?? [];
      setReconcileResult(result);
      if (result.length === 0) {
        toast.success("All balances correct — no drift detected");
      } else {
        toast.warning(
          `Fixed ${result.length} balance discrepanc${
            result.length === 1 ? "y" : "ies"
          }`
        );
      }
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      toast.error(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Operation failed");
    } finally {
      setReconciling(false);
    }
  }

  // ── Guard: admin only ─────────────────────────────────────
  if (!isAdmin) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center min-h-64">
        <div className="text-center">
          <Shield className="w-10 h-10 text-slate-300 mx-auto mb-3" />
          <p className="text-slate-600 font-medium">Admin access required</p>
          <p className="text-slate-400 text-sm mt-1">Only administrators can view settings</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    )
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="Settings"
        description="User management, item pricing, and system administration"
      />

      {/* Tabs */}
      <div className="flex gap-1 mb-6 bg-slate-100 p-1 rounded-lg w-fit">
        {TABS.map((tab) => (
          <button
            key={tab}
            onClick={() => setActiveTab(tab)}
            className={`
              px-4 py-2 rounded-md text-sm font-medium transition-all
              ${
                activeTab === tab
                  ? "bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-sm"
                  : "text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-700"
              }
            `}
          >
            {tab}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* ══ USERS ══════════════════════════════════════════════ */}
      {activeTab === "Users" && (
        <div>
          <div className="mb-4 flex items-start gap-3 bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 rounded-xl px-5 py-3">
            <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-600 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
            <div className="text-sm text-amber-800">
              <strong>To add new users:</strong> Go to your Supabase Dashboard →
              Authentication → Users → Add User. Their profile appears here
              automatically with the <strong>viewer</strong> role. Upgrade the
              role below.
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm overflow-hidden">
            {loadingProfiles ? (
              <TableLoader />
            ) : (
              <table className="w-full text-sm">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="bg-slate-50 border-b border-slate-200">
                    <th className="text-left px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                      User
                    </th>
                    <th className="text-left px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                      Current Role
                    </th>
                    <th className="text-left px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                      Change Role
                    </th>
                    <th className="text-center px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                      Status
                    </th>
                    <th className="text-left px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                      Joined
                    </th>
                    <th className="text-center px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                      Actions
                    </th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-50">
                  {profiles?.length === 0 && (
                    <tr>
                      <td
                        colSpan={6}
                        className="text-center py-10 text-slate-400 text-sm"
                      >
                        No user profiles found
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  )}
                  {profiles?.map((profile: any) => (
                    <tr
                      key={profile.id}
                      className={`hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors ${
                        !profile.is_active ? "opacity-50" : ""
                      }`}
                    >
                      <td className="px-4 py-3">
                        <div className="font-semibold text-slate-900">
                          {profile.full_name}
                        </div>
                        {profile.id === me?.id && (
                          <div className="text-xs text-blue-500 font-medium">
                            You
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-3">
                        <Badge variant={ROLE_COLORS[profile.role as UserRole]}>
                          {profile.role}
                        </Badge>
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-3">
                        {profile.id !== me?.id ? (
                          <select
                            value={profile.role}
                            disabled={updatingRole === profile.id}
                            onChange={(e) =>
                              handleRoleChange(
                                profile.id,
                                e.target.value as UserRole
                              )
                            }
                            className="
                              px-2 py-1.5 text-xs rounded-lg border border-slate-200
                              bg-white focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500
                              disabled:opacity-50
                            "
                          >
                            <option value="viewer">viewer</option>
                            <option value="production">production</option>
                            <option value="store">store</option>
                            <option value="sales">sales</option>
                            <option value="manager">manager</option>
                            <option value="admin">admin</option>
                          </select>
                        ) : (
                          <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 italic">
                            Cannot change own role
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-3 text-center">
                        <Badge
                          variant={profile.is_active ? "success" : "default"}
                        >
                          {profile.is_active ? "Active" : "Inactive"}
                        </Badge>
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-3 text-slate-500 text-xs">
                        {formatDate(profile.created_at)}
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-4 py-3 text-center">
                        {profile.id !== me?.id && (
                          <Button
                            variant="ghost"
                            size="sm"
                            onClick={() =>
                              handleToggleUser(profile.id, profile.is_active)
                            }
                            className={
                              profile.is_active
                                ? "text-red-500 hover:bg-red-50"
                                : "text-green-600 hover:bg-green-50"
                            }
                          >
                            {profile.is_active ? "Deactivate" : "Activate"}
                          </Button>
                        )}
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ══ PRICE UPDATE ═══════════════════════════════════════ */}
      {activeTab === "Price Update" && (
        <div>
          <div className="mb-4 bg-blue-50 border border-blue-200 rounded-xl px-5 py-3 text-sm text-blue-800">
            Updating a price <strong>creates a new record</strong> effective
            from today and closes the previous one. Old quotations and invoices
            are unaffected — they always stored the rate at the time of
            creation.
          </div>

          {/* Search */}
          <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm mb-4">
            <div className="px-5 py-4 flex items-center gap-3">
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder="Search items by name or code…"
                value={priceSearch}
                onChange={(e) => setPriceSearch(e.target.value)}
                className="
                  flex-1 max-w-sm px-3 py-2 text-sm rounded-lg border border-slate-300
                  focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-transparent
                "
              />
              <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 ml-auto">
                {items?.length ?? 0} items
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm overflow-hidden">
            {loadingItems ? (
              <TableLoader />
            ) : (
              <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                <table className="w-full text-sm">
                  <thead>
                    <tr className="bg-slate-50 border-b border-slate-200">
                      <th className="text-left px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                        Item
                      </th>
                      <th className="text-left px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                        Category
                      </th>
                      <th className="text-center px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                        Unit
                      </th>
                      <th className="text-right px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                        Purchase Rate
                      </th>
                      <th className="text-right px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                        Selling Rate
                      </th>
                      <th className="text-left px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                        Since
                      </th>
                      <th className="text-center px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                        Update
                      </th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-50">
                    {items?.length === 0 && (
                      <tr>
                        <td
                          colSpan={7}
                          className="text-center py-10 text-slate-400 text-sm"
                        >
                          No items found
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    )}
                    {items?.map((item: any) => (
                      <tr
                        key={item.id}
                        className="hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors"
                      >
                        <td className="px-4 py-3">
                          <span className="font-mono text-xs text-slate-400 bg-slate-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded mr-2">
                            {item.item_code}
                          </span>
                          <span className="font-medium text-slate-900">
                            {item.name}
                          </span>
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-4 py-3">
                          <Badge variant="default">
                            {item.item_category?.name ?? "—"}
                          </Badge>
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-4 py-3 text-center font-mono text-xs text-slate-500">
                          {item.unit?.name ?? "—"}
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right tabular-nums text-slate-600">
                          {item.currentPrice?.purchase_rate ? (
                            formatCurrency(item.currentPrice.purchase_rate)
                          ) : (
                            <span className="text-slate-300">—</span>
                          )}
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right tabular-nums font-semibold text-slate-900">
                          {item.currentPrice?.selling_rate ? (
                            formatCurrency(item.currentPrice.selling_rate)
                          ) : (
                            <span className="text-slate-300 font-normal">
                              —
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-4 py-3 text-xs text-slate-400">
                          {item.currentPrice?.effective_from
                            ? formatDate(item.currentPrice.effective_from)
                            : "—"}
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-4 py-3">
                          {editingPrice === item.id ? (
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                              <input
                                type="number"
                                min="0"
                                step="any"
                                placeholder="Purchase ₹"
                                value={newPurchase}
                                onChange={(e) => setNewPurchase(e.target.value)}
                                className="w-24 px-2 py-1 text-xs rounded border border-slate-200 text-right focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500"
                              />
                              <input
                                type="number"
                                min="0"
                                step="any"
                                placeholder="Selling ₹"
                                value={newSelling}
                                onChange={(e) => setNewSelling(e.target.value)}
                                className="w-24 px-2 py-1 text-xs rounded border border-slate-200 text-right focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500"
                              />
                              <button
                                onClick={() => handleSavePrice(item.id)}
                                disabled={savingPrice}
                                className="p-1.5 rounded text-green-600 hover:bg-green-50 disabled:opacity-50"
                              >
                                <Check className="w-4 h-4" />
                              </button>
                              <button
                                onClick={cancelPriceEdit}
                                className="p-1.5 rounded text-red-500 hover:bg-red-50"
                              >
                                <X className="w-4 h-4" />
                              </button>
                            </div>
                          ) : (
                            <Button
                              variant="ghost"
                              size="sm"
                              onClick={() => {
                                setEditingPrice(item.id);
                                setNewPurchase(
                                  String(item.currentPrice?.purchase_rate ?? "")
                                );
                                setNewSelling(
                                  String(item.currentPrice?.selling_rate ?? "")
                                );
                              }}
                            >
                              <Tag className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                              Update
                            </Button>
                          )}
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ══ RECONCILE ══════════════════════════════════════════ */}
      {activeTab === "Reconcile" && (
        <div className="max-w-2xl">
          <Card>
            <CardHeader>
              <h3 className="font-semibold text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-2">
                <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600" />
                Inventory Balance Reconciliation
              </h3>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardBody className="space-y-4">
              <p className="text-sm text-slate-600 leading-relaxed">
                This function recalculates every item's inventory balance from
                scratch using the raw <strong>stock_movements</strong> ledger as
                the source of truth. It compares the recalculated values against
                the cached
                <strong> inventory_balance</strong> table and corrects any
                discrepancies.
              </p>

              <div className="bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg p-3 text-sm text-slate-600">
                In normal operation this should report{" "}
                <strong>zero discrepancies.</strong> Run it if inventory numbers
                appear incorrect after investigation, after a manual database
                edit, or after a system migration.
              </div>

              <div className="bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 rounded-lg p-3 text-sm text-amber-800">
                <strong>Safe to run anytime.</strong> It only corrects the
                cached balance rows — it never touches the immutable
                stock_movements ledger.
              </div>

              <Button
                loading={reconciling}
                onClick={handleReconcile}
                className="bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-900"
              >
                <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4" />
                Run Reconciliation
              </Button>

              {/* Results */}
              {reconcileResult !== null && !reconciling && (
                <div className="mt-2">
                  {reconcileResult.length === 0 ? (
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 bg-green-50 border border-green-200 rounded-lg p-4 text-sm text-green-800">
                      <Check className="w-4 h-4 text-green-600 flex-shrink-0" />
                      All inventory balances are correct — no discrepancies
                      found
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    <div>
                      <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-amber-700 mb-3">
                        Fixed {reconcileResult.length} discrepanc
                        {reconcileResult.length === 1 ? "y" : "ies"}:
                      </p>
                      <div className="overflow-x-auto rounded-lg border border-slate-200">
                        <table className="w-full text-xs">
                          <thead>
                            <tr className="bg-slate-50 border-b border-slate-200">
                              <th className="text-left px-3 py-2 font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                                Item ID
                              </th>
                              <th className="text-right px-3 py-2 font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                                Old Qty
                              </th>
                              <th className="text-right px-3 py-2 font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                                New Qty
                              </th>
                              <th className="text-right px-3 py-2 font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                                Difference
                              </th>
                            </tr>
                          </thead>
                          <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
                            {reconcileResult.map((r: any, i: number) => (
                              <tr key={i} className="hover:bg-slate-50">
                                <td className="px-3 py-2 font-mono text-slate-500 truncate max-w-[200px]">
                                  {r.item_id}
                                </td>
                                <td className="px-3 py-2 text-right tabular-nums text-slate-600">
                                  {r.old_qty}
                                </td>
                                <td className="px-3 py-2 text-right tabular-nums font-semibold text-slate-900">
                                  {r.new_qty}
                                </td>
                                <td
                                  className={`px-3 py-2 text-right tabular-nums font-bold ${
                                    r.diff > 0
                                      ? "text-green-600"
                                      : "text-red-600"
                                  }`}
                                >
                                  {r.diff > 0 ? "+" : ""}
                                  {r.diff}
                                </td>
                              </tr>
                            ))}
                          </tbody>
                        </table>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              )}
            </CardBody>
          </Card>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

# src/app/(dashboard)/suppliers/page.tsx

```tsx
'use client'

import { useState } from 'react'
import { useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'
import { PageHeader } from '@/components/layout/page-header'
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge'
import { Input, Textarea } from '@/components/ui/input'
import { TableLoader } from '@/components/ui/spinner'
import { toast } from 'sonner'
import { Plus, Search, X } from 'lucide-react'
import { useOrgId } from '@/lib/hooks/use-tenant'

function useSuppliers(search: string, orgId: string | null) {
  const supabase = createClient();
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ["suppliers", orgId, search],
    queryFn: async () => {
      if (!orgId) return [];
      let query = supabase.from("suppliers").select("*").order("name");
      if (search) {
        query = query.or(`name.ilike.%${search}%,phone.ilike.%${search}%`);
      }
      const { data, error } = await query;
      if (error) throw error;
      return data;
    },
    staleTime: 2 * 60 * 1000,
    enabled: !!orgId,
  });
}

interface SupplierForm {
  name:           string
  contact_person: string
  phone:          string
  email:          string
  address:        string
  city:           string
  state:          string
  gst_number:     string
  payment_terms:  string
  notes:          string
}

const EMPTY: SupplierForm = {
  name: '', contact_person: '', phone: '', email: '',
  address: '', city: '', state: 'Gujarat',
  gst_number: '', payment_terms: '', notes: '',
}

export default function SuppliersPage() {
  const supabase = createClient()
  const qc       = useQueryClient()
  const orgId    = useOrgId()

  const [search,   setSearch]   = useState('')
  const [showForm, setShowForm] = useState(false)
  const [editId,   setEditId]   = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [form,     setForm]     = useState<SupplierForm>(EMPTY)
  const [saving,   setSaving]   = useState(false)

  const { data: suppliers, isLoading } = useSuppliers(search, orgId)

  const f = (field: keyof SupplierForm) => (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement | HTMLTextAreaElement>) =>
    setForm(prev => ({ ...prev, [field]: e.target.value }))

  function openNew() { setForm(EMPTY); setEditId(null); setShowForm(true) }
  function openEdit(s: any) {
    setForm({
      name:           s.name           ?? '',
      contact_person: s.contact_person ?? '',
      phone:          s.phone          ?? '',
      email:          s.email          ?? '',
      address:        s.address        ?? '',
      city:           s.city           ?? '',
      state:          s.state          ?? 'Gujarat',
      gst_number:     s.gst_number     ?? '',
      payment_terms:  s.payment_terms  ?? '',
      notes:          s.notes          ?? '',
    })
    setEditId(s.id)
    setShowForm(true)
  }

  async function handleSave() {
    if (!form.name.trim()) { toast.error('Supplier name is required'); return }
    if (!orgId) {
      toast.error("Organization not loaded");
      return;
    }
    setSaving(true)
    try {
      const payload = {
        name:           form.name.trim(),
        contact_person: form.contact_person || null,
        phone:          form.phone          || null,
        email:          form.email          || null,
        address:        form.address        || null,
        city:           form.city           || null,
        state:          form.state          || null,
        gst_number:     form.gst_number     || null,
        payment_terms:  form.payment_terms  || null,
        notes:          form.notes          || null,
      }

      if (editId) {
        const { error } = await supabase.from('suppliers').update(payload).eq('id', editId)
        if (error) throw error
        toast.success('Supplier updated')
      } else {
        const { error } = await supabase.from('suppliers').insert({
          ...payload,
          org_id: orgId,
        })
        if (error) throw error
        toast.success('Supplier added')
      }

      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['suppliers'] })
      setShowForm(false)
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      toast.error(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to save supplier')
    } finally {
      setSaving(false)
    }
  }

  async function handleToggle(id: string, current: boolean) {
    const { error } = await supabase.from('suppliers').update({ is_active: !current }).eq('id', id)
    if (error) { toast.error(error.message); return }
    qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['suppliers'] })
    toast.success(current ? 'Supplier deactivated' : 'Supplier activated')
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader title="Suppliers" description="Vendor master — all raw material and trading goods suppliers">
        <Button size="sm" onClick={openNew}>
          <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
          New Supplier
        </Button>
      </PageHeader>

      {/* Slide-in form */}
      {showForm && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex justify-end">
          <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/20 backdrop-blur-sm" onClick={() => setShowForm(false)} />
          <div className="relative w-full max-w-md bg-white shadow-2xl overflow-y-auto">
            <div className="sticky top-0 bg-white border-b border-slate-200 px-6 py-4 flex items-center justify-between">
              <h2 className="font-semibold text-slate-900">{editId ? 'Edit Supplier' : 'New Supplier'}</h2>
              <button onClick={() => setShowForm(false)} className="text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600">
                <X className="w-5 h-5" />
              </button>
            </div>
            <div className="px-6 py-5 space-y-4">
              <Input label="Supplier Name" required value={form.name} onChange={f('name')} placeholder="e.g. Sun Insulators Pvt Ltd" />
              <Input label="Contact Person" value={form.contact_person} onChange={f('contact_person')} />
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <Input label="Phone" value={form.phone} onChange={f('phone')} />
                <Input label="Email" type="email" value={form.email} onChange={f('email')} />
              </div>
              <Input label="GST Number" value={form.gst_number} onChange={f('gst_number')} placeholder="24XXXXX1234X1ZX" />
              <Textarea label="Address" value={form.address} onChange={f('address')} />
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <Input label="City" value={form.city} onChange={f('city')} />
                <Input label="State" value={form.state} onChange={f('state')} />
              </div>
              <Input label="Payment Terms" value={form.payment_terms} onChange={f('payment_terms')} placeholder="e.g. 100% advance before delivery" />
              <Textarea label="Notes" value={form.notes} onChange={f('notes')} placeholder="Specialities, lead times, notes…" />
            </div>
            <div className="sticky bottom-0 bg-white border-t border-slate-200 px-6 py-4 flex gap-3">
              <Button variant="outline" className="flex-1" onClick={() => setShowForm(false)}>Cancel</Button>
              <Button className="flex-1" loading={saving} onClick={handleSave}>
                {editId ? 'Save Changes' : 'Add Supplier'}
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Search */}
      <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm mb-6">
        <div className="px-5 py-4 flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="relative flex-1 max-w-sm">
            <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-slate-400" />
            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder="Search by name or phone…"
              value={search}
              onChange={e => setSearch(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full pl-9 pr-4 py-2 text-sm rounded-lg border border-slate-300 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-transparent"
            />
          </div>
          <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 ml-auto">{suppliers?.length ?? 0} suppliers</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Table */}
      <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm overflow-hidden">
        {isLoading ? <TableLoader /> : (
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full text-sm">
              <thead>
                <tr className="bg-slate-50 border-b border-slate-200">
                  <th className="text-left px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">Supplier</th>
                  <th className="text-left px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">Contact</th>
                  <th className="text-left px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">Location</th>
                  <th className="text-left px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">GST No.</th>
                  <th className="text-left px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">Payment Terms</th>
                  <th className="text-center px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">Status</th>
                  <th className="text-center px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase">Actions</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-50">
                {suppliers?.length === 0 && (
                  <tr><td colSpan={7} className="text-center py-12 text-slate-400 text-sm">No suppliers found</td></tr>
                )}
                {suppliers?.map((s: any) => (
                  <tr key={s.id} className={`hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors ${!s.is_active ? 'opacity-50' : ''}`}>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3">
                      <div className="font-semibold text-slate-900">{s.name}</div>
                      {s.contact_person && <div className="text-xs text-slate-400">{s.contact_person}</div>}
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3">
                      <div className="text-slate-700">{s.phone ?? '—'}</div>
                      {s.email && <div className="text-xs text-slate-400">{s.email}</div>}
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3 text-slate-600">
                      {[s.city, s.state].filter(Boolean).join(', ') || '—'}
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3">
                      {s.gst_number
                        ? <span className="font-mono text-xs text-slate-600">{s.gst_number}</span>
                        : <span className="text-slate-300">—</span>
                      }
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3 text-slate-600 text-xs max-w-[200px]">
                      {s.payment_terms ?? '—'}
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3 text-center">
                      <Badge variant={s.is_active ? 'success' : 'default'}>
                        {s.is_active ? 'Active' : 'Inactive'}
                      </Badge>
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3 text-center">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
                        <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => openEdit(s)}>Edit</Button>
                        <Button
                          variant="ghost"
                          size="sm"
                          onClick={() => handleToggle(s.id, s.is_active)}
                          className={s.is_active ? 'text-red-500 hover:bg-red-50' : 'text-green-600 hover:bg-green-50'}
                        >
                          {s.is_active ? 'Deactivate' : 'Activate'}
                        </Button>
                      </div>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}
```

```tsx
'use client'

import { useState } from 'react'
import { useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'
import { useProfile } from '@/lib/hooks/use-profile'
import { produceInventory, consumeInventory } from '@/lib/utils/inventory'
import { PageHeader } from '@/components/layout/page-header'
import { Card, CardBody, CardHeader } from '@/components/ui/card'
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'
import { Badge, ProductionStatusBadge } from '@/components/ui/badge'
import { PageLoader, TableLoader } from '@/components/ui/spinner'
import { formatDate, formatQty } from '@/lib/utils/format'
import { toast } from 'sonner'
import { useOrgId } from "@/lib/hooks/use-tenant";

import {
  Play, CheckCircle, ClipboardList,
  Package, HardHat, Calendar, AlertTriangle
} from 'lucide-react'
import Link from 'next/link'

// ── Fetch tasks assigned to the current user's worker profile ─
// Workers are matched by name to profiles.full_name
// OR admin/manager sees ALL pending/in_progress tasks
function useTasks(
  profileId: string | undefined,
  role: string | undefined,
  orgId: string | null
) {
  const supabase = createClient();

  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ["tasks", orgId, profileId, role],
    queryFn: async () => {
      if (!profileId || !orgId) return [];

      // Admin/manager — see all active production orders
      if (role === "admin" || role === "manager") {
        const { data, error } = await supabase
          .from("production_orders")
          .select(
            `
            id, po_number, status,
            start_date, target_date, completed_date, notes,
            created_at,
              production_order_items (
                id,
                qty_required,
                qty_produced,
                unit_id,
                unit:units (
                  id,
                  name
                ),
                item:items (
                  id,
                  item_code,
                  name,
                  unit_id
                )
              ),
            production_assignments (
              id,
              worker:workers ( id, name, skill )
            )
          `
          )
          .in("status", ["pending", "in_progress", "on_hold"])
          .order("created_at", { ascending: true });

        if (error) throw error;
        return data ?? [];
      }

      // Production worker — see only their assigned tasks
      // Match worker record by email from auth session (reliable, no name typo issues)
      const {
        data: { user },
      } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
      if (!user?.email) return [];

      // Find worker by email match
      const { data: worker } = await supabase
        .from("workers")
        .select("id")
        .ilike("email", user.email)
        .eq("is_active", true)
        .maybeSingle();

      if (!worker) return [];

      // Get production orders assigned to this worker
      const { data: assignments } = await supabase
        .from("production_assignments")
        .select("production_order_id")
        .eq("worker_id", worker.id);

      if (!assignments || assignments.length === 0) return [];

      const orderIds = assignments.map((a) => a.production_order_id);

      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from("production_orders")
        .select(
          `
          id, po_number, status,
          start_date, target_date, completed_date, notes,
          created_at,
            production_order_items (
              id,
              qty_required,
              qty_produced,
              unit_id,
              unit:units (
                id,
                name
              ),
              item:items (
                id,
                item_code,
                name,
                unit_id
              )
            ),
          production_assignments (
            id,
            worker:workers ( id, name, skill )
          )
        `
        )
        .in("id", orderIds)
        .in("status", ["pending", "in_progress", "on_hold"])
        .order("created_at", { ascending: true });

      if (error) throw error;
      return data ?? [];
    },
    enabled: !!profileId && !!orgId,
    staleTime: 30 * 1000,
    refetchInterval: 60 * 1000,
  });
}

export default function TasksPage() {
  const supabase = createClient()
  const qc       = useQueryClient()

  const { data: profile, isLoading: profileLoading } = useProfile()
  const orgId = useOrgId();

  const { data: tasks, isLoading: tasksLoading } = useTasks(
    profile?.id,
    profile?.role,
    orgId
  );

  const [startingId,    setStartingId]    = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [completingId,  setCompletingId]  = useState<string | null>(null)

  if (profileLoading) return <PageLoader />

  const isWorkerOrProduction = profile?.role === 'production'
  const isAdminOrManager     = profile?.role === 'admin' || profile?.role === 'manager'

  // ── Start production — consumes reserved raw materials ────
  async function handleStart(orderId: string, poNumber: string) {
    setStartingId(orderId)
    try {
      // Get active reservations for this production order
      const { data: reservations, error: resErr } = await supabase
        .from('stock_reservations')
        .select('id, item_id, qty_reserved, qty_consumed')
        .eq('ref_type', 'production_order')
        .eq('ref_id', orderId)
        .eq('status', 'active')

      if (resErr) throw resErr

      if (!reservations || reservations.length === 0) {
        toast.error('No reserved materials found for this order')
        return
      }

      // Consume all reserved raw materials at once
      for (const reservation of reservations) {
        const qtyToConsume = reservation.qty_reserved - reservation.qty_consumed
        if (qtyToConsume <= 0) continue

        await consumeInventory({
          itemId:        reservation.item_id,
          qty:           qtyToConsume,
          reservationId: reservation.id,
          refId:         orderId,
          notes:         `Consumed on start — ${poNumber}`,
        })
      }

      // Update status to in_progress
      const { error } = await supabase
        .from('production_orders')
        .update({
          status:     'in_progress',
          start_date: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
        })
        .eq('id', orderId)

      if (error) throw error

      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['tasks'] })
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['stock-levels'] })
      toast.success(`${poNumber} started — materials consumed`)

    } catch (err: unknown) {
  toast.error(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Operation failed')
    } finally {
      setStartingId(null)
    }
  }

  // ── Complete production — adds finished goods to stock ────
  async function handleComplete(orderId: string, poNumber: string, items: any[]) {
    setCompletingId(orderId)
    try {
      // Produce finished goods into stock
      for (const item of items) {
        await produceInventory({
          itemId: item.item?.id,
          qty:    item.qty_required,
          refId:  orderId,
          notes:  `Completed — ${poNumber}`,
        })

        // Update qty_produced
        await supabase
          .from('production_order_items')
          .update({ qty_produced: item.qty_required })
          .eq('id', item.id)
      }

      // Mark completed
      const { error } = await supabase
        .from('production_orders')
        .update({
          status:         'completed',
          completed_date: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
        })
        .eq('id', orderId)

      if (error) throw error

      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['tasks'] })
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['production-orders'] })
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['stock-levels'] })
      toast.success(`${poNumber} completed — finished goods added to stock`)

    } catch (err: unknown) {
  toast.error(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Operation failed')
    } finally {
      setCompletingId(null)
    }
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="My Tasks"
        description={
          isAdminOrManager
            ? 'All active production orders'
            : 'Production orders assigned to you'
        }
      />

      {/* Role context banner */}
      {isWorkerOrProduction && (
        <div className="mb-6 flex items-start gap-3 bg-purple-50 border border-purple-200 rounded-xl px-5 py-3">
          <HardHat className="w-4 h-4 text-purple-600 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
          <p className="text-sm text-purple-800">
            Showing production orders assigned to you.
            You can <strong>start</strong> and <strong>complete</strong> orders —
            but cannot create new production orders.
          </p>
        </div>
      )}

      {tasksLoading ? <TableLoader /> : (
        <>
          {(!tasks || tasks.length === 0) && (
            <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm">
              <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-16 text-center">
                <ClipboardList className="w-12 h-12 text-slate-200 mb-4" />
                <p className="text-slate-500 font-medium">No tasks assigned</p>
                <p className="text-slate-400 text-sm mt-1">
                  {isWorkerOrProduction
                    ? 'You have no active production orders assigned to you.'
                    : 'No pending or in-progress production orders.'
                  }
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="space-y-4">
            {tasks?.map((task: any) => {
              const items       = task.production_order_items ?? []
              const assignments = task.production_assignments ?? []
              const isPending    = task.status === 'pending'
              const isInProgress = task.status === 'in_progress'
              const isOnHold     = task.status === 'on_hold'
              const isOverdue    = task.target_date &&
                new Date(task.target_date) < new Date()

              return (
                <Card
                  key={task.id}
                  className={isOverdue ? 'border-red-200' : ''}
                >
                  <CardHeader>
                    <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                        <div className={`
                          w-10 h-10 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0
                          ${isPending    ? 'bg-slate-100' : ''}
                          ${isInProgress ? 'bg-purple-100' : ''}
                          ${isOnHold     ? 'bg-amber-100' : ''}
                        `}>
                          <Factory className={`w-5 h-5
                            ${isPending    ? 'text-slate-500' : ''}
                            ${isInProgress ? 'text-purple-600' : ''}
                            ${isOnHold     ? 'text-amber-600' : ''}
                          `} />
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <div className="font-semibold text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-2">
                            <Link
                              href={`/production/${task.id}`}
                              className="hover:text-blue-600 font-mono"
                            >
                              {task.po_number}
                            </Link>
                            <ProductionStatusBadge status={task.status} />
                            {isOverdue && (
                              <Badge variant="danger">Overdue</Badge>
                            )}
                          </div>
                          <div className="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-0.5 flex items-center gap-3">
                            {task.target_date && (
                              <span className={`flex items-center gap-1 ${isOverdue ? 'text-red-500' : ''}`}>
                                <Calendar className="w-3 h-3" />
                                Target: {formatDate(task.target_date)}
                              </span>
                            )}
                            {assignments.length > 0 && (
                              <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                                <HardHat className="w-3 h-3" />
                                {assignments.map((a: any) => a.worker?.name).join(', ')}
                              </span>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      {/* Action buttons */}
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-shrink-0">
                        {/* Start — pending orders only */}
                        {isPending && (
                          <Button
                            size="sm"
                            loading={startingId === task.id}
                            onClick={() => handleStart(task.id, task.po_number)}
                            className="bg-purple-600 hover:bg-purple-700"
                          >
                            <Play className="w-4 h-4" />
                            Start
                          </Button>
                        )}

                        {/* Complete — in progress orders only */}
                        {isInProgress && (
                          <Button
                            size="sm"
                            loading={completingId === task.id}
                            onClick={() => handleComplete(task.id, task.po_number, items)}
                            className="bg-green-600 hover:bg-green-700"
                          >
                            <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4" />
                            Complete
                          </Button>
                        )}

                        {/* On hold indicator */}
                        {isOnHold && (
                          <span className="text-xs text-amber-600 font-medium bg-amber-50 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-amber-200">
                            On Hold
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </CardHeader>

                  <CardBody className="pt-0">
                    {/* Items to produce */}
                    <div className="mt-3 space-y-2">
                      <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wide">
                        Items to Produce
                      </p>
                      {items.map((item: any) => {
                        const pct = item.qty_required > 0
                          ? Math.round((item.qty_produced / item.qty_required) * 100)
                          : 0

                        return (
                          <div key={item.id} className="flex items-center gap-3">
                            <div className="flex-1">
                              <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1">
                                <div className="text-sm text-slate-700">
                                  <span className="font-mono text-xs text-slate-400 bg-slate-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded mr-2">
                                    {item.item?.item_code}
                                  </span>
                                  {item.item?.name}
                                </div>
                                <div className="text-xs text-slate-500 tabular-nums">
                                  {formatQty(item.qty_produced, item.unit)} / {formatQty(item.qty_required, item.unit)}
                                </div>
                              </div>
                              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                                <div className="flex-1 bg-slate-100 rounded-full h-1.5">
                                  <div
                                    className={`h-1.5 rounded-full transition-all ${pct >= 100 ? 'bg-green-500' : 'bg-purple-500'}`}
                                    style={{ width: `${pct}%` }}
                                  />
                                </div>
                                <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 tabular-nums w-8 text-right">
                                  {pct}%
                                </span>
                              </div>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        )
                      })}
                    </div>

                    {/* Pending start warning */}
                    {isPending && (
                      <div className="mt-3 flex items-start gap-2 bg-amber-50 border border-amber-100 rounded-lg px-3 py-2">
                        <AlertTriangle className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-500 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                        <p className="text-xs text-amber-700">
                          Starting will automatically consume all reserved raw materials.
                          Make sure materials are physically ready.
                        </p>
                      </div>
                    )}

                    {task.notes && (
                      <p className="mt-3 text-xs text-slate-500 bg-slate-50 rounded-lg px-3 py-2">
                        📝 {task.notes}
                      </p>
                    )}
                  </CardBody>
                </Card>
              )
            })}
          </div>
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

// Import the Factory icon which is missing from imports above

      className={className}
```

```tsx
'use client'

import { useState } from 'react'
import { useOrgId } from "@/lib/hooks/use-tenant";
import { useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'
import { PageHeader } from '@/components/layout/page-header'
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge'
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input'
import { TableLoader } from '@/components/ui/spinner'
import { formatDate } from '@/lib/utils/format'
import { toast } from 'sonner'
import { Plus, X, HardHat, Mail, Copy, CheckCircle, Eye, EyeOff } from 'lucide-react'

function useWorkers(orgId: string | null) {
  const supabase = createClient();
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ["workers", orgId],
    queryFn: async () => {
      if (!orgId) return [];

      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from("workers")
        .select("*")
        .order("name");
      if (error) throw error;
      return data;
    },
    enabled: !!orgId,
    staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000,
  });
}

// Auto-generate email from name — mirrors the server logic
function generateEmail(name: string): string {
  const slug = name
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9\s]/g, '')
    .replace(/\s+/g, '.')
  return `${slug}@bluebox.com`
}

function defaultPassword(name: string): string {
  const slug = name.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '').slice(0, 6)
  return `bluebox@${slug}123`
}

interface WorkerForm {
  name:  string
  phone: string
  skill: string
}

interface CreatedAccount {
  email:    string
  password: string
  name:     string
}

const EMPTY: WorkerForm = { name: '', phone: '', skill: '' }

const SKILLS = [
  'Assembly & Welding',
  'Wiring & Testing',
  'GOD Set Assembly',
  'Channel Cutting & Drilling',
  'Quality Check & Packing',
  'General Labour',
]

export default function WorkersPage() {
  const supabase = createClient()
  const qc       = useQueryClient()
  const orgId = useOrgId();

  const [showForm,   setShowForm]   = useState(false)
  const [editId,     setEditId]     = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [form,       setForm]       = useState<WorkerForm>(EMPTY)
  const [saving,     setSaving]     = useState(false)
  // Shown after creation — credentials the admin shares with the worker
  const [created,    setCreated]    = useState<CreatedAccount | null>(null)
  const [showPass,   setShowPass]   = useState(false)
  const [copied,     setCopied]     = useState<string | null>(null)

  const { data: workers, isLoading } = useWorkers(orgId);

  const f = (field: keyof WorkerForm) =>
    (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) =>
      setForm(prev => ({ ...prev, [field]: e.target.value }))

  // Preview the generated email as user types the name
  const previewEmail = form.name.trim() ? generateEmail(form.name) : null
  const previewPass  = form.name.trim() ? defaultPassword(form.name) : null

  function openNew() { setForm(EMPTY); setEditId(null); setCreated(null); setShowForm(true) }

  function openEdit(w: any) {
    setForm({ name: w.name ?? '', phone: w.phone ?? '', skill: w.skill ?? '' })
    setEditId(w.id)
    setCreated(null)
    setShowForm(true)
  }

  async function copyToClipboard(text: string, key: string) {
    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text)
    setCopied(key)
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(null), 2000)
  }

  // ── Create new worker with auth account ───────────────────
  async function handleCreate() {
    if (!form.name.trim()) { toast.error('Worker name is required'); return }
    setSaving(true)
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/admin/create-worker", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          name: form.name.trim(),
          skill: form.skill || null,
          phone: form.phone || null,
        }),
      });

      const json = await res.json();

      if (!res.ok) {
        // Handle email collision suggestion
        if (res.status === 409 && json.suggestedEmail) {
          toast.error(json.error);
        } else {
          toast.error(json.error ?? "Failed to create worker");
        }
        return;
      }

      // Show the generated credentials to admin
      setCreated({
        email: json.email,
        password: json.password,
        name: form.name.trim(),
      });
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["workers"] });
      setForm(EMPTY);

      if (json.emailSuffixed) {
        toast.success(
          `Worker created — email adjusted to ${json.email} (name already taken)`
        );
      } else {
        toast.success(
          `Worker account created — share credentials with ${json.generatedFrom}`
        );
      }
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      toast.error(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Operation failed");
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  }

  // ── Update existing worker (no auth changes) ──────────────
  async function handleUpdate() {
    if (!form.name.trim()) { toast.error('Worker name is required'); return }
    setSaving(true)
    try {
      const { error } = await supabase
        .from("workers")
        .update({
          name: form.name.trim(),
          phone: form.phone || null,
          skill: form.skill || null,
        })
        .eq("id", editId!);
      if (error) throw error;
      toast.success("Worker updated");
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["workers"] });
      setShowForm(false);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      toast.error(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Operation failed");
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  }

  async function handleToggle(id: string, current: boolean) {
    const { error } = await supabase
      .from('workers')
      .update({ is_active: !current })
      .eq('id', id)
    if (error) { toast.error(error.message); return }
    qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['workers'] })
    toast.success(current ? 'Worker deactivated' : 'Worker activated')
  }

  const active   = workers?.filter(w => w.is_active)  ?? []
  const inactive = workers?.filter(w => !w.is_active) ?? []
  const initials = (name: string) =>
    name.split(' ').map(n => n[0]).slice(0, 2).join('').toUpperCase()

  return (
    <div>
      <PageHeader
        title="Workers"
        description="Shop floor workers — accounts auto-created with @bluebox.com email"
      >
        <Button size="sm" onClick={openNew}>
          <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
          Add Worker
        </Button>
      </PageHeader>

      {/* ── Credentials shown after creation ────────────────── */}
      {created && (
        <div style={{
          background: 'rgba(34,197,94,0.08)',
          border: '1px solid rgba(34,197,94,0.2)',
          borderRadius: 12,
          padding: '16px 20px',
          marginBottom: 24,
        }}>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-3">
            <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-green-500" />
            <span style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 600, color: '#4ade80' }}>
              Account created for {created.name}
            </span>
            <span style={{ fontSize: 12, color: '#475569', marginLeft: 4 }}>
              — Share these credentials with the worker
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            {/* Email */}
            <div style={{
              background: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.04)',
              border: '0.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08)',
              borderRadius: 8,
              padding: '10px 12px',
            }}>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 600, color: '#475569', letterSpacing: '0.06em', textTransform: 'uppercase', marginBottom: 4 }}>
                Login Email
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                <span style={{ fontSize: 13, color: '#e2e8f0', fontFamily: 'monospace' }}>
                  {created.email}
                </span>
                <button
                  onClick={() => copyToClipboard(created.email, 'email')}
                  style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', color: '#475569', padding: 2 }}
                >
                  {copied === 'email'
                    ? <CheckCircle style={{ width: 14, height: 14, color: '#4ade80' }} />
                    : <Copy style={{ width: 14, height: 14 }} />
                  }
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Password */}
            <div style={{
              background: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.04)',
              border: '0.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08)',
              borderRadius: 8,
              padding: '10px 12px',
            }}>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 600, color: '#475569', letterSpacing: '0.06em', textTransform: 'uppercase', marginBottom: 4 }}>
                Temporary Password
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                <span style={{ fontSize: 13, color: '#e2e8f0', fontFamily: 'monospace' }}>
                  {showPass ? created.password : '••••••••••••'}

                  <button
                    onClick={() => setShowPass(v => !v)}

                      ? <EyeOff style={{ width: 14, height: 14 }} />
                      : <Eye style={{ width: 14, height: 14 }} />
                    }
                  </button>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => copyToClipboard(created.password, 'pass')}
                    style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', color: '#475569', padding: 2 }}
                  >
                    {copied === 'pass'
                      ? <CheckCircle style={{ width: 14, height: 14, color: '#4ade80' }} />

                  </button>

      {/* ── Slide-in form ────────────────────────────────────── */}
      {showForm && (

              <Input
                label="Full Name *"
                required

              />

              <Input

  )
}
```
