# src/app/api/admin/create-worker/route.ts

```ts
// app/api/admin/create-worker/route.ts
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Server-side only — uses SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY which must
// NEVER be exposed to the browser. This route is protected by
// checking the caller's session role server-side.
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { createClient } from "@supabase/supabase-js";
import { createClient as createServerClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";

// Admin client — has full DB access, only used server-side
function adminClient() {
  return createClient(
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,
    process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY!, // never expose this
    { auth: { autoRefreshToken: false, persistSession: false } },
  );
}

// ── Email generator ────────────────────────────────────────────
// "Ramesh Kumar"  → "ramesh.kumar@bluebox.com"
// "Ram Kumar Sharma" → "ram.kumar.sharma@bluebox.com"
// Strips special chars, lowercases, joins with dots
function generateEmail(name: string): string {
  const slug = name
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9\s]/g, "") // remove special chars
    .replace(/\s+/g, "."); // spaces → dots
  return `${slug}@bluebox.com`;
}

// ── Default password ───────────────────────────────────────────
// Worker gets this on first login, they should change it.
// You could also generate a random one and show it once.
function defaultPassword(name: string): string {
  const slug = name.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, "").slice(0, 6);
  return `bluebox@${slug}123`; // e.g. "bluebox@ramesh123"
}

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  try {
    // ── 1. Verify caller is admin or manager ───────────────
    const serverSupabase = await createServerClient();
    const { data: { user } } = await serverSupabase.auth.getUser();

    if (!user) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
    }

    const { data: profile } = await serverSupabase
      .from("profiles")
      .select("role, org_id")
      .eq("id", user.id)
      .single();

    if (!profile || !["admin", "manager"].includes(profile.role)) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden — admin or manager only" }, {
        status: 403,
      });
    }

    if (!profile.org_id) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Caller must belong to an organization" }, {
        status: 400,
      });
    }

    const callerOrgId = profile.org_id;
    const admin = adminClient();

    // ── 2. Parse body ──────────────────────────────────────
    const { name, skill, phone } = await req.json();

    if (!name?.trim()) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Name is required" }, { status: 400 });
    }

    // ── 3. Find a free email (handle duplicates) ──────────────
    // Tries ramesh.kumar@bluebox.com, then ramesh.kumar2@bluebox.com,
    // ramesh.kumar3@bluebox.com etc. until one is free.
    const baseEmail = generateEmail(name);
    const baseSlug = baseEmail.replace("@bluebox.com", "");

    let finalEmail = baseEmail;
    let suffix = 2;

    while (true) {
      // Check workers table
      const { data: workerExists } = await admin
        .from("workers")
        .select("id")
        .eq("email", finalEmail)
        .maybeSingle();

      if (!workerExists) break; // email is free

      finalEmail = `${baseSlug}${suffix}@bluebox.com`;
      suffix++;

      if (suffix > 99) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          {
            error:
              `Could not find a free email for "${name}" after 99 attempts`,
          },
          { status: 500 },
        );
      }
    }

    const password = defaultPassword(name);

    // ── 4. Create Supabase Auth user ───────────────────────
    const { data: authData, error: authErr } = await admin.auth.admin
      .createUser({
        email: finalEmail,
        password,
        email_confirm: true,
        user_metadata: {
          full_name: name.trim(),
          org_id: callerOrgId,
        },
      });

    if (authErr) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: authErr.message }, { status: 400 });
    }

    const userId = authData.user.id;

    // ── 5. Upsert profiles row with production role and caller's org_id ────────
    const { error: profileErr } = await admin
      .from("profiles")
      .upsert({
        id: userId,
        full_name: name.trim(),
        role: "production",
        org_id: callerOrgId,
        is_active: true,
      }, { onConflict: "id" });

    if (profileErr) {
      await admin.auth.admin.deleteUser(userId);
      return NextResponse.json({ error: profileErr.message }, { status: 500 });
    }

    // ── 6. Insert into workers table with caller's org_id ───────────────────────
    const { data: worker, error: workerErr } = await admin
      .from("workers")
      .insert({
        org_id: callerOrgId,
        name: name.trim(),
        email: finalEmail,
        skill: skill || null,
        phone: phone || null,
        is_active: true,
      })
      .select("id")
      .single();

    if (workerErr) {
      await admin.auth.admin.deleteUser(userId);
      return NextResponse.json({ error: workerErr.message }, { status: 500 });
    }

    // ── 7. Return created account details ──────────────────
    return NextResponse.json({
      workerId: worker.id,
      userId,
      email: finalEmail,
      password,
      generatedFrom: name,
      // Let the client know if a suffix was added
      emailSuffixed: finalEmail !== baseEmail,
    });
  } catch (err: any) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: err.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}
```

```ts
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import * as XLSX from "xlsx";
import JSZip from "jszip";

export async function GET() {
  try {
    const supabase = await createClient();

    const {
      data: { user },
    } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

    if (!user) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
    }

    const { data: profile, error: profileError } = await supabase
      .from("profiles")
      .select("org_id")
      .eq("id", user.id)
      .single();

    if (profileError || !profile?.org_id) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "User is not associated with an organization" },
        { status: 403 }
      );
    }

    const { data: materialTypes, error: materialTypesError } = await supabase
      .from("material_types")
      .select("code, name")
      .eq("org_id", profile.org_id)
      .eq("is_active", true)
      .order("name");


    const { data: categories, error: categoriesError } = await supabase
        .from("item_categories")
        .select("code, name")
        .eq("org_id", profile.org_id)
        .eq("is_active", true)
        .order("name");

    if (categoriesError) {
    throw categoriesError;
    }

    if (materialTypesError) {
      throw materialTypesError;
    }

    const instructions = [
      ["ITEM IMPORT TEMPLATE"],
      [],
      ["Upload this workbook through the Item Import page."],
      [],
      ["Required fields"],
      ["item_code", "Unique item code."],
      ["name", "Item name."],
      ["category", "Must be an active category in your organization."],
      ["material_type", "Must match an active material type in your organization."],
      ["unit", "Required unit."],
    ];

    const itemImport = [
      [
        "item_code",
        "name",
        "category",
        "sub_category",
        "material_type",
        "size_spec",
        "unit",
        "hsn_code",
        "is_traded",
        "is_manufactured",
        "is_raw_material",
        "reorder_level",
        "reorder_qty",
        "notes",
      ],
    ];

    const allowedValues = [
    ["Categories", "Category Code", "", "Material Types", "Code"],
    ...Array.from(
        {
        length: Math.max(
            categories?.length ?? 0,
            materialTypes?.length ?? 0
        ),
        },
        (_, i) => [
        categories?.[i]?.name ?? "",
        categories?.[i]?.code ?? "",
        "",
        materialTypes?.[i]?.name ?? "",
        materialTypes?.[i]?.code ?? "",
        ]
    ),
    ];

    const itemImportSheet = XLSX.utils.aoa_to_sheet(itemImport);

    itemImportSheet["!dataValidation"] = [
    {
        sqref: "E2:E1000",
        type: "list",
        formulas: ['\'Allowed Values\'!$A$2:$A$1000'],
    },
    ];

    const workbook = XLSX.utils.book_new();

    XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(
      workbook,
      XLSX.utils.aoa_to_sheet(instructions),
      "Instructions"
    );

    XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(
        workbook,
        itemImportSheet,
        "Item Import"
        );

    const allowedValuesSheet = XLSX.utils.aoa_to_sheet(allowedValues);


    XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(
    workbook,
    allowedValuesSheet,
    "Allowed Values"
    );

    const buffer = XLSX.write(workbook, {
    type: "buffer",
    bookType: "xlsx",
    });

    const zip = await JSZip.loadAsync(buffer);

    const sheetXml = await zip.file("xl/worksheets/sheet2.xml")!.async("string");

    const validationXml = `
    <dataValidations count="2">
    <dataValidation type="list" allowBlank="1" showInputMessage="1" showErrorMessage="1" sqref="C2:C1000">
        <formula1>'Allowed Values'!$A$2:$A$1000</formula1>
    </dataValidation>
    <dataValidation type="list" allowBlank="1" showInputMessage="1" showErrorMessage="1" sqref="E2:E1000">
        <formula1>'Allowed Values'!$D$2:$D$1000</formula1>
    </dataValidation>
    </dataValidations>`;

    const patchedSheetXml = sheetXml.replace(
    "<ignoredErrors>",
    `${validationXml}<ignoredErrors>`
    );

    zip.file("xl/worksheets/sheet2.xml", patchedSheetXml);

    const finalBuffer = await zip.generateAsync({
    type: "nodebuffer",
    });

    return new NextResponse(new Uint8Array(finalBuffer), {
      status: 200,
      headers: {
        "Content-Type":
          "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet",
        "Content-Disposition":
          'attachment; filename="item-import-template.xlsx"',
      },
    });
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Failed to generate template",
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}
```

# src/app/api/organizations/create/route.ts

```ts
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { ORGANIZATION_TEMPLATES } from "@/lib/organization-templates";
import * as XLSX from "xlsx";
import fs from "fs/promises";
import path from "path";

type TemplateCategory = {
  code: string;
  name: string;
  description: string;
};

type TemplateMaterialType = {
  code: string;
  name: string;
  description: string;
};

export async function GET() {
  return NextResponse.json({
    templates: Object.entries(ORGANIZATION_TEMPLATES).map(
      ([id, config]) => ({
        id,
        name: config.name,
      })
    ),
  });
}

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  const supabase = await createClient();

  try {
    const { data: { user }, error: userError } =
      await supabase.auth.getUser();

    if (userError || !user) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Unauthorized" },
        { status: 401 }
      );
    }

    const body = await request.json();

    const orgName = String(body.orgName ?? "").trim();
    const template = body.template
      ? String(body.template).trim()
      : null;

    if (!orgName) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Organization name is required" },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    let categories: TemplateCategory[] = [];
    let materialTypes: TemplateMaterialType[] = [];

    if (template) {
      const templateConfig =
        ORGANIZATION_TEMPLATES[
          template as keyof typeof ORGANIZATION_TEMPLATES
        ];

      if (!templateConfig) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          { error: "Unknown organization template" },
          { status: 400 }
        );
      }

      const templatePath = path.join(
        process.cwd(),
        "public",
        "templates",
        templateConfig.file
      );

      const fileBuffer = await fs.readFile(templatePath);

      const workbook = XLSX.read(fileBuffer, {
        type: "buffer",
      });

      const categoriesSheet = workbook.Sheets["Categories"];
      const materialTypesSheet = workbook.Sheets["Material Types"];

      if (!categoriesSheet || !materialTypesSheet) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          { error: "Invalid organization template" },
          { status: 400 }
        );
      }

      categories = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json<TemplateCategory>(
        categoriesSheet,
        {
          defval: "",
        }
      );

      materialTypes = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json<TemplateMaterialType>(
        materialTypesSheet,
        {
          defval: "",
        }
      );
    }

    const { data: orgId, error } = await supabase.rpc(
      "create_organization",
      {
        p_name: orgName,
        p_template: template ?? undefined,
        p_categories: categories,
        p_material_types: materialTypes,
      }
    );

    if (error) {
      throw error;
    }

    return NextResponse.json({
      orgId,
    });
  } catch (error: unknown) {
    console.error("Organization creation failed:", error);

    const message =
      error instanceof Error
        ? error.message
        : "Failed to create organization";

    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: message },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}
```

```ts
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server'
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server'

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// PDF Generation Route
// GET /api/pdf?type=quotation&id=uuid
// GET /api/pdf?type=challan&id=uuid
// GET /api/pdf?type=grn&id=uuid
//
// Returns printable HTML — browser auto-triggers window.print()
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url)
  const type = searchParams.get('type')
  const id   = searchParams.get('id')

  if (!type || !id) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'type and id are required' }, { status: 400 })
  }

  const supabase = await createClient()
  const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser()
  if (!user) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 })
  }

const { data: profile, error: profileError } = await supabase
  .from("profiles")
  .select("org_id, organizations:org_id ( name )")
  .eq("id", user.id)
  .single()

if (profileError || !profile?.org_id) {
  return NextResponse.json(
    { error: "User is not associated with an organization" },
    { status: 403 }
  )
}

const orgName =
  (profile.organizations as { name?: string } | null)?.name ?? 'Blue Box ERP'

  try {
    switch (type) {
      case 'quotation': return generateQuotationHTML(supabase, id, orgName)
      case 'challan':   return generateChallanHTML(supabase, id, orgName)
      case 'grn':       return generateGrnHTML(supabase, id, orgName)
      default:
        return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unknown document type' }, { status: 400 })
    }
  } catch (err: unknown) {
  return NextResponse.json(
    { error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Internal server error' },
    { status: 500 }
  )
}
}

// ── Shared print CSS ──────────────────────────────────────────
const CSS = `
  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
  body { font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; color: #111; background: #fff; }
  .page { max-width: 210mm; margin: 0 auto; padding: 16mm 20mm; }
  .header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-start; margin-bottom: 24px; border-bottom: 2px solid #1E3A5F; padding-bottom: 16px; }
  .company-name { font-size: 20px; font-weight: bold; color: #1E3A5F; }
  .company-sub  { font-size: 10px; color: #666; margin-top: 2px; }
  .doc-title    { font-size: 18px; font-weight: bold; color: #2563EB; text-align: right; }
  .doc-no       { font-size: 13px; font-family: monospace; color: #111; text-align: right; margin-top: 4px; }
  .meta-grid    { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 16px; margin-bottom: 20px; }
  .meta-box     { background: #F8FAFC; border: 1px solid #E2E8F0; border-radius: 6px; padding: 12px; }
  .meta-label   { font-size: 9px; font-weight: bold; color: #64748B; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; margin-bottom: 5px; }
  .meta-value   { font-size: 11px; color: #111; line-height: 1.7; }
  table         { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-bottom: 16px; }
  thead th      { background: #1E3A5F; color: #fff; padding: 8px 10px; font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-align: left; }
  thead th.r    { text-align: right; }
  thead th.c    { text-align: center; }
  tbody td      { padding: 8px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid #F1F5F9; font-size: 11px; vertical-align: top; }
  tbody tr:nth-child(even) td { background: #F8FAFC; }
  .r            { text-align: right; }
  .c            { text-align: center; }
  .mono         { font-family: monospace; font-size: 10px; background: #F1F5F9; padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 3px; }
  .totals       { margin-left: auto; width: 250px; border: 1px solid #E2E8F0; border-radius: 6px; overflow: hidden; }
  .totals-row   { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding: 6px 12px; font-size: 11px; border-bottom: 1px solid #F1F5F9; }
  .totals-row.bold { font-weight: bold; font-size: 13px; background: #EFF6FF; color: #1D4ED8; border-bottom: none; }
  .terms        { margin-top: 18px; padding-top: 14px; border-top: 1px solid #E2E8F0; font-size: 10px; color: #555; line-height: 1.7; }
  .footer       { margin-top: 32px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding-top: 16px; border-top: 1px solid #E2E8F0; }
  .sign-box     { text-align: center; }
  .sign-line    { width: 150px; border-bottom: 1px solid #333; margin-bottom: 5px; height: 40px; }
  .sign-label   { font-size: 10px; color: #666; }
  @media print {
    body { -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact; print-color-adjust: exact; }
    .page { padding: 8mm 12mm; }
    @page { size: A4; margin: 8mm; }
  }
`

const inr = (n: number | null | undefined) =>
  n != null
    ? new Intl.NumberFormat('en-IN', { style: 'currency', currency: 'INR' }).format(n)
    : '—'

const dt = (d: string | null | undefined) =>
  d ? new Date(d).toLocaleDateString('en-IN', { day: '2-digit', month: 'short', year: 'numeric' }) : '—'

// ── Quotation ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
async function generateQuotationHTML(supabase: any, id: string, orgName: string) {
  const { data: qt, error } = await supabase
    .from('quotations')
    .select(`
      *,
      client:clients ( name, phone, gst_number, address, city ),
      quotation_lines (
        *, item:items ( item_code, name, unit, hsn_code )
      )
    `)
    .eq('id', id)
    .single()

  if (error || !qt) throw new Error('Quotation not found')

  const lines = (qt.quotation_lines ?? []).sort((a: any, b: any) => a.sort_order - b.sort_order)

  const html = `<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset="UTF-8">
<title>${qt.quotation_no}</title><style>${CSS}</style></head>
<body><div class="page">

  <div class="header">
    <div>
      <div class="company-name">${orgName}</div>
      <div class="company-sub">Electrical Hardware Supply &amp; Manufacturing</div>
      <div class="company-sub">Panvel, Maharashtra &nbsp;|&nbsp; GST: 27XXXXX1234X1ZX</div>
      <div class="company-sub">+91 98765 43210 &nbsp;|&nbsp; info@highpowerelectricals.in</div>
    </div>
    <div>
      <div class="doc-title">QUOTATION</div>
      <div class="doc-no">${qt.quotation_no}</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="meta-grid">
    <div class="meta-box">
      <div class="meta-label">Bill To</div>
      <div class="meta-value">
        <strong>${qt.client?.name ?? '—'}</strong><br>
        ${qt.client?.phone ? qt.client.phone + '<br>' : ''}
        ${qt.client?.gst_number ? 'GST: ' + qt.client.gst_number + '<br>' : ''}
        ${qt.client?.address ? qt.client.address + ', ' + (qt.client.city ?? '') : ''}
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="meta-box">
      <div class="meta-label">Quotation Details</div>
      <div class="meta-value">
        <strong>Date:</strong> ${dt(qt.quotation_date)}<br>
        ${qt.valid_until ? '<strong>Valid Until:</strong> ' + dt(qt.valid_until) + '<br>' : ''}
        ${qt.delivery_days ? '<strong>Delivery:</strong> ' + qt.delivery_days + ' working days<br>' : ''}
        ${qt.payment_terms ? '<strong>Payment:</strong> ' + qt.payment_terms : ''}
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <table>
    <thead>
      <tr>
        <th style="width:28px">#</th>
        <th>Item Description</th>
        <th class="c" style="width:55px">HSN</th>
        <th class="r" style="width:70px">Qty</th>
        <th class="c" style="width:38px">Unit</th>
        <th class="r" style="width:90px">Rate (₹)</th>
        <th class="c" style="width:38px">GST%</th>
        <th class="r" style="width:95px">Amount (₹)</th>
      </tr>
    </thead>
    <tbody>
      ${lines.map((l: any, i: number) => {
        const sub = l.qty * l.unit_rate
        const gst = sub * Number(l.gst_percent) / 100
        return `<tr>
          <td class="c">${i + 1}</td>
          <td>
            <strong>${l.description || l.item?.name || ''}</strong>
            ${l.item ? '<br><span class="mono">' + l.item.item_code + '</span>' : ''}
          </td>
          <td class="c">${l.item?.hsn_code ?? '—'}</td>
          <td class="r">${l.qty}</td>
          <td class="c">${l.unit}</td>
          <td class="r">${inr(l.unit_rate)}</td>
          <td class="c">${l.gst_percent}%</td>
          <td class="r">${inr(sub + gst)}</td>
        </tr>`
      }).join('')}
    </tbody>
  </table>

  <div class="totals">
    <div class="totals-row"><span>Subtotal</span><span>${inr(qt.subtotal)}</span></div>
    <div class="totals-row"><span>GST</span><span>${inr(qt.gst_amount)}</span></div>
    <div class="totals-row bold"><span>Total Amount</span><span>${inr(qt.total_amount)}</span></div>
  </div>

  ${qt.notes ? '<div class="terms"><strong>Notes:</strong> ' + qt.notes + '</div>' : ''}
  ${qt.transport_note ? '<div class="terms"><strong>Transport:</strong> ' + qt.transport_note + '</div>' : ''}

  <div class="terms">
    <strong>Terms &amp; Conditions:</strong>
    <ol style="margin-top:4px; padding-left:14px">
      <li>GST as applicable extra on all items</li>
      <li>Freight &amp; insurance extra at actuals unless stated otherwise</li>
      <li>${qt.payment_terms ?? '100% advance before delivery'}</li>
      <li>Validity: ${qt.valid_until ? 'till ' + dt(qt.valid_until) : '30 days from quotation date'}</li>
      <li>Prices subject to change after validity without prior notice</li>
    </ol>
  </div>

  <div class="footer">
    <div class="sign-box">
      <div class="sign-line"></div>
      <div class="sign-label">Client Signature &amp; Stamp</div>
    </div>
    <div class="sign-box">
      <div class="sign-line"></div>
      <div class="sign-label">For ${orgName}</div>
    </div>
  </div>

</div>
<script>window.onload = () => window.print()</script>
</body></html>`

  return new NextResponse(html, { headers: { 'Content-Type': 'text/html; charset=utf-8' } })
}

// ── Delivery Challan ──────────────────────────────────────────
async function generateChallanHTML(supabase: any, id: string, orgName: string) {
  const { data: dc, error } = await supabase
    .from('delivery_challans')
    .select(`
      *,
      client:clients ( name, phone, gst_number, address, city ),
      sales_order:sales_orders ( so_number ),
      delivery_challan_lines (
        *, item:items ( item_code, name, unit )
      )
    `)
    .eq('id', id)
    .single()

  if (error || !dc) throw new Error('Challan not found')

  const lines    = dc.delivery_challan_lines ?? []
  const totalQty = lines.reduce((s: number, l: any) => s + l.qty, 0)

  const transportLabel: Record<string, string> = {
    own_truck: 'Own Truck', client_truck: 'Client Truck',
    supplier_truck: 'Supplier Truck', courier: 'Courier', hand_delivery: 'Hand Delivery',
  }

  const html = `<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset="UTF-8">
<title>${dc.challan_no}</title><style>${CSS}</style></head>
<body><div class="page">

  <div class="header">
    <div>
      <div class="company-name">${orgName}</div>
      <div class="company-sub">Electrical Hardware Supply &amp; Manufacturing</div>
      <div class="company-sub">Panvel, Maharashtra</div>
    </div>
    <div>
      <div class="doc-title">DELIVERY CHALLAN</div>
      <div class="doc-no">${dc.challan_no}</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="meta-grid">
    <div class="meta-box">
      <div class="meta-label">Deliver To</div>
      <div class="meta-value">
        <strong>${dc.client?.name ?? '—'}</strong><br>
        ${dc.client?.phone ? dc.client.phone + '<br>' : ''}
        ${dc.client?.gst_number ? 'GST: ' + dc.client.gst_number + '<br>' : ''}
        ${dc.client?.address ? dc.client.address + ', ' + (dc.client.city ?? '') : ''}
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="meta-box">
      <div class="meta-label">Dispatch Details</div>
      <div class="meta-value">
        <strong>Challan Date:</strong> ${dt(dc.challan_date)}<br>
        ${dc.sales_order ? '<strong>Against SO:</strong> ' + dc.sales_order.so_number + '<br>' : ''}
        <strong>Transport:</strong> ${transportLabel[dc.transport_mode] ?? dc.transport_mode}<br>
        ${dc.vehicle_no  ? '<strong>Vehicle No.:</strong> ' + dc.vehicle_no  + '<br>' : ''}
        ${dc.driver_name ? '<strong>Driver:</strong> '      + dc.driver_name + '<br>' : ''}
        <strong>Status:</strong> ${dc.status?.toUpperCase()}
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <table>
    <thead>
      <tr>
        <th style="width:28px">#</th>
        <th>Item Description</th>
        <th class="c" style="width:60px">Code</th>
        <th class="r" style="width:70px">Qty</th>
        <th class="c" style="width:45px">Unit</th>
        <th class="r" style="width:95px">Rate (₹)</th>
        <th class="r" style="width:95px">Value (₹)</th>
      </tr>
    </thead>
    <tbody>
      ${lines.map((l: any, i: number) => `<tr>
        <td class="c">${i + 1}</td>
        <td><strong>${l.item?.name ?? '—'}</strong></td>
        <td class="c"><span class="mono">${l.item?.item_code ?? ''}</span></td>
        <td class="r"><strong>${l.qty}</strong></td>
        <td class="c">${l.unit}</td>
        <td class="r">${l.rate ? inr(l.rate) : '—'}</td>
        <td class="r">${l.line_total ? inr(l.line_total) : '—'}</td>
      </tr>`).join('')}
    </tbody>
  </table>

  <div class="totals">
    <div class="totals-row"><span>Total Qty</span><span>${totalQty}</span></div>
    <div class="totals-row bold"><span>Challan Value</span><span>${inr(dc.total_amount)}</span></div>
  </div>

  <div class="terms">
    <strong>Note:</strong> This is a delivery challan only. GST tax invoice will be raised separately.
    Goods once dispatched will not be accepted back without prior written approval.
    ${dc.notes ? '<br><strong>Notes:</strong> ' + dc.notes : ''}
  </div>

  <div class="footer">
    <div class="sign-box">
      <div class="sign-line"></div>
      <div class="sign-label">Receiver's Signature &amp; Stamp</div>
    </div>
    <div class="sign-box">
      <div class="sign-line"></div>
      <div class="sign-label">For ${orgName}</div>
    </div>
  </div>

</div>
<script>window.onload = () => window.print()</script>
</body></html>`

  return new NextResponse(html, { headers: { 'Content-Type': 'text/html; charset=utf-8' } })
}

// ── GRN ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
async function generateGrnHTML(supabase: any, id: string, orgName: string) {
  const { data: grn, error } = await supabase
    .from('inbound_receipts')
    .select(`
      *,
      supplier:suppliers ( name, phone, gst_number, city ),
      inbound_receipt_lines (
        *, item:items ( item_code, name, unit )
      )
    `)
    .eq('id', id)
    .single()

  if (error || !grn) throw new Error('GRN not found')

  const lines     = grn.inbound_receipt_lines ?? []
  const grandTotal = (grn.total_amount ?? 0) + (grn.gst_amount ?? 0)

  const html = `<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset="UTF-8">
<title>${grn.receipt_no}</title><style>${CSS}</style></head>
<body><div class="page">

  <div class="header">
    <div>
      <div class="company-name">${orgName}</div>
      <div class="company-sub">Electrical Hardware Supply &amp; Manufacturing</div>
      <div class="company-sub">Panvel, Maharashtra</div>
    </div>
    <div>
      <div class="doc-title">GOODS RECEIVED NOTE</div>
      <div class="doc-no">${grn.receipt_no}</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="meta-grid">
    <div class="meta-box">
      <div class="meta-label">Received From</div>
      <div class="meta-value">
        <strong>${grn.supplier?.name ?? '—'}</strong><br>
        ${grn.supplier?.phone ? grn.supplier.phone + '<br>' : ''}
        ${grn.supplier?.gst_number ? 'GST: ' + grn.supplier.gst_number + '<br>' : ''}
        ${grn.supplier?.city ?? ''}
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="meta-box">
      <div class="meta-label">Receipt Details</div>
      <div class="meta-value">
        <strong>GRN No.:</strong> ${grn.receipt_no}<br>
        <strong>Date:</strong> ${dt(grn.receipt_date)}<br>
        <strong>Transport:</strong> ${grn.transport_mode?.replace('_', ' ') ?? '—'}<br>
        ${grn.vehicle_no  ? '<strong>Vehicle:</strong> '   + grn.vehicle_no  + '<br>' : ''}
        ${grn.challan_no  ? '<strong>Sup. Challan:</strong> ' + grn.challan_no + '<br>' : ''}
        ${grn.invoice_no  ? '<strong>Invoice No.:</strong> '  + grn.invoice_no : ''}
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <table>
    <thead>
      <tr>
        <th style="width:28px">#</th>
        <th>Item</th>
        <th class="r" style="width:70px">Ordered</th>
        <th class="r" style="width:75px">Received</th>
        <th class="c" style="width:40px">Unit</th>
        <th class="r" style="width:90px">Rate (₹)</th>
        <th class="c" style="width:38px">GST%</th>
        <th class="r" style="width:95px">Amount (₹)</th>
      </tr>
    </thead>
    <tbody>
      ${lines.map((l: any, i: number) => `<tr>
        <td class="c">${i + 1}</td>
        <td>
          <strong>${l.item?.name ?? '—'}</strong>
          <br><span class="mono">${l.item?.item_code ?? ''}</span>
        </td>
        <td class="r">${l.qty_ordered ?? '—'}</td>
        <td class="r"><strong>${l.qty_received}</strong></td>
        <td class="c">${l.unit}</td>
        <td class="r">${inr(l.rate)}</td>
        <td class="c">${l.gst_percent}%</td>
        <td class="r">${inr(l.line_total)}</td>
      </tr>`).join('')}
    </tbody>
  </table>

  <div class="totals">
    <div class="totals-row"><span>Subtotal</span><span>${inr(grn.total_amount)}</span></div>
    <div class="totals-row"><span>GST</span><span>${inr(grn.gst_amount)}</span></div>
    <div class="totals-row bold"><span>Total</span><span>${inr(grandTotal)}</span></div>
  </div>

  ${grn.notes ? '<div class="terms"><strong>Notes:</strong> ' + grn.notes + '</div>' : ''}

  <div class="footer">
    <div class="sign-box">
      <div class="sign-line"></div>
      <div class="sign-label">Received By</div>
    </div>
    <div class="sign-box">
      <div class="sign-line"></div>
      <div class="sign-label">Store Keeper</div>
    </div>
    <div class="sign-box">
      <div class="sign-line"></div>
      <div class="sign-label">Authorised Signatory</div>
    </div>
  </div>

</div>
<script>window.onload = () => window.print()</script>
</body></html>`

  return new NextResponse(html, { headers: { 'Content-Type': 'text/html; charset=utf-8' } })
}
```

```tsx
'use client'

import { usePathname } from 'next/navigation'
import { useReorderAlerts } from '@/lib/hooks/use-stock'
import { AlertTriangle, Bell } from 'lucide-react'
import Link from 'next/link'

// Maps route to a readable page title
const pageTitles: Record<string, string> = {
  '/':             'Dashboard',
  '/inventory':    'Inventory',
  '/items':        'Items',
  '/quotations':   'Quotations',
  '/sales-orders': 'Sales Orders',
  '/production':   'Production',
  '/inbound':      'Inbound (GRN)',
  '/dispatch':     'Dispatch',
  '/clients':      'Clients',
  '/suppliers':    'Suppliers',
  '/workers':      'Workers',
  '/settings':     'Settings',
}

function getTitle(pathname: string): string {
  // Exact match first
  if (pageTitles[pathname]) return pageTitles[pathname]
  // Match by prefix (e.g. /quotations/new → Quotations)
  const base = '/' + pathname.split('/')[1]
  return pageTitles[base] ?? 'Blue Box ERP'
}

export function Header() {
  const pathname = usePathname()
  const { data: alerts } = useReorderAlerts()
  const alertCount = alerts?.length ?? 0

  return (
    <header className="
      h-14 flex items-center justify-between
      px-6 border-b border-slate-100 bg-white
      sticky top-0 z-20
    ">
      {/* Page title */}
      <h1 className="text-lg font-semibold text-slate-900">
       
      </h1>

      {/* Right side actions */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">

        {/* Reorder alert bell */}
        {alertCount > 0 && (
          <Link
            href="/inventory"
            className="
              relative flex items-center gap-1.5
              text-amber-600 bg-amber-50 hover:bg-amber-100
              px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium
              transition-colors
            "
          >
            <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4" />
            {alertCount} low stock
          </Link>
        )}

      </div>
    </header>
  )
}
```

```tsx
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils/cn'

interface PageHeaderProps {
  title: string
  description?: string
  children?: React.ReactNode  // action buttons go here
  className?: string
}

// Use at the top of every page:

//   <Button>New Quotation</Button>
// </PageHeader>
export function PageHeader({
  title,
  description,
  children,
  className,
}: PageHeaderProps) {
  return (
    <div className={cn(
      'flex items-start justify-between gap-4 mb-6',
      className
    )}>
      <div>
        <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold text-slate-900">{title}</h2>
        {description && (
          <p className="text-sm text-slate-500 mt-0.5">{description}</p>
        )}
      </div>
      {children && (
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-shrink-0">
          {children}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}
```

```tsx
'use client'

function getInitials(name?: string | null) {
  if (!name || !name.trim()) return 'U'
  const parts = name.trim().split(/\s+/)
  if (parts.length >= 2 && parts[0] && parts[1]) {
    return ((parts[0][0] ?? '') + (parts[1][0] ?? '')).toUpperCase()
  }
  return name.trim().slice(0, 2).toUpperCase()
}

interface NavItem {

const NAV: (NavItem | NavGroup)[] = [

  { label: "Settings", href: "/settings", icon: Settings, roles: ["admin"] },

const DIVIDER_BEFORE = new Set(['Settings'])

function isGroup(item: NavItem | NavGroup): item is NavGroup {
  return 'items' in item
}

const S = {
  sidebar:          { background: '#0f172a', borderRight: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06)' } as React.CSSProperties,
  logoBorder:       { borderBottom: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06)' } as React.CSSProperties,
  logoIcon:         { background: '#2563eb', borderRadius: 10, boxShadow: '0 2px 10px rgba(37,99,235,0.45)', width: 36, height: 36, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', flexShrink: 0 } as React.CSSProperties,
  divider:          { height: 1, background: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.06)', margin: '10px 4px' } as React.CSSProperties,

  rowBase:          { borderRadius: 10, transition: 'background 120ms ease' } as React.CSSProperties,
  rowActive:        { background: 'rgba(37,99,235,0.13)' } as React.CSSProperties,
  rowHover:         { background: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.05)' } as React.CSSProperties,

  iconBoxBase:      { width: 34, height: 34, borderRadius: 9, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', flexShrink: 0, transition: 'background 120ms ease, box-shadow 120ms ease' } as React.CSSProperties,
  iconBoxActive:    { background: '#1d4ed8', boxShadow: '0 2px 10px rgba(29,78,216,0.55)' } as React.CSSProperties,
  iconBoxIdle:      { background: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.055)' } as React.CSSProperties,
  iconBoxGrpActive: { background: 'rgba(37,99,235,0.15)' } as React.CSSProperties,

  subRow:           { borderRadius: 8, transition: 'background 120ms ease' } as React.CSSProperties,
  subRowActive:     { background: 'rgba(37,99,235,0.1)' } as React.CSSProperties,
  subIconBase:      { width: 28, height: 28, borderRadius: 7, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', flexShrink: 0, transition: 'background 120ms ease' } as React.CSSProperties,
  subIconActive:    { background: 'rgba(37,99,235,0.22)' } as React.CSSProperties,
  subBorderLine:    { borderLeft: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07)', marginLeft: 17, paddingLeft: 10, marginTop: 3 } as React.CSSProperties,

  footerBorder:     { borderTop: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06)' } as React.CSSProperties,
  profileCard:      { background: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.04)', border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08)', borderRadius: 10 } as React.CSSProperties,
  avatar:           { width: 32, height: 32, borderRadius: 8, background: 'linear-gradient(135deg,#2563eb,#7c3aed)', flexShrink: 0, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 700, color: '#fff', letterSpacing: '0.03em' } as React.CSSProperties,
  roleBadge:        { fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 600, padding: '3px 8px', borderRadius: 6, textTransform: 'uppercase' as const, letterSpacing: '0.05em', flexShrink: 0 } as React.CSSProperties,
  signoutBtn:       { borderRadius: 9, transition: 'background 120ms ease', width: '100%', background: 'transparent', border: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 12, padding: '9px 12px' } as React.CSSProperties,
}

export function Sidebar() {
  const pathname = usePathname()
  const router   = useRouter()
  const supabase = createClient()
  const queryClient = useQueryClient()
  const { user, profile, organization } = useTenant()

  const role = profile?.role

  const [openGroups, setOpenGroups] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>(() => {
    const initial: Record<string, boolean> = {}
    NAV.forEach((item) => {
      if (isGroup(item)) {
        initial[item.label] = item.items.some((i) => pathname.startsWith(i.href))
      }
    })
    return initial
  })

  const [hovered, setHovered] = useState<string | null>(null)

  function toggleGroup(label: string) {
    setOpenGroups((prev) => ({ ...prev, [label]: !prev[label] }))
  }

  function isActive(href: string) {
    if (href === '/') return pathname === '/'
    return pathname.startsWith(href)
  }

  function hasRole(roles: UserRole[]) {
    return role ? roles.includes(role) : false
  }

  async function handleSignOut() {
    try {
      queryClient.setQueryData(["tenant-context"], {
        user: null,
        profile: null,
        organization: null,
        orgId: null,
      })
      await supabase.auth.signOut()
      queryClient.clear()
      toast.success('Signed out')
      router.push('/login')
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Sign out error:', err)
      router.push('/login')
    }
  }

  return (
    // KEY FIX: sidebar itself is a flex column with height:100vh so it never
    // grows taller than the viewport — the nav section can then scroll internally.
    <aside
      style={{ ...S.sidebar, height: '100vh' }}
      className="flex flex-col w-64 fixed left-0 top-0 z-30"
    >

      {/* ── Logo — fixed height, never shrinks ───────────────────────── */}
      <div style={{ ...S.logoBorder, flexShrink: 0 }} className="flex items-center gap-3 px-5 py-5">
        <div style={S.logoIcon}>
          <Zap style={{ width: 17, height: 17, color: '#fff' }} />
        </div>
        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <div style={{ fontSize: 14, fontWeight: 700, color: '#f1f5f9', letterSpacing: '0.01em', lineHeight: 1.2 }} className="truncate" title={organization?.name || 'Blue Box'}>
            {organization?.name || 'Blue Box'}
          </div>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: '#475569', marginTop: 2 }}>
            ERP System
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ── Nav — takes remaining space, scrolls when content overflows ── */}
      {/*                                                                    */}
      {/*  The THREE properties that make scrolling work:                    */}
      {/*    flex: '1 1 0'  → grows to fill space but starts at 0 height     */}
      {/*    minHeight: 0   → overrides the default minHeight:auto that       */}
      {/*                     prevents flex children from shrinking           */}
      {/*    overflowY: auto → shows scrollbar only when needed              */}
      <nav style={{
        flex: '1 1 0',
        minHeight: 0,
        overflowY: 'auto',
        padding: '14px 12px',
        display: 'flex',
        flexDirection: 'column',
        gap: 3,
        // thin custom scrollbar
        scrollbarWidth: 'thin',
        scrollbarColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08) transparent',
      }}>
        {NAV.map((item) => {
          if (!hasRole(item.roles)) return null
          const showDivider = DIVIDER_BEFORE.has(item.label)

          // ── Flat item ─────────────────────────────────────────────
          if (!isGroup(item)) {
            const active = isActive(item.href)
            const isHov  = hovered === item.href
            return (
              <div key={item.href}>
                {showDivider && <div style={S.divider} />}
                <Link
                  href={item.href as Route}
                  style={{
                    ...S.rowBase,
                    ...(active ? S.rowActive : isHov ? S.rowHover : {}),
                    display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 12,
                    padding: '9px 11px', textDecoration: 'none',
                  }}
                  onMouseEnter={() => setHovered(item.href)}
                  onMouseLeave={() => setHovered(null)}
                >
                  <div style={{ ...S.iconBoxBase, ...(active ? S.iconBoxActive : S.iconBoxIdle) }}>
                    <item.icon style={{ width: 16, height: 16, color: active ? '#fff' : isHov ? '#94a3b8' : '#64748b', transition: 'color 120ms ease' }} />
                  </div>
                  <span style={{
                    fontSize: 13.5, fontWeight: active ? 600 : 500,
                    color: active ? '#e2e8f0' : isHov ? '#94a3b8' : '#64748b',
                    transition: 'color 120ms ease', flex: 1,
                  }}>
                    {item.label}
                  </span>
                </Link>
              </div>
            )
          }

          // ── Group ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
          const visibleItems = item.items.filter((i) => hasRole(i.roles))
          if (visibleItems.length === 0) return null

          const groupActive = visibleItems.some((i) => isActive(i.href))
          const isOpen      = openGroups[item.label] ?? groupActive
          const grpKey      = `grp-${item.label}`
          const isHov       = hovered === grpKey

          return (
            <div key={item.label}>
              {showDivider && <div style={S.divider} />}

              <button
                onClick={() => toggleGroup(item.label)}
                onMouseEnter={() => setHovered(grpKey)}
                onMouseLeave={() => setHovered(null)}
                style={{
                  ...S.rowBase,
                  background: isHov ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.05)' : 'transparent',
                  width: '100%', border: 'none', cursor: 'pointer',
                  display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 12,
                  padding: '9px 11px',
                }}
              >
                <div style={{ ...S.iconBoxBase, ...(groupActive ? S.iconBoxGrpActive : S.iconBoxIdle) }}>
                  <item.icon style={{ width: 16, height: 16, color: groupActive ? '#60a5fa' : isHov ? '#94a3b8' : '#64748b', transition: 'color 120ms ease' }} />
                </div>
                <span style={{
                  fontSize: 13.5, fontWeight: 500,
                  color: groupActive ? '#cbd5e1' : isHov ? '#94a3b8' : '#64748b',
                  flex: 1, textAlign: 'left', transition: 'color 120ms ease',
                }}>
                  {item.label}
                </span>
                <ChevronDown style={{
                  width: 15, height: 15, color: '#334155', flexShrink: 0,
                  transform: isOpen ? 'rotate(180deg)' : 'rotate(0deg)',
                  transition: 'transform 200ms ease',
                }} />
              </button>

              {/* Sub-items — no maxHeight cap so all items render fully */}
              <div style={{
                overflow: 'hidden',
                // Use a large enough maxHeight that no group gets clipped.
                // The nav itself scrolls, so we don't need to cap this.
                maxHeight: isOpen ? 9999 : 0,
                opacity: isOpen ? 1 : 0,
                transition: 'max-height 220ms ease, opacity 180ms ease',
              }}>
                <div style={{ ...S.subBorderLine, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 2, paddingTop: 4, paddingBottom: 4 }}>
                  {visibleItems.map((sub) => {
                    const active   = isActive(sub.href)
                    const isHovSub = hovered === sub.href
                    return (
                      <Link
                        key={sub.href}
                        href={sub.href as Route}
                        style={{
                          ...S.subRow,
                          ...(active ? S.subRowActive : isHovSub ? S.rowHover : {}),
                          display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10,
                          padding: '8px 10px', textDecoration: 'none',
                        }}
                        onMouseEnter={() => setHovered(sub.href)}
                        onMouseLeave={() => setHovered(null)}
                      >
                        <div style={{ ...S.subIconBase, ...(active ? S.subIconActive : {}) }}>
                          <sub.icon style={{ width: 14, height: 14, color: active ? '#60a5fa' : isHovSub ? '#94a3b8' : '#475569', transition: 'color 120ms ease' }} />
                        </div>
                        <span style={{
                          fontSize: 13, fontWeight: active ? 600 : 400,
                          color: active ? '#93c5fd' : isHovSub ? '#94a3b8' : '#64748b',
                          transition: 'color 120ms ease',
                        }}>
                          {sub.label}
                        </span>
                      </Link>
                    )
                  })}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )
        })}
      </nav>

      {/* ── Footer — fixed height, never shrinks ─────────────────────── */}
      <div style={{ ...S.footerBorder, flexShrink: 0, padding: '12px 12px 14px', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 6 }}>

        {(profile || user) && (
          <div style={{ ...S.profileCard, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 11, padding: '10px 12px', marginBottom: 2 }}>
            <div style={S.avatar}>
              {getInitials(profile?.full_name || user?.email?.split('@')[0])}
            </div>
            <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 12.5, fontWeight: 600, color: '#cbd5e1', overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap', lineHeight: 1.3 }}>
                {profile?.full_name?.trim() || user?.email?.split('@')[0] || 'User'}
              </div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: '#475569', marginTop: 2, overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }} title={user?.email || undefined}>
                {user?.email || 'Logged in'}
              </div>
            </div>
            {role && (
              <span style={{ ...S.roleBadge, ...roleBadgeStyle[role] }}>
                {role}
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
        )}

        <button
          onClick={handleSignOut}
          style={S.signoutBtn}
          onMouseEnter={(e) => (e.currentTarget.style.background = 'rgba(239,68,68,0.09)')}
          onMouseLeave={(e) => (e.currentTarget.style.background = 'transparent')}
        >
          <LogOut style={{ width: 15, height: 15, color: '#475569', flexShrink: 0 }} />
          <span style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 500, color: '#475569' }}>
            Sign out
          </span>
        </button>

      </div>
    </aside>
  )
}
```

# src/components/providers/query-provider.tsx

```tsx
'use client'

import { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { ReactQueryDevtools } from '@tanstack/react-query-devtools'
import { useState } from 'react'

export function QueryProvider({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  // Create client inside component so each browser session gets
  // its own cache — avoids data leaking between users on SSR
  const [queryClient] = useState(
    () =>
      new QueryClient({
        defaultOptions: {
          queries: {
            // Keep data fresh for 60 seconds before refetching
            staleTime: 60 * 1000,
            // Retry failed queries once before showing error
            retry: 1,
            // Refetch when user returns to the tab
            refetchOnWindowFocus: true,
          },
          mutations: {
            retry: 0,
          },
        },
      })
  )

  return (
    <QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}>
      {children}
      {process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development' && (
        <ReactQueryDevtools initialIsOpen={false} />
      )}
    </QueryClientProvider>
  )
}
```

# src/components/providers/tenant-provider.tsx

```tsx
"use client";

import React, { createContext, useContext, useEffect } from "react";
import { useQuery, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/client";
import type { User } from "@supabase/supabase-js";
import type { Tables, Enums } from "@/lib/types/database";
import { usePathname, useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { PageLoader } from "@/components/ui/spinner";
import { AlertTriangle, LogOut, Building2 } from "lucide-react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";

export type Profile = Tables<"profiles">;
export type Organization = Tables<"organizations">;
export type UserRole = Enums<"user_role">;

export interface TenantContextType {
  user: User | null;
  profile: Profile | null;
  organization: Organization | null;
  orgId: string | null;
  role: UserRole | null;
  isLoading: boolean;
  isError: boolean;
  error: Error | null;
  refetch: () => Promise<void>;
}

const TenantContext = createContext<TenantContextType | undefined>(undefined);

export function TenantProvider({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const supabase = createClient();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const router = useRouter();
  const pathname = usePathname();

  /*
   * Resolve the authenticated user's tenant.
   *
   * The tenant is NEVER taken from:
   * - URL parameters
   * - localStorage
   * - sessionStorage
   * - form input
   * - client-provided org_id
   *
   * The authoritative chain is:
   *
   * auth.users.id
   *      ↓
   * profiles.id
   *      ↓
   * profiles.org_id
   *      ↓
   * organizations.id
   */
  const { data, isLoading, isError, error, refetch, isFetching } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["tenant-context"],

    queryFn: async () => {
      const {
        data: { user },
        error: userError,
      } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

      if (userError || !user) {
        return {
          user: null,
          profile: null,
          organization: null,
          orgId: null,
        };
      }

      const { data: profile, error: profileError } = await supabase
        .from("profiles")
        .select("*")
        .eq("id", user.id)
        .maybeSingle();

      if (profileError) {
        throw profileError;
      }

      /*
       * Authenticated user exists but their profile does not.
       * This is different from having a profile with a NULL org_id.
       */
      if (!profile) {
        return {
          user,
          profile: null,
          organization: null,
          orgId: null,
        };
      }

      /*
       * Profile exists but has not been assigned to an organization.
       * This is the onboarding state.
       */
      if (!profile.org_id) {
        return {
          user,
          profile,
          organization: null,
          orgId: null,
        };
      }

      /*
       * Resolve the organization from the org_id stored on the
       * authenticated user's profile.
       */
      const { data: organization, error: organizationError } = await supabase
        .from("organizations")
        .select("*")
        .eq("id", profile.org_id)
        .maybeSingle();

      if (organizationError) {
        throw organizationError;
      }

      return {
        user,
        profile,
        organization: organization ?? null,
        orgId: profile.org_id,
      };
    },

    /*
     * Tenant context should remain reasonably fresh, but we don't
     * need to refetch it on every component mount.
     *
     * Auth events explicitly invalidate this query below.
     */
    staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000,

    /*
     * Don't repeatedly retry authentication/profile errors.
     */
    retry: false,
  });

  const user = data?.user ?? null;
  const profile = data?.profile ?? null;
  const organization = data?.organization ?? null;
  const orgId = data?.orgId ?? null;
  const role = profile?.role ?? null;

  /*
   * Keep tenant context synchronized with Supabase auth state.
   */
  useEffect(() => {
    const {
      data: { subscription },
    } = supabase.auth.onAuthStateChange((event) => {
      if (event === "SIGNED_OUT") {
        queryClient.setQueryData(["tenant-context"], {
          user: null,
          profile: null,
          organization: null,
          orgId: null,
        });
        queryClient.removeQueries({
          queryKey: ["tenant-context"],
        });
        queryClient.removeQueries({
          queryKey: ["profile"],
        });
      } else if (event === "SIGNED_IN" || event === "USER_UPDATED") {
        queryClient.invalidateQueries({
          queryKey: ["tenant-context"],
        });

        queryClient.invalidateQueries({
          queryKey: ["profile"],
        });
      }
    });

    return () => {
      subscription.unsubscribe();
    };
  }, [supabase, queryClient]);

  /*
   * Redirect guards for unauthenticated or un-onboarded users.
   */
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isLoading) return;

    if (
      !user &&
      !pathname.startsWith("/login") &&
      !pathname.startsWith("/auth")
    ) {
      router.push("/login");
      return;
    }

    if (
      user &&
      profile &&
      !orgId &&
      !pathname.startsWith("/onboarding") &&
      !pathname.startsWith("/login")
    ) {
      router.push("/onboarding");
    }
  }, [isLoading, user, profile, orgId, pathname, router]);

  async function handleSignOut() {
    try {
      queryClient.setQueryData(["tenant-context"], {
        user: null,
        profile: null,
        organization: null,
        orgId: null,
      });
      await supabase.auth.signOut();
      queryClient.clear();
      router.push("/login");
    } catch (signOutError) {
      console.error("Failed to sign out:", signOutError);
      router.push("/login");
    }
  }

  /*
   * 1. Tenant context is being resolved.
   */
  if (isLoading || (isFetching && !organization && !!user)) {
    return (
      <div className="flex h-screen w-screen items-center justify-center bg-slate-50">
        <PageLoader />
      </div>
    );
  }

  /*
   * 2. Unauthenticated user on a protected route.
   * Render PageLoader while Next.js transitions to /login.
   */
  if (!user) {
    if (pathname.startsWith("/login") || pathname.startsWith("/auth")) {
      return <>{children}</>;
    }

    return (
      <div className="flex h-screen w-screen items-center justify-center bg-slate-50">
        <PageLoader />
      </div>
    );
  }

  /*
   * 3. Tenant resolution itself failed for an authenticated user.
   *
   * Do not treat a database/network error as "no organization".
   */
  if (isError && !isFetching) {
    return (
      <div className="flex min-h-screen items-center justify-center bg-slate-900 p-6">
        <div className="w-full max-w-md rounded-2xl border border-slate-700 bg-slate-800 p-8 text-center shadow-xl">
          <div className="mx-auto mb-4 flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-red-500/20 bg-red-500/10 text-red-400">
            <AlertTriangle className="h-6 w-6" />
          </div>

          <h2 className="mb-2 text-xl font-bold text-white">
            Unable to load account
          </h2>

          <p className="mb-6 text-sm text-slate-400">
            We could not load your organization information. Please try again or
            sign in again.
          </p>

          <div className="flex gap-3">
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              onClick={() => refetch()}
              className="flex-1"
            >
              Try Again
            </Button>

            <Button
              variant="outline"
              onClick={handleSignOut}
              className="flex-1"
            >
              <LogOut className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
              Sign Out
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  /*
   * 3. Authenticated user has no profile.
   */
  if (user && !profile) {
    return (
      <div className="flex min-h-screen items-center justify-center bg-slate-900 p-6">
        <div className="w-full max-w-md rounded-2xl border border-slate-700 bg-slate-800 p-8 text-center shadow-xl">
          <div className="mx-auto mb-4 flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-red-500/20 bg-red-500/10 text-red-400">
            <AlertTriangle className="h-6 w-6" />
          </div>

          <h2 className="mb-2 text-xl font-bold text-white">Profile Missing</h2>

          <p className="mb-6 text-sm text-slate-400">
            Your user profile has not been initialized. Please contact your
            administrator.
          </p>

          <Button
            variant="outline"
            onClick={handleSignOut}
            className="flex w-full items-center justify-center gap-2"
          >
            <LogOut className="h-4 w-4" />
            Sign Out
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  /*
   * 4. Authenticated user has a profile but no organization.
   *
   * The route guard above sends them to /onboarding.
   * We allow the onboarding page to render here.
   */
  if (user && profile && !orgId) {
    if (pathname.startsWith("/onboarding") || pathname.startsWith("/login")) {
      return <>{children}</>;
    }

    return (
      <div className="flex h-screen w-screen items-center justify-center bg-slate-50">
        <PageLoader />
      </div>
    );
  }

  /*
   * 5. Organization ID exists but organization cannot be resolved
   * or is inactive.
   */
  if (user && profile && orgId && (!organization || !organization.is_active)) {
    if (isFetching) {
      return (
        <div className="flex h-screen w-screen items-center justify-center bg-slate-50">
          <PageLoader />
        </div>
      );
    }

    return (
      <div className="flex min-h-screen items-center justify-center bg-slate-900 p-6">
        <div className="w-full max-w-md rounded-2xl border border-slate-700 bg-slate-800 p-8 text-center shadow-xl">
          <div className="mx-auto mb-4 flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-amber-500/20 bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-400">
            <Building2 className="h-6 w-6" />
          </div>

          <h2 className="mb-2 text-xl font-bold text-white">
            Organization Inaccessible
          </h2>

          <p className="mb-6 text-sm text-slate-400">
            Your assigned organization is inactive or could not be found. Please
            contact your system administrator.
          </p>

          <Button
            variant="outline"
            onClick={handleSignOut}
            className="flex w-full items-center justify-center gap-2"
          >
            <LogOut className="h-4 w-4" />
            Sign Out
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const contextValue: TenantContextType = {
    user,
    profile,
    organization,
    orgId,
    role,
    isLoading,
    isError,
    error: (error as unknown as Error) || null,
    refetch: async () => {
      await refetch();
    },
  };

  return (
    <TenantContext.Provider value={contextValue}>
      {children}
    </TenantContext.Provider>
  );
}

export function useTenant(): TenantContextType {
  const context = useContext(TenantContext);

  if (!context) {
    throw new Error("useTenant must be used within a TenantProvider");
  }

  return context;
}
```

```tsx
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils/cn'
import type {
  Enums
} from '@/lib/types/database'

interface BadgeProps {
  children: React.ReactNode
  variant?: 'default' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'danger' | 'info' | 'purple' | 'teal'
  className?: string
}

type DocumentStatus = Enums<'document_status'>
type OrderStatus = Enums<'order_status'>
type ProductionStatus = Enums<'production_status'>
type ReservationStatus = Enums<'reservation_status'>

export function Badge({ children, variant = 'default', className }: BadgeProps) {
  const variants = {
    default: 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-600',
    success: 'bg-green-100 text-green-700',
    warning: 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-700',
    danger:  'bg-red-100  text-red-700',
    info:    'bg-blue-100 text-blue-700',
    purple:  'bg-purple-100 text-purple-700',
    teal:    'bg-teal-100 text-teal-700',
  }

  return (
    <span className={cn(
      'inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md text-xs font-medium',
      variants[variant],
      className
    )}>
      {children}
    </span>
  )
}

// ── Status badge helpers ──────────────────────────────────────
export function DocumentStatusBadge({ status }: { status: DocumentStatus }) {
  const map: Record<DocumentStatus, { label: string; variant: BadgeProps['variant'] }> = {
    draft:            { label: 'Draft',            variant: 'default' },
    pending_approval: { label: 'Pending Approval', variant: 'warning' },
    approved:         { label: 'Approved',         variant: 'success' },
    rejected:         { label: 'Rejected',         variant: 'danger' },
    cancelled:        { label: 'Cancelled',        variant: 'danger' },
    converted: { label: 'Converted',  variant: 'teal' },
  }
  const { label, variant } = map[status]
  return <Badge variant={variant}>{label}</Badge>
}

export function OrderStatusBadge({ status }: { status: OrderStatus }) {
  const map: Record<OrderStatus, { label: string; variant: BadgeProps['variant'] }> = {
    draft:        { label: 'Draft',        variant: 'default' },
    confirmed:    { label: 'Confirmed',    variant: 'info' },
    in_production:{ label: 'In Production',variant: 'purple' },
    ready:        { label: 'Ready',        variant: 'teal' },
    dispatched:   { label: 'Dispatched',   variant: 'warning' },
    delivered:    { label: 'Delivered',    variant: 'success' },
    cancelled:    { label: 'Cancelled',    variant: 'danger' },
  }
  const { label, variant } = map[status]
  return <Badge variant={variant}>{label}</Badge>
}

export function ProductionStatusBadge({ status }: { status: ProductionStatus }) {
  const map: Record<ProductionStatus, { label: string; variant: BadgeProps['variant'] }> = {
    pending:    { label: 'Pending',     variant: 'default' },
    in_progress:{ label: 'In Progress', variant: 'info' },
    completed:  { label: 'Completed',   variant: 'success' },
    on_hold:    { label: 'On Hold',     variant: 'warning' },
    cancelled:  { label: 'Cancelled',   variant: 'danger' },
  }
  const { label, variant } = map[status]
  return <Badge variant={variant}>{label}</Badge>
}
```

```tsx
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils/cn'
import { Loader2 } from 'lucide-react'
import { forwardRef } from 'react'

interface ButtonProps extends React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> {
  variant?: 'primary' | 'secondary' | 'ghost' | 'danger' | 'outline'
  size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'
  loading?: boolean
  children: React.ReactNode
}

export const Button = forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, ButtonProps>(
  ({ variant = 'primary', size = 'md', loading, className, children, disabled, ...props }, ref) => {
    const base = 'inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 font-medium rounded-lg transition-all duration-150 disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-1'

    const variants = {
      primary:   'bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white focus:ring-blue-500 shadow-sm',
      secondary: 'bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 focus:ring-slate-400',
      ghost:     'hover:bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 focus:ring-slate-400',
      danger:    'bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-700 text-white focus:ring-red-500 shadow-sm',
      outline:   'border border-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 focus:ring-slate-400',
    }

    const sizes = {
      sm:  'px-3 py-1.5 text-xs',
      md:  'px-4 py-2 text-sm',
      lg:  'px-5 py-2.5 text-base',
    }

    return (
      <button
        ref={ref}
        disabled={disabled || loading}
        className={cn(base, variants[variant], sizes[size], className)}
        {...props}
      >
        {loading && <Loader2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" />}
        {children}
      </button>
    )
  }
)

Button.displayName = 'Button'
```

# src/lib/hooks/use-items.ts

```ts
'use client'

import { useQuery, useMutation, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'
import { useOrgId } from '@/lib/hooks/use-tenant'
import { toast } from 'sonner'
import type { Tables} from '@/lib/types/database'

type Item = Tables<'items'>


// ── Item categories ──────────────────────────────────────────
export function useItemCategories() {
  const supabase = createClient()
  const orgId = useOrgId()

  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ['item-categories', orgId],
    queryFn: async () => {
      if (!orgId) return []

      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from('item_categories')
        .select('id, code, name, description, is_active')
        .eq('is_active', true)
        .order('name')

      if (error) throw error
      return data
    },
    enabled: !!orgId,
    staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000,
  })
}




// ── All items ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
export function useItems(filters?: {
  categoryId?: string
  search?: string
  isActive?: boolean
}) {
  const supabase = createClient()
  const orgId = useOrgId()

  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ['items', orgId, filters],
    queryFn: async () => {
      if (!orgId) return []

      let query = supabase
        .from('items')
        .select('*')
        .order('category_id')
        .order('item_code')

      if (filters?.isActive !== undefined) {
        query = query.eq('is_active', filters.isActive)
      } else {
        query = query.eq('is_active', true) // default: only active
      }

      if (filters?.categoryId) {
        query = query.eq('category_id', filters.categoryId)
      }

      if (filters?.search) {
        query = query.or(
          `name.ilike.%${filters.search}%,item_code.ilike.%${filters.search}%,sub_category.ilike.%${filters.search}%`
        )
      }

      const { data, error } = await query
      if (error) throw error
      return data as Item[]
    },
    enabled: !!orgId,
    staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000, // items change infrequently
  })
}

// ── Single item ───────────────────────────────────────────────
export function useItem(id: string | null) {
  const supabase = createClient()
  const orgId = useOrgId()

  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ['items', orgId, id],
    queryFn: async () => {
      if (!id || !orgId) return null
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from('items')
        .select(`
          *,
          item_prices (
            id, purchase_rate, selling_rate, gst_percent,
            effective_from, effective_to, notes
          ),

          bom!bom_finished_item_id_fkey (
            id, qty_per_unit, unit_id, notes, is_active,
            unit:units (
              id, name
            ),
            component:items!bom_component_id_fkey (
              id, item_code, name, unit_id
            )
          )
        `)
        .eq('id', id)
        .single()
      if (error) throw error
      return data
    },
    enabled: !!id && !!orgId,
    staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000,
  })
}

// ── Update item ───────────────────────────────────────────────
export function useUpdateItem() {
  const supabase = createClient()
  const qc = useQueryClient()

  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: async ({
      id,
      updates,
    }: {
      id: string
      updates: Partial<Item>
    }) => {
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from('items')
        .update(updates)
        .eq('id', id)
        .select()
        .single()
      if (error) throw error
      return data
    },
    onSuccess: (data) => {
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['items'] })
      toast.success(`${data.name} updated`)
    },
    onError: (err: Error) => {
      toast.error(err.message)
    },
  })
}
```

```ts
'use client'

import { useQuery, useMutation, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'
import { useOrgId } from '@/lib/hooks/use-tenant'
import { toast } from 'sonner'
import type { Enums, TablesUpdate } from '@/lib/types/database'

type ProductionStatus = Enums<'production_status'>

// ── All production orders ─────────────────────────────────────
export function useProductionOrders(filters?: {
  status?: ProductionStatus
}) {
  const supabase = createClient()
  const orgId = useOrgId()

  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ['production-orders', orgId, filters],
    queryFn: async () => {
      if (!orgId) return []

      let query = supabase
        .from('production_orders')
        .select(`
          *,
          creator:profiles!production_orders_created_by_fkey ( full_name ),
          production_order_items (
                id,
                qty_required,
                qty_produced,
                unit_id,
                unit:units (
                  id,
                  name
                ),
                item:items (
                  id,
                  item_code,
                  name,
                  unit_id
                )
              ),
          production_assignments (
            id, hours_worked,
            worker:workers ( id, name )
          )
        `)
        .order('created_at', { ascending: false })

      if (filters?.status) query = query.eq('status', filters.status)

      const { data, error } = await query
      if (error) throw error
      return data
    },
    staleTime: 30 * 1000,
    refetchInterval: 60 * 1000,
    enabled: !!orgId,
  })
}

// ── Single production order ───────────────────────────────────
export function useProductionOrder(id: string | null) {
  const supabase = createClient()
  const orgId = useOrgId()

  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ['production-orders', orgId, id],
    queryFn: async () => {
      if (!id || !orgId) return null

      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from('production_orders')
        .select(`
          *,
          creator:profiles!production_orders_created_by_fkey ( id, full_name ),
            production_order_items (
              id,
              qty_required,
              qty_produced,
              unit_id,
              unit:units (
                id,
                name
              ),
              item:items (
                id,
                item_code,
                name,
                unit_id
              )
            ),
          production_assignments (
            id, assigned_date, hours_worked, notes,
            worker:workers ( id, name, skill )
          )
        `)
        .eq('id', id)
        .single()

      if (error) throw error
      return data
    },
    enabled: !!id && !!orgId,
    staleTime: 30 * 1000,
  })
}

// ── BOM for a finished item ───────────────────────────────────
export function useBom(finishedItemId: string | null) {
  const supabase = createClient()
  const orgId = useOrgId()

  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ['bom', orgId, finishedItemId],
    queryFn: async () => {
      if (!finishedItemId || !orgId) return []

      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from('bom')
        .select(`
          id,
          qty_per_unit,
          unit_id,
          notes,

          unit:units (
            id,
            name
          ),

          component:items!bom_component_id_fkey (
            id,
            item_code,
            name,
            unit_id
          )
        `)
        .eq('finished_item_id', finishedItemId)
        .eq('is_active', true)

      if (error) throw error
      return data ?? []
    },
    enabled: !!finishedItemId && !!orgId,
    staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000,
  })
}

// ── All manufactured items (for new production dropdown) ──────
export function useManufacturedItems() {
  const supabase = createClient()
  const orgId = useOrgId()

  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ['manufactured-items', orgId],
    queryFn: async () => {
      if (!orgId) return []

      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from('items')
        .select(`
              id,
              item_code,
              name,
              unit_id,
              unit:units (
                id,
                name
              )
            `)
        .eq('is_manufactured', true)
        .eq('is_active', true)
        .order('name')

      if (error) throw error
      return data ?? []
    },
    enabled: !!orgId,
    staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000,
  })
}

// ── All raw material items (for manual BOM input) ─────────────
export function useRawMaterialItems() {
  const supabase = createClient()
  const orgId = useOrgId()

  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ['raw-material-items', orgId],
    queryFn: async () => {
      if (!orgId) return []

      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from('items')
        .select(`
              id,
              item_code,
              name,
              unit_id,
              unit:units (
                id,
                name
              )
            `)
        .eq('is_raw_material', true)
        .eq('is_active', true)
        .order('name')

      if (error) throw error
      return data ?? []
    },
    enabled: !!orgId,
    staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000,
  })
}

// ── Update production status ──────────────────────────────────
export function useUpdateProductionStatus() {
  const supabase = createClient()
  const qc = useQueryClient()

  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: async ({
      id,
      status,
    }: {
      id: string
      status: ProductionStatus
    }) => {
      const updates: TablesUpdate<'production_orders'> = { status }
      if (status === 'in_progress') {
        updates.start_date = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]
      }
      if (status === 'completed') {
        updates.completed_date = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]
      }

      const { error } = await supabase
        .from('production_orders')
        .update(updates)
        .eq('id', id)

      if (error) throw error
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['production-orders'] })
      toast.success('Production status updated')
    },
    onError: (err: Error) => toast.error(err.message),
  })
}

// ── Assign worker ─────────────────────────────────────────────
export function useAssignWorker() {
  const supabase = createClient()
  const qc = useQueryClient()

  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: async ({
      productionOrderId,
      workerId,
    }: {
      productionOrderId: string
      workerId: string
    }) => {
      const { error } = await supabase
        .from('production_assignments')
        .insert({
          production_order_id: productionOrderId,
          worker_id: workerId,
        })

      if (error) {
        if (error.code === '23505') {
          throw new Error('Worker already assigned')
        }
        throw error
      }
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['production-orders'] })
      toast.success('Worker assigned')
    },
    onError: (err: Error) => toast.error(err.message),
  })
}

// ── Update qty produced ───────────────────────────────────────
export function useUpdateQtyProduced() {
  const supabase = createClient()
  const qc = useQueryClient()

  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: async ({
      lineId,
      qtyProduced,
    }: {
      lineId: string
      qtyProduced: number
    }) => {
      const { error } = await supabase
        .from('production_order_items')
        .update({ qty_produced: qtyProduced })
        .eq('id', lineId)

      if (error) throw error
    },
    onSuccess: () => qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['production-orders'] }),
    onError: (err: Error) => toast.error(err.message),
  })
}
```
