# src/lib/hooks/use-profile.ts

```ts
'use client'

import { useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { useEffect } from 'react'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'
import { useOrgId } from '@/lib/hooks/use-tenant'
import type { Tables, Enums } from '@/lib/types/database'

export type Profile = Tables<'profiles'>
export type UserRole = Enums<'user_role'>

// Returns the current logged-in user's profile row.
// StaleTime is 0 so it always re-fetches on mount after a login/logout.
// The auth state listener below also invalidates it on any session change.
export function useProfile() {
  const supabase    = createClient()
  const queryClient = useQueryClient()
  const orgId = useOrgId()

  // ── Listen for auth state changes and immediately clear the cache ──
  useEffect(() => {
    const { data: { subscription } } = supabase.auth.onAuthStateChange((event) => {
      if (event === 'SIGNED_OUT') {
        queryClient.removeQueries({ queryKey: ['profile'] })
        queryClient.removeQueries({ queryKey: ['tenant-context'] })
      } else if (event === 'SIGNED_IN' || event === 'USER_UPDATED') {
        queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['profile'] })
        queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['tenant-context'] })
      }
    })
    return () => subscription.unsubscribe()
  }, [supabase, queryClient])

  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ['profile', orgId],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const { data: { user }, error: userError } = await supabase.auth.getUser()
      if (userError || !user || !orgId) return null

      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from('profiles')
        .select('*')
        .eq('id', user.id)
        .maybeSingle()

      if (error) throw error
      return (data as Profile) ?? null
    },
    enabled: !!orgId,
    staleTime: 0,
  })
}

// Convenience hook — returns just the role
export function useRole(): UserRole | null {
  const { data } = useProfile()
  return data?.role ?? null
}

// Permission helpers
export function useCanApprove(): boolean {
  const role = useRole()
  return role === 'admin' || role === 'manager'
}

export function useCanWriteInventory(): boolean {
  const role = useRole()
  return role === 'admin' || role === 'store' || role === 'production'
}

export function useCanSell(): boolean {
  const role = useRole()
  return role === 'admin' || role === 'manager' || role === 'sales'
}

export function useIsAdmin(): boolean {
  return useRole() === 'admin'
}
```

# src/lib/hooks/use-quotations.ts

```ts
'use client'

import { useQuery, useMutation, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'
import { useOrgId } from '@/lib/hooks/use-tenant'
import { toast } from 'sonner'
import type { Enums, Tables } from '@/lib/types/database'

export type Quotation = Tables<'quotations'>
export type DocumentStatus = Enums<'document_status'>

// ── All quotations ────────────────────────────────────────────
export function useQuotations(filters?: {
  status?: DocumentStatus
  clientId?: string
  search?: string
}) {
  const supabase = createClient()
  const orgId = useOrgId()

  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ['quotations', orgId, filters],
    queryFn: async () => {
      if (!orgId) return []

      let query = supabase
        .from('quotations')
        .select(`
          *,
          client:clients ( id, name, phone ),
          creator:profiles!quotations_created_by_fkey ( full_name )
        `)
        .order('created_at', { ascending: false })

      if (filters?.status) {
        query = query.eq('status', filters.status)
      }
      if (filters?.clientId) {
        query = query.eq('client_id', filters.clientId)
      }
      if (filters?.search) {
        query = query.ilike('quotation_no', `%${filters.search}%`)
      }

      const { data, error } = await query
      if (error) throw error
      return data
    },
    enabled: !!orgId,
    staleTime: 30 * 1000,
  })
}

// ── Single quotation with lines ───────────────────────────────
export function useQuotation(id: string | null) {
  const supabase = createClient()
  const orgId = useOrgId()

  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ['quotations', orgId, id],
    queryFn: async () => {
      if (!id || !orgId) return null

      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from('quotations')
        .select(`
          *,
          client:clients ( id, name, phone, gst_number, address, city ),
          creator:profiles!quotations_created_by_fkey ( id, full_name ),
          approver:profiles!quotations_approved_by_fkey ( id, full_name ),
          quotation_lines (
            *,
            item:items ( id, item_code, name, unit, hsn_code )
          )
        `)
        .eq('id', id)
        .single()

      if (error) throw error
      return data
    },
    enabled: !!id && !!orgId,
    staleTime: 30 * 1000,
  })
}

// ── Update quotation status ───────────────────────────────────
export function useUpdateQuotationStatus() {
  const supabase = createClient()
  const qc = useQueryClient()

  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: async ({
      id,
      status,
      comments,
    }: {
      id: string
      status: DocumentStatus
      comments?: string
    }) => {
      // Update quotation status
      const updates: Partial<Quotation> = { status }

      if (status === 'approved') {
        updates.approved_at = new Date().toISOString()

        // approved_by is set by the DB via auth.uid() in audit log
        // We set it here manually for the UI
        const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser()

        if (user) {
          updates.approved_by = user.id
        }
      }

      const { error: qError } = await supabase
        .from('quotations')
        .update(updates)
        .eq('id', id)

      if (qError) throw qError

      // Log the approval action
      const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser()

      if (user) {
        const { data: qData } = await supabase
          .from('quotations')
          .select('org_id')
          .eq('id', id)
          .single()

        if (qData?.org_id) {
          await supabase.from('approvals').insert({
            org_id: qData.org_id,
            ref_type: 'quotation',
            ref_id: id,
            action: status === 'approved'
              ? 'approved'
              : status === 'rejected'
              ? 'rejected'
              : 'revision_requested',
            actioned_by: user.id,
            comments: comments ?? null,
          })
        }
      }
    },

    onSuccess: (_, vars) => {
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['quotations'] })

      toast.success(
        vars.status === 'approved'
          ? 'Quotation approved'
          : vars.status === 'rejected'
          ? 'Quotation rejected'
          : 'Status updated'
      )
    },

    onError: (err: Error) => toast.error(err.message),
  })
}
```

```ts
// ── Update SO status ──────────────────────────────────────────
export function useUpdateSOStatus() {
  const supabase = createClient()
  const qc = useQueryClient()

  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: async ({
      id,
      status,
    }: {
      id: string
      status: OrderStatus
    }) => {
      const { error } = await supabase
        .from('sales_orders')
        .update({ status })
        .eq('id', id)
      if (error) throw error
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['sales-orders'] })
      toast.success('Order status updated')
    },
    onError: (err: Error) => toast.error(err.message),
  })
}

// ── Record advance payment ────────────────────────────────────
export function useRecordPayment() {
  const supabase = createClient()
  const qc = useQueryClient()

  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: async ({
      id,
      amount,
      currentAdvance,
      totalAmount,
    }: {
      id: string
      amount: number
      currentAdvance: number
      totalAmount: number
    }) => {
      const newAdvance = currentAdvance + amount
      const { error } = await supabase
        .from('sales_orders')
        .update({
          advance_paid: newAdvance,
          balance_due: totalAmount - newAdvance,
        })
        .eq('id', id)
      if (error) throw error
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['sales-orders'] })
      toast.success('Payment recorded')
    },
    onError: (err: Error) => toast.error(err.message),
  })
}
```

```ts
'use client'

import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'
import { useOrgId } from '@/lib/hooks/use-tenant'
import type { Tables } from '@/lib/types/database'

export type StockLevel = Tables<'v_stock_levels'>
// ── All stock levels ──────────────────────────────────────────
export function useStockLevels(search?: string) {
  const supabase = createClient()
  const orgId = useOrgId()

  return useQuery({
      queryKey: ['stock-levels', orgId, search],
      queryFn: async () => {
        if (!orgId) return []

        let query = supabase
        .from('v_stock_levels')
        .select('*')
        .order('category_id')
        .order('name')

      if (search) {
        query = query.or(
          `name.ilike.%${search}%,item_code.ilike.%${search}%`
        )
      }

      const { data, error } = await query
      if (error) throw error
      return data as StockLevel[]
    },
    enabled: !!orgId,
    staleTime: 30 * 1000, // 30 seconds — stock changes frequently
    refetchInterval: 60 * 1000, // auto-refetch every minute
  })
}

// ── Single item stock ─────────────────────────────────────────
export function useItemStock(itemId: string | null) {
  const supabase = createClient()
  const orgId = useOrgId()

  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ['stock-levels', orgId, itemId],
    queryFn: async () => {
      if (!itemId || !orgId) return null
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from('v_stock_levels')
        .select('*')
        .eq('item_id', itemId)
        .single()
      if (error) throw error
      return data as StockLevel
    },
    enabled: !!itemId && !!orgId,
    staleTime: 30 * 1000,
  })
}

// ── Reorder alerts ────────────────────────────────────────────
export function useReorderAlerts() {
  const supabase = createClient()
  const orgId = useOrgId()

  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ['reorder-alerts', orgId],
    queryFn: async () => {
      if (!orgId) return []

      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from('v_reorder_alerts')
        .select('*')
        .order('qty_available', { ascending: true })
      if (error) throw error
      return data as StockLevel[]
    },
    enabled: !!orgId,
    staleTime: 60 * 1000,
    refetchInterval: 5 * 60 * 1000, // check every 5 minutes
  })
}
```

# src/lib/supabase/middleware.ts

```ts
import { createServerClient } from '@supabase/ssr'
import { type NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server'
import type { Database } from '@/lib/types/database'

// Middleware client — used ONLY inside middleware.ts
// Refreshes the auth session on every request so the
// JWT token stays fresh without the user needing to re-login.
export async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {
  let supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({ request })

  const supabase = createServerClient<Database>(
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY!,
    {
      cookies: {
        getAll() {
          return request.cookies.getAll()
        },
        setAll(cookiesToSet) {
          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value }) =>
            request.cookies.set(name, value)
          )
          supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({ request })
          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =>
            supabaseResponse.cookies.set(name, value, options)
          )
        },
      },
    }
  )

  // Refresh the session — keeps the user logged in
  const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser()

  // If not logged in and trying to access a protected route → redirect to login
  if (
    !user &&
    !request.nextUrl.pathname.startsWith('/login') &&
    !request.nextUrl.pathname.startsWith('/auth') &&
    !request.nextUrl.pathname.startsWith('/onboarding')
  ) {
    const url = request.nextUrl.clone()
    url.pathname = '/login'
    return NextResponse.redirect(url)
  }

  // If logged in and on the login page → redirect to dashboard
  if (user && request.nextUrl.pathname === '/login') {
    const url = request.nextUrl.clone()
    url.pathname = '/'
    return NextResponse.redirect(url)
  }

  return supabaseResponse
}
```

```ts
import { createServerClient } from '@supabase/ssr'
import { cookies } from 'next/headers'
import type { Database } from '@/lib/types/database'

// Server client — used in Server Components, Server Actions,
// and Route Handlers. Reads the session cookie to identify
// the logged-in user and apply RLS automatically.
export async function createClient() {
  const cookieStore = await cookies()

  return createServerClient<Database>(
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY!,
    {
      cookies: {
        getAll() {
          return cookieStore.getAll()
        },
        setAll(cookiesToSet) {
          try {
            cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =>
              cookieStore.set(name, value, options)
            )
          } catch {
            // Server Component — cookies can't be set here.
            // Handled by the middleware instead.
          }
        },
      },
    }
  )
}
```

# src/lib/utils/bom-import.ts

```ts
import { type RowResult, toNumber, toStringOrNull } from "./spreadsheet-import";

export interface BomImportRow {
    finished_item_id: string;
    component_id: string;
    qty_per_unit: number;
    unit_id: string;
    notes: string | null;
}

// unitsByCode maps this organization's unit code → unit name.
// Example: "NO" → "No", "MTR" → "Meter"
export function validateBomRow(
    raw: Record<string, unknown>,
    rowNumber: number,
    itemsByCode: Map<string, string>,
    unitsByName: Map<string, string>,
): RowResult<BomImportRow> {
    const errors: string[] = [];

    const finishedCode = String(raw.finished_item_code ?? "").trim()
        .toUpperCase();

    const componentCode = String(raw.component_item_code ?? "").trim()
        .toUpperCase();

    if (!finishedCode) errors.push("finished_item_code is required");
    if (!componentCode) errors.push("component_item_code is required");

    const finished_item_id = itemsByCode.get(finishedCode);

    if (finishedCode && !finished_item_id) {
        errors.push(
            `no item found with code "${finishedCode}" in this organization`,
        );
    }

    const component_id = itemsByCode.get(componentCode);

    if (componentCode && !component_id) {
        errors.push(
            `no item found with code "${componentCode}" in this organization`,
        );
    }

    if (finishedCode && componentCode && finishedCode === componentCode) {
        errors.push(
            "finished_item_code and component_item_code cannot be the same item",
        );
    }

    const qty_per_unit = toNumber(raw.qty_per_unit, 0);

    if (qty_per_unit <= 0) {
        errors.push("qty_per_unit must be greater than 0");
    }

    const unitInput = String(raw.unit ?? "").trim();

    const unit = unitsByName.get(unitInput.toLowerCase());

    if (!unit) {
        errors.push(`unit "${unitInput}" is not a valid unit`);
    }

    if (errors.length > 0 || !finished_item_id || !component_id || !unit) {
        return {
            rowNumber,
            raw,
            data: null,
            errors,
        };
    }

    return {
    rowNumber,
    raw,
    errors: [],
    data: {
        finished_item_id,
        component_id,
        qty_per_unit,
        unit_id: unit,
        notes: toStringOrNull(raw.notes),
    },
    };
}
```

# src/lib/utils/format.ts

```ts
import { format, formatDistanceToNow, parseISO } from 'date-fns'

// ── Currency ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
export function formatCurrency(amount: number | null | undefined): string {
  if (amount === null || amount === undefined) return '—'
  return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-IN', {
    style: 'currency',
    currency: 'INR',
    minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2,
  }).format(amount)
}

// Short version: ₹1,23,456 (no decimals for large amounts)
export function formatCurrencyShort(amount: number | null | undefined): string {
  if (amount === null || amount === undefined) return '—'
  return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-IN', {
    style: 'currency',
    currency: 'INR',
    minimumFractionDigits: 0,
    maximumFractionDigits: 0,
  }).format(amount)
}

// ── Quantity ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
export function formatQty(
  qty: number | null | undefined,
  unit?: string
): string {
  if (qty === null || qty === undefined) return '—'
  const formatted = new Intl.NumberFormat('en-IN', {
    minimumFractionDigits: 0,
    maximumFractionDigits: 4,
  }).format(qty)
  return unit ? `${formatted} ${unit}` : formatted
}

// ── Date ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export function formatDate(
  date: string | null | undefined,
  fmt = 'dd MMM yyyy'
): string {
  if (!date) return '—'
  try {
    return format(parseISO(date), fmt)
  } catch {
    return '—'
  }
}

export function formatDateTime(date: string | null | undefined): string {
  return formatDate(date, 'dd MMM yyyy, hh:mm a')
}

export function formatRelative(date: string | null | undefined): string {
  if (!date) return '—'
  try {
    return formatDistanceToNow(parseISO(date), { addSuffix: true })
  } catch {
    return '—'
  }
}

// ── GST ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export function calculateGst(amount: number, gstPercent: string): number {
  return (amount * Number(gstPercent)) / 100
}

export function calculateTotal(
  subtotal: number,
  gstPercent: string
): { gst: number; total: number } {
  const gst = calculateGst(subtotal, gstPercent)
  return { gst, total: subtotal + gst }
}

// ── Document numbers ──────────────────────────────────────────
export function isQuotationNo(no: string) { return no.startsWith('QT-') }
export function isSalesOrderNo(no: string) { return no.startsWith('SO-') }
export function isGrnNo(no: string)        { return no.startsWith('GRN-') }
export function isPrdNo(no: string)        { return no.startsWith('PRD-') }
export function isDcNo(no: string)         { return no.startsWith('DC-') }
```

```ts
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Inventory RPC Wrappers
// Every function generates a unique operation_id for idempotency.
// Args match the generated database.ts exactly — no 'as any' casts.
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function opId() {
  return crypto.randomUUID()
}

// ── receive_inventory ─────────────────────────────────────────
// Args (from generated types):
// p_batch_no, p_item_id, p_notes, p_operation_id, p_qty, p_rate, p_ref_id, p_ref_type
export async function receiveInventory(params: {
  itemId:   string
  qty:      number
  rate:     number
  refId:    string       // inbound_receipt id
  batchNo?: string
  notes?:   string
}) {
  const supabase = createClient()
  const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('receive_inventory', {
    p_operation_id: opId(),
    p_item_id:      params.itemId,
    p_qty:          params.qty,
    p_rate:         params.rate,
    p_ref_type:     'inbound_receipt',
    p_ref_id:       params.refId,
    p_batch_no:     params.batchNo,
    p_notes:        params.notes,
  })
  if (error) throw new Error(error.message)
  return data
}

// ── reserve_inventory ─────────────────────────────────────────
// Args (from generated types):
// p_expiry_hours, p_item_id, p_notes, p_operation_id, p_qty, p_ref_id, p_ref_type
export async function reserveInventory(params: {
  itemId:       string
  qty:          number
  refType:      'sales_order' | 'production_order'
  refId:        string
  expiryHours?: number
  notes?:       string
}) {
  const supabase = createClient()
  const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('reserve_inventory', {
    p_operation_id: opId(),
    p_item_id:      params.itemId,
    p_qty:          params.qty,
    p_ref_type:     params.refType,
    p_ref_id:       params.refId,
    p_expiry_hours: params.expiryHours ?? 72,
    p_notes:        params.notes,
  })
  if (error) throw new Error(error.message)
  return data
}

// ── release_inventory ─────────────────────────────────────────
// Args (from generated types):
// p_notes, p_operation_id, p_qty_to_release, p_reservation_id
export async function releaseInventory(params: {
  reservationId:  string
  qtyToRelease?:  number   // undefined = release all remaining
  notes?:         string
}) {
  const supabase = createClient()
  const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('release_inventory', {
    p_operation_id:   opId(),
    p_reservation_id: params.reservationId,
    p_qty_to_release: params.qtyToRelease,
    p_notes:          params.notes,
  })
  if (error) throw new Error(error.message)
  return data
}

// ── consume_inventory ─────────────────────────────────────────
// Args (from generated types):
// p_item_id, p_notes, p_operation_id, p_qty, p_ref_id, p_ref_type, p_reservation_id
export async function consumeInventory(params: {
  itemId:          string
  qty:             number
  reservationId?:  string
  refId?:          string   // production_order id
  notes?:          string
}) {
  const supabase = createClient()
  const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('consume_inventory', {
    p_operation_id:   opId(),
    p_item_id:        params.itemId,
    p_qty:            params.qty,
    p_reservation_id: params.reservationId,
    p_ref_type:       'production_order',
    p_ref_id:         params.refId,
    p_notes:          params.notes,
  })
  if (error) throw new Error(error.message)
  return data
}

// ── produce_inventory ─────────────────────────────────────────
// Args (from generated types):
// p_item_id, p_notes, p_operation_id, p_qty, p_ref_id, p_ref_type
export async function produceInventory(params: {
  itemId:  string
  qty:     number
  refId?:  string   // production_order id
  notes?:  string
}) {
  const supabase = createClient()
  const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('produce_inventory', {
    p_operation_id: opId(),
    p_item_id:      params.itemId,
    p_qty:          params.qty,
    p_ref_type:     'production_order',
    p_ref_id:       params.refId,
    p_notes:        params.notes,
  })
  if (error) throw new Error(error.message)
  return data
}

// ── dispatch_inventory ────────────────────────────────────────
// Args (from generated types):
// p_item_id, p_notes, p_operation_id, p_qty, p_rate, p_ref_id, p_ref_type, p_reservation_id
export async function dispatchInventory(params: {
  itemId:          string
  qty:             number
  rate:            number
  reservationId?:  string
  refId?:          string   // delivery_challan id
  notes?:          string
}) {
  const supabase = createClient()
  const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('dispatch_inventory', {
    p_operation_id:   opId(),
    p_item_id:        params.itemId,
    p_qty:            params.qty,
    p_rate:           params.rate,
    p_reservation_id: params.reservationId,
    p_ref_type:       'delivery_challan',
    p_ref_id:         params.refId,
    p_notes:          params.notes,
  })
  if (error) throw new Error(error.message)
  return data
}

// ── adjust_inventory ──────────────────────────────────────────
// Args (from generated types):
// p_delta, p_item_id, p_operation_id, p_reason, p_ref_id
// Note: args are alphabetical in generated types but passed as object so order doesn't matter
export async function adjustInventory(params: {
  itemId:  string
  delta:   number
  reason:  string
  refId?:  string
}) {
  const supabase = createClient()
  const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('adjust_inventory', {
    p_operation_id: opId(),
    p_item_id:      params.itemId,
    p_delta:        params.delta,
    p_reason:       params.reason,
    p_ref_id:       params.refId,
  })
  if (error) throw new Error(error.message)
  return data
}

// ── check_bom_availability ────────────────────────────────────
// Args (from generated types):
// p_production_order_id
export async function checkBomAvailability(productionOrderId: string) {
  const supabase = createClient()
  const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('check_bom_availability', {
    p_production_order_id: productionOrderId,
  })
  if (error) throw new Error(error.message)
  return data as {
    production_order_id: string
    checked_at:          string
    can_produce:         boolean
    materials: Array<{
      item_id:       string
      item_code:     string
      item_name:     string
      unit:          string
      qty_required:  number
      qty_available: number
      shortage:      number
      sufficient:    boolean
    }>
  }
}
```

# src/lib/utils/item-import.ts

```ts

import {
    type RowResult,
    toBoolean,
    toNumber,
    toStringOrNull,
} from "./spreadsheet-import";



export interface ItemImportRow {
    item_code: string;
    name: string;
    category_id: string;
    sub_category: string | null;
    material_type_id: string;
    size_spec: string | null;
    unit_id: string;
    hsn_code: string | null;
    is_traded: boolean;
    is_manufactured: boolean;
    is_raw_material: boolean;
    reorder_level: number;
    reorder_qty: number;
    notes: string | null;
}

// Expected columns (case/spacing-insensitive after normalization):
// item_code, name, category, sub_category, material_type, size_spec, unit,
// hsn_code, is_traded, is_manufactured, is_raw_material, reorder_level,
// reorder_qty, notes
export function validateItemRow(
    raw: Record<string, unknown>,
    rowNumber: number,
    categories: { id: string; name: string }[],
    materialTypes: { id: string; name: string }[],
    units: { id: string; name: string }[],
): RowResult<ItemImportRow> {
    const errors: string[] = [];

    const item_code = String(raw.item_code ?? "").trim();
    if (!item_code) errors.push("item_code is required");

    const name = String(raw.name ?? "").trim();
    if (!name) errors.push("name is required");

    const categoryInput = String(raw.category ?? "").trim();

    const category = categories.find(
        (c) => c.name.toLowerCase() === categoryInput.toLowerCase(),
    );

    if (!category) {
        errors.push(
            `category must be one of: ${categories.map((c) => c.name).join(", ")}`
        );
    }

    const materialInput = String(raw.material_type ?? "").trim();

    const materialType = materialTypes.find(
        (m) => m.name.toLowerCase() === materialInput.toLowerCase(),
    );

    if (!materialType) {
        errors.push(
            `material_type must be one of: ${materialTypes
                .map((m) => m.name)
                .join(", ")}`
        );
    }
    const unitInput = String(raw.unit ?? "").trim();

    const unit = units.find(
        (u) => u.name.toLowerCase() === unitInput.toLowerCase(),
    );

    if (!unit) {
        errors.push(
            `unit must be one of: ${units.map((u) => u.name).join(", ")}`
        );
    }

    const is_traded = toBoolean(raw.is_traded);
    const is_manufactured = toBoolean(raw.is_manufactured);
    const is_raw_material = toBoolean(raw.is_raw_material);
    if (!is_traded && !is_manufactured && !is_raw_material) {
        errors.push(
            "at least one of is_traded / is_manufactured / is_raw_material must be true",
        );
    }

   if (errors.length > 0 || !category || !materialType || !unit) {
        return { rowNumber, raw, data: null, errors };
    }

    return {
        rowNumber,
        raw,
        errors: [],
        data: {
            item_code,
            name,
            category_id: category.id,
            sub_category: toStringOrNull(raw.sub_category),
            material_type_id: materialType.id,
            size_spec: toStringOrNull(raw.size_spec),
            unit_id: unit.id,
            hsn_code: toStringOrNull(raw.hsn_code),
            is_traded,
            is_manufactured,
            is_raw_material,
            reorder_level: toNumber(raw.reorder_level, 0),
            reorder_qty: toNumber(raw.reorder_qty, 0),
            notes: toStringOrNull(raw.notes),
        },
    };
}
```

# src/lib/utils/spreadsheet-import.ts

```ts
import * as XLSX from "xlsx";

// Reads an .xlsx, .xls, or .csv file and returns its first sheet as an
// array of plain objects keyed by header row. Header names are trimmed
// and lowercased with spaces/hyphens converted to underscores, so
// "Item Code", "item-code", and "item_code" all map to the same key.
export async function parseSpreadsheet(
    file: File,
    sheetName?: string,
): Promise<Record<string, unknown>[]> {
    const buffer = await file.arrayBuffer();
    const workbook = XLSX.read(buffer, { type: "array" });
    const selectedSheetName = sheetName ?? workbook.SheetNames[0];
    if (!selectedSheetName) return [];

    const sheet = workbook.Sheets[selectedSheetName];
    if (!sheet) return [];
    const rawRows: Record<string, unknown>[] = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(sheet, {
        defval: "",
        raw: false, // keep values as strings so we control coercion ourselves
    });

    return rawRows.map((row) => {
        const normalized: Record<string, unknown> = {};
        for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(row)) {
            const normalizedKey = key.trim().toLowerCase().replace(
                /[\s-]+/g,
                "_",
            );
            normalized[normalizedKey] = typeof value === "string"
                ? value.trim()
                : value;
        }
        return normalized;
    });
}

// ── Shared coercion helpers used by both import validators ────────────────

export function toBoolean(value: unknown, fallback = false): boolean {
    if (typeof value === "boolean") return value;
    const s = String(value ?? "").trim().toLowerCase();
    if (["true", "yes", "y", "1"].includes(s)) return true;
    if (["false", "no", "n", "0"].includes(s)) return false;
    return fallback;
}

export function toNumber(value: unknown, fallback = 0): number {
    if (typeof value === "number") return value;
    const n = Number(String(value ?? "").trim());
    return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : fallback;
}

export function toStringOrNull(value: unknown): string | null {
    const s = String(value ?? "").trim();
    return s.length > 0 ? s : null;
}

// A single row's validation outcome, used to drive the preview table.
export interface RowResult<T> {
    rowNumber: number; // 1-based, matches the spreadsheet row (header = row 1)
    raw: Record<string, unknown>;
    data: T | null; // present only if errors is empty
    errors: string[];
}
```

# src/middleware.ts

```ts
import { type NextRequest } from 'next/server'
import { updateSession } from '@/lib/supabase/middleware'

// This middleware runs on every request.
// It refreshes the Supabase session and redirects
// unauthenticated users to /login.
export async function middleware(request: NextRequest) {
  return await updateSession(request)
}

export const config = {
  matcher: [
    // Run on all routes EXCEPT:
    // - _next/static (static files)
    // - _next/image (image optimization)
    // - favicon.ico
    // - public folder files
    '/((?!_next/static|_next/image|favicon.ico|.*\\.(?:svg|png|jpg|jpeg|gif|webp)$).*)',
  ],
}
```

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "public"."adjust_inventory"("p_operation_id" "uuid", "p_item_id" "uuid", "p_delta" numeric, "p_reason" "text", "p_ref_id" "uuid" DEFAULT NULL::"uuid") RETURNS "jsonb"
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql" SECURITY DEFINER
    SET "search_path" TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare
  v_cached jsonb; v_balance public.inventory_balance; v_movement_id uuid;
  v_move_type movement_type; v_qty numeric; v_result jsonb; v_user uuid := auth.uid();
  v_org uuid;
begin
  select result_payload into v_cached from public.inventory_ops_log where operation_id = p_operation_id;
  if found then return v_cached; end if;

  if p_delta = 0 then raise exception 'Adjustment delta cannot be zero' using errcode = 'P0002'; end if;

  perform public.assert_item_in_my_org(p_item_id);
  if (select role from public.profiles where id = v_user) not in ('admin','store','manager') then
    raise exception 'Unauthorized: only admin/store/manager can adjust inventory' using errcode = 'P0005';
  end if;

  v_org := public.my_org();
  v_balance := public.lock_inventory_balance(p_item_id);

  if p_delta > 0 then
    v_move_type := 'adjustment_in'; v_qty := p_delta;
  else
    v_move_type := 'adjustment_out'; v_qty := abs(p_delta);
    perform public.validate_stock_sufficiency(p_item_id, v_qty, v_balance);
  end if;

  insert into public.stock_movements(item_id, org_id, movement_type, qty, ref_type, ref_id, notes, created_by)
  values (p_item_id, v_org, v_move_type, v_qty, 'manual_adjustment', p_ref_id, p_reason, v_user)
  returning id into v_movement_id;

  v_result := jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'operation_id', p_operation_id, 'movement_id', v_movement_id,
      'item_id', p_item_id, 'delta', p_delta, 'movement_type', v_move_type);

  insert into public.inventory_ops_log(operation_id, org_id, operation_type, item_id, qty, ref_type, result_movement_id, result_payload, created_by)
  values (p_operation_id, v_org, 'adjust', p_item_id, p_delta, 'manual_adjustment', v_movement_id, v_result, v_user);

  return v_result;
end;
$$;


ALTER FUNCTION "public"."adjust_inventory"("p_operation_id" "uuid", "p_item_id" "uuid", "p_delta" numeric, "p_reason" "text", "p_ref_id" "uuid") OWNER TO "postgres";


CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "public"."assert_item_in_my_org"("p_item_id" "uuid") RETURNS "void"
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql" SECURITY DEFINER
    SET "search_path" TO 'public'
    AS $$
begin
  if not exists (
    select 1 from public.items where id = p_item_id and org_id = public.my_org()
  ) then
    raise exception 'Item % not found in your organization', p_item_id using errcode = 'P0007';
  end if;
end;
$$;


ALTER FUNCTION "public"."assert_item_in_my_org"("p_item_id" "uuid") OWNER TO "postgres";


CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "public"."check_bom_availability"("p_production_order_id" "uuid") RETURNS "jsonb"
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql" SECURITY DEFINER
    SET "search_path" TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare
  v_result   jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
  v_shortages jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
  v_has_shortage boolean := false;
begin
  -- For each item in the production order, cross-reference BOM qty needed
  -- against inventory_balance.available_qty
  select
    jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'item_id',       poi.item_id,
        'item_code',     i.item_code,
        'item_name',     i.name,
        'unit',          i.unit,
        'qty_required',  poi.qty_required,
        'qty_available', coalesce(ib.available_qty, 0),
        'shortage',      greatest(0, poi.qty_required - coalesce(ib.available_qty, 0)),
        'sufficient',    coalesce(ib.available_qty, 0) >= poi.qty_required
      )
    )
  into v_result
  from public.production_order_items poi
  join public.items i on i.id = poi.item_id
  left join public.inventory_balance ib on ib.item_id = poi.item_id
  where poi.production_order_id = p_production_order_id;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'production_order_id', p_production_order_id,
    'checked_at',          now(),
    'can_produce',         not exists(
      select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(v_result,'[]'::jsonb)) r
      where (r->>'sufficient')::boolean = false
    ),
    'materials', coalesce(v_result, '[]'::jsonb)
  );
end;
$$;


ALTER FUNCTION "public"."check_bom_availability"("p_production_order_id" "uuid") OWNER TO "postgres";


COMMENT ON FUNCTION "public"."check_bom_availability"("p_production_order_id" "uuid") IS 'Returns material availability for a production order. Use before confirming production to detect shortages.';



CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "public"."consume_inventory"("p_operation_id" "uuid", "p_item_id" "uuid", "p_qty" numeric, "p_reservation_id" "uuid" DEFAULT NULL::"uuid", "p_ref_type" "text" DEFAULT 'production_order'::"text", "p_ref_id" "uuid" DEFAULT NULL::"uuid", "p_notes" "text" DEFAULT NULL::"text") RETURNS "jsonb"
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql" SECURITY DEFINER
    SET "search_path" TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare
  v_cached jsonb; v_balance public.inventory_balance; v_res public.stock_reservations;
  v_movement_id uuid; v_result jsonb; v_user uuid := auth.uid(); v_org uuid;
begin
  select result_payload into v_cached from public.inventory_ops_log where operation_id = p_operation_id;
  if found then return v_cached; end if;
  if p_qty <= 0 then raise exception 'qty must be positive for consume_inventory' using errcode = 'P0002'; end if;

  perform public.assert_item_in_my_org(p_item_id);
  v_org := public.my_org();
  v_balance := public.lock_inventory_balance(p_item_id);

  if p_reservation_id is not null then
    select * into v_res from public.stock_reservations
    where id = p_reservation_id and item_id = p_item_id and org_id = v_org and status in ('active','partially_consumed')
    for update nowait;

    if not found then
      raise exception 'Reservation % not found or already consumed', p_reservation_id using errcode = 'P0003';
    end if;

    declare v_remaining numeric;
    begin
      v_remaining := v_res.qty_reserved - v_res.qty_consumed - v_res.qty_released;
      if p_qty > v_remaining then
        raise exception 'Consume qty (%) exceeds remaining reservation (%)', p_qty, v_remaining using errcode = 'P0004';
      end if;
    end;

    update public.stock_reservations
    set qty_consumed = qty_consumed + p_qty,
        status = case when (qty_consumed + qty_released + p_qty) = qty_reserved then 'consumed'::reservation_status else 'partially_consumed'::reservation_status end,
        updated_at = now()
    where id = p_reservation_id;

    update public.inventory_balance set reserved_qty = greatest(0, reserved_qty - p_qty), updated_at = now() where item_id = p_item_id;
  else
    perform public.validate_stock_sufficiency(p_item_id, p_qty, v_balance);
  end if;

  insert into public.stock_movements(item_id, org_id, movement_type, qty, ref_type, ref_id, notes, created_by)
  values (p_item_id, v_org, 'consumed', p_qty, p_ref_type, p_ref_id, p_notes, v_user)
  returning id into v_movement_id;

  v_result := jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'operation_id', p_operation_id, 'movement_id', v_movement_id,
      'item_id', p_item_id, 'qty_consumed', p_qty, 'reservation_id', p_reservation_id);

  insert into public.inventory_ops_log(operation_id, org_id, operation_type, item_id, qty, ref_type, ref_id, result_movement_id, result_payload, created_by)
  values (p_operation_id, v_org, 'consume', p_item_id, p_qty, p_ref_type, p_ref_id, v_movement_id, v_result, v_user);

  return v_result;
end;
$$;


ALTER FUNCTION "public"."consume_inventory"("p_operation_id" "uuid", "p_item_id" "uuid", "p_qty" numeric, "p_reservation_id" "uuid", "p_ref_type" "text", "p_ref_id" "uuid", "p_notes" "text") OWNER TO "postgres";


CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "public"."create_organization"("p_name" "text") RETURNS "uuid"
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql" SECURITY DEFINER
    SET "search_path" TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare
  v_org_id  uuid;
  v_existing uuid;
begin
  select org_id into v_existing from public.profiles where id = auth.uid();
  if v_existing is not null then
    raise exception 'User already belongs to an organization' using errcode = 'P0006';
  end if;

  insert into public.organizations (name) values (p_name) returning id into v_org_id;

  update public.profiles
  set org_id = v_org_id, role = 'admin'
  where id = auth.uid();

  return v_org_id;
end;
$$;


ALTER FUNCTION "public"."create_organization"("p_name" "text") OWNER TO "postgres";


CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "public"."dispatch_inventory"("p_operation_id" "uuid", "p_item_id" "uuid", "p_qty" numeric, "p_rate" numeric, "p_reservation_id" "uuid" DEFAULT NULL::"uuid", "p_ref_type" "text" DEFAULT 'delivery_challan'::"text", "p_ref_id" "uuid" DEFAULT NULL::"uuid", "p_notes" "text" DEFAULT NULL::"text") RETURNS "jsonb"
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql" SECURITY DEFINER
    SET "search_path" TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare
  v_cached jsonb; v_balance public.inventory_balance; v_res public.stock_reservations;
  v_movement_id uuid; v_result jsonb; v_user uuid := auth.uid(); v_org uuid;
begin
  select result_payload into v_cached from public.inventory_ops_log where operation_id = p_operation_id;
  if found then return v_cached; end if;
  if p_qty <= 0 then raise exception 'qty must be positive for dispatch_inventory' using errcode = 'P0002'; end if;

  perform public.assert_item_in_my_org(p_item_id);
  v_org := public.my_org();
  v_balance := public.lock_inventory_balance(p_item_id);

  if p_reservation_id is not null then
    select * into v_res from public.stock_reservations
    where id = p_reservation_id and item_id = p_item_id and org_id = v_org and status in ('active','partially_consumed')
    for update nowait;

    if not found then
      raise exception 'Reservation % not active for dispatch', p_reservation_id using errcode = 'P0003';
    end if;

    declare v_remaining numeric;
    begin
      v_remaining := v_res.qty_reserved - v_res.qty_consumed - v_res.qty_released;
      if p_qty > v_remaining then
        raise exception 'Dispatch qty (%) exceeds reservation remaining (%)', p_qty, v_remaining using errcode = 'P0004';
      end if;
    end;

    update public.stock_reservations
    set qty_consumed = qty_consumed + p_qty,
        status = case when (qty_consumed + qty_released + p_qty) = qty_reserved then 'consumed'::reservation_status else 'partially_consumed'::reservation_status end,
        updated_at = now()
    where id = p_reservation_id;

    update public.inventory_balance set reserved_qty = greatest(0, reserved_qty - p_qty), updated_at = now() where item_id = p_item_id;
  else
    perform public.validate_stock_sufficiency(p_item_id, p_qty, v_balance);
  end if;

  insert into public.stock_movements(item_id, org_id, movement_type, qty, rate_at_time, ref_type, ref_id, notes, created_by)
  values (p_item_id, v_org, 'sold', p_qty, p_rate, p_ref_type, p_ref_id, p_notes, v_user)
  returning id into v_movement_id;

  v_result := jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'operation_id', p_operation_id, 'movement_id', v_movement_id,
      'item_id', p_item_id, 'qty_dispatched', p_qty, 'reservation_id', p_reservation_id);

  insert into public.inventory_ops_log(operation_id, org_id, operation_type, item_id, qty, ref_type, ref_id, result_movement_id, result_payload, created_by)
  values (p_operation_id, v_org, 'dispatch', p_item_id, p_qty, p_ref_type, p_ref_id, v_movement_id, v_result, v_user);

  return v_result;
end;
$$;


ALTER FUNCTION "public"."dispatch_inventory"("p_operation_id" "uuid", "p_item_id" "uuid", "p_qty" numeric, "p_rate" numeric, "p_reservation_id" "uuid", "p_ref_type" "text", "p_ref_id" "uuid", "p_notes" "text") OWNER TO "postgres";


CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "public"."expire_stale_reservations"() RETURNS integer
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql" SECURITY DEFINER
    SET "search_path" TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare
  v_count int := 0;
  v_res   record;
begin
  for v_res in
    select id, item_id,
           qty_reserved - qty_consumed - qty_released as qty_to_release
    from public.stock_reservations
    where status in ('active','partially_consumed')
      and reservation_expiry < now()
  loop
    update public.stock_reservations
    set qty_released = qty_reserved - qty_consumed,
        status       = 'expired',
        updated_at   = now()
    where id = v_res.id;

    update public.inventory_balance
    set reserved_qty = greatest(0, reserved_qty - v_res.qty_to_release),
        updated_at   = now()
    where item_id = v_res.item_id;

    v_count := v_count + 1;
  end loop;

  return v_count;
end;
$$;


ALTER FUNCTION "public"."expire_stale_reservations"() OWNER TO "postgres";

SET default_tablespace = '';

SET default_table_access_method = "heap";


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "public"."inventory_balance" (
    "item_id" "uuid" NOT NULL,
    "current_qty" numeric(14,4) DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
    "reserved_qty" numeric(14,4) DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
    "available_qty" numeric(14,4) GENERATED ALWAYS AS (("current_qty" - "reserved_qty")) STORED,
    "updated_at" timestamp with time zone DEFAULT "now"() NOT NULL,
    "org_id" "uuid" NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT "available_cannot_exceed_current" CHECK (("current_qty" >= "reserved_qty")),
    CONSTRAINT "current_qty_non_negative" CHECK (("current_qty" >= (0)::numeric)),
    CONSTRAINT "reserved_non_negative" CHECK (("reserved_qty" >= (0)::numeric))
);


ALTER TABLE "public"."inventory_balance" OWNER TO "postgres";


COMMENT ON TABLE "public"."inventory_balance" IS 'Fast-read, row-lockable inventory state cache. current_qty synced from stock_movements via trigger. reserved_qty managed by reservation functions. DO NOT write to this table directly — use RPC functions only.';



COMMENT ON COLUMN "public"."inventory_balance"."current_qty" IS 'Physical quantity on hand. Mirrors ledger sum.';



COMMENT ON COLUMN "public"."inventory_balance"."reserved_qty" IS 'Quantity reserved for pending sales orders / production. Does NOT reduce current_qty — only reduces available_qty.';



COMMENT ON COLUMN "public"."inventory_balance"."available_qty" IS 'current_qty - reserved_qty. What can be freely allocated.';



CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "public"."lock_inventory_balance"("p_item_id" "uuid") RETURNS "public"."inventory_balance"
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql" SECURITY DEFINER
    SET "search_path" TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare
  v_balance public.inventory_balance;
  v_org     uuid;
begin
  perform public.assert_item_in_my_org(p_item_id);

  select * into v_balance
  from public.inventory_balance
  where item_id = p_item_id
  for update nowait;

  if not found then
    select org_id into v_org from public.items where id = p_item_id;

    insert into public.inventory_balance (item_id, org_id, current_qty, reserved_qty)
    values (p_item_id, v_org, 0, 0)
    on conflict (item_id) do nothing
    returning * into v_balance;

    select * into v_balance
    from public.inventory_balance
    where item_id = p_item_id
    for update nowait;
  end if;

  return v_balance;
end;
$$;


ALTER FUNCTION "public"."lock_inventory_balance"("p_item_id" "uuid") OWNER TO "postgres";


COMMENT ON FUNCTION "public"."lock_inventory_balance"("p_item_id" "uuid") IS 'Acquires row-level lock on inventory_balance for a single item. Uses NOWAIT to fail fast and prevent deadlock queuing. Call inside a transaction before any inventory mutation.';

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "public"."produce_inventory"("p_operation_id" "uuid", "p_item_id" "uuid", "p_qty" numeric, "p_ref_type" "text" DEFAULT 'production_order'::"text", "p_ref_id" "uuid" DEFAULT NULL::"uuid", "p_notes" "text" DEFAULT NULL::"text") RETURNS "jsonb"
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql" SECURITY DEFINER
    SET "search_path" TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare
  v_cached jsonb; v_movement_id uuid; v_result jsonb; v_user uuid := auth.uid(); v_org uuid;
begin
  select result_payload into v_cached from public.inventory_ops_log where operation_id = p_operation_id;
  if found then return v_cached; end if;
  if p_qty <= 0 then raise exception 'qty must be positive for produce_inventory' using errcode = 'P0002'; end if;

  perform public.assert_item_in_my_org(p_item_id);
  v_org := public.my_org();
  perform public.lock_inventory_balance(p_item_id);

  insert into public.stock_movements(item_id, org_id, movement_type, qty, ref_type, ref_id, notes, created_by)
  values (p_item_id, v_org, 'produced', p_qty, p_ref_type, p_ref_id, p_notes, v_user)
  returning id into v_movement_id;

  v_result := jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'operation_id', p_operation_id, 'movement_id', v_movement_id,
      'item_id', p_item_id, 'qty_produced', p_qty);

  insert into public.inventory_ops_log(operation_id, org_id, operation_type, item_id, qty, ref_type, ref_id, result_movement_id, result_payload, created_by)
  values (p_operation_id, v_org, 'produce', p_item_id, p_qty, p_ref_type, p_ref_id, v_movement_id, v_result, v_user);

  return v_result;
end;
$$;


ALTER FUNCTION "public"."produce_inventory"("p_operation_id" "uuid", "p_item_id" "uuid", "p_qty" numeric, "p_ref_type" "text", "p_ref_id" "uuid", "p_notes" "text") OWNER TO "postgres";


CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "public"."receive_inventory"("p_operation_id" "uuid", "p_item_id" "uuid", "p_qty" numeric, "p_rate" numeric, "p_ref_type" "text", "p_ref_id" "uuid", "p_batch_no" "text" DEFAULT NULL::"text", "p_notes" "text" DEFAULT NULL::"text") RETURNS "jsonb"
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql" SECURITY DEFINER
    SET "search_path" TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare
  v_cached jsonb; v_movement_id uuid; v_result jsonb; v_user uuid := auth.uid(); v_org uuid;
begin
  select result_payload into v_cached from public.inventory_ops_log where operation_id = p_operation_id;
  if found then return v_cached; end if;
  if p_qty <= 0 then raise exception 'qty must be positive for receive_inventory' using errcode = 'P0002'; end if;

  perform public.assert_item_in_my_org(p_item_id);
  v_org := public.my_org();
  perform public.lock_inventory_balance(p_item_id);

  insert into public.stock_movements(item_id, org_id, movement_type, qty, rate_at_time, ref_type, ref_id, batch_no, notes, created_by)
  values (p_item_id, v_org, 'inbound', p_qty, p_rate, p_ref_type, p_ref_id, p_batch_no, p_notes, v_user)
  returning id into v_movement_id;

  v_result := jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'operation_id', p_operation_id, 'movement_id', v_movement_id,
      'item_id', p_item_id, 'qty_received', p_qty);

  insert into public.inventory_ops_log(operation_id, org_id, operation_type, item_id, qty, ref_type, ref_id, result_movement_id, result_payload, created_by)
  values (p_operation_id, v_org, 'receive', p_item_id, p_qty, p_ref_type, p_ref_id, v_movement_id, v_result, v_user);

  return v_result;
end;
$$;


ALTER FUNCTION "public"."receive_inventory"("p_operation_id" "uuid", "p_item_id" "uuid", "p_qty" numeric, "p_rate" numeric, "p_ref_type" "text", "p_ref_id" "uuid", "p_batch_no" "text", "p_notes" "text") OWNER TO "postgres";


CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "public"."reconcile_inventory_balance"() RETURNS TABLE("item_id" "uuid", "old_qty" numeric, "new_qty" numeric, "diff" numeric)
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql" SECURITY DEFINER
    SET "search_path" TO 'public'
    AS $$
begin
  if (select role from public.profiles where id = auth.uid()) != 'admin' then
    raise exception 'Only admin can run reconciliation' using errcode = 'P0005';
  end if;

  return query
  with ledger_totals as (
    select m.item_id,
      sum(case when m.movement_type in ('inbound','produced','adjustment_in','returned_client') then m.qty else -m.qty end) as true_qty
    from public.stock_movements m
    where m.org_id = public.my_org()
    group by m.item_id
  ),
  updates as (
    update public.inventory_balance ib
    set current_qty = greatest(0, coalesce(lt.true_qty, 0)), updated_at = now()
    from ledger_totals lt
    where ib.item_id = lt.item_id and ib.org_id = public.my_org()
    returning ib.item_id, ib.current_qty as old_qty, greatest(0, coalesce(lt.true_qty, 0)) as new_qty
  )
  select u.item_id, u.old_qty, u.new_qty, u.new_qty - u.old_qty as diff
  from updates u
  where abs(u.new_qty - u.old_qty) > 0.0001;
end;
$$;


ALTER FUNCTION "public"."reconcile_inventory_balance"() OWNER TO "postgres";


CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "public"."release_inventory"("p_operation_id" "uuid", "p_reservation_id" "uuid", "p_qty_to_release" numeric DEFAULT NULL::numeric, "p_notes" "text" DEFAULT NULL::"text") RETURNS "jsonb"
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql" SECURITY DEFINER
    SET "search_path" TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare
  v_cached jsonb; v_res public.stock_reservations; v_qty_release numeric; v_remaining numeric;
  v_result jsonb; v_user uuid := auth.uid();
begin
  select result_payload into v_cached from public.inventory_ops_log where operation_id = p_operation_id;
  if found then return v_cached; end if;

  select * into v_res from public.stock_reservations
  where id = p_reservation_id and org_id = public.my_org() and status in ('active','partially_consumed')
  for update nowait;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'Reservation % not found or not in releasable status', p_reservation_id using errcode = 'P0003';
  end if;

  perform public.lock_inventory_balance(v_res.item_id);

  v_remaining := v_res.qty_reserved - v_res.qty_consumed - v_res.qty_released;
  v_qty_release := coalesce(p_qty_to_release, v_remaining);

  if v_qty_release > v_remaining then
    raise exception 'Release qty (%) exceeds remaining reservation (%)', v_qty_release, v_remaining using errcode = 'P0004';
  end if;

  update public.stock_reservations
  set qty_released = qty_released + v_qty_release,
      status = case when (qty_consumed + qty_released + v_qty_release) = qty_reserved then 'released'::reservation_status else 'partially_consumed'::reservation_status end,
      updated_at = now()
  where id = p_reservation_id;

  update public.inventory_balance set reserved_qty = greatest(0, reserved_qty - v_qty_release), updated_at = now() where item_id = v_res.item_id;

  v_result := jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'operation_id', p_operation_id, 'reservation_id', p_reservation_id,
      'qty_released', v_qty_release, 'item_id', v_res.item_id);

  insert into public.inventory_ops_log(operation_id, org_id, operation_type, item_id, qty, ref_type, ref_id, result_payload, created_by)
  values (p_operation_id, v_res.org_id, 'release', v_res.item_id, v_qty_release, v_res.ref_type, v_res.ref_id, v_result, v_user);

  return v_result;
end;
$$;


ALTER FUNCTION "public"."release_inventory"("p_operation_id" "uuid", "p_reservation_id" "uuid", "p_qty_to_release" numeric, "p_notes" "text") OWNER TO "postgres";


CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "public"."reserve_inventory"("p_operation_id" "uuid", "p_item_id" "uuid", "p_qty" numeric, "p_ref_type" "text", "p_ref_id" "uuid", "p_expiry_hours" integer DEFAULT 72, "p_notes" "text" DEFAULT NULL::"text") RETURNS "jsonb"
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql" SECURITY DEFINER
    SET "search_path" TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare
  v_cached jsonb; v_balance public.inventory_balance; v_reservation_id uuid; v_result jsonb;
  v_user uuid := auth.uid(); v_org uuid;
begin
  select result_payload into v_cached from public.inventory_ops_log where operation_id = p_operation_id;
  if found then return v_cached; end if;
  if p_qty <= 0 then raise exception 'qty must be positive for reserve_inventory' using errcode = 'P0002'; end if;

  perform public.assert_item_in_my_org(p_item_id);
  v_org := public.my_org();
  v_balance := public.lock_inventory_balance(p_item_id);
  perform public.validate_stock_sufficiency(p_item_id, p_qty, v_balance);

  insert into public.stock_reservations(item_id, org_id, qty_reserved, ref_type, ref_id, reservation_expiry, notes, created_by)
  values (p_item_id, v_org, p_qty, p_ref_type, p_ref_id, now() + (p_expiry_hours || ' hours')::interval, p_notes, v_user)
  returning id into v_reservation_id;

  update public.inventory_balance set reserved_qty = reserved_qty + p_qty, updated_at = now() where item_id = p_item_id;

  v_result := jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'operation_id', p_operation_id, 'reservation_id', v_reservation_id,
      'item_id', p_item_id, 'qty_reserved', p_qty, 'expires_at', now() + (p_expiry_hours || ' hours')::interval);

  insert into public.inventory_ops_log(operation_id, org_id, operation_type, item_id, qty, ref_type, ref_id, result_payload, created_by)
  values (p_operation_id, v_org, 'reserve', p_item_id, p_qty, p_ref_type, p_ref_id, v_result, v_user);

  return v_result;
end;
$$;


ALTER FUNCTION "public"."reserve_inventory"("p_operation_id" "uuid", "p_item_id" "uuid", "p_qty" numeric, "p_ref_type" "text", "p_ref_id" "uuid", "p_expiry_hours" integer, "p_notes" "text") OWNER TO "postgres";

    LANGUAGE "plpgsql"
    SET "search_path" TO 'public'
    AS $$
begin
  new.updated_at = now();
  return new;
end;
$$;


ALTER FUNCTION "public"."set_updated_at"() OWNER TO "postgres";


CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "public"."sync_inventory_balance"() RETURNS "trigger"
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql" SECURITY DEFINER
    SET "search_path" TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare
  v_delta numeric(14,4);
  v_org   uuid;
begin
  v_delta := case new.movement_type
    when 'inbound'            then  new.qty
    when 'produced'           then  new.qty
    when 'adjustment_in'      then  new.qty
    when 'returned_client'    then  new.qty
    when 'consumed'           then -new.qty
    when 'sold'               then -new.qty
    when 'adjustment_out'     then -new.qty
    when 'returned_supplier'  then -new.qty
    else 0
  end;

  select org_id into v_org from public.items where id = new.item_id;

  insert into public.inventory_balance (item_id, org_id, current_qty, reserved_qty, updated_at)
  values (new.item_id, v_org, greatest(0, v_delta), 0, now())
  on conflict (item_id) do update
    set current_qty = greatest(0, public.inventory_balance.current_qty + v_delta),
        updated_at  = now();

  return new;
end;
$$;


ALTER FUNCTION "public"."sync_inventory_balance"() OWNER TO "postgres";


COMMENT ON FUNCTION "public"."sync_inventory_balance"() IS 'Keeps inventory_balance.current_qty in sync with stock_movements. Fires after every ledger insert. Never update/delete stock_movements.';



CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "public"."validate_stock_sufficiency"("p_item_id" "uuid", "p_qty_needed" numeric, "p_balance" "public"."inventory_balance" DEFAULT NULL::"public"."inventory_balance") RETURNS "void"
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql" SECURITY DEFINER
    SET "search_path" TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare
  v_balance  public.inventory_balance;
  v_name     text;
begin
  -- Use passed balance (already locked) or fetch fresh
  if p_balance is null then
    select * into v_balance from public.inventory_balance where item_id = p_item_id;
  else
    v_balance := p_balance;
  end if;

  select name into v_name from public.items where id = p_item_id;

  if v_balance is null or v_balance.available_qty < p_qty_needed then
    raise exception
      'Insufficient stock for item "%". Available: %, Requested: %',
      v_name,
      coalesce(v_balance.available_qty, 0),
      p_qty_needed
    using errcode = 'P0001';
  end if;
end;
$$;


ALTER FUNCTION "public"."validate_stock_sufficiency"("p_item_id" "uuid", "p_qty_needed" numeric, "p_balance" "public"."inventory_balance") OWNER TO "postgres";


CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "public"."write_audit_log"() RETURNS "trigger"
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql" SECURITY DEFINER
    SET "search_path" TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare
  v_id  uuid;
  v_uid uuid;
begin
  v_uid := auth.uid();
  if tg_op = 'DELETE' then
    v_id := old.id;
    insert into public.audit_logs(table_name, record_id, action, old_values, changed_by)
    values(tg_table_name, v_id, 'DELETE', to_jsonb(old), v_uid);
  elsif tg_op = 'UPDATE' then
    v_id := new.id;
    insert into public.audit_logs(table_name, record_id, action, old_values, new_values, changed_by)
    values(tg_table_name, v_id, 'UPDATE', to_jsonb(old), to_jsonb(new), v_uid);
  else
    v_id := new.id;
    insert into public.audit_logs(table_name, record_id, action, new_values, changed_by)
    values(tg_table_name, v_id, 'INSERT', to_jsonb(new), v_uid);
  end if;
  return coalesce(new, old);
end;
$$;


ALTER FUNCTION "public"."write_audit_log"() OWNER TO "postgres";

);

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW "public"."v_current_prices" WITH ("security_invoker"='true') AS
 SELECT DISTINCT ON ("p"."item_id") "p"."item_id",
    "i"."item_code",
    "i"."name",
    "p"."purchase_rate",
    "p"."selling_rate",
    ("p"."gst_percent")::"text" AS "gst_percent",
    ("p"."rate_unit")::"text" AS "rate_unit",
    "p"."effective_from",
    "p"."notes" AS "price_notes"
   FROM ("public"."item_prices" "p"
     JOIN "public"."items" "i" ON (("i"."id" = "p"."item_id")))
  WHERE (("p"."effective_to" IS NULL) OR ("p"."effective_to" >= CURRENT_DATE))
  ORDER BY "p"."item_id", "p"."effective_from" DESC;


ALTER VIEW "public"."v_current_prices" OWNER TO "postgres";


CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW "public"."v_stock_levels" WITH ("security_invoker"='true') AS
 SELECT "i"."id" AS "item_id",
    "i"."item_code",
    "i"."name",
    ("i"."category")::"text" AS "category",
    ("i"."unit")::"text" AS "unit",
    "i"."reorder_level",
    COALESCE("ib"."current_qty", (0)::numeric) AS "qty_on_hand",
    COALESCE("ib"."reserved_qty", (0)::numeric) AS "qty_reserved",
    COALESCE("ib"."available_qty", (0)::numeric) AS "qty_available",
        CASE
            WHEN (COALESCE("ib"."available_qty", (0)::numeric) <= "i"."reorder_level") THEN true
            ELSE false
        END AS "below_reorder",
    "ib"."updated_at" AS "balance_updated_at"
   FROM ("public"."items" "i"
     LEFT JOIN "public"."inventory_balance" "ib" ON (("ib"."item_id" = "i"."id")))
  WHERE ("i"."is_active" = true);


ALTER VIEW "public"."v_stock_levels" OWNER TO "postgres";


CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW "public"."v_reorder_alerts" WITH ("security_invoker"='true') AS
 SELECT "item_id",
    "item_code",
    "name",
    "category",
    "unit",
    "reorder_level",
    "qty_on_hand",
    "qty_reserved",
    "qty_available",
    "below_reorder",
    "balance_updated_at"
   FROM "public"."v_stock_levels"
  WHERE ("below_reorder" = true)
  ORDER BY "qty_on_hand";


ALTER VIEW "public"."v_reorder_alerts" OWNER TO "postgres";


CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW "public"."v_so_pipeline" WITH ("security_invoker"='true') AS
 SELECT "so"."id",
    "so"."so_number",
    "c"."name" AS "client_name",
    "c"."phone" AS "client_phone",
    "so"."order_date",
    "so"."delivery_date",
    ("so"."status")::"text" AS "status",
    "so"."total_amount",
    "so"."advance_paid",
    "so"."balance_due",
    "q"."quotation_no",
    "p"."full_name" AS "created_by_name"
   FROM ((("public"."sales_orders" "so"
     JOIN "public"."clients" "c" ON (("c"."id" = "so"."client_id")))
     LEFT JOIN "public"."quotations" "q" ON (("q"."id" = "so"."quotation_id")))
     LEFT JOIN "public"."profiles" "p" ON (("p"."id" = "so"."created_by")));


ALTER VIEW "public"."v_so_pipeline" OWNER TO "postgres";
```

# supabase/functions/expire-reservations/index.ts

```ts
// supabase/functions/expire-reservations/index.ts
//
// Hourly stock reservation expiry Edge Function
//
// DEPLOY:
//   supabase functions deploy expire-reservations
//
// SCHEDULE (in Supabase Dashboard → Edge Functions → expire-reservations → Schedule):
//   0 * * * *    ← runs at the top of every hour (UTC)
//
// Or via pg_cron in SQL Editor:
//   select cron.schedule(
//     'hourly-expire-reservations',
//     '0 * * * *',
//     $$ select net.http_post(
//       url := 'https://YOUR_PROJECT_REF.supabase.co/functions/v1/expire-reservations',
//       headers := '{"Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY"}'::jsonb
//     ) $$
//   );
//
// WHAT IT DOES:
//   Finds stock reservations where:
//     - status IN ('active', 'partially_consumed')
//     - reservation_expiry < now()
//   For each expired reservation:
//     - Sets status = 'expired'
//     - Sets qty_released = qty_reserved - qty_consumed
//     - Decrements reserved_qty on inventory_balance
//   This returns committed stock back to available_qty so it
//   can be allocated to other orders.
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

import { createClient } from 'https://esm.sh/@supabase/supabase-js@2'

const SUPABASE_URL          = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!
const SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!

Deno.serve(async (req: Request) => {

  // ── Auth check ────────────────────────────────────────────
  const authHeader = req.headers.get('Authorization')
  if (!authHeader || !authHeader.startsWith('Bearer ')) {
    return new Response(
      JSON.stringify({ error: 'Missing authorization header' }),
      { status: 401, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } }
    )
  }

  const startedAt = new Date().toISOString()
  console.log(`[expire-reservations] Starting at ${startedAt}`)

  // ── Supabase client with service_role ─────────────────────
  const supabase = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE, {
    auth: { persistSession: false }
  })

  try {
    // ── 1. Run expiry function ────────────────────────────
    // expire_stale_reservations() is a SECURITY DEFINER function that:
    //   a) Finds all active/partially_consumed reservations past expiry
    //   b) For each: sets qty_released, marks status = 'expired'
    //   c) Decrements reserved_qty on inventory_balance
    //   d) Returns count of expired reservations
    const { data: expiredCount, error: expireError } = await supabase
      .rpc('expire_stale_reservations')

    if (expireError) {
      console.error('[expire-reservations] RPC error:', expireError.message)
      return new Response(
        JSON.stringify({
          success:    false,
          error:      expireError.message,
          started_at: startedAt,
          ended_at:   new Date().toISOString(),
        }),
        { status: 500, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } }
      )
    }

    const count   = (expiredCount as number) ?? 0
    const endedAt = new Date().toISOString()

    // ── 2. Log result ─────────────────────────────────────
    if (count === 0) {
      console.log('[expire-reservations] ✓ No stale reservations found')
    } else {
      console.log(`[expire-reservations] Expired ${count} stale reservation(s) — stock returned to available`)
    }

    // ── 3. Check for reservations expiring soon ───────────
    // Warn about reservations expiring in the next 2 hours
    // so the business can take action before stock is released
    const soon = new Date()
    soon.setHours(soon.getHours() + 2)

    const { data: expiringSoon } = await supabase
      .from('stock_reservations')
      .select(`
        id, qty_reserved, qty_consumed, reservation_expiry, ref_type, ref_id,
        item:items ( item_code, name )
      `)
      .in('status', ['active', 'partially_consumed'])
      .lt('reservation_expiry', soon.toISOString())
      .gt('reservation_expiry', new Date().toISOString())
      .order('reservation_expiry', { ascending: true })

    if (expiringSoon && expiringSoon.length > 0) {
      console.warn(
        `[expire-reservations] ⚠ ${expiringSoon.length} reservation(s) expiring in < 2 hours:`
      )
      for (const r of expiringSoon) {
        const item = r.item as any
        console.warn(
          `  ${item?.item_code} — ${item?.name} | ` +
          `qty=${r.qty_reserved} | ` +
          `expires=${r.reservation_expiry} | ` +
          `ref=${r.ref_type}:${r.ref_id}`
        )
      }
    }

    // ── 4. Return result ──────────────────────────────────
    return new Response(
      JSON.stringify({
        success:          true,
        expired_count:    count,
        expiring_soon:    expiringSoon?.length ?? 0,
        message:          count === 0
          ? 'No stale reservations found'
          : `Expired ${count} stale reservation${count === 1 ? '' : 's'} — stock returned to available`,
        started_at:       startedAt,
        ended_at:         endedAt,
      }),
      {
        status:  200,
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }
      }
    )

  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error('[expire-reservations] Unexpected error:', err?.message ?? err)
    return new Response(
      JSON.stringify({
        success:    false,
        error:      err?.message ?? 'Unknown error',
        started_at: startedAt,
        ended_at:   new Date().toISOString(),
      }),
      { status: 500, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } }
    )
  }
})
```

# supabase/functions/reconcile/index.ts

```ts
// supabase/functions/reconcile/index.ts
//
// Nightly inventory balance reconciliation Edge Function
//
// DEPLOY:
//   supabase functions deploy reconcile
//
// SCHEDULE (in Supabase Dashboard → Edge Functions → reconcile → Schedule):
//   0 0 * * *    ← runs at midnight every day (UTC)
//
// Or via pg_cron in SQL Editor:
//   select cron.schedule(
//     'nightly-reconcile',
//     '0 0 * * *',
//     $$ select net.http_post(
//       url := 'https://YOUR_PROJECT_REF.supabase.co/functions/v1/reconcile',
//       headers := '{"Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY"}'::jsonb
//     ) $$
//   );
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

import { createClient } from 'https://esm.sh/@supabase/supabase-js@2'

const SUPABASE_URL            = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL')!
const SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE   = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')!

Deno.serve(async (req: Request) => {

  // ── Auth check ────────────────────────────────────────────
  // Only allow calls with the service_role key or from the scheduler
  const authHeader = req.headers.get('Authorization')
  if (!authHeader || !authHeader.startsWith('Bearer ')) {
    return new Response(
      JSON.stringify({ error: 'Missing authorization header' }),
      { status: 401, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } }
    )
  }

  const startedAt = new Date().toISOString()
  console.log(`[reconcile] Starting at ${startedAt}`)

  // ── Supabase client with service_role ─────────────────────
  // service_role bypasses RLS — needed because reconcile_inventory_balance()
  // requires admin-level access to read and update all inventory_balance rows
  const supabase = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE, {
    auth: { persistSession: false }
  })

  try {
    // ── 1. Run reconciliation ─────────────────────────────
    // reconcile_inventory_balance() is a SECURITY DEFINER function that:
    //   a) Recalculates true stock qty from raw stock_movements ledger
    //   b) Compares against cached inventory_balance rows
    //   c) Fixes any drift and returns the list of corrected items
    const { data: reconcileResult, error: reconcileError } = await supabase
      .rpc('reconcile_inventory_balance')

    if (reconcileError) {
      console.error('[reconcile] RPC error:', reconcileError.message)
      return new Response(
        JSON.stringify({
          success:    false,
          error:      reconcileError.message,
          started_at: startedAt,
          ended_at:   new Date().toISOString(),
        }),
        { status: 500, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } }
      )
    }

    const drifted = (reconcileResult as any[]) ?? []
    const endedAt = new Date().toISOString()

    // ── 2. Log result ─────────────────────────────────────
    if (drifted.length === 0) {
      console.log('[reconcile] ✓ All inventory balances correct — no drift detected')
    } else {
      console.warn(`[reconcile] ⚠ Fixed ${drifted.length} balance drift(s):`)
      for (const row of drifted) {
        console.warn(
          `  item_id=${row.item_id}  old=${row.old_qty}  new=${row.new_qty}  diff=${row.diff}`
        )
      }
    }

    // ── 3. Optionally write to an audit / ops log ─────────
    // This insert is best-effort — do not fail the function if it errors
    try {
      await supabase
        .from('audit_logs')
        .insert({
          table_name: 'inventory_balance',
          record_id:  '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000', // sentinel for system ops
          action:     'RECONCILE',
          new_values: {
            drifted_count: drifted.length,
            drifted_items: drifted,
            started_at:    startedAt,
            ended_at:      endedAt,
          },
          changed_by: null, // system action — no auth user
        })
    } catch (logErr) {
      console.warn('[reconcile] Could not write audit log entry:', logErr)
    }

    // ── 4. Return result ──────────────────────────────────
    return new Response(
      JSON.stringify({
        success:       true,
        drifted_count: drifted.length,
        drifted_items: drifted,
        message:       drifted.length === 0
          ? 'All inventory balances are correct'
          : `Fixed ${drifted.length} balance discrepanc${drifted.length === 1 ? 'y' : 'ies'}`,
        started_at:    startedAt,
        ended_at:      endedAt,
      }),
      {
        status:  200,
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }
      }
    )

  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error('[reconcile] Unexpected error:', err?.message ?? err)
    return new Response(
      JSON.stringify({
        success:    false,
        error:      err?.message ?? 'Unknown error',
        started_at: startedAt,
        ended_at:   new Date().toISOString(),
      }),
      { status: 500, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } }
    )
  }
})
```

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "public"."adjust_inventory"("p_operation_id" "uuid", "p_item_id" "uuid", "p_delta" numeric, "p_reason" "text", "p_ref_id" "uuid" DEFAULT NULL::"uuid") RETURNS "jsonb"
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql" SECURITY DEFINER
    SET "search_path" TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare
  v_cached      jsonb;
  v_balance     public.inventory_balance;
  v_movement_id uuid;
  v_move_type   movement_type;
  v_qty         numeric;
  v_result      jsonb;
  v_user        uuid := auth.uid();
begin
  select result_payload into v_cached
  from public.inventory_ops_log
  where operation_id = p_operation_id;
  if found then return v_cached; end if;

  if p_delta = 0 then
    raise exception 'Adjustment delta cannot be zero' using errcode = 'P0002';
  end if;

  -- Role check: only admin or store may adjust
  if (select role from public.profiles where id = v_user) not in ('admin','store','manager') then
    raise exception 'Unauthorized: only admin/store/manager can adjust inventory'
    using errcode = 'P0005';
  end if;

  -- Lock balance
  v_balance := public.lock_inventory_balance(p_item_id);

  if p_delta > 0 then
    v_move_type := 'adjustment_in';
    v_qty       := p_delta;
  else
    v_move_type := 'adjustment_out';
    v_qty       := abs(p_delta);
    -- Validate sufficient stock for removal
    perform public.validate_stock_sufficiency(p_item_id, v_qty, v_balance);
  end if;

  insert into public.stock_movements(
    item_id, movement_type, qty, ref_type, ref_id, notes, created_by
  )
  values (p_item_id, v_move_type, v_qty, 'manual_adjustment', p_ref_id, p_reason, v_user)
  returning id into v_movement_id;

  v_result := jsonb_build_object(
    'success', true,
    'operation_id', p_operation_id,
    'movement_id', v_movement_id,
    'item_id', p_item_id,
    'delta', p_delta,
    'movement_type', v_move_type
  );

  insert into public.inventory_ops_log(
    operation_id, operation_type, item_id, qty,
    ref_type, result_movement_id, result_payload, created_by
  ) values (
    p_operation_id, 'adjust', p_item_id, p_delta,
    'manual_adjustment', v_movement_id, v_result, v_user
  );

  return v_result;
end;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "public"."check_bom_availability"("p_production_order_id" "uuid") RETURNS "jsonb"
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql" SECURITY DEFINER
    SET "search_path" TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare
  v_result   jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
  v_shortages jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
  v_has_shortage boolean := false;
begin
  -- For each item in the production order, cross-reference BOM qty needed
  -- against inventory_balance.available_qty
  select
    jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'item_id',       poi.item_id,
        'item_code',     i.item_code,
        'item_name',     i.name,
        'unit',          i.unit,
        'qty_required',  poi.qty_required,
        'qty_available', coalesce(ib.available_qty, 0),
        'shortage',      greatest(0, poi.qty_required - coalesce(ib.available_qty, 0)),
        'sufficient',    coalesce(ib.available_qty, 0) >= poi.qty_required
      )
    )
  into v_result
  from public.production_order_items poi
  join public.items i on i.id = poi.item_id
  left join public.inventory_balance ib on ib.item_id = poi.item_id
  where poi.production_order_id = p_production_order_id;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'production_order_id', p_production_order_id,
    'checked_at',          now(),
    'can_produce',         not exists(
      select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(v_result,'[]'::jsonb)) r
      where (r->>'sufficient')::boolean = false
    ),
    'materials', coalesce(v_result, '[]'::jsonb)
  );
end;
$$;
```
