CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "public"."consume_inventory"("p_operation_id" "uuid", "p_item_id" "uuid", "p_qty" numeric, "p_reservation_id" "uuid" DEFAULT NULL::"uuid", "p_ref_type" "text" DEFAULT 'production_order'::"text", "p_ref_id" "uuid" DEFAULT NULL::"uuid", "p_notes" "text" DEFAULT NULL::"text") RETURNS "jsonb"
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql" SECURITY DEFINER
    SET "search_path" TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare
  v_cached       jsonb;
  v_balance      public.inventory_balance;
  v_res          public.stock_reservations;
  v_movement_id  uuid;
  v_result       jsonb;
  v_user         uuid := auth.uid();
begin
  -- 1. Idempotency
  select result_payload into v_cached
  from public.inventory_ops_log
  where operation_id = p_operation_id;
  if found then return v_cached; end if;

  if p_qty <= 0 then
    raise exception 'qty must be positive for consume_inventory' using errcode = 'P0002';
  end if;

  -- 2. Lock balance
  v_balance := public.lock_inventory_balance(p_item_id);

  -- 3. If reservation provided, lock and validate it
  if p_reservation_id is not null then
    select * into v_res
    from public.stock_reservations
    where id = p_reservation_id
      and item_id = p_item_id
      and status in ('active','partially_consumed')
    for update nowait;

    if not found then
      raise exception 'Reservation % not found or already consumed', p_reservation_id
      using errcode = 'P0003';
    end if;

    declare
      v_remaining numeric;
    begin
      v_remaining := v_res.qty_reserved - v_res.qty_consumed - v_res.qty_released;
      if p_qty > v_remaining then
        raise exception 'Consume qty (%) exceeds remaining reservation (%)',
          p_qty, v_remaining using errcode = 'P0004';
      end if;
    end;

    -- Update reservation
    update public.stock_reservations
    set qty_consumed = qty_consumed + p_qty,
        status = case
          when (qty_consumed + qty_released + p_qty) = qty_reserved
            then 'consumed'::reservation_status
          else 'partially_consumed'::reservation_status
        end,
        updated_at = now()
    where id = p_reservation_id;

    -- Release reserved_qty (moving from reserved → consumed via ledger)
    update public.inventory_balance
    set reserved_qty = greatest(0, reserved_qty - p_qty),
        updated_at   = now()
    where item_id = p_item_id;

  else
    -- No reservation: consume directly from available stock
    perform public.validate_stock_sufficiency(p_item_id, p_qty, v_balance);
  end if;

  -- 4. Insert ledger row (trigger decrements current_qty automatically)
  insert into public.stock_movements(
    item_id, movement_type, qty, ref_type, ref_id, notes, created_by
  )
  values (p_item_id, 'consumed', p_qty, p_ref_type, p_ref_id, p_notes, v_user)
  returning id into v_movement_id;

  v_result := jsonb_build_object(
    'success', true,
    'operation_id', p_operation_id,
    'movement_id', v_movement_id,
    'item_id', p_item_id,
    'qty_consumed', p_qty,
    'reservation_id', p_reservation_id
  );

  insert into public.inventory_ops_log(
    operation_id, operation_type, item_id, qty,
    ref_type, ref_id, result_movement_id, result_payload, created_by
  ) values (
    p_operation_id, 'consume', p_item_id, p_qty,
    p_ref_type, p_ref_id, v_movement_id, v_result, v_user
  );

  return v_result;
end;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "public"."dispatch_inventory"("p_operation_id" "uuid", "p_item_id" "uuid", "p_qty" numeric, "p_rate" numeric, "p_reservation_id" "uuid" DEFAULT NULL::"uuid", "p_ref_type" "text" DEFAULT 'delivery_challan'::"text", "p_ref_id" "uuid" DEFAULT NULL::"uuid", "p_notes" "text" DEFAULT NULL::"text") RETURNS "jsonb"
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql" SECURITY DEFINER
    SET "search_path" TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare
  v_cached       jsonb;
  v_balance      public.inventory_balance;
  v_res          public.stock_reservations;
  v_movement_id  uuid;
  v_result       jsonb;
  v_user         uuid := auth.uid();
begin
  select result_payload into v_cached
  from public.inventory_ops_log
  where operation_id = p_operation_id;
  if found then return v_cached; end if;

  if p_qty <= 0 then
    raise exception 'qty must be positive for dispatch_inventory' using errcode = 'P0002';
  end if;

  -- Lock balance
  v_balance := public.lock_inventory_balance(p_item_id);

  if p_reservation_id is not null then
    -- Dispatch against reservation
    select * into v_res
    from public.stock_reservations
    where id = p_reservation_id
      and item_id = p_item_id
      and status in ('active','partially_consumed')
    for update nowait;

    if not found then
      raise exception 'Reservation % not active for dispatch', p_reservation_id
      using errcode = 'P0003';
    end if;

    declare v_remaining numeric;
    begin
      v_remaining := v_res.qty_reserved - v_res.qty_consumed - v_res.qty_released;
      if p_qty > v_remaining then
        raise exception 'Dispatch qty (%) exceeds reservation remaining (%)',
          p_qty, v_remaining using errcode = 'P0004';
      end if;
    end;

    update public.stock_reservations
    set qty_consumed = qty_consumed + p_qty,
        status = case
          when (qty_consumed + qty_released + p_qty) = qty_reserved
            then 'consumed'::reservation_status
          else 'partially_consumed'::reservation_status
        end,
        updated_at = now()
    where id = p_reservation_id;

    update public.inventory_balance
    set reserved_qty = greatest(0, reserved_qty - p_qty),
        updated_at   = now()
    where item_id = p_item_id;

  else
    -- No reservation: validate open stock
    perform public.validate_stock_sufficiency(p_item_id, p_qty, v_balance);
  end if;

  -- Ledger entry (trigger decrements current_qty)
  insert into public.stock_movements(
    item_id, movement_type, qty, rate_at_time,
    ref_type, ref_id, notes, created_by
  )
  values (p_item_id, 'sold', p_qty, p_rate, p_ref_type, p_ref_id, p_notes, v_user)
  returning id into v_movement_id;

  v_result := jsonb_build_object(
    'success', true,
    'operation_id', p_operation_id,
    'movement_id', v_movement_id,
    'item_id', p_item_id,
    'qty_dispatched', p_qty,
    'reservation_id', p_reservation_id
  );

  insert into public.inventory_ops_log(
    operation_id, operation_type, item_id, qty,
    ref_type, ref_id, result_movement_id, result_payload, created_by
  ) values (
    p_operation_id, 'dispatch', p_item_id, p_qty,
    p_ref_type, p_ref_id, v_movement_id, v_result, v_user
  );

  return v_result;
end;
$$;


ALTER FUNCTION "public"."dispatch_inventory"("p_operation_id" "uuid", "p_item_id" "uuid", "p_qty" numeric, "p_rate" numeric, "p_reservation_id" "uuid", "p_ref_type" "text", "p_ref_id" "uuid", "p_notes" "text") OWNER TO "postgres";


CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "public"."expire_stale_reservations"() RETURNS integer
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql" SECURITY DEFINER
    SET "search_path" TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare
  v_count int := 0;
  v_res   record;
begin
  for v_res in
    select id, item_id,
           qty_reserved - qty_consumed - qty_released as qty_to_release
    from public.stock_reservations
    where status in ('active','partially_consumed')
      and reservation_expiry < now()
  loop
    update public.stock_reservations
    set qty_released = qty_reserved - qty_consumed,
        status       = 'expired',
        updated_at   = now()
    where id = v_res.id;

    update public.inventory_balance
    set reserved_qty = greatest(0, reserved_qty - v_res.qty_to_release),
        updated_at   = now()
    where item_id = v_res.item_id;

    v_count := v_count + 1;
  end loop;

  return v_count;
end;
$$;

SET default_tablespace = '';

SET default_table_access_method = "heap";


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "public"."inventory_balance" (
    "item_id" "uuid" NOT NULL,
    "current_qty" numeric(14,4) DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
    "reserved_qty" numeric(14,4) DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
    "available_qty" numeric(14,4) GENERATED ALWAYS AS (("current_qty" - "reserved_qty")) STORED,
    "updated_at" timestamp with time zone DEFAULT "now"() NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT "available_cannot_exceed_current" CHECK (("current_qty" >= "reserved_qty")),
    CONSTRAINT "current_qty_non_negative" CHECK (("current_qty" >= (0)::numeric)),
    CONSTRAINT "reserved_non_negative" CHECK (("reserved_qty" >= (0)::numeric))
);


ALTER TABLE "public"."inventory_balance" OWNER TO "postgres";


COMMENT ON TABLE "public"."inventory_balance" IS 'Fast-read, row-lockable inventory state cache. current_qty synced from stock_movements via trigger. reserved_qty managed by reservation functions. DO NOT write to this table directly — use RPC functions only.';



COMMENT ON COLUMN "public"."inventory_balance"."current_qty" IS 'Physical quantity on hand. Mirrors ledger sum.';



COMMENT ON COLUMN "public"."inventory_balance"."reserved_qty" IS 'Quantity reserved for pending sales orders / production. Does NOT reduce current_qty — only reduces available_qty.';



COMMENT ON COLUMN "public"."inventory_balance"."available_qty" IS 'current_qty - reserved_qty. What can be freely allocated.';



CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "public"."lock_inventory_balance"("p_item_id" "uuid") RETURNS "public"."inventory_balance"
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql" SECURITY DEFINER
    SET "search_path" TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare
  v_balance public.inventory_balance;
begin
  -- Row-level lock: blocks other transactions from modifying this
  -- specific item's balance until our transaction commits/rollbacks.
  -- NOWAIT: fail fast rather than queue up, preventing deadlocks.
  select * into v_balance
  from public.inventory_balance
  where item_id = p_item_id
  for update nowait;

  if not found then
    -- Auto-create balance row if item exists but has no balance entry
    insert into public.inventory_balance (item_id, current_qty, reserved_qty)
    values (p_item_id, 0, 0)
    on conflict (item_id) do nothing
    returning * into v_balance;

    -- Try lock again after creation
    select * into v_balance
    from public.inventory_balance
    where item_id = p_item_id
    for update nowait;
  end if;

  return v_balance;
end;
$$;

COMMENT ON FUNCTION "public"."lock_inventory_balance"("p_item_id" "uuid") IS 'Acquires row-level lock on inventory_balance for a single item. Uses NOWAIT to fail fast and prevent deadlock queuing. Call inside a transaction before any inventory mutation.';

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "public"."produce_inventory"("p_operation_id" "uuid", "p_item_id" "uuid", "p_qty" numeric, "p_ref_type" "text" DEFAULT 'production_order'::"text", "p_ref_id" "uuid" DEFAULT NULL::"uuid", "p_notes" "text" DEFAULT NULL::"text") RETURNS "jsonb"
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql" SECURITY DEFINER
    SET "search_path" TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare
  v_cached      jsonb;
  v_movement_id uuid;
  v_result      jsonb;
  v_user        uuid := auth.uid();
begin
  select result_payload into v_cached
  from public.inventory_ops_log
  where operation_id = p_operation_id;
  if found then return v_cached; end if;

  if p_qty <= 0 then
    raise exception 'qty must be positive for produce_inventory' using errcode = 'P0002';
  end if;

  -- Lock balance (good practice even for additions — prevents race on balance row)
  perform public.lock_inventory_balance(p_item_id);

  insert into public.stock_movements(
    item_id, movement_type, qty, ref_type, ref_id, notes, created_by
  )
  values (p_item_id, 'produced', p_qty, p_ref_type, p_ref_id, p_notes, v_user)
  returning id into v_movement_id;

  v_result := jsonb_build_object(
    'success', true,
    'operation_id', p_operation_id,
    'movement_id', v_movement_id,
    'item_id', p_item_id,
    'qty_produced', p_qty
  );

  insert into public.inventory_ops_log(
    operation_id, operation_type, item_id, qty,
    ref_type, ref_id, result_movement_id, result_payload, created_by
  ) values (
    p_operation_id, 'produce', p_item_id, p_qty,
    p_ref_type, p_ref_id, v_movement_id, v_result, v_user
  );

  return v_result;
end;
$$;


ALTER FUNCTION "public"."produce_inventory"("p_operation_id" "uuid", "p_item_id" "uuid", "p_qty" numeric, "p_ref_type" "text", "p_ref_id" "uuid", "p_notes" "text") OWNER TO "postgres";


CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "public"."receive_inventory"("p_operation_id" "uuid", "p_item_id" "uuid", "p_qty" numeric, "p_rate" numeric, "p_ref_type" "text", "p_ref_id" "uuid", "p_batch_no" "text" DEFAULT NULL::"text", "p_notes" "text" DEFAULT NULL::"text") RETURNS "jsonb"
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql" SECURITY DEFINER
    SET "search_path" TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare
  v_cached      jsonb;
  v_movement_id uuid;
  v_result      jsonb;
  v_user        uuid := auth.uid();
begin
  -- 1. Idempotency check
  select result_payload into v_cached
  from public.inventory_ops_log
  where operation_id = p_operation_id;
  if found then return v_cached; end if;

  -- 2. Validate inputs
  if p_qty <= 0 then
    raise exception 'qty must be positive for receive_inventory' using errcode = 'P0002';
  end if;

  -- 3. Lock balance row (no stock validation needed for inbound)
  perform public.lock_inventory_balance(p_item_id);

  -- 4. Insert ledger row
  insert into public.stock_movements(
    item_id, movement_type, qty, rate_at_time,
    ref_type, ref_id, batch_no, notes, created_by
  )
  values (
    p_item_id, 'inbound', p_qty, p_rate,
    p_ref_type, p_ref_id, p_batch_no, p_notes, v_user
  )
  returning id into v_movement_id;
  -- Trigger trg_sync_balance fires here automatically

  -- 5. Build result
  v_result := jsonb_build_object(
    'success', true,
    'operation_id', p_operation_id,
    'movement_id', v_movement_id,
    'item_id', p_item_id,
    'qty_received', p_qty
  );

  -- 6. Log idempotency
  insert into public.inventory_ops_log(
    operation_id, operation_type, item_id, qty,
    ref_type, ref_id, result_movement_id, result_payload, created_by
  ) values (
    p_operation_id, 'receive', p_item_id, p_qty,
    p_ref_type, p_ref_id, v_movement_id, v_result, v_user
  );

  return v_result;
end;
$$;


ALTER FUNCTION "public"."receive_inventory"("p_operation_id" "uuid", "p_item_id" "uuid", "p_qty" numeric, "p_rate" numeric, "p_ref_type" "text", "p_ref_id" "uuid", "p_batch_no" "text", "p_notes" "text") OWNER TO "postgres";


CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "public"."reconcile_inventory_balance"() RETURNS TABLE("item_id" "uuid", "old_qty" numeric, "new_qty" numeric, "diff" numeric)
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql" SECURITY DEFINER
    SET "search_path" TO 'public'
    AS $$
begin
  -- Role check: admin only
  if (select role from public.profiles where id = auth.uid()) != 'admin' then
    raise exception 'Only admin can run reconciliation' using errcode = 'P0005';
  end if;

  return query
  with ledger_totals as (
    select
      m.item_id,
      sum(case
        when m.movement_type in ('inbound','produced','adjustment_in','returned_client')
          then m.qty
        else -m.qty
      end) as true_qty
    from public.stock_movements m
    group by m.item_id
  ),
  updates as (
    update public.inventory_balance ib
    set current_qty = greatest(0, coalesce(lt.true_qty, 0)),
        updated_at  = now()
    from ledger_totals lt
    where ib.item_id = lt.item_id
    returning ib.item_id,
              ib.current_qty as old_qty,
              greatest(0, coalesce(lt.true_qty, 0)) as new_qty
  )
  select
    u.item_id,
    u.old_qty,
    u.new_qty,
    u.new_qty - u.old_qty as diff
  from updates u
  where abs(u.new_qty - u.old_qty) > 0.0001;
end;
$$;


ALTER FUNCTION "public"."reconcile_inventory_balance"() OWNER TO "postgres";


CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "public"."release_inventory"("p_operation_id" "uuid", "p_reservation_id" "uuid", "p_qty_to_release" numeric DEFAULT NULL::numeric, "p_notes" "text" DEFAULT NULL::"text") RETURNS "jsonb"
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql" SECURITY DEFINER
    SET "search_path" TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare
  v_cached      jsonb;
  v_res         public.stock_reservations;
  v_qty_release numeric;
  v_remaining   numeric;
  v_result      jsonb;
  v_user        uuid := auth.uid();
begin
  -- 1. Idempotency
  select result_payload into v_cached
  from public.inventory_ops_log
  where operation_id = p_operation_id;
  if found then return v_cached; end if;

  -- 2. Fetch + lock reservation row
  select * into v_res
  from public.stock_reservations
  where id = p_reservation_id
    and status in ('active','partially_consumed')
  for update nowait;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'Reservation % not found or not in releasable status', p_reservation_id
    using errcode = 'P0003';
  end if;

  -- 3. Lock balance
  perform public.lock_inventory_balance(v_res.item_id);

  -- 4. Calculate release qty
  v_remaining   := v_res.qty_reserved - v_res.qty_consumed - v_res.qty_released;
  v_qty_release := coalesce(p_qty_to_release, v_remaining);

  if v_qty_release > v_remaining then
    raise exception 'Release qty (%) exceeds remaining reservation (%)',
      v_qty_release, v_remaining
    using errcode = 'P0004';
  end if;

  -- 5. Update reservation
  update public.stock_reservations
  set qty_released = qty_released + v_qty_release,
      status = case
        when (qty_consumed + qty_released + v_qty_release) = qty_reserved
          then 'released'::reservation_status
        else 'partially_consumed'::reservation_status
      end,
      updated_at = now()
  where id = p_reservation_id;

  -- 6. Return qty to available (reduce reserved_qty on balance)
  update public.inventory_balance
  set reserved_qty = greatest(0, reserved_qty - v_qty_release),
      updated_at   = now()
  where item_id = v_res.item_id;

  v_result := jsonb_build_object(
    'success', true,
    'operation_id', p_operation_id,
    'reservation_id', p_reservation_id,
    'qty_released', v_qty_release,
    'item_id', v_res.item_id
  );

  insert into public.inventory_ops_log(
    operation_id, operation_type, item_id, qty,
    ref_type, ref_id, result_payload, created_by
  ) values (
    p_operation_id, 'release', v_res.item_id, v_qty_release,
    v_res.ref_type, v_res.ref_id, v_result, v_user
  );

  return v_result;
end;
$$;


ALTER FUNCTION "public"."release_inventory"("p_operation_id" "uuid", "p_reservation_id" "uuid", "p_qty_to_release" numeric, "p_notes" "text") OWNER TO "postgres";


CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "public"."reserve_inventory"("p_operation_id" "uuid", "p_item_id" "uuid", "p_qty" numeric, "p_ref_type" "text", "p_ref_id" "uuid", "p_expiry_hours" integer DEFAULT 72, "p_notes" "text" DEFAULT NULL::"text") RETURNS "jsonb"
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql" SECURITY DEFINER
    SET "search_path" TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare
  v_cached       jsonb;
  v_balance      public.inventory_balance;
  v_reservation_id uuid;
  v_result       jsonb;
  v_user         uuid := auth.uid();
begin
  -- 1. Idempotency
  select result_payload into v_cached
  from public.inventory_ops_log
  where operation_id = p_operation_id;
  if found then return v_cached; end if;

  if p_qty <= 0 then
    raise exception 'qty must be positive for reserve_inventory' using errcode = 'P0002';
  end if;

  -- 2. Lock balance row — prevents concurrent over-reservation
  v_balance := public.lock_inventory_balance(p_item_id);

  -- 3. Validate available stock (available = current - reserved)
  perform public.validate_stock_sufficiency(p_item_id, p_qty, v_balance);

  -- 4. Create reservation
  insert into public.stock_reservations(
    item_id, qty_reserved, ref_type, ref_id,
    reservation_expiry, notes, created_by
  )
  values (
    p_item_id, p_qty, p_ref_type, p_ref_id,
    now() + (p_expiry_hours || ' hours')::interval,
    p_notes, v_user
  )
  returning id into v_reservation_id;

  -- 5. Update reserved_qty on balance (the only manual balance write)
  update public.inventory_balance
  set reserved_qty = reserved_qty + p_qty,
      updated_at   = now()
  where item_id = p_item_id;

  v_result := jsonb_build_object(
    'success', true,
    'operation_id', p_operation_id,
    'reservation_id', v_reservation_id,
    'item_id', p_item_id,
    'qty_reserved', p_qty,
    'expires_at', now() + (p_expiry_hours || ' hours')::interval
  );

  -- 6. Log
  insert into public.inventory_ops_log(
    operation_id, operation_type, item_id, qty,
    ref_type, ref_id, result_payload, created_by
  ) values (
    p_operation_id, 'reserve', p_item_id, p_qty,
    p_ref_type, p_ref_id, v_result, v_user
  );

  return v_result;
end;
$$;


ALTER FUNCTION "public"."reserve_inventory"("p_operation_id" "uuid", "p_item_id" "uuid", "p_qty" numeric, "p_ref_type" "text", "p_ref_id" "uuid", "p_expiry_hours" integer, "p_notes" "text") OWNER TO "postgres";

  new.updated_at = now();

ALTER FUNCTION "public"."set_updated_at"() OWNER TO "postgres";


CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "public"."sync_inventory_balance"() RETURNS "trigger"
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql" SECURITY DEFINER
    SET "search_path" TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare
  v_delta numeric(14,4);
begin
  -- Determine direction from movement type
  -- Positive movements: inbound, produced, adjustment_in, returned_client
  -- Negative movements: consumed, sold, adjustment_out, returned_supplier
  v_delta := case new.movement_type
    when 'inbound'            then  new.qty
    when 'produced'           then  new.qty
    when 'adjustment_in'      then  new.qty
    when 'returned_client'    then  new.qty
    when 'consumed'           then -new.qty
    when 'sold'               then -new.qty
    when 'adjustment_out'     then -new.qty
    when 'returned_supplier'  then -new.qty
    else 0
  end;

  -- Upsert balance row (creates if missing for new items)
  insert into public.inventory_balance (item_id, current_qty, reserved_qty, updated_at)
  values (new.item_id, greatest(0, v_delta), 0, now())
  on conflict (item_id) do update
    set current_qty = greatest(0, inventory_balance.current_qty + v_delta),
        updated_at  = now();

  return new;
end;
$$;


ALTER FUNCTION "public"."sync_inventory_balance"() OWNER TO "postgres";


COMMENT ON FUNCTION "public"."sync_inventory_balance"() IS 'Keeps inventory_balance.current_qty in sync with stock_movements. Fires after every ledger insert. Never update/delete stock_movements.';



CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "public"."validate_stock_sufficiency"("p_item_id" "uuid", "p_qty_needed" numeric, "p_balance" "public"."inventory_balance" DEFAULT NULL::"public"."inventory_balance") RETURNS "void"
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql" SECURITY DEFINER
    SET "search_path" TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare
  v_balance  public.inventory_balance;
  v_name     text;
begin
  -- Use passed balance (already locked) or fetch fresh
  if p_balance is null then
    select * into v_balance from public.inventory_balance where item_id = p_item_id;
  else
    v_balance := p_balance;
  end if;

  select name into v_name from public.items where id = p_item_id;

  if v_balance is null or v_balance.available_qty < p_qty_needed then
    raise exception
      'Insufficient stock for item "%". Available: %, Requested: %',
      v_name,
      coalesce(v_balance.available_qty, 0),
      p_qty_needed
    using errcode = 'P0001';
  end if;
end;
$$;


ALTER FUNCTION "public"."validate_stock_sufficiency"("p_item_id" "uuid", "p_qty_needed" numeric, "p_balance" "public"."inventory_balance") OWNER TO "postgres";


CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "public"."write_audit_log"() RETURNS "trigger"
    LANGUAGE "plpgsql" SECURITY DEFINER
    SET "search_path" TO 'public'
    AS $$
declare
  v_id  uuid;
  v_uid uuid;
begin
  v_uid := auth.uid();
  if tg_op = 'DELETE' then
    v_id := old.id;
    insert into public.audit_logs(table_name, record_id, action, old_values, changed_by)
    values(tg_table_name, v_id, 'DELETE', to_jsonb(old), v_uid);
  elsif tg_op = 'UPDATE' then
    v_id := new.id;
    insert into public.audit_logs(table_name, record_id, action, old_values, new_values, changed_by)
    values(tg_table_name, v_id, 'UPDATE', to_jsonb(old), to_jsonb(new), v_uid);
  else
    v_id := new.id;
    insert into public.audit_logs(table_name, record_id, action, new_values, changed_by)
    values(tg_table_name, v_id, 'INSERT', to_jsonb(new), v_uid);
  end if;
  return coalesce(new, old);
end;
$$;


ALTER FUNCTION "public"."write_audit_log"() OWNER TO "postgres";

    CONSTRAINT "consumed_status_valid" CHECK ((("status" <> 'consumed'::"public"."reservation_status") OR (("qty_consumed" + "qty_released") = "qty_reserved"))),
    CONSTRAINT "reservation_totals_valid" CHECK ((("qty_consumed" + "qty_released") <= "qty_reserved")),
    CONSTRAINT "stock_reservations_qty_consumed_check" CHECK (("qty_consumed" >= (0)::numeric)),
    CONSTRAINT "stock_reservations_qty_released_check" CHECK (("qty_released" >= (0)::numeric)),

);

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW "public"."v_current_prices" WITH ("security_invoker"='true') AS
 SELECT DISTINCT ON ("p"."item_id") "p"."item_id",
    "i"."item_code",
    "i"."name",
    "p"."purchase_rate",
    "p"."selling_rate",
    ("p"."gst_percent")::"text" AS "gst_percent",
    ("p"."rate_unit")::"text" AS "rate_unit",
    "p"."effective_from",
    "p"."notes" AS "price_notes"
   FROM ("public"."item_prices" "p"
     JOIN "public"."items" "i" ON (("i"."id" = "p"."item_id")))
  WHERE (("p"."effective_to" IS NULL) OR ("p"."effective_to" >= CURRENT_DATE))
  ORDER BY "p"."item_id", "p"."effective_from" DESC;


ALTER VIEW "public"."v_current_prices" OWNER TO "postgres";


CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW "public"."v_stock_levels" WITH ("security_invoker"='true') AS
 SELECT "i"."id" AS "item_id",
    "i"."item_code",
    "i"."name",
    ("i"."category")::"text" AS "category",
    ("i"."unit")::"text" AS "unit",
    "i"."reorder_level",
    COALESCE("ib"."current_qty", (0)::numeric) AS "qty_on_hand",
    COALESCE("ib"."reserved_qty", (0)::numeric) AS "qty_reserved",
    COALESCE("ib"."available_qty", (0)::numeric) AS "qty_available",
        CASE
            WHEN (COALESCE("ib"."available_qty", (0)::numeric) <= "i"."reorder_level") THEN true
            ELSE false
        END AS "below_reorder",
    "ib"."updated_at" AS "balance_updated_at"
   FROM ("public"."items" "i"
     LEFT JOIN "public"."inventory_balance" "ib" ON (("ib"."item_id" = "i"."id")))
  WHERE ("i"."is_active" = true);


ALTER VIEW "public"."v_stock_levels" OWNER TO "postgres";


CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW "public"."v_reorder_alerts" WITH ("security_invoker"='true') AS
 SELECT "item_id",
    "item_code",
    "name",
    "category",
    "unit",
    "reorder_level",
    "qty_on_hand",
    "qty_reserved",
    "qty_available",
    "below_reorder",
    "balance_updated_at"
   FROM "public"."v_stock_levels"
  WHERE ("below_reorder" = true)
  ORDER BY "qty_on_hand";


ALTER VIEW "public"."v_reorder_alerts" OWNER TO "postgres";


CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW "public"."v_so_pipeline" WITH ("security_invoker"='true') AS
 SELECT "so"."id",
    "so"."so_number",
    "c"."name" AS "client_name",
    "c"."phone" AS "client_phone",
    "so"."order_date",
    "so"."delivery_date",
    ("so"."status")::"text" AS "status",
    "so"."total_amount",
    "so"."advance_paid",
    "so"."balance_due",
    "q"."quotation_no",
    "p"."full_name" AS "created_by_name"
   FROM ((("public"."sales_orders" "so"
     JOIN "public"."clients" "c" ON (("c"."id" = "so"."client_id")))
     LEFT JOIN "public"."quotations" "q" ON (("q"."id" = "so"."quotation_id")))
     LEFT JOIN "public"."profiles" "p" ON (("p"."id" = "so"."created_by")));


ALTER VIEW "public"."v_so_pipeline" OWNER TO "postgres";

# supabase/migrations/20260907150000_multi_tenancy.sql

```sql
-- =========================================================================
-- Blue Box ERP — Multi-Tenancy Migration
-- Safe on both an empty database and one with existing data (backfills
-- pre-existing rows into a default organization before enforcing NOT NULL).
-- =========================================================================

begin;

-- -------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 1. Organizations (tenants)
-- -------------------------------------------------------------------------

create table if not exists "public"."organizations" (
    "id" uuid default extensions.uuid_generate_v4() not null primary key,
    "name" text not null,
    "slug" text unique,
    "is_active" boolean default true not null,
    "created_at" timestamp with time zone default now() not null,
    "updated_at" timestamp with time zone default now() not null
);
alter table "public"."organizations" owner to "postgres";

create trigger "trg_upd_organizations"
    before update on "public"."organizations"
    for each row execute function "public"."set_updated_at"();

alter table "public"."organizations" enable row level security;

-- -------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 2. org_id on profiles + my_org() helper + onboarding RPC
-- -------------------------------------------------------------------------

alter table "public"."profiles"
    add column "org_id" uuid references "public"."organizations"("id");

create index "idx_profiles_org" on "public"."profiles" ("org_id");

create or replace function "public"."my_org"() returns uuid
    language sql stable security definer set search_path to public as
$$ select org_id from public.profiles where id = auth.uid() $$;

alter function "public"."my_org"() owner to "postgres";
grant execute on function "public"."my_org"() to authenticated, service_role;

create or replace function "public"."handle_new_user"() returns trigger
    language plpgsql security definer set search_path to public as
$$
begin
  insert into public.profiles (id, full_name, role, org_id)
  values (
    new.id,
    coalesce(new.raw_user_meta_data->>'full_name', ''),
    'viewer',
    nullif(new.raw_user_meta_data->>'org_id','')::uuid
  );
  return new;
end;
$$;

create or replace function "public"."create_organization"("p_name" text) returns uuid
    language plpgsql security definer set search_path to public as
$$
declare
  v_org_id  uuid;
  v_existing uuid;
begin
  select org_id into v_existing from public.profiles where id = auth.uid();
  if v_existing is not null then
    raise exception 'User already belongs to an organization' using errcode = 'P0006';
  end if;

  insert into public.organizations (name) values (p_name) returning id into v_org_id;

  update public.profiles
  set org_id = v_org_id, role = 'admin'
  where id = auth.uid();

  return v_org_id;
end;
$$;
alter function "public"."create_organization"(text) owner to "postgres";
grant execute on function "public"."create_organization"(text) to authenticated;

create policy "member reads own org" on "public"."organizations"
    for select using (id = public.my_org());

create policy "admin updates own org" on "public"."organizations"
    for update using (id = public.my_org() and public.my_role() = 'admin');

-- -------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 3. Per-organization document counters (replaces the global seq_* sequences)
-- -------------------------------------------------------------------------

create table if not exists "public"."org_sequences" (
    "org_id" uuid not null references "public"."organizations"("id") on delete cascade,
    "seq_name" text not null,
    "current_value" bigint default 0 not null,
    primary key ("org_id", "seq_name")
);
alter table "public"."org_sequences" owner to "postgres";
alter table "public"."org_sequences" enable row level security;

create or replace function "public"."next_org_seq"("p_org_id" uuid, "p_seq_name" text)
returns bigint
language plpgsql security definer set search_path to public
as $$
declare
  v_val bigint;
begin
  insert into public.org_sequences (org_id, seq_name, current_value)
  values (p_org_id, p_seq_name, 1)
  on conflict (org_id, seq_name)
  do update set current_value = public.org_sequences.current_value + 1
  returning current_value into v_val;
  return v_val;
end;
$$;
alter function "public"."next_org_seq"(uuid, text) owner to "postgres";

create or replace function "public"."next_dc_no"("p_org_id" uuid) returns text
    language sql set search_path to public as
$$ select 'DC-' || to_char(current_date,'YYYY') || '-' || lpad(public.next_org_seq(p_org_id,'dc')::text, 4, '0') $$;

create or replace function "public"."next_grn_no"("p_org_id" uuid) returns text
    language sql set search_path to public as
$$ select 'GRN-' || to_char(current_date,'YYYY') || '-' || lpad(public.next_org_seq(p_org_id,'grn')::text, 4, '0') $$;

create or replace function "public"."next_prd_no"("p_org_id" uuid) returns text
    language sql set search_path to public as
$$ select 'PRD-' || to_char(current_date,'YYYY') || '-' || lpad(public.next_org_seq(p_org_id,'prd')::text, 4, '0') $$;

create or replace function "public"."next_qt_no"("p_org_id" uuid) returns text
    language sql set search_path to public as
$$ select 'QT-' || to_char(current_date,'YYYY') || '-' || lpad(public.next_org_seq(p_org_id,'qt')::text, 4, '0') $$;

create or replace function "public"."next_so_no"("p_org_id" uuid) returns text
    language sql set search_path to public as
$$ select 'SO-' || to_char(current_date,'YYYY') || '-' || lpad(public.next_org_seq(p_org_id,'so')::text, 4, '0') $$;

grant execute on function "public"."next_dc_no"(uuid) to authenticated, service_role;
grant execute on function "public"."next_grn_no"(uuid) to authenticated, service_role;
grant execute on function "public"."next_prd_no"(uuid) to authenticated, service_role;
grant execute on function "public"."next_qt_no"(uuid) to authenticated, service_role;
grant execute on function "public"."next_so_no"(uuid) to authenticated, service_role;

drop function if exists public.next_dc_no();
drop function if exists public.next_grn_no();
drop function if exists public.next_prd_no();
drop function if exists public.next_qt_no();
drop function if exists public.next_so_no();

-- -------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 4. org_id on every top-level business table
--    Nullable first, backfilled into a default org, then NOT NULL — safe
--    whether the database is empty (local) or already has rows (cloud).
-- -------------------------------------------------------------------------

alter table "public"."clients"            add column "org_id" uuid references "public"."organizations"("id");
alter table "public"."suppliers"          add column "org_id" uuid references "public"."organizations"("id");
alter table "public"."items"              add column "org_id" uuid references "public"."organizations"("id");
alter table "public"."bom"                add column "org_id" uuid references "public"."organizations"("id");
alter table "public"."item_prices"        add column "org_id" uuid references "public"."organizations"("id");
alter table "public"."quotations"         add column "org_id" uuid references "public"."organizations"("id");
alter table "public"."sales_orders"       add column "org_id" uuid references "public"."organizations"("id");
alter table "public"."production_orders"  add column "org_id" uuid references "public"."organizations"("id");
alter table "public"."workers"            add column "org_id" uuid references "public"."organizations"("id");
alter table "public"."stock_movements"    add column "org_id" uuid references "public"."organizations"("id");
alter table "public"."stock_reservations" add column "org_id" uuid references "public"."organizations"("id");
alter table "public"."inventory_balance"  add column "org_id" uuid references "public"."organizations"("id");
alter table "public"."inventory_ops_log"  add column "org_id" uuid references "public"."organizations"("id");
alter table "public"."delivery_challans"  add column "org_id" uuid references "public"."organizations"("id");
alter table "public"."inbound_receipts"   add column "org_id" uuid references "public"."organizations"("id");
alter table "public"."approvals"          add column "org_id" uuid references "public"."organizations"("id");
alter table "public"."audit_logs"         add column "org_id" uuid references "public"."organizations"("id"); -- stays nullable

do $$
declare
  v_default_org_id uuid;
  v_needs_backfill boolean;
begin
  select exists (select 1 from public.items limit 1)
      or exists (select 1 from public.profiles where org_id is null limit 1)
      or exists (select 1 from public.inventory_balance limit 1)
      or exists (select 1 from public.clients limit 1)
      or exists (select 1 from public.suppliers limit 1)
      or exists (select 1 from public.quotations limit 1)
      or exists (select 1 from public.sales_orders limit 1)
      or exists (select 1 from public.production_orders limit 1)
      or exists (select 1 from public.workers limit 1)
    into v_needs_backfill;

  if v_needs_backfill then
    insert into public.organizations (name, slug)
    values ('Default Organization', 'default')
    returning id into v_default_org_id;

    update public.items              set org_id = v_default_org_id where org_id is null;
    update public.inventory_balance  set org_id = v_default_org_id where org_id is null;
    update public.clients            set org_id = v_default_org_id where org_id is null;
    update public.suppliers          set org_id = v_default_org_id where org_id is null;
    update public.bom                set org_id = v_default_org_id where org_id is null;
    update public.item_prices        set org_id = v_default_org_id where org_id is null;
    update public.quotations         set org_id = v_default_org_id where org_id is null;
    update public.sales_orders       set org_id = v_default_org_id where org_id is null;
    update public.production_orders  set org_id = v_default_org_id where org_id is null;
    update public.workers            set org_id = v_default_org_id where org_id is null;
    update public.stock_movements    set org_id = v_default_org_id where org_id is null;
    update public.stock_reservations set org_id = v_default_org_id where org_id is null;
    update public.inventory_ops_log  set org_id = v_default_org_id where org_id is null;
    update public.delivery_challans  set org_id = v_default_org_id where org_id is null;
    update public.inbound_receipts   set org_id = v_default_org_id where org_id is null;
    update public.approvals          set org_id = v_default_org_id where org_id is null;
    update public.audit_logs         set org_id = v_default_org_id where org_id is null;

    update public.profiles
    set org_id = v_default_org_id, role = 'admin'
    where org_id is null;
  end if;
end $$;

alter table "public"."clients"            alter column "org_id" set not null;
alter table "public"."suppliers"          alter column "org_id" set not null;
alter table "public"."items"              alter column "org_id" set not null;

-- 5. Update RLS policies: every "auth.uid() IS NOT NULL" read policy and
--    every role-based write policy must also scope to org_id = my_org().
-- -------------------------------------------------------------------------

drop policy if exists "auth reads approvals"  on "public"."approvals";
drop policy if exists "auth reads audit"      on "public"."audit_logs";

create policy "org reads clients"    on "public"."clients"    for select using (org_id = public.my_org());

create policy "org reads qt"         on "public"."quotations" for select using (org_id = public.my_org());
create policy "org reads so"         on "public"."sales_orders" for select using (org_id = public.my_org());
create policy "org reads prd"        on "public"."production_orders" for select using (org_id = public.my_org());
create policy "org reads workers"    on "public"."workers"    for select using (org_id = public.my_org());
create policy "org reads stock"      on "public"."stock_movements" for select using (org_id = public.my_org());
create policy "org reads reservations" on "public"."stock_reservations" for select using (org_id = public.my_org());
create policy "org reads balance"    on "public"."inventory_balance" for select using (org_id = public.my_org());
create policy "org reads dc"         on "public"."delivery_challans" for select using (org_id = public.my_org());
create policy "org reads grn"        on "public"."inbound_receipts" for select using (org_id = public.my_org());
create policy "org reads approvals"  on "public"."approvals" for select using (org_id = public.my_org());
create policy "org reads audit"      on "public"."audit_logs" for select using (org_id = public.my_org());

    using (org_id = public.my_org() and public.my_role() = any (array['admin','sales','manager']::public.user_role[]));

    using (org_id = public.my_org() and public.my_role() = any (array['admin','store']::public.user_role[]));

drop policy if exists "prod manages bom" on "public"."bom";
create policy "org prod manages bom" on "public"."bom"
    using (org_id = public.my_org() and public.my_role() = any (array['admin','production']::public.user_role[]));

    using (org_id = public.my_org() and public.my_role() = any (array['admin','store','manager']::public.user_role[]));

    using (org_id = public.my_org() and public.my_role() = any (array['admin','manager','sales']::public.user_role[]));

drop policy if exists "sales manages so" on "public"."sales_orders";

    using (org_id = public.my_org() and public.my_role() = any (array['admin','manager','sales']::public.user_role[]));

drop policy if exists "prod manages prd" on "public"."production_orders";
create policy "org prod manages prd" on "public"."production_orders"
    using (org_id = public.my_org() and public.my_role() = any (array['admin','manager','production']::public.user_role[]));

drop policy if exists "admin manages workers" on "public"."workers";

    using (org_id = public.my_org() and public.my_role() = any (array['admin','manager']::public.user_role[]));

drop policy if exists "store inserts stock" on "public"."stock_movements";
create policy "org store inserts stock" on "public"."stock_movements"
    for insert with check (org_id = public.my_org() and public.my_role() = any (array['admin','store','production']::public.user_role[]));

drop policy if exists "store manages dc" on "public"."delivery_challans";

    using (org_id = public.my_org() and public.my_role() = any (array['admin','manager','store']::public.user_role[]));

    using (org_id = public.my_org() and public.my_role() = any (array['admin','store']::public.user_role[]));

-- -------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 7. CRITICAL: the ledger/RPC functions run SECURITY DEFINER owned by
--    "postgres", which bypasses RLS entirely. They need explicit org checks.
-- -------------------------------------------------------------------------

create or replace function "public"."assert_item_in_my_org"("p_item_id" uuid) returns void
    language plpgsql security definer set search_path to public as
$$
begin
  if not exists (
    select 1 from public.items where id = p_item_id and org_id = public.my_org()
  ) then
    raise exception 'Item % not found in your organization', p_item_id using errcode = 'P0007';
  end if;
end;
$$;
alter function "public"."assert_item_in_my_org"(uuid) owner to "postgres";

create or replace function "public"."lock_inventory_balance"("p_item_id" "uuid") returns "public"."inventory_balance"
    language plpgsql security definer set search_path to 'public' as
$$
declare
  v_balance public.inventory_balance;
  v_org     uuid;
begin
  perform public.assert_item_in_my_org(p_item_id);

  select * into v_balance
  from public.inventory_balance
  where item_id = p_item_id
  for update nowait;

  if not found then
    select org_id into v_org from public.items where id = p_item_id;

    insert into public.inventory_balance (item_id, org_id, current_qty, reserved_qty)
    values (p_item_id, v_org, 0, 0)
    on conflict (item_id) do nothing
    returning * into v_balance;

    select * into v_balance
    from public.inventory_balance
    where item_id = p_item_id
    for update nowait;
  end if;

  return v_balance;
end;
$$;

create or replace function "public"."sync_inventory_balance"() returns trigger
    language plpgsql security definer set search_path to 'public' as
$$
declare
  v_delta numeric(14,4);
  v_org   uuid;
begin
  v_delta := case new.movement_type
    when 'inbound'            then  new.qty
    when 'produced'           then  new.qty
    when 'adjustment_in'      then  new.qty
    when 'returned_client'    then  new.qty
    when 'consumed'           then -new.qty
    when 'sold'               then -new.qty
    when 'adjustment_out'     then -new.qty
    when 'returned_supplier'  then -new.qty
    else 0
  end;

  select org_id into v_org from public.items where id = new.item_id;

  insert into public.inventory_balance (item_id, org_id, current_qty, reserved_qty, updated_at)
  values (new.item_id, v_org, greatest(0, v_delta), 0, now())
  on conflict (item_id) do update
    set current_qty = greatest(0, public.inventory_balance.current_qty + v_delta),
        updated_at  = now();

  return new;
end;
$$;

create or replace function "public"."adjust_inventory"("p_operation_id" "uuid","p_item_id" "uuid","p_delta" numeric,"p_reason" "text","p_ref_id" "uuid" default null)
returns jsonb language plpgsql security definer set search_path to 'public' as
$$
declare
  v_cached jsonb; v_balance public.inventory_balance; v_movement_id uuid;
  v_move_type movement_type; v_qty numeric; v_result jsonb; v_user uuid := auth.uid();
  v_org uuid;
begin
  select result_payload into v_cached from public.inventory_ops_log where operation_id = p_operation_id;
  if found then return v_cached; end if;

  if p_delta = 0 then raise exception 'Adjustment delta cannot be zero' using errcode = 'P0002'; end if;

  perform public.assert_item_in_my_org(p_item_id);
  if (select role from public.profiles where id = v_user) not in ('admin','store','manager') then
    raise exception 'Unauthorized: only admin/store/manager can adjust inventory' using errcode = 'P0005';
  end if;

  v_org := public.my_org();
  v_balance := public.lock_inventory_balance(p_item_id);

  if p_delta > 0 then
    v_move_type := 'adjustment_in'; v_qty := p_delta;
  else
    v_move_type := 'adjustment_out'; v_qty := abs(p_delta);
    perform public.validate_stock_sufficiency(p_item_id, v_qty, v_balance);
  end if;

  insert into public.stock_movements(item_id, org_id, movement_type, qty, ref_type, ref_id, notes, created_by)
  values (p_item_id, v_org, v_move_type, v_qty, 'manual_adjustment', p_ref_id, p_reason, v_user)
  returning id into v_movement_id;

  v_result := jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'operation_id', p_operation_id, 'movement_id', v_movement_id,
      'item_id', p_item_id, 'delta', p_delta, 'movement_type', v_move_type);

  insert into public.inventory_ops_log(operation_id, org_id, operation_type, item_id, qty, ref_type, result_movement_id, result_payload, created_by)
  values (p_operation_id, v_org, 'adjust', p_item_id, p_delta, 'manual_adjustment', v_movement_id, v_result, v_user);

  return v_result;
end;
$$;

create or replace function "public"."consume_inventory"("p_operation_id" "uuid","p_item_id" "uuid","p_qty" numeric,"p_reservation_id" "uuid" default null,"p_ref_type" "text" default 'production_order',"p_ref_id" "uuid" default null,"p_notes" "text" default null)
returns jsonb language plpgsql security definer set search_path to 'public' as
$$
declare
  v_cached jsonb; v_balance public.inventory_balance; v_res public.stock_reservations;
  v_movement_id uuid; v_result jsonb; v_user uuid := auth.uid(); v_org uuid;
begin
  select result_payload into v_cached from public.inventory_ops_log where operation_id = p_operation_id;
  if found then return v_cached; end if;
  if p_qty <= 0 then raise exception 'qty must be positive for consume_inventory' using errcode = 'P0002'; end if;

  perform public.assert_item_in_my_org(p_item_id);
  v_org := public.my_org();
  v_balance := public.lock_inventory_balance(p_item_id);

  if p_reservation_id is not null then
    select * into v_res from public.stock_reservations
    where id = p_reservation_id and item_id = p_item_id and org_id = v_org and status in ('active','partially_consumed')
    for update nowait;

    if not found then
      raise exception 'Reservation % not found or already consumed', p_reservation_id using errcode = 'P0003';
    end if;

    declare v_remaining numeric;
    begin
      v_remaining := v_res.qty_reserved - v_res.qty_consumed - v_res.qty_released;
      if p_qty > v_remaining then
        raise exception 'Consume qty (%) exceeds remaining reservation (%)', p_qty, v_remaining using errcode = 'P0004';
      end if;
    end;

    update public.stock_reservations
    set qty_consumed = qty_consumed + p_qty,
        status = case when (qty_consumed + qty_released + p_qty) = qty_reserved then 'consumed'::reservation_status else 'partially_consumed'::reservation_status end,
        updated_at = now()
    where id = p_reservation_id;

    update public.inventory_balance set reserved_qty = greatest(0, reserved_qty - p_qty), updated_at = now() where item_id = p_item_id;
  else
    perform public.validate_stock_sufficiency(p_item_id, p_qty, v_balance);
  end if;

  insert into public.stock_movements(item_id, org_id, movement_type, qty, ref_type, ref_id, notes, created_by)
  values (p_item_id, v_org, 'consumed', p_qty, p_ref_type, p_ref_id, p_notes, v_user)
  returning id into v_movement_id;

  v_result := jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'operation_id', p_operation_id, 'movement_id', v_movement_id,
      'item_id', p_item_id, 'qty_consumed', p_qty, 'reservation_id', p_reservation_id);

  insert into public.inventory_ops_log(operation_id, org_id, operation_type, item_id, qty, ref_type, ref_id, result_movement_id, result_payload, created_by)
  values (p_operation_id, v_org, 'consume', p_item_id, p_qty, p_ref_type, p_ref_id, v_movement_id, v_result, v_user);

  return v_result;
end;
$$;

create or replace function "public"."dispatch_inventory"("p_operation_id" "uuid","p_item_id" "uuid","p_qty" numeric,"p_rate" numeric,"p_reservation_id" "uuid" default null,"p_ref_type" "text" default 'delivery_challan',"p_ref_id" "uuid" default null,"p_notes" "text" default null)
returns jsonb language plpgsql security definer set search_path to 'public' as
$$
declare
  v_cached jsonb; v_balance public.inventory_balance; v_res public.stock_reservations;
  v_movement_id uuid; v_result jsonb; v_user uuid := auth.uid(); v_org uuid;
begin
  select result_payload into v_cached from public.inventory_ops_log where operation_id = p_operation_id;
  if found then return v_cached; end if;
  if p_qty <= 0 then raise exception 'qty must be positive for dispatch_inventory' using errcode = 'P0002'; end if;

  perform public.assert_item_in_my_org(p_item_id);
  v_org := public.my_org();
  v_balance := public.lock_inventory_balance(p_item_id);

  if p_reservation_id is not null then
    select * into v_res from public.stock_reservations
    where id = p_reservation_id and item_id = p_item_id and org_id = v_org and status in ('active','partially_consumed')
    for update nowait;

    if not found then
      raise exception 'Reservation % not active for dispatch', p_reservation_id using errcode = 'P0003';
    end if;

    declare v_remaining numeric;
    begin
      v_remaining := v_res.qty_reserved - v_res.qty_consumed - v_res.qty_released;
      if p_qty > v_remaining then
        raise exception 'Dispatch qty (%) exceeds reservation remaining (%)', p_qty, v_remaining using errcode = 'P0004';
      end if;
    end;

    update public.stock_reservations
    set qty_consumed = qty_consumed + p_qty,
        status = case when (qty_consumed + qty_released + p_qty) = qty_reserved then 'consumed'::reservation_status else 'partially_consumed'::reservation_status end,
        updated_at = now()
    where id = p_reservation_id;

    update public.inventory_balance set reserved_qty = greatest(0, reserved_qty - p_qty), updated_at = now() where item_id = p_item_id;
  else
    perform public.validate_stock_sufficiency(p_item_id, p_qty, v_balance);
  end if;

  insert into public.stock_movements(item_id, org_id, movement_type, qty, rate_at_time, ref_type, ref_id, notes, created_by)
  values (p_item_id, v_org, 'sold', p_qty, p_rate, p_ref_type, p_ref_id, p_notes, v_user)
  returning id into v_movement_id;

  v_result := jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'operation_id', p_operation_id, 'movement_id', v_movement_id,
      'item_id', p_item_id, 'qty_dispatched', p_qty, 'reservation_id', p_reservation_id);

  insert into public.inventory_ops_log(operation_id, org_id, operation_type, item_id, qty, ref_type, ref_id, result_movement_id, result_payload, created_by)
  values (p_operation_id, v_org, 'dispatch', p_item_id, p_qty, p_ref_type, p_ref_id, v_movement_id, v_result, v_user);

  return v_result;
end;
$$;

create or replace function "public"."produce_inventory"("p_operation_id" "uuid","p_item_id" "uuid","p_qty" numeric,"p_ref_type" "text" default 'production_order',"p_ref_id" "uuid" default null,"p_notes" "text" default null)
returns jsonb language plpgsql security definer set search_path to 'public' as
$$
declare
  v_cached jsonb; v_movement_id uuid; v_result jsonb; v_user uuid := auth.uid(); v_org uuid;
begin
  select result_payload into v_cached from public.inventory_ops_log where operation_id = p_operation_id;
  if found then return v_cached; end if;
  if p_qty <= 0 then raise exception 'qty must be positive for produce_inventory' using errcode = 'P0002'; end if;

  perform public.assert_item_in_my_org(p_item_id);
  v_org := public.my_org();
  perform public.lock_inventory_balance(p_item_id);

  insert into public.stock_movements(item_id, org_id, movement_type, qty, ref_type, ref_id, notes, created_by)
  values (p_item_id, v_org, 'produced', p_qty, p_ref_type, p_ref_id, p_notes, v_user)
  returning id into v_movement_id;

  v_result := jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'operation_id', p_operation_id, 'movement_id', v_movement_id,
      'item_id', p_item_id, 'qty_produced', p_qty);

  insert into public.inventory_ops_log(operation_id, org_id, operation_type, item_id, qty, ref_type, ref_id, result_movement_id, result_payload, created_by)
  values (p_operation_id, v_org, 'produce', p_item_id, p_qty, p_ref_type, p_ref_id, v_movement_id, v_result, v_user);

  return v_result;
end;
$$;

create or replace function "public"."receive_inventory"("p_operation_id" "uuid","p_item_id" "uuid","p_qty" numeric,"p_rate" numeric,"p_ref_type" "text","p_ref_id" "uuid","p_batch_no" "text" default null,"p_notes" "text" default null)
returns jsonb language plpgsql security definer set search_path to 'public' as
$$
declare
  v_cached jsonb; v_movement_id uuid; v_result jsonb; v_user uuid := auth.uid(); v_org uuid;
begin
  select result_payload into v_cached from public.inventory_ops_log where operation_id = p_operation_id;
  if found then return v_cached; end if;
  if p_qty <= 0 then raise exception 'qty must be positive for receive_inventory' using errcode = 'P0002'; end if;

  perform public.assert_item_in_my_org(p_item_id);
  v_org := public.my_org();
  perform public.lock_inventory_balance(p_item_id);

  insert into public.stock_movements(item_id, org_id, movement_type, qty, rate_at_time, ref_type, ref_id, batch_no, notes, created_by)
  values (p_item_id, v_org, 'inbound', p_qty, p_rate, p_ref_type, p_ref_id, p_batch_no, p_notes, v_user)
  returning id into v_movement_id;

  v_result := jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'operation_id', p_operation_id, 'movement_id', v_movement_id,
      'item_id', p_item_id, 'qty_received', p_qty);

  insert into public.inventory_ops_log(operation_id, org_id, operation_type, item_id, qty, ref_type, ref_id, result_movement_id, result_payload, created_by)
  values (p_operation_id, v_org, 'receive', p_item_id, p_qty, p_ref_type, p_ref_id, v_movement_id, v_result, v_user);

  return v_result;
end;
$$;

create or replace function "public"."reserve_inventory"("p_operation_id" "uuid","p_item_id" "uuid","p_qty" numeric,"p_ref_type" "text","p_ref_id" "uuid","p_expiry_hours" integer default 72,"p_notes" "text" default null)
returns jsonb language plpgsql security definer set search_path to 'public' as
$$
declare
  v_cached jsonb; v_balance public.inventory_balance; v_reservation_id uuid; v_result jsonb;
  v_user uuid := auth.uid(); v_org uuid;
begin
  select result_payload into v_cached from public.inventory_ops_log where operation_id = p_operation_id;
  if found then return v_cached; end if;
  if p_qty <= 0 then raise exception 'qty must be positive for reserve_inventory' using errcode = 'P0002'; end if;

  perform public.assert_item_in_my_org(p_item_id);
  v_org := public.my_org();
  v_balance := public.lock_inventory_balance(p_item_id);
  perform public.validate_stock_sufficiency(p_item_id, p_qty, v_balance);

  insert into public.stock_reservations(item_id, org_id, qty_reserved, ref_type, ref_id, reservation_expiry, notes, created_by)
  values (p_item_id, v_org, p_qty, p_ref_type, p_ref_id, now() + (p_expiry_hours || ' hours')::interval, p_notes, v_user)
  returning id into v_reservation_id;

  update public.inventory_balance set reserved_qty = reserved_qty + p_qty, updated_at = now() where item_id = p_item_id;

  v_result := jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'operation_id', p_operation_id, 'reservation_id', v_reservation_id,
      'item_id', p_item_id, 'qty_reserved', p_qty, 'expires_at', now() + (p_expiry_hours || ' hours')::interval);

  insert into public.inventory_ops_log(operation_id, org_id, operation_type, item_id, qty, ref_type, ref_id, result_payload, created_by)
  values (p_operation_id, v_org, 'reserve', p_item_id, p_qty, p_ref_type, p_ref_id, v_result, v_user);

  return v_result;
end;
$$;

create or replace function "public"."release_inventory"("p_operation_id" "uuid","p_reservation_id" "uuid","p_qty_to_release" numeric default null,"p_notes" "text" default null)
returns jsonb language plpgsql security definer set search_path to 'public' as
$$
declare
  v_cached jsonb; v_res public.stock_reservations; v_qty_release numeric; v_remaining numeric;
  v_result jsonb; v_user uuid := auth.uid();
begin
  select result_payload into v_cached from public.inventory_ops_log where operation_id = p_operation_id;
  if found then return v_cached; end if;

  select * into v_res from public.stock_reservations
  where id = p_reservation_id and org_id = public.my_org() and status in ('active','partially_consumed')
  for update nowait;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'Reservation % not found or not in releasable status', p_reservation_id using errcode = 'P0003';
  end if;

  perform public.lock_inventory_balance(v_res.item_id);

  v_remaining := v_res.qty_reserved - v_res.qty_consumed - v_res.qty_released;
  v_qty_release := coalesce(p_qty_to_release, v_remaining);

  if v_qty_release > v_remaining then
    raise exception 'Release qty (%) exceeds remaining reservation (%)', v_qty_release, v_remaining using errcode = 'P0004';
  end if;

  update public.stock_reservations
  set qty_released = qty_released + v_qty_release,
      status = case when (qty_consumed + qty_released + v_qty_release) = qty_reserved then 'released'::reservation_status else 'partially_consumed'::reservation_status end,
      updated_at = now()
  where id = p_reservation_id;

  update public.inventory_balance set reserved_qty = greatest(0, reserved_qty - v_qty_release), updated_at = now() where item_id = v_res.item_id;

  v_result := jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'operation_id', p_operation_id, 'reservation_id', p_reservation_id,
      'qty_released', v_qty_release, 'item_id', v_res.item_id);

  insert into public.inventory_ops_log(operation_id, org_id, operation_type, item_id, qty, ref_type, ref_id, result_payload, created_by)
  values (p_operation_id, v_res.org_id, 'release', v_res.item_id, v_qty_release, v_res.ref_type, v_res.ref_id, v_result, v_user);

  return v_result;
end;
$$;

create or replace function "public"."reconcile_inventory_balance"() returns table("item_id" uuid, "old_qty" numeric, "new_qty" numeric, "diff" numeric)
language plpgsql security definer set search_path to 'public' as
$$
begin
  if (select role from public.profiles where id = auth.uid()) != 'admin' then
    raise exception 'Only admin can run reconciliation' using errcode = 'P0005';
  end if;

  return query
  with ledger_totals as (
    select m.item_id,
      sum(case when m.movement_type in ('inbound','produced','adjustment_in','returned_client') then m.qty else -m.qty end) as true_qty
    from public.stock_movements m
    where m.org_id = public.my_org()
    group by m.item_id
  ),
  updates as (
    update public.inventory_balance ib
    set current_qty = greatest(0, coalesce(lt.true_qty, 0)), updated_at = now()
    from ledger_totals lt
    where ib.item_id = lt.item_id and ib.org_id = public.my_org()
    returning ib.item_id, ib.current_qty as old_qty, greatest(0, coalesce(lt.true_qty, 0)) as new_qty
  )
  select u.item_id, u.old_qty, u.new_qty, u.new_qty - u.old_qty as diff
  from updates u
  where abs(u.new_qty - u.old_qty) > 0.0001;
end;
$$;

commit;
```

begin;

        references public.organizations(id)
        on delete cascade,

    code text not null,
    name text not null,
    description text,

    is_active boolean not null default true,

    created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
    updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),

    constraint item_categories_org_code_key
        unique (org_id, code),

        unique (org_id, name),

    constraint item_categories_org_id_id_key
        unique (org_id, id)
);

    on public.item_categories (org_id);

    before update on public.item_categories
    for each row
    execute function public.set_updated_at();

-- ============================================================
-- RLS
-- ============================================================

alter table public.item_categories enable row level security;

create policy "members read own item categories"
    on public.item_categories
    for select

create policy "managers insert own item categories"
    on public.item_categories
    for insert
    with check (
        org_id = public.my_org()
        and public.my_role() in ('admin', 'manager')
    );

create policy "managers update own item categories"

        and public.my_role() in ('admin', 'manager')
    )

        org_id = public.my_org()
        and public.my_role() in ('admin', 'manager')
    );

create policy "managers delete own item categories"
    on public.item_categories

    using (

    );

commit;

# supabase/migrations/20261006055000_update_stock_level_category.sql

```sql
begin;

drop view if exists public.v_reorder_alerts;

drop view if exists public.v_stock_levels;

create view public.v_stock_levels
with (security_invoker = true)
as
select
    i.id as item_id,
    i.item_code,
    i.name,
    i.category_id,
    ic.name as category,
    i.unit,
    i.reorder_level,
    coalesce(ib.current_qty, 0) as qty_on_hand,
    coalesce(ib.reserved_qty, 0) as qty_reserved,
    coalesce(ib.available_qty, 0) as qty_available,
    case
        when coalesce(ib.available_qty, 0) <= i.reorder_level
        then true
        else false
    end as below_reorder,
    ib.updated_at as balance_updated_at
from public.items i
left join public.item_categories ic
    on ic.id = i.category_id
   and ic.org_id = i.org_id
left join public.inventory_balance ib
    on ib.item_id = i.id
   and ib.org_id = i.org_id
where i.is_active = true;

alter view public.v_stock_levels owner to postgres;

create view public.v_reorder_alerts
with (security_invoker = true)
as
select
    item_id,
    item_code,
    name,
    category_id,
    category,
    unit,
    reorder_level,
    qty_on_hand,
    qty_reserved,
    qty_available,
    below_reorder,
    balance_updated_at
from public.v_stock_levels
where below_reorder = true
order by qty_on_hand;

alter view public.v_reorder_alerts owner to postgres;

commit;
```

# supabase/migrations/20261006071000_create_organization_template.sql

```sql
begin;

drop function if exists public.create_organization(text);

create or replace function public.create_organization(
    p_name text,
    p_template text default null,
    p_categories jsonb default '[]'::jsonb,
    p_material_types jsonb default '[]'::jsonb
)
returns uuid
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $function$
declare
    v_org_id uuid;
    v_existing uuid;
begin
    select org_id
    into v_existing
    from public.profiles
    where id = auth.uid();

    if v_existing is not null then
        raise exception 'User already belongs to an organization'
            using errcode = 'P0006';
    end if;

    insert into public.organizations (name)
    values (p_name)
    returning id into v_org_id;

    update public.profiles
    set org_id = v_org_id,
        role = 'admin'
    where id = auth.uid();

    if p_template is not null then

        insert into public.item_categories (
            org_id,
            code,
            name,
            description
        )
        select
            v_org_id,
            category->>'code',
            category->>'name',
            category->>'description'
        from jsonb_array_elements(p_categories) as category;

        insert into public.material_types (
            org_id,
            code,
            name,
            description
        )
        select
            v_org_id,
            material_type->>'code',
            material_type->>'name',
            material_type->>'description'
        from jsonb_array_elements(p_material_types) as material_type;

    end if;

    return v_org_id;
end;
$function$;

revoke all on function public.create_organization(
    text,
    text,
    jsonb,
    jsonb
) from public;

grant execute on function public.create_organization(
    text,
    text,
    jsonb,
    jsonb
) to authenticated;

commit;
```

# supabase/migrations/20261006085000_update_stock_views_dynamic_unit.sql

```sql
begin;

drop view if exists public.v_reorder_alerts;
drop view if exists public.v_stock_levels;

create view public.v_stock_levels
with (security_invoker = true)
as
select
    i.id as item_id,
    i.item_code,
    i.name,
    i.category_id,
    ic.name as category,
    i.unit_id,
    u.name as unit,
    i.reorder_level,
    coalesce(ib.current_qty, 0) as qty_on_hand,
    coalesce(ib.reserved_qty, 0) as qty_reserved,
    coalesce(ib.available_qty, 0) as qty_available,
    case
        when coalesce(ib.available_qty, 0) <= i.reorder_level
        then true
        else false
    end as below_reorder,
    ib.updated_at as balance_updated_at
from public.items i
left join public.item_categories ic
    on ic.id = i.category_id
   and ic.org_id = i.org_id
left join public.units u
    on u.id = i.unit_id
   and u.org_id = i.org_id
left join public.inventory_balance ib
    on ib.item_id = i.id
   and ib.org_id = i.org_id
where i.is_active = true;

alter view public.v_stock_levels owner to postgres;

create view public.v_reorder_alerts
with (security_invoker = true)
as
select
    item_id,
    item_code,
    name,
    category_id,
    category,
    unit_id,
    unit,
    reorder_level,
    qty_on_hand,
    qty_reserved,
    qty_available,
    below_reorder,
    balance_updated_at
from public.v_stock_levels
where below_reorder = true
order by qty_on_hand;

alter view public.v_reorder_alerts owner to postgres;

commit;
```

# supabase/migrations/20261006088000_update_current_prices_dynamic_unit.sql

```sql
begin;

drop view if exists public.v_current_prices;

create view public.v_current_prices
with (security_invoker = true)
as
select distinct on (p.item_id)
    p.item_id,
    i.item_code,
    i.name,
    p.purchase_rate,
    p.selling_rate,
    p.gst_percent::text as gst_percent,
    u.name as rate_unit,
    p.effective_from,
    p.notes as price_notes
from public.item_prices p
join public.items i
    on i.id = p.item_id
left join public.units u
    on u.id = p.unit_id
order by p.item_id, p.effective_from desc;

alter view public.v_current_prices owner to postgres;

commit;
```

    "created_by", "created_at", "updated_at"
)

   AND c."name" = v."category_name"
JOIN public.material_types mt
    ON mt.org_id = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'
   AND lower(mt.name) = lower(v."material_type")

JOIN public.units u
    ON u.org_id = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'
   AND (
        (v."unit" = 'No.'  AND u.code = 'NO')
     OR (v."unit" = 'Mtr'  AND u.code = 'MTR')
     OR (v."unit" = 'Kg'   AND u.code = 'KG')
     OR (v."unit" = 'Set'  AND u.code = 'SET')
     OR (v."unit" = 'Pair' AND u.code = 'PAIR')
   );





-- Manufacturing BOM test items
INSERT INTO public.items (
    id,
    item_code,
    name,
    category_id,
    material_type_id,
    sub_category,
    size_spec,
    unit_id,
    hsn_code,
    is_traded,
    is_manufactured,
    is_raw_material,
    reorder_level,
    reorder_qty,
    notes,
    org_id
)
SELECT
    v.id::uuid,
    v.item_code,
    v.name,
    c.id,
    mt.id,
    v.sub_category,
    v.size_spec,
    u.id,
    v.hsn_code,
    v.is_traded,
    v.is_manufactured,
    v.is_raw_material,
    v.reorder_level,
    v.reorder_qty,
    v.notes,
    '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::uuid
FROM (
    VALUES
        (
            '10000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001',
            'MFG-001',
            'GOD Contact Assembly',
            'Assembly',
            null,
            'NO',
            null,
            true,
            true,
            false,
            0,
            0,
            'Manufacturing BOM test assembly'
        ),
        (
            '10000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002',
            'MFG-002',
            'GOD Contact Sub Assembly',
            'Sub Assembly',
            null,
            'SET',
            null,
            true,
            true,
            true,
            0,
            0,
            'Manufacturing BOM test sub-assembly'
        ),
        (
            '10000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003',
            'MFG-003',
            'Copper Contact Raw',
            'Raw Material',
            null,
            'NO',
            null,
            true,
            false,
            true,
            0,
            0,
            'Manufacturing BOM test raw material'
        ),
        (
            '10000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000004',
            'MFG-004',
            'GOD Spring Raw',
            'Raw Material',
            null,
            'NO',
            null,
            true,
            false,
            true,
            0,
            0,
            'Manufacturing BOM test raw material'
        ),
        (
            '10000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000005',
            'MFG-005',
            'GOD Rivet Raw',
            'Raw Material',
            null,
            'NO',
            null,
            true,
            false,
            true,
            0,
            0,
            'Manufacturing BOM test raw material'
        )
) AS v(
    id,
    item_code,
    name,
    sub_category,
    size_spec,
    unit_code,
    hsn_code,
    is_traded,
    is_manufactured,
    is_raw_material,
    reorder_level,
    reorder_qty,
    notes
)
JOIN public.item_categories c
    ON c.org_id = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'
   AND c.code = 'GOD'
JOIN public.material_types mt
    ON mt.org_id = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'
   AND mt.code = CASE
       WHEN v.item_code = 'MFG-003' THEN 'COPPER'
       ELSE 'GI'
   END
JOIN public.units u
    ON u.org_id = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'
   AND u.code = v.unit_code
ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING;

# supabase/snippets/adding roles (Testing).sql

```sql
-- =========================================================================
-- Blue Box ERP — Manual org access switch
-- Simple, no Razorpay/plans dependency. Toggle organizations.access_status
-- directly in the Supabase Table Editor, or via the SQL commands below.
-- =========================================================================

begin;

alter table "public"."organizations"
    add column "access_status" text not null default 'active'
        check ("access_status" in ('active', 'suspended')),
    add column "suspended_reason" text,
    add column "suspended_at" timestamp with time zone;

-- Fast org-scoped check, used in the dashboard layout gate below.
create or replace function "public"."org_is_active"() returns boolean
    language sql stable security definer set search_path to public as
$$
  select access_status = 'active'
  from public.organizations
  where id = public.my_org()
$$;
alter function "public"."org_is_active"() owner to "postgres";
grant execute on function "public"."org_is_active"() to authenticated;

commit;

-- =========================================================================
-- Usage — run these directly in the Supabase SQL Editor whenever you need to
-- cut off or restore an org's access. No app redeploy needed.
-- =========================================================================

-- Suspend an org (replace the id and reason):
-- update public.organizations
-- set access_status = 'suspended', suspended_reason = 'Payment overdue', suspended_at = now()
-- where id = '<org-id>';

-- Restore an org:
-- update public.organizations
-- set access_status = 'active', suspended_reason = null, suspended_at = null
-- where id = '<org-id>';

-- Or just toggle it visually: Supabase Dashboard → Table Editor → organizations
-- → find the row → click the access_status cell → pick 'active' or 'suspended'.
```

# supabase/snippets/Untitled query 133.sql

```sql


select movement_type, qty, created_at
from stock_movements
where item_id = '00813bc9-ebdf-4123-abdd-13ddc863a07b'
order by created_at;


-- Removes auto dispatch trigger
drop trigger if exists trg_dispatch_from_stock
on public.delivery_challan_lines;

drop function if exists public.dispatch_from_stock();

-- Removes auto GRN trigger
drop trigger if exists trg_grn_to_stock
on public.inbound_receipt_lines;

drop function if exists public.grn_to_stock();

-- Recalculate balances
select * from reconcile_inventory_balance();



select
  item_id,
  sum(
    case
      when movement_type in (
        'inbound',
        'produced',
        'returned_client'
      )
      then qty

      else -qty
    end
  ) as ledger_qty

from stock_movements
group by item_id;


select unnest(enum_range(null::movement_type));
```

# supabase/snippets/Untitled query 692.sql

```sql
-- What does the raw ledger say?
select
  movement_type,
  qty,
  created_at,
  case
    when movement_type in ('inbound','produced','adjustment_in','returned_client')
    then qty
    else -qty
  end as delta
from stock_movements
where item_id = 'dcb40665-6af5-4ce4-803b-eb306cf0e108'
order by created_at;

select * from reconcile_inventory_balance();
```
